        "contents": "export const workflowAPI = {\n  // AI问答 - 支持自定义Dify配置\n  aiSearch: async (query: string, inputs: any = {}, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('aiSearch');\n\n    try {\n      const response = await apiClient.post&lt;{ message?: string }&gt;(\"/workflow/ai-search\", {\n        query,\n        inputs,\n        conversationId,\n      }, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"AI search API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 智能搜索\n  smartSearch: async (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('smartSearch');\n\n    try {\n      const requestData: any = { query };\n      if (conversationId) {\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\"/workflow/smart-search\", requestData, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"Smart search API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 技术包装\n  techPackage:\n,\n};",

        "contents": "async deleteAIRole(id: string): Promise&lt;AIRoleResponse&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 与AI角色对话\n   */\n  async chatWithRole(\n    roleId: string,\n    query?: string,\n    inputs: any = {},\n    conversationId?: string,\n    files?: File[]\n  ): Promise&lt;ChatResponse&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 如果有文件，使用 FormData 上传\n      if (files &amp;&amp; files.length &gt; 0) {\n        const formData = new FormData();\n        formData.append('query', query || '');\n        formData.append('inputs', JSON.stringify(inputs));\n        if (conversationId) {\n          formData.append('conversationId', conversationId);\n        }\n        \n        // 添加所有文件\n        files.forEach((file) =&gt; {\n          formData.append('files', file);\n        });\n\n        const response = await api.post(&#96;/ai-roles/${roleId}/chat&#96;, formData, {\n          timeout: 420_000, // AI对话请求使用7分钟超时（独立Agent可能需要多轮工具调用，留出缓冲）\n          headers: {\n            'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data',\n          },\n        });\n        return response.data;\n      } else {\n        // 没有文件，使用 JSON\n        const response = await api.post(&#96;/ai-roles/${roleId}/chat&#96;, {\n          query,\n          inputs,\n          conversationId,\n        }, {\n          timeout: 420_000, // AI对话请求使用7分钟超时（独立Agent可能需要多轮工具调用，留出缓冲）\n        });\n        return response.data;\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('AI角色对话失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'AI角色对话失败',\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 测试AI角色连接\n   */\n  async testConnection(roleId: string): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try\n  }",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\nasync execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      const effectiveOutputMappings = featureConfig.outputMappings?.length\n        ? featureConfig.outputMappings\n        : targetMappingConfig?.outputMappings || [];\n\n      const baseContent = await this.resolveBaseContent(conversation, dto);\n      const conversationQuery = baseContent || &#96;触发子Agent：${dto.featureType}&#96;;\n\n      const conversationData = this.buildConversationData(\n        conversation,\n        conversationQuery,\n        targetSources,\n        dto\n      );\n\n      const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, effectiveInputMappings);\n\n      // 判断 targetWorkflowId 是 AI 角色 ID 还是工作流 ID\n      // AI 角色 ID 可能以 'role_' 或 'ai-role-' 开头，工作流 ID 以 'wf_' 开头\n      const isRoleId = targetWorkflowId.startsWith('role_') || targetWorkflowId.startsWith('ai-role-');\n      \n      let workflowResult;\n      if (isRoleId) {\n        // 直接调用 AI 角色\n        logger.info('检测到 AI 角色 ID，直接调用角色', { roleId: targetWorkflowId, featureType: dto.featureType });\n        workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeRole(targetWorkflowId, workflowInput);\n      } else {\n        // 通过工作流调用\n        logger.info('检测到工作流 ID，通过工作流调用', { workflowId: targetWorkflowId, featureType: dto.featureType });\n        workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(\n          targetWorkflowId,\n          { input: workflowInput }\n        );\n      }\n\n      const extractedOutput = extractWorkflowOutput(workflowResult, effectiveOutputMappings);\n\n      const aiContent = extractedOutput.content\n        || workflowResult.message\n        || &#96;子Agent ${dto.featureType} 已执行&#96;;\n\n      const messageOutputs = {\n        ...extractedOutput,\n,\n      };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行Agent节点\n   */\n  private async executeAgentNode(\n    node: any,\n    sharedContext: Record&lt;string, any&gt;\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    const agentId = node.agentId || node.data?.agentId;\n    if (!agentId) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;Agent节点 ${node.id} 未配置agentId&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 获取AI角色配置\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(agentId);\n    if (!role) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${agentId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    if (!role.enabled) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色已禁用: ${agentId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 准备输入数据\n    const nodeInput = this.prepareNodeInput(node, sharedContext);\n    \n    // 尝试从多个可能的字段中提取query\n    // 优先级：query &gt; input &gt; workflowInput.query &gt; 整个nodeInput的字符串化\n    let query = nodeInput.query;\n    if (!query) {\n      query = nodeInput.input;\n    }\n    if (!query &amp;&amp; nodeInput.workflowInput?.query) {\n      query = nodeInput.workflowInput.query;\n    }\n    if (!query &amp;&amp; typeof nodeInput === 'object') {\n      // 如果还是没有，尝试从其他常见字段中提取\n      query = nodeInput.question || nodeInput.text || nodeInput.content;\n    }\n    if (!query) {\n      // 最后回退：如果nodeInput是字符串，直接使用；否则字符串化\n      query = typeof nodeInput === 'string' ? nodeInput : JSON.stringify(nodeInput);\n    }\n    \n    const inputs = { ...nodeInput };\n    delete inputs.query;\n    delete inputs.input;\n\n    // 检查 provider 类型，Workflow 目前只支持 Dify\n    const provider = role.provider || 'dify';\n    if (provider === 'direct-agent') {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 是 Direct Agent 类型，不支持在 Workflow 中使用。请使用 Dify 类型的角色。&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 根据连接类型调用Dify API\n    if (!role.difyConfig) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 的Dify配置不存在&#96;);\n    }\n\n    const { connectionType, apiKey, apiUrl } = role.difyConfig;\n    // 尝试从多个可能的位置获取 conversationId\n    // 优先级：nodeInput.conversationId &gt; nodeInput.workflowInput.conversationId &gt; sharedContext.workflowInput.conversationId\n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行 Agent（核心方法）\n   * @param roleId 角色ID\n   * @param query 用户查询\n   * @param conversationId 对话ID（可选，如果不存在会生成新的）\n   * @param context 上下文数据（用于变量替换）\n   * @returns 执行结果\n   */\n  async executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\n    const startTime = Date.now();\n    const MAX_EXECUTION_TIME = 360000; // 6分钟总体超时（留出缓冲给前端7分钟超时）\n    \n    // 检查超时的辅助函数\n    const checkTimeout = () =&gt; {\n      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;\n      if (elapsed &gt; MAX_EXECUTION_TIME) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent执行超时：已执行 ${Math.round(elapsed / 1000)} 秒，超过最大执行时间 ${MAX_EXECUTION_TIME / 1000} 秒&#96;);\n      }\n    };\n    \n    // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\n    checkTimeout();\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\n    if (!role) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    if (!role.agentConfig) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;Agent配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\n\n    // 2. 生成或使用 conversationId\n    const finalConversationId = conversationId || this.generateConversationId();\n\n    // 3. 渲染 System Prompt\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\n      context\n    );\n\n    // 4. 获取上下文消息\n    checkTimeout();\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\n      finalConversationId,\n      config.contextStrategy,\n      query\n    );\n\n    // 5. 构建完整消息列表\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [];\n    \n    // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\n    if (config.contextStrategy.includeSystemPrompt || contextMessages.length === 0) {\n      messages.push({\n        role: 'system',\n        content: systemPrompt\n      });\n    }\n\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\nasync executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\n;\n    }\n\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\n    messages.push({\n      role: 'user',\n      content: query\n    });\n\n    // 6. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\n    const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\n\n    // 7. 获取 LLM Provider\n    const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\n\n    // 8. 调用 LLM（可能包含多轮工具调用）\n    checkTimeout();\n    let response = await this.executeWithTools(provider, messages, config.llm, tools, config.tools || [], checkTimeout);\n\n    // 9. 保存消息历史\n    await this.saveMessages(finalConversationId, query, response, roleId);\n\n    // 10. 返回结果\n    return {\n      content: response.content,\n      conversationId: finalConversationId,\n      usage: response.usage,\n      metadata: {\n        model: response.model,\n        finishReason: response.finishReason,\n        toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0\n      }\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行带工具调用的 LLM 请求（可能多轮）\n   */\n  private async executeWithTools(\n    provider: ILLMProvider,\n    messages: ChatMessage[],\n    llmConfig: LLMConfig,\n    tools: Tool[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void\n  ): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行带工具调用的 LLM 请求（可能多轮）\n   */\n  private async executeWithTools(\n    provider: ILLMProvider,\n    messages: ChatMessage[],\n    llmConfig: LLMConfig,\n    tools: Tool[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void\n  ): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\n    let iteration = 0;\n    let currentMessages = [...messages];\n    let lastResponse: LLMResponse;\n\n    while (iteration &lt; this.maxToolCallIterations) {\n      // 检查超时\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n      \n      // 调用 LLM\n      const response = await provider.chat(currentMessages, llmConfig, tools.length &gt; 0 ? tools : undefined);\n      lastResponse = response;\n\n      // LLM 调用后检查超时\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n\n      // 如果没有工具调用，直接返回\n      if (!response.toolCalls || response.toolCalls.length === 0) {\n        return response;\n      }\n\n      // 将 assistant 的回复添加到消息历史\n      currentMessages.push({\n        role: 'assistant',\n        content: response.content || ''\n      });\n\n      // 执行工具调用（检查超时）\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n      const toolResults = await this.executeTools(response.toolCalls, toolConfigs, checkTimeout);\n\n      // 工具执行后检查超时\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n\n      // 将工具调用结果添加到消息历史\n      for (const result of toolResults) {\n        currentMessages.push({\n          role: 'tool',\n          content: result.content,\n          name: result.toolName,\n          tool_call_id: result.toolCallId\n        });\n      }\n\n      iteration++;\n    }\n\n    // 如果达到最大迭代次数，返回最后一次响应\n    if (iteration &gt;= this.maxToolCallIterations) {\n      console.warn(&#96;工具调用达到最大迭代次数: ${this.maxToolCallIterations}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    return lastResponse!;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行多个工具调用\n   */\n  private async executeTools(\n    toolCalls: any[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void\n  ): Promise&lt;Array&lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&gt;&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const TechNewsletterNode: React.FC&lt;TechNewsletterNodeProps&gt; = \nconst [conversationId, setConversationId] = &lt;string | undefined&gt;(undefined);\n\n  // 处理AI搜索\n  const handleAiSearch = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!query.trim()) return;\n\n    setInternalLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // 添加用户消息到历史\n      const userMessage: ChatMessage = {\n        id: Date.now().toString(),\n        type: \"user\",\n        content: query,\n        timestamp: Date.now(),\n      };\n      setChatHistory((prev) =&gt; [...prev, userMessage]);\n\n      // 调用技术通稿API\n      const response = await workflowAPI.coreDraft(\n        {\n          query,\n          selectedKnowledgePoints: selectedItems,\n          source: \"TechNewsletterNode\",\n        },\n        undefined, // difyConfig 参数\n        conversationId // conversationId 参数\n      );\n\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        // 更新conversationId以支持多轮对话\n        if (response.data.conversationId) {\n          setConversationId(response.data.conversationId);\n        }\n        \n        setAiResponse(response.data.content || response.data.answer || \"\");\n\n        // 添加AI响应到历史\n        const aiMessage: ChatMessage = {\n          id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\n          type: \"ai\",\n          content: response.data.content || response.data.answer || \"\",\n          timestamp: Date.now() + 1,\n        };\n        setChatHistory((prev) =&gt; [...prev, aiMessage]);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"技术通稿生成失败:\", error);\n      setAiResponse(\"抱歉，技术通稿生成失败，请稍后重试。\");\n    } finally {\n      setInternalLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 处理点赞\n  const handleLike = () =&gt; {\n    setLiked(!liked);\n    if (disliked) setDisliked(false);\n  };\n\n  // 处理点踩\n  const handleDislike = () =&gt; {\n    setDisliked(!disliked);\n    if (liked) setLiked(false);\n  };\n\n  // 处理复制\n  const handleCopy = () =&gt; {\n    navigator.clipboard.writeText(aiResponse);\n  };\n\n  // 处理分享\n  const handleShare = () =&gt; {\n    // 分享逻辑\n    console.log(\"分享技术通稿内容\");\n  };\n\n  // 处理重新生成\n  const handleRegenerate = () =&gt; {\n    handleAiSearch();\n  };\n;",

tools : undefined);\n      lastResponse = response;\n\n      // LLM 调用后检查超时\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n\n      // 如果没有工具调用，直接返回\n      if (!response.toolCalls || response.toolCalls.length === 0) {\n        return response;\n      }\n\n      // 将 assistant 的回复添加到消息历史\n      currentMessages.push({\n        role: 'assistant',\n        content: response.content || ''\n      });\n\n      // 执行工具调用（检查超时）\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n      const toolResults = await this.executeTools(response.toolCalls, toolConfigs, checkTimeout);\n\n      // 工具执行后检查超时\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n\n      // 将工具调用结果添加到消息历史\n      for (const result of toolResults) {\n        currentMessages.push({\n          role: 'tool',\n          content: result.content,\n          name: result.toolName,\n          tool_call_id: result.toolCallId\n        });\n      }\n\n      iteration++;\n    }\n\n    // 如果达到最大迭代次数，返回最后一次响应\n    if (iteration &gt;= this.maxToolCallIterations) {\n      console.warn(&#96;工具调用达到最大迭代次数: ${this.maxToolCallIterations}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    return lastResponse!;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行多个工具调用\n   */\n  private async executeTools(\n    toolCalls: any[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void\n  ): Promise&lt;Array&lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&gt;&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\nasync executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\n;\n    }\n\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\n    messages.push({\n      role: 'user',\n      content: query\n    });\n\n    // 6. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\n    const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\n\n    // 7. 获取 LLM Provider\n    const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\n\n    // 8. 调用 LLM（可能包含多轮工具调用）\n    checkTimeout();\n    let response = await this.executeWithTools(provider, messages, config.llm, tools, config.tools || [], checkTimeout);\n\n    // 9. 保存消息历史\n    await this.saveMessages(finalConversationId, query, response, roleId);\n\n    // 10. 返回结果\n    return {\n      content: response.content,\n      conversationId: finalConversationId,\n      usage: response.usage,\n      metadata: {\n        model: response.model,\n        finishReason: response.finishReason,\n        toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0\n      }\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行带工具调用的 LLM 请求（可能多轮）\n   */\n  private async executeWithTools(\n    provider: ILLMProvider,\n    messages: ChatMessage[],\n    llmConfig: LLMConfig,\n    tools: Tool[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void\n  ): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class OpenAIProvider implements ILLMProvider {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 发送聊天请求\n   */\n  async chat(messages: ChatMessage[], config: LLMConfig, tools?: Tool[]): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\n    const url = &#96;${this.apiBaseUrl}/chat/completions&#96;;\n    \n    const requestBody: any = {\n      model: config.model,\n      messages: this.formatMessages(messages),\n      temperature: config.temperature,\n      max_tokens: config.maxTokens,\n    };\n\n    if (config.topP !== undefined) {\n      requestBody.top_p = config.topP;\n    }\n\n    // 添加工具定义（如果提供）\n    if (tools &amp;&amp; tools.length &gt; 0) {\n      requestBody.tools = tools;\n      requestBody.tool_choice = 'auto';\n    }\n\n    let lastError: Error | null = null;\n    \n    // 重试逻辑\n    for (let attempt = 0; attempt &lt; this.maxRetries; attempt++) {\n      try {\n        const response = await axios.post(url, requestBody, {\n          headers: {\n            'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${this.apiKey}&#96;,\n            'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n          },\n          timeout: this.timeout,\n        });\n\n        return this.parseResponse(response.data);\n      } catch (error) {\n        lastError = error as Error;\n        \n        // 如果是网络错误或超时，重试\n        if (this.isRetryableError(error)) {\n          if (attempt &lt; this.maxRetries - 1) {\n            // 指数退避\n            await this.sleep(Math.pow(2, attempt) * 1000);\n            continue;\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果是客户端错误（4xx），不重试\n        if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {\n          const axiosError = error as AxiosError;\n          if (axiosError.response &amp;&amp; axiosError.response.status &gt;= 400 &amp;&amp; axiosError.response.status &lt; 500) {\n            throw this.handleError(error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    throw this.handleError(lastError || new Error('未知错误'));\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 测试连接\n   */\n  async testConnection(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "class DifyClient {\n\n\n  async callApp(appType: DifyAppType, inputs: any, responseMode = 'blocking', user = 'todify3-user'): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    logger.info('调用 Dify 应用', { appType, responseMode });\n    const gateway = this.getGateway(appType);\n    const result = await gateway.executeChat({\n      query: inputs.query || '',\n      conversationId: inputs.conversation_id,\n      inputs,\n      userId: user,\n    });\n\n    if (isSuccess(result) &amp;&amp; result.value.raw) {\n      return result.value.raw;\n    }\n\n    if (!isSuccess(result)) {\n      throw new Error(result.error.message);\n    }\n\n    throw new Error('Dify 应用调用未返回有效数据');\n  }\n\n  async aiSearch(query: string, inputs: any = {}, conversationId = '', responseMode = 'blocking'): Promise&lt;DifyChatResponse&gt; {\n    \n  }",

            "line": 384,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行 Agent（核心方法）\n   * @param roleId 角色ID\n   * @param query 用户查询\n   * @param conversationId 对话ID（可选，如果不存在会生成新的）\n   * @param context 上下文数据（用于变量替换）\n   * @returns 执行结果\n   */\n  async executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\n    const startTime = Date.now();\n    const MAX_EXECUTION_TIME = 360000; // 6分钟总体超时（留出缓冲给前端7分钟超时）\n    \n    // 检查超时的辅助函数\n    const checkTimeout = () =&gt; {\n      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;\n      if (elapsed &gt; MAX_EXECUTION_TIME) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent执行超时：已执行 ${Math.round(elapsed / 1000)} 秒，超过最大执行时间 ${MAX_EXECUTION_TIME / 1000} 秒&#96;);\n      }\n    };\n    \n    // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\n    checkTimeout();\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\n    if (!role) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    if (!role.agentConfig) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;Agent配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\n\n    // 2. 生成或使用 conversationId\n    const finalConversationId = conversationId || this.generateConversationId();\n\n    // 3. 渲染 System Prompt\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\n      context\n    );\n\n    // 4. 获取上下文消息\n    checkTimeout();\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\n      finalConversationId,\n      config.contextStrategy,\n      query\n    );\n\n    // 5. 构建完整消息列表\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [];\n    \n    // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\n    if (config.contextStrategy.includeSystemPrompt || contextMessages.length === 0) {\n      messages.push({\n        role: 'system',\n        content: systemPrompt\n      });\n    }\n\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ToolExecutor {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行工具调用\n   * @param toolCall 工具调用信息\n   * @param toolConfig 工具配置\n   * @returns 执行结果（JSON 字符串）\n   */\n  async executeTool(toolCall: ToolCall, toolConfig: ToolConfig): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 解析参数\n      const args = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments || '{}');\n\n      // 验证参数\n      this.validateParameters(args, toolConfig.parameters);\n\n      // 根据工具类型执行\n      let result: ToolExecutionResult;\n\n      switch (toolConfig.type) {\n        case 'search':\n          result = await this.executeSearch(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'calculation':\n          result = this.executeCalculation(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'time':\n          result = this.getTime(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'api':\n          result = await this.executeAPI(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'workflow':\n          result = await this.executeWorkflow(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'agent':\n          result = await this.executeAgent(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        default:\n          result = {\n            success: false,\n            content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;不支持的工具类型: ${toolConfig.type}&#96; })\n          };\n      }\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return JSON.stringify({ error: result.error || '工具执行失败' });\n      }\n\n      return result.content;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(&#96;工具执行失败: ${toolConfig.name}&#96;, error);\n      return JSON.stringify({\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '工具执行失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 验证参数\n   */\n  private validateParameters(args: any, parameters: ToolConfig['parameters']): void {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行多个工具调用\n   */\n  private async executeTools(\n    toolCalls: any[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void\n  ): Promise&lt;Array&lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&gt;&gt; {\n    const results = [];\n    const TOOL_TIMEOUT = 60000; // 每个工具调用60秒超时\n\n    for (const toolCall of toolCalls) {\n      // 在每个工具调用前检查超时\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n      \n      const config = toolConfigs.find(t =&gt; t.enabled &amp;&amp; t.name === toolCall.function.name);\n      \n      if (!config) {\n        results.push({\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;工具不存在或已禁用: ${toolCall.function.name}&#96; })\n        });\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      try {\n        // 使用 ToolExecutor 执行工具，添加超时控制\n        const result = await Promise.race([\n          this.toolExecutor.executeTool(toolCall, config),\n          new Promise&lt;string&gt;((_, reject) =&gt; \n            setTimeout(() =&gt; reject(new Error(&#96;工具调用超时: ${toolCall.function.name} (${TOOL_TIMEOUT / 1000}秒)&#96;)), TOOL_TIMEOUT)\n          )\n        ]);\n        results.push({\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\n          content: result\n        });\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error(&#96;工具执行失败: ${toolCall.function.name}&#96;, error);\n        results.push({\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ \n            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '工具执行失败' \n          })\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return results;\n  }\n\n\n  /**\n   * 准备工具定义（转换为 OpenAI Function 格式）\n   */\n  private prepareTools(toolConfigs: ToolConfig[]): Tool[] {\n    return\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\nprivate async executeAgentNode(\n    node: any,\n    sharedContext: Record&lt;string, any&gt;\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n\n\n    logger.info('准备执行Agent节点', {\n      nodeId: node.id,\n      agentId,\n      connectionType,\n      query: query?.substring(0, 100),\n      queryLength: query?.length || 0,\n      '传递给Dify的conversationId': conversationId || '空（首次对话）',\n      inputsKeys: Object.keys(inputs || {}),\n    });\n\n    if (connectionType === 'chatflow') {\n      // 使用聊天流模式\n      const result = await gateway.executeChat({\n        query,\n        conversationId,\n        inputs,\n        userId: 'todify3-user',\n      });\n\n      if (isSuccess(result)) {\n        const chatResponse = result.value.raw as any;\n        const agentOutput = {\n          answer: chatResponse.answer || result.value.answer,\n          conversation_id: chatResponse.conversation_id || result.value.conversationId,\n          message_id: chatResponse.message_id || result.value.messageId,\n          metadata: chatResponse.metadata || {},\n          raw: chatResponse,\n        };\n        \n        logger.info('Agent节点执行完成 (chatflow)', {\n          nodeId: node.id,\n          agentId,\n          hasAnswer: !!agentOutput.answer,\n          answerLength: agentOutput.answer?.length || 0,\n          answerPreview: agentOutput.answer?.substring(0, 200) || null,\n          answerType: typeof agentOutput.answer,\n          rawKeys: chatResponse &amp;&amp; typeof chatResponse === 'object' ? Object.keys(chatResponse) : null,\n        });\n        \n        return agentOutput;\n      } else {\n        logger.error('Agent节点执行失败 (chatflow)', {\n          nodeId: node.id,\n          agentId,\n          error: result.error,\n        });\n        throw new Error(result.error.message || 'Dify聊天调用失败');\n      }\n    } else {\n      // 使用工作流模式\n      const result = await gateway.executeWorkflow\n;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行Agent节点\n   */\n  private async executeAgentNode(\n    node: any,\n    sharedContext: Record&lt;string, any&gt;\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    const agentId = node.agentId || node.data?.agentId;\n    if (!agentId) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;Agent节点 ${node.id} 未配置agentId&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 获取AI角色配置\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(agentId);\n    if (!role) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${agentId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    if (!role.enabled) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色已禁用: ${agentId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 准备输入数据\n    const nodeInput = this.prepareNodeInput(node, sharedContext);\n    \n    // 尝试从多个可能的字段中提取query\n    // 优先级：query &gt; input &gt; workflowInput.query &gt; 整个nodeInput的字符串化\n    let query = nodeInput.query;\n    if (!query) {\n      query = nodeInput.input;\n    }\n    if (!query &amp;&amp; nodeInput.workflowInput?.query) {\n      query = nodeInput.workflowInput.query;\n    }\n    if (!query &amp;&amp; typeof nodeInput === 'object') {\n      // 如果还是没有，尝试从其他常见字段中提取\n      query = nodeInput.question || nodeInput.text || nodeInput.content;\n    }\n    if (!query) {\n      // 最后回退：如果nodeInput是字符串，直接使用；否则字符串化\n      query = typeof nodeInput === 'string' ? nodeInput : JSON.stringify(nodeInput);\n    }\n    \n    const inputs = { ...nodeInput };\n    delete inputs.query;\n    delete inputs.input;\n\n    // 检查 provider 类型，Workflow 目前只支持 Dify\n    const provider = role.provider || 'dify';\n    if (provider === 'direct-agent') {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 是 Direct Agent 类型，不支持在 Workflow 中使用。请使用 Dify 类型的角色。&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 根据连接类型调用Dify API\n    if (!role.difyConfig) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 的Dify配置不存在&#96;);\n    }\n\n    const { connectionType, apiKey, apiUrl } = role.difyConfig;\n    // 尝试从多个可能的位置获取 conversationId\n    // 优先级：nodeInput.conversationId &gt; nodeInput.workflowInput.conversationId &gt; sharedContext.workflowInput.conversationId\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ToolExecutor {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行 Agent 调用工具\n   */\n  private async executeAgent(toolConfig: ToolConfig, args: any): Promise&lt;ToolExecutionResult&gt; {\n    try {\n      const implementation = toolConfig.implementation;\n      if (!implementation || !implementation.agentId) {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Agent ID 未配置' })\n        };\n      }\n\n      const agentId = implementation.agentId;\n      const query = args.query || args.input || JSON.stringify(args);\n\n      // 获取 Agent 配置\n      const agent = await aiRoleModel.getById(agentId);\n      if (!agent || !agent.enabled) {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;Agent 不存在或已禁用: ${agentId}&#96; })\n        };\n      }\n\n      // TODO: 调用 Agent 的 chat 接口\n      // 这里需要避免循环调用，暂时返回占位符\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        content: JSON.stringify({\n          message: &#96;Agent ${agentId} 调用功能将在后续版本中实现&#96;,\n          query\n        })\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        content: JSON.stringify({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Agent 调用失败' })\n      };\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class DifyGateway {\n\n\n  async executeChat(input: ChatInput): Promise&lt;Result&lt;ChatOutput&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await this.retry(() =&gt;\n        this.chatClient.post('/chat-messages', {\n          query: input.query,\n          conversation_id: input.conversationId,\n          inputs: input.inputs ?? {},\n          response_mode: 'blocking',\n          user: input.userId ?? 'todify-user',\n          files: [],\n        })\n      );\n\n      return success({\n        conversationId: response.data?.conversation_id,\n        messageId: response.data?.message_id,\n        answer: response.data?.answer,\n        raw: response.data,\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      const axiosError = error as any;\n      const errorDetails = {\n        message: axiosError.message || (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)),\n        code: axiosError.code,\n        status: axiosError.response?.status,\n        statusText: axiosError.response?.statusText,\n        responseData: axiosError.response?.data,\n        requestUrl: axiosError.config?.url,\n        requestBaseURL: axiosError.config?.baseURL,\n        fullUrl: axiosError.config?.baseURL ? &#96;${axiosError.config.baseURL}${axiosError.config.url}&#96; : axiosError.config?.url,\n        errno: axiosError.errno,\n        syscall: axiosError.syscall,\n        address: axiosError.address,\n        port: axiosError.port,\n      };\n      logger.error('Dify executeChat 失败', { error: errorDetails, input });\n      console.error('Dify executeChat 详细错误:', JSON.stringify(errorDetails, null, 2));\n      \n      // 构建详细的错误消息\n      let errorMessage = errorDetails.message;\n      if (errorDetails.code) {\n        errorMessage += &#96; (${errorDetails.code})&#96;;\n      }\n      if (errorDetails.status) {\n        errorMessage += &#96; [HTTP ${errorDetails.status}]&#96;;\n      }\n      if (errorDetails.responseData) {\n        errorMessage += &#96;: ${JSON.stringify(errorDetails.responseData)}&#96;;\n      }\n      \n      return failure({\n        code: 'DIFY_CHAT_ERROR',\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { ChatMessageService } from '@/services/ChatMessageService';\nimport DifyClient from '@/services/DifyClient';\nimport { db } from '@/config/database';\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\nimport { Result, failure, success } from '@/shared/lib/result';\n\nimport { ExecuteAiSearchDTO } from '../dto/executeAiSearch.dto';\n\nexport class ExecuteAiSearchUseCase {\n  async execute(dto: ExecuteAiSearchDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;unknown&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      logger.info('执行 AI 搜索', { query: dto.query });\n\n      const processedInputs = await this.processInputs(dto.inputs);\n      const result = await DifyClient.aiSearch(dto.query, processedInputs, dto.conversationId ??         "contents": "export class OpenAIProvider implements ILLMProvider {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 解析响应\n   */\n  private parseResponse(data: any): LLMResponse {\n    const choice = data.choices[0];\n    const message = choice.message;\n\n    const response: LLMResponse = {\n      content: message.content || '',\n      usage: {\n        promptTokens: data.usage?.prompt_tokens || 0,\n        completionTokens: data.usage?.completion_tokens || 0,\n        totalTokens: data.usage?.total_tokens || 0,\n      },\n      model: data.model,\n      finishReason: this.mapFinishReason(choice.finish_reason),\n    };\n\n    // 解析工具调用\n    if (message.tool_calls &amp;&amp; message.tool_calls.length &gt; 0) {\n      response.toolCalls = message.tool_calls.map((tc: any) =&gt; ({\n        id: tc.id,\n        type: tc.type,\n        function: {\n          name: tc.function.name,\n          arguments: tc.function.arguments,\n        },\n      }));\n    }\n\n    return response;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射完成原因\n   */\n  private mapFinishReason(reason: string): 'stop' | 'length' | 'tool_calls' | 'content_filter' {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import DifyClient from '@/services/DifyClient';\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\nimport { Result, failure, success } from '@/shared/lib/result';\n\nimport { ExecuteTechStrategyDTO } from '../dto/executeTechStrategy.dto';\n\nexport class ExecuteTechStrategyUseCase {\n  async execute(dto: ExecuteTechStrategyDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;unknown&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const inputs = dto.inputs?.techPackage || JSON.stringify(dto.inputs);\n      const difyInputs = {\n        input1: inputs,\n        input2: inputs,\n        query: inputs,\n        techPackage: inputs,\n        template: dto.inputs?.template || 'default',\n      };\n\n      const result = await DifyClient.techStrategy(difyInputs);\n\n      try {\n        await ChatMessageService.saveDifyWorkflowResponse(\n          result,\n          '技术策略生成',\n          'tech-strategy',\n          dto.inputs,\n          dto.conversationId\n        );\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.warn('保存技术策略消息失败', { error });\n      }\n\n      return success(result);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('技术策略执行失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'TECH_STRATEGY_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '技术策略失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\nasync execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      const effectiveOutputMappings = featureConfig.outputMappings?.length\n        ? featureConfig.outputMappings\n        : targetMappingConfig?.outputMappings || [];\n\n      const baseContent = await this.resolveBaseContent(conversation, dto);\n      const conversationQuery = baseContent || &#96;触发子Agent：${dto.featureType}&#96;;\n\n      const conversationData = this.buildConversationData(\n        conversation,\n        conversationQuery,\n        targetSources,\n        dto\n      );\n\n      const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, effectiveInputMappings);\n\n      // 判断 targetWorkflowId 是 AI 角色 ID 还是工作流 ID\n      // AI 角色 ID 可能以 'role_' 或 'ai-role-' 开头，工作流 ID 以 'wf_' 开头\n      const isRoleId = targetWorkflowId.startsWith('role_') || targetWorkflowId.startsWith('ai-role-');\n      \n      let workflowResult;\n      if (isRoleId) {\n        // 直接调用 AI 角色\n        logger.info('检测到 AI 角色 ID，直接调用角色', { roleId: targetWorkflowId, featureType: dto.featureType });\n        workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeRole(targetWorkflowId, workflowInput);\n      } else {\n        // 通过工作流调用\n        logger.info('检测到工作流 ID，通过工作流调用', { workflowId: targetWorkflowId, featureType: dto.featureType });\n        workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(\n          targetWorkflowId,\n          { input: workflowInput }\n        );\n      }\n\n      const extractedOutput = extractWorkflowOutput(workflowResult, effectiveOutputMappings);\n\n      const aiContent = extractedOutput.content\n        || workflowResult.message\n        || &#96;子Agent ${dto.featureType} 已执行&#96;;\n\n      const messageOutputs = {\n        ...extractedOutput,\n,\n      };\n  }\n}",

{\\n    scrollToBottom();\\n  }, [messages]);\\n\\n  const handleKeyPress = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (e.key === \\\"Enter\\\" &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !isLoading) {\\n      handleSendMessage();\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleSendMessage = async () =&amp;gt;\\n;\\n;\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&amp;lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&amp;gt; = \\n\\n\\n  const handleCreateNewConversation = useCallback(async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      clearGlobalError();\\n      // 提出新问题时，清空勾选状态和已发送来源\\n      setSelectedSourceIds([]);\\n      setSentSourceIds([]);\\n      \\n      const conversation = await aiSearchService.createConversation({\\n        title: &amp;#96;对话 ${new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN', { year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }).replace(/\\\\//g, '/')}&amp;#96;,\\n        sources: [], // 新对话不附带来源，等用户勾选后首次发送时传递\\n        pageType: effectivePageType, // 使用包含项目ID的 pageType\\n      });\\n\\n      if (selectedWorkflowId) {\\n        persistWorkflowSelection(selectedWorkflowId, conversation.id);\\n      }\\n      await loadConversations({ activeConversationId: conversation.id });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"创建新对话失败:\\\", error);\\n      reportError(\\\"创建新对话失败，请稍后重试\\\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\\n    }\\n  }, [\\n    clearGlobalError,\\n    reportError,\\n    selectedWorkflowId,\\n    persistWorkflowSelection,\\n    loadConversations,\\n    effectivePageType,\\n  ]);\\n\\n  const handleShowHistory = useCallback(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    setShowConversationList(true);\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 标记来源已发送给 Dify，避免重复发送\\n  const handleSourcesSent = useCallback((sourceIds: string[]) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setSentSourceIds(prev =&amp;gt; {\\n      const newIds = sourceIds.filter(id =&amp;gt; !prev.includes(id));\\n      if (newIds.length === 0) return prev;\\n      return [...prev, ...newIds];\\n    });\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleSelectConversation = async (conversation: Conversation)\\n;\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 4985,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\\nimport { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';\\nimport { Project } from '../types/project';\\nimport { ProjectFormData } from '../types/project';\\nimport projectService from '../services/projectService';\\nimport FeaturedProjectList from '../components/project/FeaturedProjectList';\\nimport RecentProjectList from '../components/project/RecentProjectList';\\nimport NewProjectModal from '../components/project/NewProjectModal';\\nimport NewProjectCard from '../components/project/NewProjectCard';\\nimport ProjectCard from '../components/project/ProjectCard';\\nimport { Plus, List, Grid, ChevronDown, Search } from 'lucide-react';\\n\\ntype TabType = 'all' | 'my' | 'featured';\\n\\nconst HomePage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();\\n  \\n  // 从 URL 参数中读取标签页，如果没有则默认为 'featured'\\n  const tabFromUrl = searchParams.get('tab') as TabType | null;\\n  const initialTab: TabType = (tabFromUrl &amp;amp;&amp;amp; ['all', 'my', 'featured'].includes(tabFromUrl)) \\n    ? tabFromUrl \\n    : 'featured';\\n  \\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState&amp;lt;TabType&amp;gt;(initialTab);\\n  const [featuredProjects, setFeaturedProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [recentProjects, setRecentProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [allProjects, setAllProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [isNewProjectModalOpen, setIsNewProjectModalOpen] = useState(false);\\n  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState&amp;lt;'recent' | 'name' | 'date'&amp;gt;('recent');\\n\\n  // 当 URL 参数变化时，更新 activeTab\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const tabFromUrl = searchParams.get('tab') as TabType | null;\\n    if (tabFromUrl &amp;amp;&amp;amp; ['all', 'my', 'featured'].includes(tabFromUrl) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; tabFromUrl !== activeTab) {\\n      setActiveTab(tabFromUrl);\\n    }\\n  }, [searchParams]);\\n\\n  // 加载数据\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    loadProjects();\\n  }, [activeTab, sortBy]);\\n\\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setIsLoading(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 加载精选项目\\n      const featuredResponse = await projectService.getFeaturedProjects(4);\\n      if (featuredResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; featuredResponse.data) {\\n        setFeaturedProjects(featuredResponse.data);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 加载最近项目\\n      const recentResponse = await projectService.getRecentProjects(20);\\n      if (recentResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; recentResponse.data) {\\n        setRecentProjects(recentResponse.data);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 加载所有项目（用于\\\"全部\\\"和\\\"我的项目\\\"标签，或强制加载时）\\n      if (forceLoadAll || activeTab === 'all' || activeTab === 'my') {\\n        const allResponse = await projectService.getProjects({\\n          page: 1,\\n          pageSize: 100,\\n          orderBy: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'last_opened_at' : sortBy === 'name' ? 'name' : 'created_at',\\n          orderDirection: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'\\n        });\\n        if (allResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; allResponse.data) {\\n          setAllProjects(allResponse.data.data);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleCreateProject = async (data: ProjectFormData) =&amp;gt; {\\n    const response = await projectService.createProject(data);\\n    if (response.success) {\\n      // 创建成功后，切换到\\\"我的项目\\\"标签页以显示新创建的项目\\n      setActiveTab('my');\\n      // 强制重新加载所有数据（包括所有项目列表）\\n      await loadProjects(true);\\n    } else {\\n      alert(response.error || '创建项目失败');\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleProjectClick = async (project: Project) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 更新最后打开时间\\n    await projectService.updateLastOpenedAt(project.id);\\n    // 导航到项目资源管理页面\\n    navigate(&amp;#96;/project/${project.id}/resources&amp;#96;);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleProjectMenuClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, project: Project) =&amp;gt; {\\n    e.stopPropagation();\\n    // TODO: 实现项目菜单（编辑、删除等）\\n    console.log('Project menu clicked:', project);\\n  };\\n\\n  const getDisplayProjects = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    switch (activeTab) {\\n      case 'featured':\\n        return featuredProjects;\\n      case 'my':\\n        return allProjects;\\n      case 'all':\\n        return allProjects;\\n      default:\\n        return [];\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      {/* 顶部导航栏 */}\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-40\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-between h-16\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 左侧标签页 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('all');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'all' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'all'\\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\n                }&amp;#96;}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                全部\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('my');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'my' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'my'\\n                    ?                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"const TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = \\n\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 开始加载配置...');\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 获取到所有配置:', configs.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 过滤后的启用配置:', enabled.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n  }\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 9578,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import { useParams, useNavigate } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport { ArrowLeft, RefreshCw } from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\n\\nimport TechPackageNode from \\\"../components/nodes/TechPackageNode\\\";\\nimport CoreDraftNode from \\\"../components/nodes/CoreDraftNode\\\";\\nimport AiSearchNode from \\\"../components/nodes/AiSearchNode\\\";\\nimport PromotionStrategyNode from \\\"../components/nodes/PromotionStrategyNode\\\";\\nimport TechPackagePage from \\\"./TechPackagePage\\\";\\nimport PressReleasePage from \\\"./PressReleasePage\\\";\\nimport TechStrategyPage from \\\"./TechStrategyPage\\\";\\nimport TechArticlePage from \\\"./TechArticlePage\\\";\\nimport { getNodeById } from \\\"../config/workflowNodes\\\";\\nimport LoadingAnimation, {\\n  LoadingButton,\\n} from \\\"../components/LoadingAnimation\\\";\\nimport PageTransition, { AnimatedPage } from \\\"../components/PageTransition\\\";\\nimport TopNavigation from \\\"../components/TopNavigation\\\";\\nimport { aiRoleService } from \\\"../services/aiRoleService\\\";\\nimport { AIRoleConfig } from \\\"../types/aiRole\\\";\\nimport { \\n  findAIRoleForNode, \\n  isValidIndependentNodeType,\\n  IndependentNodeType \\n} from \\\"../utils/nodeRoleMapping\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfigPreview } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\n// 节点组件映射\\nconst nodeComponents = {\\n  tech_package: TechPackageNode,\\n  core_draft: CoreDraftNode,\\n  ai_search: AiSearchNode,\\n  ai_qa: AiSearchNode, // ai_qa 也映射到 AiSearchNode\\n  promotion_strategy: PromotionStrategyNode, // 推广策略节点\\n};\\n\\nconst NodePage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt;\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 9746,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = \\n\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = (event?: Event) =&amp;gt; {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到配置更新事件:', event);\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = (event?: Event) =&amp;gt; {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到自定义刷新事件:', event);\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo\\n;\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 10187,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate, useLocation } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport {\\n  MessageCircle,\\n  Target,\\n  FileText,\\n  Mic,\\n  Home,\\n  Settings,\\n  User,\\n  ChevronDown,\\n} from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\";\\nimport { PublicPageConfig } from \\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\";\\n\\ninterface TopNavigationProps {\\n  currentPageTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\ninterface NavigationItem {\\n  id: string;\\n  label: string;\\n  icon: any;\\n  path: string;\\n  disabled: boolean;\\n  category: 'main' | 'management';\\n  configId?: string;\\n}\\n\\n// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\n];\\n\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\n];\\n\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\n  '/ai-roles',\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\n  '/ai-management',\\n];\\n\\n\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const location = useLocation();\\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('用户');\\n  \\n  // 获取当前登录用户名\\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \\n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\\n      if (username) {\\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\\n        try {\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\\n        } catch {\\n          return username;\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\\n    }\\n    // 默认返回\\\"用户\\\"\\n    return '用户';\\n  };\\n  \\n  // 初始化用户名\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    \\n    // 监听 localStorage 变化（跨标签页同步）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'username' || e.key === 'user_name' || e.key === 'currentUser' || e.key === 'userName') {\\n        setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n      }\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义事件（同标签页更新）\\n    const handleUserUpdate = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\\n    };\\n    \\n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    \\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 开始加载配置...');\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      const configs = await publicPageConfigService.getAllConfigs();\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 获取到所有配置:', configs.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n      // 过滤出已启用且有地址的配置\\n      const enabled = configs.filter(\\n        (config) =&amp;gt; config.isActive &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.address\\n      );\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 过滤后的启用配置:', enabled.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n      setActiveConfigs(enabled);\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      // 对于后端未运行的情况，静默处理\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      if (errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      console.error('[TopNavigation] 加载配置失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 初始加载\\n    loadActiveConfigs();\\n\\n    // 监听配置更新事件\\n    const handleConfigUpdate = (event?: Event) =&amp;gt; {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到配置更新事件:', event);\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n\\n    // 监听storage变化（跨标签页通信）\\n    const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (e.key === 'publicPageConfigsRefresh') {\\n        loadActiveConfigs();\\n      }\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n    \\n    // 监听自定义刷新事件（同标签页触发）\\n    const handleCustomRefresh = (event?: Event) =&amp;gt; {\\n      console.log('[TopNavigation] 收到自定义刷新事件:', event);\\n      loadActiveConfigs();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigUpdated', handleConfigUpdate);\\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\\n      window.removeEventListener('publicPageConfigsRefresh', handleCustomRefresh);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 重新计算 mainItems，activeConfigs:', activeConfigs.map(c =&amp;gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\\n\\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\\n        items.push({\\n          id: 'home',\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\\n        (c) =&amp;gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\\n      );\\n\\n      if (config) {\\n        console.log(&amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 找到配置 ${navItem.name}:&amp;#96;, config);\\n        items.push({\\n          id: config.id,\\n          label: config.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: &amp;#96;/${config.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          disabled: false,\\n          category: 'main',\\n          configId: config.id,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        console.log(&amp;#96;[TopNavigation] 未找到配置 ${navItem.name}，将显示为禁用状态&amp;#96;);\\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\\n        items.push({\\n          id: &amp;#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&amp;#96;,\\n          label: navItem.name,\\n          icon: navItem.icon,\\n          path: navItem.path,\\n          disabled: true,\\n          category: 'main',\\n        });\\n      }\\n    });\\n\\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 生成的 mainItems:', items.map(i =&amp;gt; ({ id: i.id, label: i.label, disabled: i.disabled })));\\n    return items;\\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\\n\\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&amp;gt; ({\\n      id: navItem.path,\\n      label: navItem.name,\\n      icon: navItem.icon,\\n      path: navItem.path,\\n      disabled: false,\\n      category: 'management' as const,\\n    }));\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (disabled) {\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\\n    if (path === '/' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; itemId === 'home') {\\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\\n    } else {\\n      navigate(path);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 首页特殊处理\\n    if (path === '/') {\\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\\n    }\\n    // Agent配置特殊处理：如果当前路径是Agent配置的子页面，也认为是当前路径\\n    if (path === '/ai-management') {\\n      return AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS.some(agentPath =&amp;gt; \\n        location.pathname === agentPath || location.pathname.startsWith(agentPath + '/')\\n      );\\n    }\\n    // 精确匹配\\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\\n  };\\n\\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    return (\\n      &amp;lt;div key={groupIndex} className=\\\"flex items-center\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {items.map((item) =&amp;gt; {\\n          const Icon = item.icon;\\n          const isCurrent = isCurrentPath(item.path);\\n\\n          return (\\n            &amp;lt;React.Fragment key={item.id}&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleNavigation(item.path, item.disabled, item.id)}\\n                disabled={item.disabled}\\n                className={&amp;#96;\\n                  relative flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\\n                  transition-all duration-200 group\\n                  ${\\n                    item.disabled\\n                      ? \\\"text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50\\\"\\n                      : isCurrent\\n                        ? \\\"text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 shadow-sm\\\"\\n                        : \\\"text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50\\\"\\n                  }\\n                &amp;#96;}\\n                title={item.label}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Icon className={&amp;#96;w-4 h-4 ${isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-500 group-hover:text-blue-600'}&amp;#96;} /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;{item.label}&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                \\n                {/* 当前页面指示器 */}\\n                {isCurrent &amp;amp;&amp;amp;                   "lineNumber": 12615,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const RESERVED_ROUTES = [\\n 'field-mapping-management'\\n];\\n\\n/**\\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\\n */\\nconst AddressPage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const { address } = useParams&amp;lt;{ address: string }&amp;gt;();\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\\n  const [executionResult, setExecutionResult] = useState&amp;lt;any&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [publicConfig, setPublicConfig] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [configLoading, setConfigLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [error, setError] = useState&amp;lt;string | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n\\n  // 加载公开页面配置\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const loadPublicConfig = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (!address) {\\n        setError('地址参数缺失');\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 检查是否是保留路由\\n      if (RESERVED_ROUTES.includes(address)) {\\n        setError('该路径为系统保留路径');\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      try {\\n        setConfigLoading(true);\\n        setError(null);\\n        // 根据地址查找配置\\n        const configData = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigByAddress(address);\\n        if (configData &amp;amp;&amp;amp; configData.config) {\\n          setPublicConfig(configData);\\n        } else {\\n          setError('未找到对应的页面配置');\\n        }\\n      } catch (err: any) {\\n        console.error('加载配置失败:', err);\\n        // 如果404，说明不是有效的地址配置，跳转到首页\\n        if (err.response?.status === 404) {\\n          navigate('/');\\n          return;\\n        }\\n        setError(err.message || '加载配置失败');\\n      } finally {\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    loadPublicConfig();\\n  }, [address, navigate]);\\n\\n  // 处理节点执行\\n  const handleNodeExecution = async (inputData: any)\\n;\\n;\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\\nimport { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';\\nimport { Project } from '../types/project';\\nimport { ProjectFormData } from '../types/project';\\nimport projectService from '../services/projectService';\\nimport FeaturedProjectList from '../components/project/FeaturedProjectList';\\nimport RecentProjectList from '../components/project/RecentProjectList';\\nimport NewProjectModal from '../components/project/NewProjectModal';\\nimport NewProjectCard from '../components/project/NewProjectCard';\\nimport ProjectCard from '../components/project/ProjectCard';\\nimport { Plus, List, Grid, ChevronDown, Search, User } from 'lucide-react';\\n\\ntype TabType = 'all' | 'my' | 'featured';\\n\\nconst HomePage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();\\n  \\n  // 从 URL 参数中读取标签页，如果没有则默认为 'featured'\\n  const tabFromUrl = searchParams.get('tab') as TabType | null;\\n  const initialTab: TabType = (tabFromUrl &amp;amp;&amp;amp; ['all', 'my', 'featured'].includes(tabFromUrl)) \\n    ? tabFromUrl \\n    : 'featured';\\n  \\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState&amp;lt;TabType&amp;gt;(initialTab);\\n  const [featuredProjects, setFeaturedProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [recentProjects, setRecentProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [allProjects, setAllProjects] = useState&amp;lt;Project[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [isNewProjectModalOpen, setIsNewProjectModalOpen] = useState(false);\\n  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState&amp;lt;'recent' | 'name' | 'date'&amp;gt;('recent');\\n\\n  // 当 URL 参数变化时，更新 activeTab\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const tabFromUrl = searchParams.get('tab') as TabType | null;\\n    if (tabFromUrl &amp;amp;&amp;amp; ['all', 'my', 'featured'].includes(tabFromUrl) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; tabFromUrl !== activeTab) {\\n      setActiveTab(tabFromUrl);\\n    }\\n  }, [searchParams]);\\n\\n  // 加载数据\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    loadProjects();\\n  }, [activeTab, sortBy]);\\n\\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setIsLoading(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 加载精选项目\\n      const featuredResponse = await projectService.getFeaturedProjects(4);\\n      if (featuredResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; featuredResponse.data) {\\n        setFeaturedProjects(featuredResponse.data);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 加载最近项目\\n      const recentResponse = await projectService.getRecentProjects(20);\\n      if (recentResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; recentResponse.data) {\\n        setRecentProjects(recentResponse.data);\\n      }\\n\\n      // 加载所有项目（用于\\\"全部\\\"和\\\"我的项目\\\"标签，或强制加载时）\\n      if (forceLoadAll || activeTab === 'all' || activeTab === 'my') {\\n        const allResponse = await projectService.getProjects({\\n          page: 1,\\n          pageSize: 100,\\n          orderBy: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'last_opened_at' : sortBy === 'name' ? 'name' : 'created_at',\\n          orderDirection: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'\\n        });\\n        if (allResponse.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; allResponse.data) {\\n          setAllProjects(allResponse.data.data);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleCreateProject = async (data: ProjectFormData) =&amp;gt; {\\n    const response = await projectService.createProject(data);\\n    if (response.success) {\\n      // 创建成功后，切换到\\\"我的项目\\\"标签页以显示新创建的项目\\n      setActiveTab('my');\\n      // 强制重新加载所有数据（包括所有项目列表）\\n      await loadProjects(true);\\n    } else {\\n      alert(response.error || '创建项目失败');\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleProjectClick = async (project: Project) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 更新最后打开时间\\n    await projectService.updateLastOpenedAt(project.id);\\n    // 导航到项目资源管理页面\\n    navigate(&amp;#96;/project/${project.id}/resources&amp;#96;);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleProjectMenuClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, project: Project) =&amp;gt; {\\n    e.stopPropagation();\\n    // TODO: 实现项目菜单（编辑、删除等）\\n    console.log('Project menu clicked:', project);\\n  };\\n\\n  const getDisplayProjects = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    switch (activeTab) {\\n      case 'featured':\\n        return featuredProjects;\\n      case 'my':\\n        return allProjects;\\n      case 'all':\\n        return allProjects;\\n      default:\\n        return [];\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;div className=\\\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\\\"&amp;gt;\\n      {/* 顶部导航栏 */}\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-40\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-between h-16\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            {/* 左侧标签页 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-1\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('all');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'all' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'all'\\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\n                }&amp;#96;}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                全部\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('my');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'my' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'my'\\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\n                }&amp;#96;}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                我的项目\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                  setActiveTab('featured');\\n                  setSearchParams({ tab: 'featured' });\\n                }}\\n                className={&amp;#96;px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors ${\\n                  activeTab === 'featured'\\n                    ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'\\n                    : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'\\n                }&amp;#96;}\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                精选项目\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; navigate('/public-knowledge')}\\n                className=\\\"px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md transition-colors text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100\\\"\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                公共知识库\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n            {/* 右侧操作栏 */}\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n              {/* 全局搜索 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"relative\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;div className=\\\"absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;Search className=\\\"h-4 w-4 text-gray-400\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;input\\n                  type=\\\"text\\\"\\n                  placeholder=\\\"全局搜索...\\\"\\n                  onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                    // TODO: 实现全局搜索功能\\n                    console.log('全局搜索被点击');\\n                  }}\\n                  className=\\\"pl-10 pr-4 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 border border-gray-300 rounded-md hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent w-48\\\"\\n                /&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n              {/* 视图切换 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center border border-gray-300 rounded-md\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;button className=\\\"p-2 hover:bg-gray-100\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;List className=\\\"w-4 h-4 text-gray-600\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;button className=\\\"p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 border-l border-gray-300\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;Grid className=\\\"w-4 h-4 text-gray-600\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n              {/* 排序 */}\\n              &amp;lt;div className=\\\"relative\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;button className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-1 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 border border-gray-300 rounded-md hover:bg-gray-50\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;最近&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;ChevronDown className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n              {/* 新建按钮 */}\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                onClick={() =&amp;gt; setIsNewProjectModalOpen(true)}\\n                className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white bg-blue-600 rounded-md hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors\\\"\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;Plus className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;新建&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n\\n              {/* 用户按钮 */}\\n              &amp;lt;button\\n                className=\\\"flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all duration-200\\\"\\n                title=\\\"用户\\\"\\n              &amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;User className=\\\"w-4 h-4\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;用户&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n      {/* 内容区域 */}\\n      &amp;lt;div className=\\\"max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8\\\"&amp;gt;\\n        {isLoading ? (\\n          &amp;lt;div className=\\\"flex items-center justify-center py-12\\\"&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;div className=\\\"animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600\\\"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n        ) : (\\n          &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n            {activeTab === 'featured' ? (\\n              &amp;lt;&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;FeaturedProjectList\\n                  projects={featuredProjects}\\n                  onProjectClick={handleProjectClick}\\n                /&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;RecentProjectList\\n                  projects={recentProjects}\\n                  onProjectClick={handleProjectClick}\\n                  onNewProjectClick={() =&amp;gt; setIsNewProjectModalOpen(true)}\\n                  onProjectMenuClick={handleProjectMenuClick}\\n                /&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/&amp;gt;\\n            ) : (\\n              &amp;lt;div&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;h2 className=\\\"text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  {activeTab === 'all' ? '全部项目' : '我的项目'}\\n                &amp;lt;/h2&amp;gt;\\n                &amp;lt;div className=\\\"grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4\\\"&amp;gt;\\n                  &amp;lt;NewProjectCard onClick={() =&amp;gt; setIsNewProjectModalOpen(true)} /&amp;gt;\\n                  {getDisplayProjects().map((project) =&amp;gt; (\\n                    &amp;lt;ProjectCard\\n                      key={project.id}\\n                      project={project}\\n                      onClick={() =&amp;gt; handleProjectClick(project)}\\n                      onMenuClick={(e) =&amp;gt; handleProjectMenuClick(e, project)}\\n                    /&amp;gt;\\n                  ))}\\n                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n            )}\\n          &amp;lt;/&amp;gt;\\n        )}\\n      &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n      {/* 新建项目对话框 */}\\n      &amp;lt;NewProjectModal\\n        isOpen={isNewProjectModalOpen}\\n        onClose={() =&amp;gt; setIsNewProjectModalOpen(false)}\\n        onSubmit={handleCreateProject}\\n      /&amp;gt;\\n    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\nexport default HomePage;\\n\","

                  "lineNumber": 3784,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"import DifyClient from '@/services/DifyClient';\\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\\nimport { Result, failure, success } from '@/shared/lib/result';\\n\\nimport { ExecuteTechStrategyDTO } from '../dto/executeTechStrategy.dto';\\n\\nexport class ExecuteTechStrategyUseCase {\\n  async execute(dto: ExecuteTechStrategyDTO): Promise&amp;lt;Result&amp;lt;unknown&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const inputs = dto.inputs?.techPackage || JSON.stringify(dto.inputs);\\n      const difyInputs = {\\n        input1: inputs,\\n        input2: inputs,\\n        query: inputs,\\n        techPackage: inputs,\\n        template: dto.inputs?.template || 'default',\\n      };\\n\\n      const result = await DifyClient.techStrategy(difyInputs);\\n\\n      try {\\n        await ChatMessageService.saveDifyWorkflowResponse(\\n          result,\\n          '技术策略生成',\\n          'tech-strategy',\\n          dto.inputs,\\n          dto.conversationId\\n        );\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        logger.warn('保存技术策略消息失败', { error });\\n      }\\n\\n      return success(result);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.error('技术策略执行失败', { error });\\n      return failure({\\n        code: 'TECH_STRATEGY_FAILED',\\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '技术策略失败',\\n        details: error,\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 11406,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const RESERVED_ROUTES = [\\n 'field-mapping-management'\\n];\\n\\n/**\\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\\n */\\nconst AddressPage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const { address } = useParams&amp;lt;{ address: string }&amp;gt;();\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\\n  const [executionResult, setExecutionResult] = useState&amp;lt;any&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [publicConfig, setPublicConfig] = useState&amp;lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [configLoading, setConfigLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [error, setError] = useState&amp;lt;string | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n\\n  // 加载公开页面配置\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const loadPublicConfig = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (!address) {\\n        setError('地址参数缺失');\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 检查是否是保留路由\\n      if (RESERVED_ROUTES.includes(address)) {\\n        setError('该路径为系统保留路径');\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      try {\\n        setConfigLoading(true);\\n        setError(null);\\n        // 根据地址查找配置\\n        const configData = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigByAddress(address);\\n        if (configData &amp;amp;&amp;amp; configData.config) {\\n          setPublicConfig(configData);\\n        } else {\\n          setError('未找到对应的页面配置');\\n        }\\n      } catch (err: any) {\\n        console.error('加载配置失败:', err);\\n        // 如果404，说明不是有效的地址配置，跳转到首页\\n        if (err.response?.status === 404) {\\n          navigate('/');\\n          return;\\n        }\\n        setError(err.message || '加载配置失败');\\n      } finally {\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    loadPublicConfig();\\n  }, [address, navigate]);\\n\\n  // 处理节点执行\\n  const handleNodeExecution = async (inputData: any)\\n;\\n;\","
