                  "lineNumber": 14080,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { Plus, FileText, X, MessageSquare, FileCode, Brain, Package, Target, Newspaper } from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport { useNavigate } from \\\"react-router-dom\\\";\\nimport AddSourceModal from \\\"./AddSourceModal\\\";\\nimport AddTextModal from \\\"./AddTextModal\\\";\\nimport EditSourceModal from \\\"./EditSourceModal\\\";\\nimport KnowledgeBaseBrowser from \\\"./KnowledgeBaseBrowser\\\";\\nimport { Source as SourceType, SourceCategory } from \\\"../../services/sourceService\\\";\\n\\nexport interface Source {\\n  id: string;\\n  title: string;\\n  type: \\\"knowledge_base\\\" | \\\"external\\\";\\n  url?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  category?: SourceCategory;\\n}\\n\\ninterface SourceSidebarProps {\\n  sources?: Source[];\\n  selectedSources?: string[];\\n  onSourcesChange?: (sources: Source[]) =&amp;gt; void;\\n  onSelectionChange?: (selectedIds: string[]) =&amp;gt; void;\\n  pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article';\\n}\\n\\n// 获取来源类别的显示信息\\nconst getCategoryInfo = (category?: SourceCategory) =&amp;gt; {\\n  switch (category) {\\n    case 'technical-translation':\\n      return {\\n        label: '技术转译',\\n        icon: FileCode,\\n        color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700',\\n        iconColor: 'text-blue-600',\\n      };\\n    case 'ai-qa-summary':\\n      return {\\n        label: 'AI问答总结',\\n        icon: Brain,\\n        color: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700',\\n        iconColor: 'text-purple-600',\\n      };\\n    case 'tech-package-qa':\\n      return {\\n        label: '技术包装问答',\\n        icon: Package,\\n        color: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700',\\n        iconColor: 'text-orange-600',\\n      };\\n    case 'tech-strategy-qa':\\n      return {\\n        label: '技术策略问答',\\n        icon: Target,\\n        color: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700',\\n        iconColor: 'text-green-600',\\n      };\\n    case 'tech-article-qa':\\n      return {\\n        label: '技术通稿问答',\\n        icon: Newspaper,\\n        color: 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700',\\n        iconColor: 'text-indigo-600',\\n      };\\n    case 'external':\\n    default:\\n      return {\\n        label: '外部来源',\\n        icon: FileText,\\n        color: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700',\\n        iconColor: 'text-gray-600',\\n      };\\n  }\\n};\\n\\nconst SourceSidebar: React.FC&amp;lt;SourceSidebarProps&amp;gt; = ({\\n  sources = [],\\n  selectedSources = [],\\n  onSourcesChange,\\n  onSelectionChange,\\n  pageType,\\n}) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showTextModal, setShowTextModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showKnowledgeBrowser, setShowKnowledgeBrowser] = useState(false);\\n  const [editingSource, setEditingSource] = useState&amp;lt;Source | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [isSelectAll, setIsSelectAll] = useState(false);\\n\\n  const handleAddSource = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setShowTextModal(true);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleExplore = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setShowKnowledgeBrowser(true);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleSelectAll = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    const newSelectAll = !isSelectAll;\\n    setIsSelectAll(newSelectAll);\\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\\n      if (newSelectAll) {\\n        onSelectionChange(sources.map((s) =&amp;gt; s.id));\\n      } else {\\n        onSelectionChange([]);\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleSourceToggle = (sourceId: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\\n      const newSelection = selectedSources.includes(sourceId)\\n        ? selectedSources.filter((id) =&amp;gt; id !== sourceId)\\n        : [...selectedSources, sourceId];\\n      onSelectionChange(newSelection);\\n      setIsSelectAll(newSelection.length === sources.length &amp;amp;&amp;amp; sources.length &amp;gt; 0);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleSourceClick = (source: Source) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setEditingSource(source);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleUpdateSource = (updatedSource: Source) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\\n      const newSources = sources.map((s) =&amp;gt;\\n        s.id === updatedSource.id ? updatedSource : s\\n      );\\n      onSourcesChange(newSources);\\n    }\\n    setEditingSource(null);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleDeleteSource = (sourceId: string, e: React.MouseEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n    e.stopPropagation(); // 阻止事件冒泡，防止触发编辑弹窗\\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\\n      const newSources = sources.filter((s) =&amp;gt; s.id !== sourceId);\\n      onSourcesChange(newSources);\\n      if (onSelectionChange) {\\n        onSelectionChange(\\n          selectedSources.filter((id) =&amp;gt; {\\n          // 从 metadata 中解析 category\\n          let category: string | undefined;\\n          if (source.metadata) {\\n            if (typeof source.metadata === 'string') {\\n              try {\\n                const parsed = JSON.parse(source.metadata);\\n                category = parsed.category || parsed.sourceCategory;\\n              } catch (e) {\\n                // 忽略解析错误\\n              }\\n            } else if (typeof source.metadata === 'object') {\\n              category = source.metadata.category || source.metadata.sourceCategory;\\n            }\\n          }\\n          // 也检查直接设置的 category\\n          if (source.category) {\\n            category = source.category;\\n          }\\n          return category &amp;amp;&amp;amp; {\\n    if (source.category) {\\n      return source.category;\\n    }\\n    if (source.metadata) {\\n      if (typeof source.metadata === 'string') {\\n        try {\\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(source.metadata);\\n          return parsed.category || parsed.sourceCategory;\\n        } catch (e) {\\n          return undefined;\\n        }\\n      } else if (typeof source.metadata === 'object') {\\n        return source.metadata.category || source.metadata.sourceCategory;\\n      }\\n    }\\n    return undefined;\\n  };\\n\\n  // 获取类别显示名称\\n  const getCategoryDisplayName = (category?: SourceCategory): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    setShowHistoryView(true);\\n    loadHistoryRecords();\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadTechPoints = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await techPointService.getTechPoints({\\n        page: 1,\\n        pageSize: 100\","

                  "lineNumber": 864,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"export const workflowAPI = {\\\\nasync (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt;                   "lineNumber": 932,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"// 主要功能的固定顺序和映射\\\\nconst MAIN_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: '项目管理', icon: Home, path: '/', address: null },\\\\n  { name: '技术包装', icon: MessageCircle, path: '/tech-package', address: 'tech-package' },\\\\n  { name: '技术策略', icon: Target, path: '/tech-strategy', address: 'tech-strategy' },\\\\n  { name: '技术通稿', icon: FileText, path: '/tech-article', address: 'tech-article' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// 管理功能的固定顺序和映射（合并为Agent配置）\\\\nconst MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER = [\\\\n  { name: 'Agent配置', icon: Settings, path: '/ai-management' },\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// Agent配置相关的子页面路径\\\\nconst AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS = [\\\\n  '/ai-roles',\\\\n  '/agent-workflow',\\\\n  '/ai-chat-multi',\\\\n  '/public-page-configs',\\\\n  '/ai-management',\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nconst TopNavigation: React.FC&amp;amp;lt;TopNavigationProps&amp;amp;gt; = ({ currentPageTitle }) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const location = useLocation();\\\\n;\\\",\""

                  "lineNumber": 968,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import api from \\\\\\\"./api\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\nexport interface Source {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  title: string;\\\\n  type: \\\\\\\"knowledge_base\\\\\\\" | \\\\\\\"external\\\\\\\";\\\\n  url?: string;\\\\n  description?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nexport interface SourceInformation {\\\\n  id?: number;\\\\n  source_id: string;\\\\n  title: string;\\\\n  type: \\\\\\\"knowledge_base\\\\\\\" | \\\\\\\"external\\\\\\\";\\\\n  url?: string;\\\\n  description?: string;\\\\n  page_type?: \\\\\\\"tech-package\\\\\\\" | \\\\\\\"press-release\\\\\\\" | \\\\\\\"tech-strategy\\\\\\\" | \\\\\\\"tech-article\\\\\\\";\\\\n  conversation_id?: string;\\\\n  metadata?: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, any&amp;amp;gt;;\\\\n  status?: \\\\\\\"active\\\\\\\" | \\\\\\\"archived\\\\\\\" | \\\\\\\"deleted\\\\\\\";\\\\n  created_by?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nexport interface AddExternalSourceParams {\\\\n  title: string;\\\\n  url?: string;\\\\n  file?: File;\\\\n  description?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nexport interface KnowledgeBaseItem {\\\\n  id: number;\\\\n  title: string;\\\\n  techPoint?: string;\\\\n  description?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nconst sourceService = {\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取知识库列表\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getKnowledgeBaseList(): Promise&amp;amp;lt;{\\\\n    success: boolean;\\\\n    data?: KnowledgeBaseItem[];\\\\n    error?: string;\\\\n  }&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 这里可以调用实际的API，目前先返回空数组\\\\n      // const response = await api.get('/knowledge-base/list');\\\\n      // return response.data;\\\\n      return {\\\\n        success: true,\\\\n        data: [],\\\\n      };\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error(\\\\\\\"获取知识库列表失败:\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n      return {\\\\n        success: false,\\\\n        error: \\\\\\\"获取知识库列表失败\\\\\\\",\\\\n      };\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 添加外部来源\\\\n   */\\\\n  async addExternalSource(\\\\n    params: AddExternalSourceParams\\\\n  ): Promise&amp;amp;lt;{\\\\n    success: boolean;\\\\n    data?: Source;\\\\n    error?: string;\\\\n  }&amp;amp;gt;                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import { useParams, useNavigate } from \\\\\\\"react-router-dom\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport PressReleasePage from \\\\\\\"./PressReleasePage\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport TechPackagePage from \\\\\\\"./TechPackagePage\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport PageTransition from \\\\\\\"../components/PageTransition\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport TopNavigation from \\\\\\\"../components/TopNavigation\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport publicPageConfigService from \\\\\\\"../services/publicPageConfigService\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { PublicPageConfigPreview } from \\\\\\\"../types/publicPageConfig\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { AIRoleConfig } from \\\\\\\"../types/aiRole\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\n// 保留的路由路径，不应该被当作地址配置处理\\\\nconst RESERVED_ROUTES = [\\\\n  'workflow', 'config', 'tech-points', 'car-series', 'ai-search-test',\\\\n  'ai-chat', 'workflow-stats', 'enhanced-workflow-stats', 'history',\\\\n  'ai-roles', 'ai-chat-multi', 'agent-workflow', 'public-page-configs',\\\\n  'ai-management', 'public-chat',\\\\n  // 标准独立页面路由\\\\n  'tech-package', 'tech-strategy', 'tech-article', 'press-release',\\\\n  // 向后兼容的路由（已重定向）\\\\n  'ai-search', 'tech-publish',\\\\n  // 管理页面路由\\\\n  'template-management', 'field-mapping-management'\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\\\\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\\\\n */\\\",\""

                  "lineNumber": 1089,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"const RESERVED_ROUTES = [\\\\n 'field-mapping-management'\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\\\\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\\\\n */\\\\nconst AddressPage: React.FC = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const { address } = useParams&amp;amp;lt;{ address: string }&amp;amp;gt;();\\\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\\\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\\\\n  const [executionResult, setExecutionResult] = useState&amp;amp;lt;any&amp;amp;gt;(null);\\\\n  const [publicConfig, setPublicConfig] = useState&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&amp;amp;gt;(null);\\\\n  const [configLoading, setConfigLoading] = useState(true);\\\\n  const [error, setError] = useState&amp;amp;lt;string | null&amp;amp;gt;(null);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载公开页面配置\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const loadPublicConfig = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      if (!address) {\\\\n        setError('地址参数缺失');\\\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 检查是否是保留路由\\\\n      if (RESERVED_ROUTES.includes(address)) {\\\\n        setError('该路径为系统保留路径');\\\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\\\n        return;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      try {\\\\n        setConfigLoading(true);\\\\n        setError(null);\\\\n        // 根据地址查找配置\\\\n        const configData = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigByAddress(address);\\\\n        if (configData &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; configData.config) {\\\\n          setPublicConfig(configData);\\\\n        } else {\\\\n          setError('未找到对应的页面配置');\\\\n        }\\\\n      } catch (err: any) {\\\\n        console.error('加载配置失败:', err);\\\\n        // 如果404，说明不是有效的地址配置，跳转到首页\\\\n        if (err.response?.status === 404) {\\\\n          navigate('/');\\\\n          return;\\\\n        }\\\\n        setError(err.message || '加载配置失败');\\\\n      } finally {\\\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    loadPublicConfig();\\\\n  }, [address, navigate]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 处理节点执行\\\\n  const handleNodeExecution = async (inputData: any)\\\\n;\\\\n;\\\",\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"// 工作流节点定义\\\\nexport const workflowNodes: WorkflowNode[] = [\\\\n  {\\\\n    id: 'ai_qa',\\\\n    name: 'AI问答',\\\\n    type: 'ai_qa',\\\\n    description: '向AI助手提问获取专业解答',\\\\n    icon: MessageCircle,\\\\n    path: '/node/ai-qa',\\\\n    nextSteps: ['tech_package', 'core_draft', 'speech']\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  {\\\\n    id: 'ai_search',\\\\n    name: 'AI搜索',\\\\n    type: 'ai_search',\\\\n    description: 'AI智能搜索助手',\\\\n    icon: Search,\\\\n    path: '/node/ai-search',\\\\n    nextSteps: ['tech_package', 'core_draft', 'speech']\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  {\\\\n    id: 'tech_package',\\\\n    name: '技术包装',\\\\n    type: 'tech_package',\\\\n    description: '对搜索结果进行技术包装',\\\\n    icon: Package,\\\\n    path: '/node/tech-package',\\\\n    dependencies: ['ai_qa'],\\\\n    nextSteps: ['promotion_strategy', 'core_draft', 'speech']\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  {\\\\n    id: 'promotion_strategy',\\\\n    name: '技术策略',\\\\n    type: 'promotion_strategy',\\\\n    description: '生成技术策略内容',\\\\n    icon: Target,\\\\n    path: '/node/promotion-strategy',\\\\n    dependencies: ['tech_package'],\\\\n    nextSteps: ['core_draft', 'speech']\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  {\\\\n    id: 'core_draft',\\\\n    name: '核心稿件',\\\\n    type: 'core_draft',\\\\n    description: '生成核心文档稿件',\\\\n    icon: FileText,\\\\n    path: '/node/core-draft',\\\\n    dependencies: ['tech_package', 'promotion_strategy'],\\\\n    nextSteps: ['speech']\\\\n  },\\\\n  {\\\\n    id: 'speech',\\\\n    name: '演讲稿',\\\\n    type: 'speech',\\\\n    description: '生成演讲稿内容',\\\\n    icon: Mic,\\\\n    path: '/node/speech',\\\\n    dependencies: ['core_draft'],\\\\n    nextSteps: []\\\\n  }\\\\n];\\\\n\\\\n// 根据节点ID获取节点配置\\\\nexport const getNodeById = (nodeId: string)\\\\n;\\\",\""
                },

                  "lineNumber": 1137,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"// 根据页面类型获取配置\\\\nexport const getPageConfig = (pageType: PageType): PageConfig =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  switch (pageType) {\\\\n    case 'press-release':\\\\n      return pressReleaseConfig;\\\\n    case 'tech-strategy':\\\\n      return techStrategyConfig;\\\\n    case 'tech-article':\\\\n      return techArticleConfig;\\\\n    case 'ai-qa':\\\\n      return aiQaConfig;\\\\n    case 'tech-package':\\\\n    default:\\\\n      return techPackageConfig;\\\\n  }\\\\n};\\\",\""
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 1145,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"class PublicPageConfigService {\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 初始化/更新默认页面配置\\\\n   * 确保技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿这3个页面使用正确的模板并处于开启状态\\\\n   * @param templates 模板HTML映射对象，用于获取模板HTML内容\\\\n   */\\\\n  async ensureDefaultPageConfigs(templates?: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, string&amp;amp;gt;): Promise&amp;amp;lt;PublicPageConfig[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const existingConfigs = await this.getAllConfigs();\\\\n    const updatedConfigs: PublicPageConfig[] = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 定义需要确保的3个页面配置\\\\n    const defaultPageConfigs = [\\\\n      {\\\\n        name: '技术包装',\\\\n        description: '技术内容包装工作流公开页面',\\\\n        address: 'tech-package',\\\\n        templateType: 'ai-chat-source-tools' as const,\\\\n      },\\\\n      {\\\\n        name: '技术策略',\\\\n        description: '技术策略生成工作流公开页面',\\\\n        address: 'tech-strategy',\\\\n        templateType: 'ai-chat-source-tools' as const,\\\\n      },\\\\n      {\\\\n        name: '技术通稿',\\\\n        description: '核心内容生成工作流公开页面',\\\\n        address: 'tech-article',\\\\n        templateType: 'ai-chat-source-tools' as const,\\\\n      },\\\\n    ];\\\\n\\\\n    for (const defaultConfig of defaultPageConfigs)\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\",\""
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 1153,

                },

                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 1161,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"const FieldMappingConfigManager: React.FC = \\\\n\\\\n\\\\n  // 排除AI对话框的标签映射\\\\n  const FEATURE_LABELS: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, string&amp;amp;gt; = {\\\\n    'five-view-analysis': '五看',\\\\n    'three-fix-analysis': '三定',\\\\n    'tech-matrix': '技术矩阵',\\\\n    'propagation-strategy': '传播',\\\\n    'exhibition-video': '展具与视频',\\\\n    'translation': '翻译',\\\\n    'ppt-outline': '技术通稿',\\\\n    'script': '脚本',\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const FEATURE_PAGE_MAP: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, string&amp;amp;gt; = {\\\\n    'five-view-analysis': '技术包装',\\\\n    'three-fix-analysis': '技术包装',\\\\n    'tech-matrix': '技术包装',\\\\n    'propagation-strategy': '技术策略',\\\\n    'exhibition-video': '技术包装',\\\\n    'translation': '技术包装',\\\\n    'ppt-outline': '技术通稿',\\\\n    'script': '技术包装',\\\\n    'speech': '发布会稿',\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const PAGE_LABELS: Record&amp;amp;lt;'tech-package' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article' | 'press-release', string&amp;amp;gt; = {\\\\n    'tech-package': '技术包装',\\\\n    'tech-strategy': '技术策略',\\\\n    'tech-article': '技术通稿',\\\\n    'press-release': '发布稿',\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const loadData = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try\\\\n;\\\\n;\\\",\""

instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n      });\n\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 拓扑排序：确定节点执行顺序\n   */\n  private topologicalSort(nodes: any[], edges: any[]): any[][] {\n    const nodeMap = new Map&lt;string, any&gt;();\n    const inDegree = new Map&lt;string, number&gt;();\n    const dependents = new Map&lt;string, string[]&gt;();\n\n    nodes.forEach(node =&gt; {\n      nodeMap.set(node.id, node);\n      inDegree.set(node.id, 0);\n      dependents.set(node.id, []);\n    });\n\n    edges.forEach(edge =&gt; {\n      const currentInDegree = inDegree.get(edge.target) || 0;\n      inDegree.set(edge.target, currentInDegree + 1);\n\n      const currentDependents = dependents.get(edge.source) || [];\n      currentDependents.push(edge.target);\n      dependents.set(edge.source, currentDependents);\n    });\n\n    const result: any[][] = [];\n    const queue: any[] = [];\n    const processed = new Set&lt;string&gt;();\n\n    // 找到所有入度为0的节点（起始节点）\n &gt; 0) {\n        result.push(level);\n      }\n    }\n\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行单个节点\n   */\n  private async executeNode(\n    node: any,\n    sharedContext: Record&lt;string,   });\n\n    return {\n      inputs: results,\n      count: results.length,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行Agent节点\n   */\n  private async executeAgentNode(\n    node: any,\n    sharedContext: obj?.[key], outputValue);\n        }\n      } else {\n        outputValue = sharedContext;\n      }\n\n      if (!sharedContext.outputs) {\n        sharedContext.outputs = {};\n      }\n      sharedContext.outputs[outputName] = outputValue;\n\n      results.push({\n        name: outputName,\n        value: outputValue,\n        type: outputParam.type || typeof outputValue,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return {\n      outputs: results,\n      count: results.length,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 准备节点输入\n   */\n  private prepareNodeInput(\n    node: any,\n    sharedContext: Record&lt;string, any&gt;\n  ): Record&lt;string, any&gt; {\n    const nodeInput: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n\n    // 合并静态输入\n    if (node.data?.inputs) {\n      Object.assign(nodeInput, node.data.inputs);\n    }\n\n    // 合并共享上下文\n    Object.assign(nodeInput, sharedContext);\n\n    // 合并上游节点输出\n    if (node.data?.inputSources) {\n      for (const [field, source] of Object.entries(node.data.inputSources as Record&lt;string, any&gt;)) {\n        if (source.type === 'static') {\n          nodeInput[field] = source.value;\n        } else if (source.type === 'node_output') {\n          const upstreamOutput = sharedContext.nodeOutputs?.[source.nodeId];\n          if (upstreamOutput) {\n            nodeInput[field] = source.outputField\n              ? upstreamOutput[source.outputField]\n              : upstreamOutput;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    return nodeInput;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取工作流执行历史\n   */\n  async getExecutionHistory(workflowId: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowExecution[]&gt; {\n    return await workflowExecutionModel.update(executionId, updates);\n  }\n\n  private buildFallbackOutput(workflow: AgentWorkflow, workflowInput: Record&lt;string, any&gt;) {\n    const query =\n      workflowInput?.input ||\n      workflowInput?.query ||\n      workflowInput?.summary ||\n      (typeof workflowInput === 'string' ? workflowInput : '');\n\n    const contentLines: string[] = [];\n    if (query) {\n      contentLines.push(&#96;根据您的输入：${query}&#96;);\n    } else {\n      contentLines.push('尚未获取到具体的用户输入。');\n    }\n\n    const hasConfiguredAgent = this.workflowHasConfiguredAgent(workflow);\n    if (hasConfiguredAgent) {\n      contentLines.push('工作流已启动，但当前环境尚未接入实际的执行引擎。');\n      contentLines.push('如需获得真实结果，请在后端集成 Dify 或实现 Agent 执行逻辑。');\n    } else {\n      contentLines.push('检测到工作流中尚未配置有效的 Agent 节点。');\n      contentLines.push('请在“工作流”页面为 Agent 节点选择对应的智能体后再试。');\n    }\n\n    return {\n      message: '工作流执行完成（模拟响应）',\n      content: contentLines.join('\\n'),\n      metadata: {\n        hasConfiguredAgent,\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  private workflowHasConfiguredAgent(workflow: AgentWorkflow): boolean {\n    try {\n      const nodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\n      return nodes.some(\n        (node: any) =&gt;\n          node?.type === 'agent' &amp;&amp;\n          node?.data &amp;&amp;\n          node.data.agentId &amp;&amp;\n          String(node.data.agentId).trim().length &gt; 0,\n      );\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.warn('解析工作流节点失败，无法判断 Agent 配置状态', { workflowId: workflow.id, error });\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建模板\n   */\n  async createTemplate(data: any): Promise&lt;WorkflowTemplate&gt; {\n    console.log('[AgentWorkflowService] createTemplate 接收到的数据:', {\n      name: data.name,\n      category: data.category,\n      hasWorkflowStructure: !!data.workflowStructure,\n      hasWorkflow_structure: !!data.workflow_structure,\n      workflowStructureType: typeof data.workflowStructure,\n      workflowStructureKeys: data.workflowStructure &amp;&amp; typeof data.workflowStructure === 'object' ? Object.keys(data.workflowStructure) : null,\n    });\n    \n    // 确保 workflowStructure 字段名正确（前端发送的是 workflowStructure，后端模型期望 workflow_structure）\n    const createData: any = {\n      name: data.name,\n      description: data.description,\n      category: data.category,\n      thumbnail: data.thumbnail,\n      metadata: data.metadata,\n      is_public: data.isPublic !== undefined ? data.isPublic : data.is_public,\n      // 优先使用 workflowStructure（前端发送的字段名），如果没有则使用 workflow_structure\n      workflow_structure: data.workflowStructure || data.workflow_structure,\n    };\n    \n    // 如果有 id，也传递\n    if (data.id) {\n      createData.id = data.id;\n    }\n    \n    console.log('[AgentWorkflowService] 转换后的数据:', {\n      hasWorkflowStructure: !!createData.workflow_structure,\n      workflowStructureType: typeof createData.workflow_structure,\n      workflowStructureKeys: createData.workflow_structure &amp;&amp; typeof createData.workflow_structure === 'object' ?                   "lineNumber": 15519,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&amp;lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&amp;gt; = \\n\\n\\n  // 加载页面类型的来源信息（作为基础来源，始终保留）\\n  const loadPageTypeSources = useCallback(async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 使用有效的 pageType（可能包含项目ID）\\n      const pageTypeToLoad = projectId ? &amp;#96;${config.pageType}-project-${projectId}&amp;#96; : config.pageType;\\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 开始加载页面类型来源信息:', pageTypeToLoad);\\n      const sourceResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByPageType(pageTypeToLoad);\\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载结果:', {\\n        success: sourceResult.success,\\n        count: sourceResult.data?.length || 0,\\n        error: sourceResult.error\\n      });\\n      \\n      if (sourceResult.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; sourceResult.data &amp;amp;&amp;amp; sourceResult.data.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载到的来源:', sourceResult.data.map(s =&amp;gt; ({ id: s.id, title: s.title })));\\n        setSources(prev =&amp;gt; {\\n          // 合并现有来源和数据库中的来源，避免重复\\n          const sourceMap = new Map&amp;lt;string, Source&amp;gt;();\\n          // 先添加现有来源\\n          prev.forEach(s =&amp;gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\\n          // 再添加数据库中的来源（会覆盖重复的）\\n          sourceResult.data!.forEach(s =&amp;gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\\n          const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\\n          console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length);\\n          return merged;\\n        });\\n      } else if (sourceResult.error) {\\n        console.warn('[SourceInfo] 加载失败:', sourceResult.error);\\n      } else {\\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 没有找到页面类型的来源信息');\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"[SourceInfo] 加载页面类型来源信息失败:\\\", error);\\n      // 不阻止页面加载，只记录错误\\n    }\\n  }, [config.pageType, projectId]);\\n\\n  // 检查 URL 参数中的 sourceId 并自动选中（支持多个 sourceId）\\n;\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&amp;lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&amp;gt; = \\nconst loadConversationDetail = \\nasync (\\n      conversationId: string,\\n      options?: {\\n        append?: boolean;\\n        before?: string;\\n      }\\n    ) =&amp;gt; {\\n\\n        \\n        // 从数据库加载该对话的来源信息（仅在非追加模式下加载，避免重复）\\n        if (!options?.append) {\\n          try {\\n            console.log('[SourceInfo] 开始加载对话来源信息:', conversationId);\\n            const sourceResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByConversationId(conversationId);\\n            console.log('[SourceInfo] 对话来源加载结果:', {\\n              success: sourceResult.success,\\n              count: sourceResult.data?.length || 0,\\n              error: sourceResult.error\\n            });\\n            \\n            const dbSources = sourceResult.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; sourceResult.data ?                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"/**\\\\n * AI问答页面\\\\n * 复用tech-package系统构建，但作为独立页面可进行定制化改造\\\\n */\\\\nimport React from \\\\\\\"react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport BaseAISearchPage from \\\\\\\"../components/ai-search/BaseAISearchPage\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { aiQaConfig } from \\\\\\\"../configs/pageConfigs\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\nconst AIQAPage: React.FC = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  return &amp;amp;lt;BaseAISearchPage config={aiQaConfig} /&amp;amp;gt;;\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport default AIQAPage;\\\\n\\\\n\\\",\""
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 1314,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import api from './api';\\\\nimport { agentWorkflowService } from './agentWorkflowService';\\\\nimport { techPointService } from './techPointService';\\\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from './knowledgePointService';\\\\nimport {\\\\n  Conversation,\\\\n  Message,\\\\n  OutputContent,\\\\n  WorkflowConfig,\\\\n  FileUploadResponse,\\\\n  CreateConversationRequest,\\\\n  SendMessageRequest,\\\\n  ApiResponse,\\\\n  Source,\\\\n  FieldMappingConfig,\\\\n} from '../types/aiSearch';\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * AI问答服务\\\\n */\\\\nclass AiSearchService {\\\\n  private normalizeMessage(raw: any): Message {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      ...raw,\\\\n      createdAt: raw?.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取配置的工作流\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowConfig | null&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\\\\n      const params = pageType ? &amp;amp;#96;?pageType=${pageType}&amp;amp;#96; : '';\\\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;amp;#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\\\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\\\\n        // 获取工作流详情\\\\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\\\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\\\n        if (workflow) {\\\\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\\\\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\\\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      return null;\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\\\n      return null;\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\\\n   */\\\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\\\n    \\\\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\\\n    \\\\n    return {\\\\n      id: workflow.id,\\\\n      name: workflow.name,\\\\n      description: workflow.description,\\\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\\\n        required: p.required || false,\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\n      })),\\\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\n      })),\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取文件列表\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\\\n    category?: string;\\\",\""
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 1347,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"class AiSearchService {\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 上传文件\\\\n   */\\\\n  async uploadFiles(files: File[], pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;amp;lt;FileUploadResponse[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const formData = new FormData();\\\\n      files.forEach((file) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        formData.append('files', file);\\\\n      });\\\\n      \\\\n      // 如果提供了pageType，添加到formData\\\\n      if (pageType) {\\\\n        formData.append('pageType', pageType);\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await api.post('/ai-search/upload', formData, {\\\\n        headers: {\\\\n          'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data',\\\\n        },\\\\n      });\\\\n\\\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\\\n        return response.data.data;\\\\n      }\\\\n      throw new Error(response.data.error || '文件上传失败');\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\\\\n      throw error;\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 合并知识库内容\\\\n   */\\\\n  async mergeKnowledgeBaseContent(sources: Source[]): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const knowledgeBaseSources = sources.filter((s) =&amp;amp;gt; s.type === 'knowledge_base');\\\\n  }\\\",\""
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 1355,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import React, { useState } from \\\\\\\"react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { X, Upload, Link as LinkIcon, Trash2 } from \\\\\\\"lucide-react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { Source } from \\\\\\\"./SourceSidebar\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { aiSearchService } from \\\\\\\"../../services/aiSearchService\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\ninterface AddSourceModalProps {\\\\n  onClose: () =&amp;amp;gt; void;\\\\n  onAddExternalSource: (source: Omit&amp;amp;lt;Source, \\\\\\\"id\\\\\\\"&amp;amp;gt;) =&amp;amp;gt; void;\\\\n  pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article';\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nconst AddSourceModal: React.FC&amp;amp;lt;AddSourceModalProps&amp;amp;gt; = ({\\\\n  onClose,\\\\n  onAddExternalSource,\\\\n  pageType,\\\\n})\\\\n;\\\",\""
                },

setGlobalErrorDetail(null);\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const reportError = useCallback((message: string, detail?: unknown) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setGlobalError(message);\\n    if (!detail) {\\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(null);\\n      return;\\n    }\\n\\n    if (typeof detail === \\\"string\\\") {\\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(detail);\\n      return;\\n    }\\n\\n    if (detail instanceof Error) console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载到的来源:', sourceResult.data.map(s =&amp;gt; ({ id: s.id, title: s.title })));\\n        setSources(prev =&amp;gt; {\\n          // 合并现有来源和数据库中的来源，避免重复\\n          const sourceResult.data!.forEach(s =&amp;gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\\n          const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\\n          console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length);\\n          return merged;\\n        });\\n      } else if (sourceResult.error) {\\n        console.warn('[SourceInfo] 加载失败:', sourceResult.error);\\n      } else {\\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] sources.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 检测到 URL 参数中的 sourceIds:', urlSourceIds);\\n      \\n      const newSelectedIds: string[] = [];\\n      let hasNewSelection = false;\\n      \\n      // 检查每个 sourceId 是否存在于来源中，并添加到选中列表\\n      urlSourceIds.forEach(sourceId =&amp;gt; {\\n        const foundSource = sources.find(s =&amp;gt; s.id === sourceId);\\n        if (foundSource) {\\n    const loadDefaultWorkflowFromMapping = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n      try {\\n        const mappings = await aiSearchService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs();\\n        // 查找该 pageType 对应的第一个工作流（作为默认工作流）\\n        // 支持向后兼容：press-release 也匹配 speech\\n        const pageKeys = config.pageType === 'press-release' \\n          ? w.id === workflowId)) {\\n              setDefaultWorkflowFromMapping(workflowId);\\n              console.log(&amp;#96;[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置找到 ${config.pageType} 的默认工作流:&amp;#96;, workflowId);\\n              return;\\n            }\\n          }\\n        }\\n        \\n        // 如果没有找到匹配的，尝试使用该工作流配置中的第一个工作流\\n        // 查找所有为该 pageType 配置的工作流，使用第一个\\n        const allWorkflowsForPage = new Set&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;();\\n        for (const mapping of mappings) {\\n          const featureObjects = Array.isArray(mapping.config?.featureObjects) \\n            ? mapping.config.featureObjects \\n            : [];\\n          \\n          const hasMatchingPageType = featureObjects.some((f: any) =&amp;gt; \\n            f.pageType &amp;amp;&amp;amp; pageKeys.includes(f.pageType)\\n          );\\n          \\n          if (hasMatchingPageType) {\\n            allWorkflowsForPage.add(mapping.workflowId);\\n          }\\n        }\\n        \\n        // 使用第一个匹配的工作流\\n        if (allWorkflowsForPage.size &amp;gt; 0) {\\n          const firstWorkflowId = Array.from(allWorkflowsForPage)[0];\\n          if (availableWorkflows.some(w =&amp;gt; w.id === firstWorkflowId)) {\\n            setDefaultWorkflowFromMapping(firstWorkflowId);\\n            console.log(&amp;#96;[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置找到 ${config.pageType} 的默认工作流（使用工作流配置）:&amp;#96;, firstWorkflowId);\\n            return;\\n          }\\n        }\\n        \\n        setDefaultWorkflowFromMapping(null);\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        console.error('[BaseAISearchPage] 加载字段映射配置失败:', error);\\n        setDefaultWorkflowFromMapping(null);\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    if (availableWorkflows.length &amp;gt;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\\nimport { Upload, Search, X, FileText, Trash2, Check, ChevronDown, FileCode, Eye, Save, Send, Loader2, User, Bot, Brain } from 'lucide-react';\\nimport { Project } from '../types/project';\\nimport projectService from from '../types/knowledgePoint';\\nimport { FileUploadResponse } from '../types/aiSearch';\\nimport { PublicKnowledgeFile } from '../types/publicKnowledge';\\nimport api from '../services/api';\\nimport { workflowAPI } from '../services/api';\\nimport { configService } from '../services/configService';\\n\\ninterface SourceInformation {\\n  id: number;\\n  source_id: string;\\n  title: string;\\n  type: 'knowledge_base' | 'external';\\n  url?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  created_at: string;\\n}\\n\\nconst ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const { projectId } = useParams&amp;lt;{ projectId: string }&amp;gt;();\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const fileInputRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLInputElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const techPointSelectorRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLDivElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  \\n  const [project, setProject] = useState&amp;lt;Project | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [sources, setSources] = useState&amp;lt;SourceInformation[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');\\n  const [selectedTechPoints, setSelectedTechPoints] = useState&amp;lt;number[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [selectedKnowledgePoints, setSelectedKnowledgePoints] = useState&amp;lt;number[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [techPoints, setTechPoints] = useState&amp;lt;TechPoint[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [knowledgePoints, setKnowledgePoints] = useState&amp;lt;KnowledgePoint[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [publicKnowledgeFiles, setPublicKnowledgeFiles] = useState&amp;lt;PublicKnowledgeFile[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [selectedPublicFiles, setSelectedPublicFiles] = useState&amp;lt;number[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [isUploading, useState(false);\\n  const [techPointSearch, setTechPointSearch] = useState('');\\n  const [knowledgeBaseSearch, setKnowledgeBaseSearch] = useState('');\\n  const [publicFileSearch, setPublicFileSearch] = useState('');\\n  const [configuredResources, setConfiguredResources] = useState&amp;lt;{\\n    files: SourceInformation[];\\n    internetInfo: SourceInformation[];\\n    techPoints: TechPoint[];\\n    knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoint[];\\n  }&amp;gt;({\\n    files: [],\\n    internetInfo: [],\\n    techPoints: [],\\n    knowledgePoints: []\\n  });\\n  const [isTranslating, setIsTranslating] = useState(false);\\n  const [translatedContent, setTranslatedContent] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('');\\n  const [showReviewModal, setShowReviewModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [reviewContent, setReviewContent] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('');\\n  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);\\n  const [showTechPointModal, setShowTechPointModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showFileUploadModal, setShowFileUploadModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showKnowledgePointModal, setShowKnowledgePointModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showInternetInfoModal, setShowInternetInfoModal] = useState(false);\\n  const fileInputRefModal = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLInputElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  \\n  // AI问答相关状态\\n  const [aiMessages, setAiMessages] = useState&amp;lt;Array&amp;lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&amp;gt;&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [aiInputMessage, setAiInputMessage] = useState('');\\n  const [aiLoading, setAiLoading] = useState(false);\\n  const [aiConversationId, setAiConversationId] = useState&amp;lt;string | undefined&amp;gt;(undefined);\\n  const aiMessagesEndRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLDivElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (projectId) {\\n      loadProject();\\n      loadSources();\\n      loadTechPoints();\\n      loadPublicKnowledgeFiles();\\n    }\\n  }, [projectId]);\\n\\n  // AI消息自动滚动到底部\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    aiMessagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\\n  }, [aiMessages]);\\n\\n  // AI问答发送消息\\n  const handleAISendMessage = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!aiInputMessage.trim() || aiLoading) return;\\n\\n    const userMessage = {\\n      id: Date.now().toString(),\\n      content: aiInputMessage.trim(),\\n      sender: 'user' as const,\\n      timestamp: new Date(),\\n    };\\n\\n    setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;gt; [...prev, userMessage]);\\n    const currentMessage = aiInputMessage.trim();\\n    setAiInputMessage('');\\n    setAiLoading(true);\\n\\n    try {\\n      // 获取智能工作流AI问答的Dify配置\\n      const aiQAConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig('smart-workflow-ai-qa');\\n\\n      // 构建上下文信息（包含项目资源）\\n      const contextMessages = aiMessages.map((msg) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        role: msg.sender === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant',\\n        content: msg.content,\\n      }));\\n\\n      // 添加项目资源信息到上下文\\n      const resourceContext: string[] = [];\\n      if (configuredResources.techPoints.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        resourceContext.push(&amp;#96;已选择的技术点：${configuredResources.techPoints.map(tp =&amp;gt; tp.name).join('、')}&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n      if (configuredResources.files.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        resourceContext.push(&amp;#96;已上传的文件：${configuredResources.files.map(f =&amp;gt; f.title).join('、')}&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n      if (configuredResources.knowledgePoints.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        resourceContext.push(&amp;#96;已选择的知识点：${configuredResources.knowledgePoints.map(kp =&amp;gt; kp.title).join('、')}&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n\\n      const inputs: any = {\\n        context: contextMessages,\\n      };\\n\\n      if (resourceContext.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        inputs.projectResources = resourceContext.join('\\\\n');\\n      }\\n\\n      // 调用AI问答API\\n      const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\\n        currentMessage,\\n        inputs,\\n        (aiQAConfig &amp;amp;&amp;amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\\n        aiConversationId || undefined\\n      );\\n\\n      let responseContent = '抱歉，我无法处理您的请求。';\\n\\n      if (result.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; result.data) {\\n        responseContent = result.data.answer || result.data.result || responseContent;\\n        // 更新conversationId以支持多轮对话\\n        if (result.data.conversation_id) {\\n          setAiConversationId(result.data.conversation_id);\\n        }\\n      } else {\\n        responseContent = result.error || responseContent;\\n      }\\n\\n      const aiMessage = {\\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\\n        content: responseContent,\\n        sender: 'ai' as const,\\n        timestamp: new Date(),\\n      };\\n\\n      setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;gt; [...prev, aiMessage]);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('AI问答API调用失败:', error);\\n      const errorMessage = {\\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\\n        content: '抱歉，AI服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。',\\n        sender: 'ai' as const,\\n        timestamp: new Date(),\\n      };\\n      setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;gt; [...prev, errorMessage]);\\n    } finally {\\n      setAiLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles();\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data) {\\n        setPublicKnowledgeFiles(response.data);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载公共知识库文件失败:', error);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 更新已配置的资源清单\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 区分文件来源和互联网信息点\\n    // 文件来源：通过文件上传功能上传的文件（URL是文件路径，不是http链接）\\n    // 互联网信息点：来自\\\"检索信息\\\"模块的来源（排除上传的文件，只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源）\\n    const files = sources.filter(s =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 文件上传的通常URL是文件路径，不是http链接\\n      return s.type === 'external' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; s.url &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('http') &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('https');\\n    });\\n    // 互联网信息点：排除上传的文件，只包含真正的互联网信息（http/https链接或文本来源）\\n    const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的）\\n      if (s.url &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('http') &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('https')) {\\n        return false;\\n      }\\n      // 包含http/https链接的来源，或者没有URL的文本来源（通过检索信息添加的）\\n      return true;\\n    });\\n    \\n    setConfiguredResources({\\n      files: files,\\n      internetInfo: internetInfo,\\n      techPoints: techPoints.filter(tp =&amp;gt; selectedTechPoints.includes(tp.id)),\\n      knowledgePoints: knowledgePoints.filter(kp =&amp;gt; selectedKnowledgePoints.includes(kp.id))\\n    });\\n  }, [sources, selectedTechPoints, selectedKnowledgePoints, techPoints, knowledgePoints]);\\n\\n  const loadProject = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\n    try {\\n      const response = await projectService.getProjectById(parseInt(projectId));\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data) {\\n        setProject(response.data);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadSources = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\n    try {\\n      // 获取项目的来源信息\\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\\n        params: {\\n          pageType: &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96;,\\n          page: 1,\\n          pageSize: 100\\n        }\\n      });\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        setSources(response.data.data);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载来源信息失败:', error);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadTechPoints = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await techPointService.getTechPoints({\\n        page: 1,\\n        pageSize: 100\\n      });\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data) {\\n        setTechPoints(response.data.data || []);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载技术点失败:', error);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadKnowledgePoints = async (techPointIds: number[]) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (techPointIds.length === 0) {\\n      setKnowledgePoints([]);\\n      return;\\n    }\\n    try {\\n      // 加载所有选中技术点的知识点\\n      const allKnowledgePoints: KnowledgePoint[] = [];\\n      for (const techPointId of techPointIds) {\\n        const response = await knowledgePointService.getByTechPointId(techPointId, {\\n          page: 1,\\n          pageSize: 100\\n        });\\n        if (response.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data) {\\n          // response.data 是知识点数组\\n          allKnowledgePoints.push(...response.data);\\n        }\\n      }\\n      setKnowledgePoints(allKnowledgePoints);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载知识点失败:', error);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (selectedTechPoints.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      loadKnowledgePoints(selectedTechPoints);\\n    } else {\\n      setKnowledgePoints([]);\\n    }\\n  }, [selectedTechPoints]);\\n\\n  // 点击外部关闭下拉菜单\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (techPointSelectorRef.current &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !techPointSelectorRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {\\n        setShowTechPointSelector(false);\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);\\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);\\n    };\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleFileUpload = async (files: FileList | null) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!files || files.length === 0 || !projectId) return;\\n    \\n    setIsUploading(true);\\n    try {\\n      const fileArray = Array.from(files);\\n      // 上传文件\\n      const uploadedFiles = await aiSearchService.uploadFiles(fileArray, undefined);\\n      \\n      // 创建来源信息记录\\n      for (const uploadedFile of uploadedFiles) {\\n        // 如果markdown内容太长，只保存摘要\\n        let description = &amp;#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(uploadedFile.size)}&amp;#96;;\\n        if (uploadedFile.markdownContent) {\\n          // 只保存前500个字符作为描述，完整内容保留在文件记录中\\n          const contentPreview = uploadedFile.markdownContent.length &amp;gt; 500\\n            ? uploadedFile.markdownContent.substring(0, 500) + '...'\\n            : uploadedFile.markdownContent;\\n          description = contentPreview;\\n        }\\n        \\n        await api.post('/source-information', {\\n          source_id: uploadedFile.id || uploadedFile.fileId || &amp;#96;file_${Date.now()}&amp;#96;,\\n          title: uploadedFile.name,\\n          type: 'external',\\n          url: uploadedFile.url,\\n          description: description,\\n          page_type: &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96;,\\n          conversation_id: null\\n        });\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 重新加载来源列表\\n      await loadSources();\\n      \\n      // 清空文件输入\\n      if (fileInputRefModal.current) {\\n        fileInputRefModal.current.value = '';\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\\n      alert('文件上传失败，请重试');\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsUploading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleDeleteSource = async (sourceId: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!confirm('确定要删除这个来源吗？')) return;\\n    \\n    try {\\n      await api.delete(&amp;#96;/source-information/${sourceId}&amp;#96;);\\n      await loadSources();\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('删除来源失败:', error);\\n      alert('删除来源失败');\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024) return bytes + ' B';\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';\\n    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';\\n  };\\n\\n  const formatDate = (dateString?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!dateString) return '';\\n    const date = new Date(dateString);\\n    return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN', {\\n      year: 'numeric',\\n      month: 'long',\\n      day: 'numeric'\\n    });\\n  };\\n\\n  // 过滤检索信息：排除上传的文件，只显示真正的检索信息（http/https链接或文本来源）\\n  const filteredSources = sources.filter(source =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的，不是http链接）\\n    if (source.url &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !source.url.startsWith('http') &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !source.url.startsWith('https')) {\\n      return false;\\n    }\\n    // 只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源\\n    return true;\\n  }).filter(source =&amp;gt;\\n    source.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||\\n    source.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())\\n  );\\n\\n  const filteredTechPoints = techPoints.filter(tp =&amp;gt;\\n    tp.name.toLowerCase().includes(techPointSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\\n    tp.description?.toLowerCase().includes(techPointSearch.toLowerCase())\\n  );\\n\\n  const filteredKnowledgePoints = knowledgePoints.filter(kp =&amp;gt;\\n    kp.title.toLowerCase().includes(knowledgeBaseSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\\n    kp.content?.toLowerCase().includes(knowledgeBaseSearch.toLowerCase())\\n  );\\n\\n  const filteredPublicFiles = publicKnowledgeFiles.filter(file =&amp;gt;\\n    file.name.toLowerCase().includes(publicFileSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\\n    file.description?.toLowerCase().includes(publicFileSearch.toLowerCase())\\n  );\\n\\n  const toggleTechPoint = (techPointId: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setSelectedTechPoints(prev =&amp;gt;\\n      prev.includes(techPointId)\\n        ? prev.filter(id =&amp;gt; id !== techPointId)\\n        : [...prev, techPointId]\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  const toggleKnowledgePoint = (knowledgePointId: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setSelectedKnowledgePoints(prev =&amp;gt;\\n      prev.includes(knowledgePointId)\\n        ? prev.filter(id =&amp;gt; id !== knowledgePointId)\\n        : [...prev, knowledgePointId]\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  const togglePublicFile = async (fileId: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (selectedPublicFiles.includes(fileId)) {\\n      setSelectedPublicFiles(prev =&amp;gt; prev.filter(id =&amp;gt; id !== fileId));\\n    } else {\\n      setSelectedPublicFiles(prev =&amp;gt; [...prev, fileId]);\\n      // 将选中的公共知识库文件添加到项目来源中\\n      if (projectId) {\\n        const file = publicKnowledgeFiles.find(f =&amp;gt; f.id === fileId);\\n        if (file) {\\n          try {\\n            await api.post('/source-information', {\\n              source_id: &amp;#96;public_kb_${file.id}&amp;#96;,\\n              title: file.name,\\n              type: 'knowledge_base',\\n              url: file.file_url || file.file_path,\\n              description: file.description || &amp;#96;公共知识库文件: ${file.name}&amp;#96;,\\n              page_type: &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96;,\\n              conversation_id: null\\n            });\\n            // 重新加载来源列表\\n            await loadSources();\\n          } catch (error) {\\n            console.error('添加公共知识库文件到项目失败:', error);\\n          }\\n        }\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleTechnicalTranslation = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setIsTranslating(true);\\n    setTranslatedContent('');\\n    \\n    try {\\n      const contentParts: string[] = [];\\n      \\n      // 1. 拼接已选择的技术点\\n      if (configuredResources.techPoints.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n                   "lineNumber": 36071,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class AgentOrchestrator {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行 Agent（核心方法）\\n   * @param roleId 角色ID\\n   * @param query 用户查询\\n   * @param conversationId 对话ID（可选，如果不存在会生成新的）\\n   * @param context 上下文数据（用于变量替换）\\n   * @returns 执行结果\\n   */\\n  async executeAgent(\\n    roleId: string,\\n    query: string,\\n    conversationId: string = '',\\n    context: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {}\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;AgentExecutionResult&amp;gt; {\\n    const startTime = Date.now();\\n    const MAX_EXECUTION_TIME = 360000; // 6分钟总体超时（留出缓冲给前端7分钟超时）\\n    \\n    // 检查超时的辅助函数\\n    const checkTimeout = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;\\n      if (elapsed &amp;gt; MAX_EXECUTION_TIME) {\\n        throw new Error(&amp;#96;Agent执行超时：已执行 ${Math.round(elapsed / 1000)} 秒，超过最大执行时间 ${MAX_EXECUTION_TIME / 1000} 秒&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n    };\\n    \\n    // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\\n    checkTimeout();\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\\n    if (!role) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    if (!role.agentConfig) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;Agent配置不存在: ${roleId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\\n\\n    // 2. 生成或使用 conversationId\\n    const finalConversationId = conversationId || this.generateConversationId();\\n\\n    // 3. 渲染 System Prompt\\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\\n      context\\n    );\\n\\n    // 4. 获取上下文消息\\n    checkTimeout();\\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\\n      finalConversationId,\\n      config.contextStrategy,\\n      query\\n    );\\n\\n    // 5. 构建完整消息列表\\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [];\\n    \\n    // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\\n    if (config.contextStrategy.includeSystemPrompt || contextMessages.length === 0) {\\n      messages.push({\\n        role: 'system',\\n        content: systemPrompt\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import api from './api';\\nimport { agentWorkflowService } from './agentWorkflowService';\\nimport { techPointService } from './techPointService';\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from './knowledgePointService';\\nimport {\\n  Conversation,\\n  Message,\\n  OutputContent,\\n  WorkflowConfig,\\n  FileUploadResponse,\\n  CreateConversationRequest,\\n  SendMessageRequest,\\n  ApiResponse,\\n  Source,\\n  FieldMappingConfig,\\n} from '../types/aiSearch';\\n\\n/**\\n * AI问答服务\\n */\\nclass AiSearchService {\\n  private normalizeMessage(raw: any): Message {\\n    return {\\n      ...raw,\\n      createdAt: raw?.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取配置的工作流\\n   */\\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowConfig | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\\n      const params = pageType ? &amp;#96;?pageType=${pageType}&amp;#96; : '';\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&amp;#96;);\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\\n        // 获取工作流详情\\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\n        if (workflow) {\\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\\n        }\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\n      }\\n      \\n      return null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\n   */\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\n    \\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\n    \\n    return {\\n      id: workflow.id,\\n      name: workflow.name,\\n      description: workflow.description,\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\n        required: p.required || false,\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取文件列表\\n   */\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\n    category?: string;\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"// 配置multer用于文件上传\\nconst storage = multer.diskStorage({\\n  destination: (req, file, cb) =&amp;gt; {\\n    cb(null, 'uploads/ai-search/');\\n  },\\n  filename: (req, file, cb) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 生成唯一文件名，但保留原始扩展名\\n    const uniqueSuffix = Date.now() + '-' + Math.round(Math.random() * 1E9);\\n    const ext = path.extname(file.originalname);\\n    cb(null, &amp;#96;${uniqueSuffix}${ext}&amp;#96;);\\n  },\\n});\\n\\nconst upload = multer({\\n  storage: storage,\\n  limits: {\\n    fileSize: 10 * 1024 * 1024, // 10MB\\n  },\\n  fileFilter: (req: Request, file: Express.Multer.File, cb: multer.FileFilterCallback) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 允许的文件类型：PDF, PPT, txt, markdown, word\\n    const allowedTypes = [\\n      'application/pdf',\\n      'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint', // .ppt\\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation', // .pptx\\n      'application/msword', // .doc\\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', // .docx\\n      'text/plain',\\n      'text/markdown',\\n    ];\\n    // 也允许通过扩展名判断\\n    const allowedExtensions = ['.pdf', '.ppt', '.pptx', '.doc', '.docx', '.txt', '.md', '.markdown'];\\n    const fileExtension = require('path').extname(file.originalname).toLowerCase();\\n    \\n    if (allowedTypes.includes(file.mimetype) || allowedExtensions.includes(fileExtension)) {\\n      cb(null, true);\\n    } else {\\n      cb(new Error(&amp;#96;不支持的文件类型: ${file.mimetype}。支持的类型：PDF, PPT, txt, markdown, word&amp;#96;));\\n    }\\n  },\\n});\\n\\n// 确保上传目录存在\\nconst uploadDir = 'uploads/ai-search/';\\nif (!fs.existsSync(uploadDir)) {\\n  fs.mkdirSync(uploadDir, { recursive: true });\\n}\\n\\n// 初始化服务\\nconst aiSearchService = new AiSearchService();\\nconst fieldMappingService = new FieldMappingService();\\nconst createConversationUseCase = new CreateConversationUseCase(aiSearchService);\\nconst getConversationsUseCase = new GetConversationsUseCase(aiSearchService);\\nconst getConversationDetailUseCase = new GetConversationDetailUseCase(aiSearchService);\\nconst sendMessageUseCase = new SendMessageUseCase;\","

                  "lineNumber": 12101,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import api from './api';\\nimport { agentWorkflowService } from './agentWorkflowService';\\nimport { techPointService } from './techPointService';\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from './knowledgePointService';\\nimport {\\n  Conversation,\\n  Message,\\n  OutputContent,\\n  WorkflowConfig,\\n  FileUploadResponse,\\n  CreateConversationRequest,\\n  SendMessageRequest,\\n  ApiResponse,\\n  Source,\\n  FieldMappingConfig,\\n} from '../types/aiSearch';\\n\\n/**\\n * AI问答服务\\n */\\nclass AiSearchService {\\n  private normalizeMessage(raw: any): Message {\\n    return {\\n      ...raw,\\n      createdAt: raw?.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取配置的工作流\\n   */\\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowConfig | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\\n      const params = pageType ? &amp;#96;?pageType=${pageType}&amp;#96; : '';\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&amp;#96;);\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\\n        // 获取工作流详情\\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\n        if (workflow) {\\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\\n        }\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\n      }\\n      \\n      return null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\n   */\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\n    \\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\n    \\n    return {\\n      id: workflow.id,\\n      name: workflow.name,\\n      description: workflow.description,\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\n        required: p.required || false,\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取文件列表\\n   */\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\n    category?: string;\","

{\\n    e.preventDefault();\\n    if (sourceType === \\\"url\\\") {\\n      if (!url.trim()) {\\n        alert(\\\"请输入URL\\\");\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      onAddExternalSource({\\n        title: title.trim() || url,\\n        type: \\\"external\\\",\\n        url: url.trim(),\\n        description: description.trim(),\\n      });\\n      setUrl(\\\"\\\");\\n      setTitle(\\\"\\\");\\n      setDescription(\\\"\\\");\\n      onClose();\\n    } else {\\n      if (files.length === 0) {\\n        alert(\\\"请选择文件\\\");\\n        return;\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 上传文件到服务器\\n      setIsUploading(true);\\n      try {\\n        const uploadedFiles = await aiSearchService.uploadFiles(files, pageType);\\n        \\n        // 文件已保存到数据库，不需要通过onAddExternalSource添加\\n        // 页面会自动通过loadFiles加载文件列表\\n        // 只需要关闭弹窗即可\\n        \\n        setFiles([]);\\n        setTitle(\\\"\\\");\\n        setDescription(\\\"\\\");\\n        onClose();\\n        \\n        // 触发文件列表刷新（通过自定义事件）\\n        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('filesUploaded'));\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\\n        alert('文件上传失败，请重试');\\n      } finally {\\n        setIsUploading(false);\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent&amp;lt;HTMLInputElement&amp;gt;) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (e.target.files) {\\n      const newFiles = Array.from(e.target.files);\\n      setFiles([...files, ...newFiles]);\\n      if (!title.trim() &amp;amp;&amp;amp; newFiles.length === 1) {\\n        setTitle(newFiles[0].name);\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleRemoveFile = (index: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setFiles(files.filter((_, i) =&amp;gt; i !== index));\\n  };\\n\\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024) return bytes + \\\" B\\\";\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; {\\n                setSourceType(\\\"url\\\");\\n                setFiles([]);\\n              }}\\n              className={&amp;#96;flex-1 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors ${\\n                sourceType === \\\"url\\\"\\n                  ? \\\"bg-blue-600 text-white\\\"\\n                  : \\\"bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-200\\\"\\n              }&amp;#96;}\\n            &amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;LinkIcon className=\\\"w-4 h-4 inline-block mr-2\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n              URL链接\\n            &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n            &amp;lt;button\\n              type=\\\"button\\\"\\n              onClick={() =&amp;gt; {\\n                setSourceType(\\\"file\\\");\\n                setUrl(\\\"\\\");\\n              }}\\n              className={&amp;#96;flex-1 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors ${\\n                sourceType === \\\"file\\\"\\n                  ? \\\"bg-blue-600 text-white\\\"\\n                  : \\\"bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-200\\\"\\n              }&amp;#96;}\\n            &amp;gt;\\n              &amp;lt;Upload className=\\\"w-4 h-4 inline-block mr-2\\\" /&amp;gt;\\n              上传文件\\n            &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;\\n          &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;\\n\\n          {/* URL输入 */}\\n          {sourceType === \\\"url\\\" &amp;amp;&amp;amp;                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\\nimport { Upload, Search, X, FileText, Trash2, Check, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';\\nimport { Project } from '../types/project';\\nimport projectService from '../services/projectService';\\nimport { aiSearchService } from '../services/aiSearchService';\\nimport { techPointService } from '../services/techPointService';\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from '../services/knowledgePointService';\\nimport { TechPoint } from '../types/techPoint';\\nimport { KnowledgePoint } from '../types/knowledgePoint';\\nimport { FileUploadResponse } from '../types/aiSearch';\\nimport api from '../services/api';\\n\\ninterface SourceInformation {\\n  id: number;\\n  source_id: string;\\n  title: string;\\n  type: 'knowledge_base' | 'external';\\n  url?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  created_at: string;\\n}\\n\\nconst ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const { projectId } = useParams&amp;lt;{ projectId: string }&amp;gt;();\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const fileInputRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLInputElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const techPointSelectorRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLDivElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  \\n  const [project, setProject] = useState&amp;lt;Project | null&amp;gt;(null);\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 28290,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# 文件转Markdown功能设置说明\\n\\n## 概述\\n\\n系统已实现文件转Markdown功能，支持将上传的PDF、Word、PPT、TXT、Markdown文件转换为Markdown格式，并将其作为附加信息传递给Agent参与对话。\\n\\n## 功能特性\\n\\n1. **支持的文件类型**：\\n   - PDF (.pdf)\\n   - PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptx)\\n   - Word (.doc, .docx)\\n   - 文本文件 (.txt)\\n   - Markdown (.md, .markdown)\\n\\n2. **自动转换**：\\n   - 文件上传时自动提取文本内容并转换为Markdown格式\\n   - Markdown内容存储在文件记录的metadata中\\n\\n3. **智能传递**：\\n   - 文件的Markdown内容作为附加信息自动传递给Agent\\n   - 无论是否第一次对话，文件内容都会作为上下文传递\\n\\n## 安装依赖\\n\\n为了支持文件转换功能，需要安装以下npm包：\\n\\n### 必需依赖\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\n# PDF文件转换\\nnpm install pdf-parse\\n\\n# Word文件转换\\nnpm install mammoth\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 可选依赖（PPT转换）\\n\\nPPT文件转换功能目前返回占位符文本。如需完整支持，可以安装以下库：\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\n# PPT转换（可选，需要额外配置）\\nnpm install officegen\\n# 或\\nnpm install pptx2json\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 使用说明\\n\\n### 前端使用\\n\\n1. 在\\\"添加来源\\\"弹窗中选择\\\"上传文件\\\"模式\\n2. 拖放或选择文件（支持PDF、PPT、Word、TXT、Markdown）\\n3. 文件上传后会自动提取文本内容\\n\\n### 后端处理\\n\\n1. 文件上传时，&amp;#96;FileToMarkdownService&amp;#96;会自动识别文件类型\\n2. 调用相应的转换方法提取文本内容\\n3. 将Markdown内容存储在文件记录的metadata中\\n4. 发送消息时，从文件记录中提取Markdown内容\\n5. 将Markdown内容作为附加信息添加到用户查询中\\n\\n## 代码结构\\n\\n### 服务文件\\n\\n- &amp;#96;backend/src/services/FileToMarkdownService.ts&amp;#96; - 文件转Markdown服务\\n- &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes.ts&amp;#96; - 文件上传路由（已集成转换功能）\\n- &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/SendMessage.usecase.ts&amp;#96; - 消息发送用例（已集成Markdown内容提取）\\n\\n### 前端组件\\n\\n- &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/ai-search/AddTextModal.tsx&amp;#96; - 添加来源弹窗（已更新文件类型限制）\","
                },

                {
                  "lineNumber": 38458,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"class AiSearchService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取文件列表\\n   */\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\n    category?: string;\\n    conversationId?: string;\\n    pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release';\\n    limit?: number;\\n    offset?: number;\\n    excludeGarbled?: boolean; // 排除乱码文件名\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;FileUploadResponse[]&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const params = new URLSearchParams();\\n      if (options?.category) {\\n        params.set('category', options.category);\\n      }\\n      if (options?.conversationId) {\\n        params.set('conversationId', options.conversationId);\\n      }\\n      if (options?.pageType) {\\n        params.set('pageType', options.pageType);\\n      }\\n      if (options?.limit) {\\n        params.set('limit', String(options.limit));\\n      }\\n      if (options?.offset) {\\n        params.set('offset', String(options.offset));\\n      }\\n      if (options?.excludeGarbled !== false) {\\n        // 默认排除乱码文件名\\n        params.set('excludeGarbled', 'true');\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果明确设置为false，则不排除\\n        params.set('excludeGarbled', 'false');\\n      }\\n\\n      const query = params.toString();\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;/ai-search/files${query ? &amp;#96;?${query}&amp;#96; : ''}&amp;#96;);\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        return response.data.data;\\n      }\\n      return [];\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\\n      return [];\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 上传文件\\n   */\\n  async uploadFiles(files: File[], pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;lt;FileUploadResponse[]&amp;gt; {\\n    \\n  }\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&amp;lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&amp;gt; = \\n\\n\\n  const loadFiles = useCallback(async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      try {\\n        const cleanupApi = await import(\\\"../../services/api\\\");\\n        await cleanupApi.default.delete('/ai-search/files/garbled/cleanup');\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        console.warn('清理乱码文件失败:', error);\\n      }\\n\\n      const files = await aiSearchService.getFiles({ pageType: config.pageType });\\n      const fileSources: Source[] = files.map((file) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        id: &amp;#96;file_${file.id || file.fileId}&amp;#96;,\\n        title: file.name,\\n        type: 'external' as const,\\n        url: file.url,\\n        description: &amp;#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(file.size)}&amp;#96;,\\n      }));\\n      \\n      setSources((prev) =&amp;gt; {\\n        const nonFileSources = prev.filter((s) =&amp;gt; !s.id.startsWith('file_'));\\n        return [...nonFileSources, ...fileSources];\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载文件列表失败:', error);\\n    }\\n  }, [config.pageType]);\\n\\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024) return bytes + ' B';\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';\\n    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadAvailableWorkflows = useCallback(async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(true);\\n      const list = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n      setAvailableWorkflows(list);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"加载工作流列表失败:\\\", error);\\n      reportError(\\\"加载工作流列表失败\\\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  }, [reportError]);\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    loadAvailableWorkflows();\\n  }, [loadAvailableWorkflows]);\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const loadEnabledToolsForPage = async () =&amp;gt;\\n;\\n  }\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 39793,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const AISearchPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n  const loadFiles = useCallback(async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 先尝试清理乱码文件\\n      try {\\n        const cleanupApi = await import(\\\"../services/api\\\");\\n        await cleanupApi.default.delete('/ai-search/files/garbled/cleanup');\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        // 清理失败不影响文件列表加载\\n        console.warn('清理乱码文件失败:', error);\\n      }\\n\\n      const files = await aiSearchService.getFiles({ pageType });\\n      // 将文件转换为Source格式\\n      const fileSources: Source[] = files.map((file) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        id: &amp;#96;file_${file.id || file.fileId}&amp;#96;,\\n        title: file.name,\\n        type: 'external' as const,\\n        url: file.url,\\n        description: &amp;#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(file.size)}&amp;#96;,\\n      }));\\n      \\n      // 完全替换文件来源，避免重复\\n      setSources((prev) =&amp;gt; {\\n        // 保留非文件来源（知识库来源等）\\n        const nonFileSources = prev.filter((s) =&amp;gt; !s.id.startsWith('file_'));\\n        // 使用数据库中的文件列表，完全替换文件来源\\n        return [...nonFileSources, ...fileSources];\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载文件列表失败:', error);\\n    }\\n  }, [pageType]);\\n\\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024) return bytes + ' B';\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';\\n    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadAvailableWorkflows = useCallback(async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(true);\\n      const list = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n      setAvailableWorkflows(list);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"加载工作流列表失败:\\\", error);\\n      reportError(\\\"加载工作流列表失败\\\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  }, [reportError]);\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    loadAvailableWorkflows();\\n  }, [loadAvailableWorkflows]);\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const loadEnabledToolsForPage = async () =&amp;gt;\\n;\\n  }\\n;\","
