                  "lineNumber": 45034,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# 文件转Markdown功能设置说明\\n\\n## 概述\\n\\n系统已实现文件转Markdown功能，支持将上传的PDF、Word、PPT、TXT、Markdown文件转换为Markdown格式，并将其作为附加信息传递给Agent参与对话。\\n\\n## 功能特性\\n\\n1. **支持的文件类型**：\\n   - PDF (.pdf)\\n   - PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptx)\\n   - Word (.doc, .docx)\\n   - 文本文件 (.txt)\\n   - Markdown (.md, .markdown)\\n\\n2. **自动转换**：\\n   - 文件上传时自动提取文本内容并转换为Markdown格式\\n   - Markdown内容存储在文件记录的metadata中\\n\\n3. **智能传递**：\\n   - 文件的Markdown内容作为附加信息自动传递给Agent\\n   - 无论是否第一次对话，文件内容都会作为上下文传递\\n\\n## 安装依赖\\n\\n为了支持文件转换功能，需要安装以下npm包：\\n\\n### 必需依赖\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\n# PDF文件转换\\nnpm install pdf-parse\\n\\n# Word文件转换\\nnpm install mammoth\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 可选依赖（PPT转换）\\n\\nPPT文件转换功能目前返回占位符文本。如需完整支持，可以安装以下库：\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\n# PPT转换（可选，需要额外配置）\\nnpm install officegen\\n# 或\\nnpm install pptx2json\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 使用说明\\n\\n### 前端使用\\n\\n1. 在\\\"添加来源\\\"弹窗中选择\\\"上传文件\\\"模式\\n2. 拖放或选择文件（支持PDF、PPT、Word、TXT、Markdown）\\n3. 文件上传后会自动提取文本内容\\n\\n### 后端处理\\n\\n1. 文件上传时，&amp;#96;FileToMarkdownService&amp;#96;会自动识别文件类型\\n2. 调用相应的转换方法提取文本内容\\n3. 将Markdown内容存储在文件记录的metadata中\\n4. 发送消息时，从文件记录中提取Markdown内容\\n5. 将Markdown内容作为附加信息添加到用户查询中\\n\\n## 代码结构\\n\\n### 服务文件\\n\\n- &amp;#96;backend/src/services/FileToMarkdownService.ts&amp;#96; - 文件转Markdown服务\\n- &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes.ts&amp;#96; - 文件上传路由（已集成转换功能）\\n- &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/SendMessage.usecase.ts&amp;#96; - 消息发送用例（已集成Markdown内容提取）\\n\\n### 前端组件\\n\\n- &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/ai-search/AddTextModal.tsx&amp;#96; - 添加来源弹窗（已更新文件类型限制）\","

                  "lineNumber": 46317,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"// 配置multer用于文件上传\\nconst storage = multer.diskStorage({\\n  destination: (req, file, cb) =&amp;gt; {\\n    cb(null, 'uploads/ai-search/');\\n  },\\n  filename: (req, file, cb) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 生成唯一文件名，但保留原始扩展名\\n    const uniqueSuffix = Date.now() + '-' + Math.round(Math.random() * 1E9);\\n    const ext = path.extname(file.originalname);\\n    cb(null, &amp;#96;${uniqueSuffix}${ext}&amp;#96;);\\n  },\\n});\\n\\nconst upload = multer({\\n  storage: storage,\\n  limits: {\\n    fileSize: 10 * 1024 * 1024, // 10MB\\n  },\\n  fileFilter: (req: Request, file: Express.Multer.File, cb: multer.FileFilterCallback) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 允许的文件类型：PDF, PPT, txt, markdown, word\\n    const allowedTypes = [\\n      'application/pdf',\\n      'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint', // .ppt\\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation', // .pptx\\n      'application/msword', // .doc\\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', // .docx\\n      'text/plain',\\n      'text/markdown',\\n    ];\\n    // 也允许通过扩展名判断\\n    const allowedExtensions = ['.pdf', '.ppt', '.pptx', '.doc', '.docx', '.txt', '.md', '.markdown'];\\n    const fileExtension = require('path').extname(file.originalname).toLowerCase();\\n    \\n    if (allowedTypes.includes(file.mimetype) || allowedExtensions.includes(fileExtension)) {\\n      cb(null, true);\\n    } else {\\n      cb(new Error(&amp;#96;不支持的文件类型: ${file.mimetype}。支持的类型：PDF, PPT, txt, markdown, word&amp;#96;));\\n    }\\n  },\\n});\\n\\n// 确保上传目录存在\\nconst uploadDir = 'uploads/ai-search/';\\nif (!fs.existsSync(uploadDir)) {\\n  fs.mkdirSync(uploadDir, { recursive: true });\\n}\\n\\n// 初始化服务\\nconst aiSearchService = new AiSearchService();\\nconst fieldMappingService = new FieldMappingService();\\nconst createConversationUseCase = new CreateConversationUseCase(aiSearchService);\\nconst getConversationsUseCase = new GetConversationsUseCase(aiSearchService);\\nconst getConversationDetailUseCase = new GetConversationDetailUseCase(aiSearchService);\\nconst sendMessageUseCase = new SendMessageUseCase;\","

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import api from './api';\\\\nimport { agentWorkflowService } from './agentWorkflowService';\\\\nimport { techPointService } from './techPointService';\\\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from './knowledgePointService';\\\\nimport {\\\\n  Conversation,\\\\n  Message,\\\\n  OutputContent,\\\\n  WorkflowConfig,\\\\n  FileUploadResponse,\\\\n  CreateConversationRequest,\\\\n  SendMessageRequest,\\\\n  ApiResponse,\\\\n  Source,\\\\n  FieldMappingConfig,\\\\n} from '../types/aiSearch';\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * AI问答服务\\\\n */\\\\nclass AiSearchService {\\\\n  private normalizeMessage(raw: any): Message {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      ...raw,\\\\n      createdAt: raw?.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取配置的工作流\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowConfig | null&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\\\\n      const params = pageType ? &amp;amp;#96;?pageType=${pageType}&amp;amp;#96; : '';\\\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;amp;#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\\\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\\\\n        // 获取工作流详情\\\\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\\\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\\\n        if (workflow) {\\\\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\\\\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\\\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      return null;\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\\\n      return null;\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\\\n   */\\\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\\\n    \\\\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\\\n    \\\\n    return {\\\\n      id: workflow.id,\\\\n      name: workflow.name,\\\\n      description: workflow.description,\\\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\\\n        required: p.required || false,\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\n      })),\\\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\n      })),\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取文件列表\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\\\n    category?: string;\\\",\""

                  "lineNumber": 5251,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import { apiClient, type ApiErrorPayload, type ApiResponse } from \\\\\\\"@/shared/lib/api/apiClient\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\nexport interface WorkflowResponse {\\\\n  success: boolean;\\\\n  data?: any;\\\\n  error?: string;\\\\n  message?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nconst toWorkflowResponse = &amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt;(response: ApiResponse&amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp; { message?: string }): WorkflowResponse =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  if (response.success) {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      success: true,\\\\n      data: response.data,\\\\n      message: response.message,\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  return {\\\\n    success: false,\\\\n    error: response.error?.message ?? response.message ?? \\\\\\\"请求失败\\\\\\\",\\\\n    data: response.data,\\\\n  };\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nconst handleApiError = (scope: string, error: unknown): WorkflowResponse =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  console.error(&amp;amp;#96;${scope} error:&amp;amp;#96;, error);\\\\n  if ((error as ApiErrorPayload)?.message) {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      success: false,\\\\n      error: (error as ApiErrorPayload).message,\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n  if (error instanceof Error) {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      success: false,\\\\n      error: error.message,\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n  return {\\\\n    success: false,\\\\n    error: \\\\\\\"请求失败\\\\\\\",\\\\n  };\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport interface DifyAPIConfig {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  name: string;\\\\n  description: string;\\\\n  apiUrl: string;\\\\n  apiKey: string;\\\\n  enabled: boolean;\\\\n  createdAt?: Date;\\\\n  updatedAt?: Date;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nconst warnDeprecatedDifyConfig = (scope: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  console.warn(&amp;amp;#96;[workflowAPI] 已忽略前端传入的 difyConfig (${scope})，所有调用均改为通过后端网关处理&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport const workflowAPI = {\\\\n  // AI问答 - 支持自定义Dify配置\\\\n  aiSearch: async (query: string, inputs: any = {}, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('aiSearch');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post&amp;amp;lt;{ message?: string }&amp;amp;gt;(\\\\\\\"/workflow/ai-search\\\\\\\", {\\\\n        query,\\\\n        inputs,\\\\n        conversationId,\\\\n      }, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"AI search API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 智能搜索\\\\n  smartSearch: async (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('smartSearch');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = { query };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/smart-search\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Smart search API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 技术包装\\\\n  techPackage: async (searchResults: any, template?: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techPackage');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      let inputs: any;\\\\n\\\\n      if (searchResults &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; typeof searchResults === 'object' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; searchResults.query) {\\\\n        inputs = {\\\\n          query: searchResults.query,\\\\n          selectedKnowledgePoints: searchResults.selectedKnowledgePoints,\\\\n        };\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        inputs = {\\\\n          searchResults: searchResults,\\\\n          template: template,\\\\n        };\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/tech-package\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Tech package API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 技术策略\\\\n  techStrategy: async (techPackage: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techStrategy');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\n        inputs: { techPackage },\\\\n      };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/tech-strategy\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Tech strategy API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 推广策略\\\\n  promotionStrategy: async (techStrategy: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('promotionStrategy');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\n        inputs: { techStrategy },\\\\n      };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/promotion-strategy\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Promotion strategy API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 技术通稿\\\\n  coreDraft: async (promotionStrategy: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('coreDraft');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\n        inputs: { promotionStrategy },\\\\n      };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/core-draft\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Core draft API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 发布会演讲稿\\\\n  speechGeneration: async (coreDraft: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('speechGeneration');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\n        inputs: { coreDraft },\\\\n      };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/speech-generation\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Speech generation API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 演讲稿\\\\n  speech: async (inputs: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('speech');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/speech-generation\\\\\\\", requestData);\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Speech API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nconst legacyApi = {\\\\n  async get&amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;gt;(url: string, config?: any) {\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.get&amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt;(url, config);\\\\n    return { data };\\\\n  },\\\\n  async post&amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;gt;(url: string, body?: any, config?: any) {\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.post&amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt;(url, body, config);\\\\n    return { data };\\\\n  },\\\\n  async put&amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;gt;(url: string, body?: any, config?: any) {\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.put&amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt;(url, body, config);\\\\n    return { data };\\\\n  },\\\\n  async delete&amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;gt;(url: string, config?: any) {\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.delete&amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt;(url, config);\\\\n    return { data };\\\\n  },\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport default legacyApi;\\\\n\\\",\""

(PAGE_LABELS[feature.pageType as keyof typeof PAGE_LABELS] || PAGE_LABELS['tech-package']) : (FEATURE_PAGE_MAP[feature.featureType] || '技术包装'),\\n              featureType: feature.featureType,\\n              featureLabel: (feature as any).label || FEATURE_LABELS[feature.featureType] || feature.featureType,\\n              config: {\\n                ...mapping.config,\\n                inputMappings: feature.inputMappings || [],\\n                outputMappings: feature.outputMappings || [],\\n              },\\n            });\\n          }\\n        }\\n      }\\n      setMappings(rows);\\n      setWorkflows(workflowsData);\\n      setRoles(rolesData);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载数据失败:', error);\\n      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '加载数据失败，请稍后重试' });\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleEdit = (mapping: FieldMappingListItem) =&amp;gt;\\n;\\n;\","

{\\n  logger.debug('API Route Handler', {\\n    method: req.method,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    baseUrl: req.baseUrl,\\n    path: req.path,\\n    params: req.params,\\n    query: req.query,\\n    body: req.body,\\n  });\\n  next();\\n});\\n\\n// 注册路由\\nrouter.use('/tech-categories', techCategoriesRouter);\\nrouter.use('/tech-points', techPointsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/brands', brandsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/car-models', carModelsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/car-series', carSeriesRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow', workflowModuleRouter);\\nrouter.use('/knowledge-points', knowledgePointsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/chat', chatRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow-stats', workflowStatsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/dify', difyProxyRouter);\\nrouter.use('/ai-roles', aiRoleRouter);\\nrouter.use('/agent-workflows', agentWorkflowRouter);\\nrouter.use('/executions', workflowExecutionRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow-templates', workflowTemplateRouter);\\nrouter.use('/public-page-configs', publicPageConfigRouter);\\nrouter.use('/page-tool-configs', pageToolConfigRouter);\\nrouter.use('/source-information', sourceInformationRouter);\\nrouter.use('/projects', projectsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/ai-search', aiSearchModuleRouter);\\n\\n// 健康检查\\nrouter.get('/health', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\\n    headers: req.headers,\\n    method: req.method,\\n    url: req.url,\\n  });\\n  try {\\n    const response = {\\n      success: true,\\n      message: 'API is running',\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n      version: '1.0.0'\\n    };\\n    res.json(response);\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: 'Health check failed',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 简单测试端点\\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.warn('API 路由未找到', {\\n    method: req.method,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    path: req.path,\\n  });\\n  res.status(404).json({\\n    success: false,\\n    error: {\\n      code: 'NOT_FOUND',\\n      message: &amp;#96;路由不存在: ${req.method} ${req.path}&amp;#96;,\\n    },\\n  });\\n});\\n\\nexport default router;\","

                  "lineNumber": 3883,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { apiClient, type ApiErrorPayload, type ApiResponse } from \\\"@/shared/lib/api/apiClient\\\";\\n\\nexport interface WorkflowResponse {\\n  success: boolean;\\n  data?: any;\\n  error?: string;\\n  message?: string;\\n}\\n\\nconst toWorkflowResponse = &amp;lt;T&amp;gt;(response: ApiResponse&amp;lt;T&amp;gt; &amp;amp; { message?: string }): WorkflowResponse =&amp;gt; {\\n  if (response.success) {\\n    return {\\n      success: true,\\n      data: response.data,\\n      message: response.message,\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  return {\\n    success: false,\\n    error: response.error?.message ?? response.message ?? \\\"请求失败\\\",\\n    data: response.data,\\n  };\\n};\\n\\nconst handleApiError = (scope: string, error: unknown): WorkflowResponse =&amp;gt; {\\n  console.error(&amp;#96;${scope} error:&amp;#96;, error);\\n  if ((error as ApiErrorPayload)?.message) {\\n    return {\\n      success: false,\\n      error: (error as ApiErrorPayload).message,\\n    };\\n  }\\n  if (error instanceof Error) {\\n    return {\\n      success: false,\\n      error: error.message,\\n    };\\n  }\\n  return {\\n    success: false,\\n    error: \\\"请求失败\\\",\\n  };\\n};\\n\\nexport interface DifyAPIConfig {\\n  id: string;\\n  name: string;\\n  description: string;\\n  apiUrl: string;\\n  apiKey: string;\\n  enabled: boolean;\\n  createdAt?: Date;\\n  updatedAt?: Date;\\n}\\n\\nconst warnDeprecatedDifyConfig = (scope: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n  console.warn(&amp;#96;[workflowAPI] 已忽略前端传入的 difyConfig (${scope})，所有调用均改为通过后端网关处理&amp;#96;);\\n};\\n\\nexport const workflowAPI = {\\n  // AI问答 - 支持自定义Dify配置\\n  aiSearch: async (query: string, inputs: any = {}, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('aiSearch');\\n\\n    try {\\n      const response = await apiClient.post&amp;lt;{ message?: string }&amp;gt;(\\\"/workflow/ai-search\\\", {\\n        query,\\n        inputs,\\n        conversationId,\\n      }, {\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\n      });\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      return handleApiError(\\\"AI search API\\\", error);\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 智能搜索\\n  smartSearch: async (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('smartSearch');\\n\\n    try {\\n      const requestData: any = { query };\\n      if (conversationId) {\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\"/workflow/smart-search\\\", requestData, {\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\n      });\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      return handleApiError(\\\"Smart search API\\\", error);\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 技术包装\\n  techPackage: async (searchResults: any, template?: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techPackage');\\n\\n    try {\\n      let inputs: any;\\n\\n      if (searchResults &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof searchResults === 'object' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; searchResults.query) {\\n        inputs = {\\n          query: searchResults.query,\\n          selectedKnowledgePoints: searchResults.selectedKnowledgePoints,\\n        };\\n      } else {\\n        inputs = {\\n          searchResults: searchResults,\\n          template: template,\\n        };\\n      }\\n\\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\\n      if (conversationId) {\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\"/workflow/tech-package\\\", requestData, {\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\n      });\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      return handleApiError(\\\"Tech package API\\\", error);\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 技术策略\\n  techStrategy: async (techPackage: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt;         "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行Agent节点\n   */\n  private async executeAgentNode(\n    node: any,\n    sharedContext: Record&lt;string, any&gt;\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    const agentId = node.agentId || node.data?.agentId;\n    if (!agentId) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;Agent节点 ${node.id} 未配置agentId&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 获取AI角色配置\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(agentId);\n    if (!role) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${agentId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    if (!role.enabled) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色已禁用: ${agentId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 准备输入数据\n    const nodeInput = this.prepareNodeInput(node, sharedContext);\n    \n    // 尝试从多个可能的字段中提取query\n    // 优先级：query &gt; input &gt; workflowInput.query &gt; 整个nodeInput的字符串化\n    let query = nodeInput.query;\n    if (!query) {\n      query = nodeInput.input;\n    }\n    if (!query &amp;&amp; nodeInput.workflowInput?.query) {\n      query = nodeInput.workflowInput.query;\n    }\n    if (!query &amp;&amp; typeof nodeInput === 'object') {\n      // 如果还是没有，尝试从其他常见字段中提取\n      query = nodeInput.question || nodeInput.text || nodeInput.content;\n    }\n    if (!query) {\n      // 最后回退：如果nodeInput是字符串，直接使用；否则字符串化\n      query = typeof nodeInput === 'string' ? nodeInput : JSON.stringify(nodeInput);\n    }\n    \n    const inputs = { ...nodeInput };\n    delete inputs.query;\n    delete inputs.input;\n\n    // 检查 provider 类型，Workflow 目前只支持 Dify\n    const provider = role.provider || 'dify';\n    if (provider === 'direct-agent') {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 是 Direct Agent 类型，不支持在 Workflow 中使用。请使用 Dify 类型的角色。&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 根据连接类型调用Dify API\n    if (!role.difyConfig) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 的Dify配置不存在&#96;);\n    }\n\n    const { connectionType, apiKey, apiUrl } = role.difyConfig;\n    // 尝试从多个可能的位置获取 conversationId\n    // 优先级：nodeInput.conversationId &gt; nodeInput.workflowInput.conversationId &gt; sharedContext.workflowInput.conversationId\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行工作流（异步）\n   */\n  async executeWorkflow(\n    workflowId: string,\n    options: any\n  ): Promise&lt;{ executionId: string; message: string; data?: any }&gt; {\n    // 获取工作流定义\n    const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(workflowId);\n    if (!workflow) {\n      throw new Error('工作流不存在');\n    }\n\n    const startedAt = Date.now();\n    // 创建执行实例\n    const execution = await workflowExecutionModel.create({\n      execution_type: 'agent_workflow',\n      workflow_id: workflowId,\n      workflow_name: workflow.name,\n      status: 'running',\n      shared_context: options.input || {},\n      node_results: [],\n      start_time: new Date().toISOString(),\n    });\n\n    try {\n      // 解析工作流节点和边\n      const nodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\n      const edges = JSON.parse(workflow.edges || '[]');\n\n      logger.info('开始执行工作流', {\n        workflowId,\n        workflowName: workflow.name,\n        nodesCount: nodes.length,\n        edgesCount: edges.length,\n        nodeTypes: nodes.map((n: any) =&gt; n.type),\n        agentNodes: nodes.filter((n: any) =&gt; n.type === 'agent').map((n: any) =&gt; ({\n          id: n.id,\n          agentId: n.agentId || n.data?.agentId,\n          hasData: !!n.data,\n        })),\n        outputNodes: nodes.filter((n: any) =&gt; n.type === 'output').map((n: any) =&gt; ({\n          id: n.id,\n          outputs: n.data?.outputs,\n        })),\n      });\n\n      // 检查是否有配置的Agent节点\n      const hasConfiguredAgent = this.workflowHasConfiguredAgent(workflow);\n      logger.info('检查Agent节点配置', {\n        workflowId,\n        hasConfiguredAgent,\n      });\n      \n      if (!hasConfiguredAgent) {\n        const fallbackOutput = this.buildFallbackOutput;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class WorkflowEngine {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行单个节点\n   */\n  private async executeNode(\n    workflow: AgentWorkflow,\n    node: AgentWorkflowNode,\n    options: Required&lt;WorkflowExecutionOptions&gt;\n  ): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    const nodeResult = this.execution!.nodeResults.find(r =&gt; r.nodeId === node.id);\n    if (!nodeResult) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    nodeResult.status = 'running';\n    nodeResult.startTime = new Date();\n    this.notifyProgress();\n\n    try {\n      // 准备节点输入\n      const nodeInput = await this.prepareNodeInput(workflow, node, this.execution!.sharedContext);\n      nodeResult.input = nodeInput;\n\n      let output: any;\n\n      // 根据节点类型执行不同的逻辑\n      switch (node.type) {\n        case 'agent':\n          output = await this.executeAgentNode(node, nodeInput);\n          break;\n        case 'condition':\n          output = await this.executeConditionNode(node, nodeInput);\n          break;\n        case 'assign':\n          output = await this.executeAssignNode(node, nodeInput);\n          break;\n        case 'merge':\n          output = await this.executeMergeNode(node, workflow);\n          break;\n        case 'transform':\n          output = await this.executeTransformNode(node, nodeInput);\n          break;\n        case 'input':\n          output = await this.executeInputNode(node, options.input);\n          break;\n        case 'output':\n          output = await this.executeOutputNode(node, workflow);\n          break;\n        case 'memory':\n          output = await this.executeMemoryNode(node, workflow);\n          break;\n        default:\n          throw new Error(&#96;不支持的节点类型: ${node.type}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      nodeResult.status = 'completed';\n      nodeResult.output = output;\n      nodeResult.endTime = new Date();\n      nodeResult.duration = nodeResult.endTime.getTime() - nodeResult.startTime.getTime();\n\n      // 将输出保存到共享上下文\n      this.execution!.sharedContext.nodeOutputs[node.id] = output;\n\n    } catch (error) {\n      nodeResult.status = 'failed';\n      nodeResult.endTime = new Date();\n      nodeResult.duration =\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行单个节点\n   */\n  private async executeNode(\n    node: any,\n    sharedContext: Record&lt;string, any&gt;,\n    options: any\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      switch (node.type) {\n        case 'input':\n          return this.executeInputNode(node, sharedContext, options);\n        case 'agent':\n          return await this.executeAgentNode(node, sharedContext);\n        case 'output':\n          return this.executeOutputNode(node, sharedContext);\n        default:\n          logger.warn(&#96;未知节点类型: ${node.type}&#96;, { nodeId: node.id });\n          return { type: node.type, status: 'skipped' };\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error(&#96;节点执行失败: ${node.id}&#96;, { error });\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行输入节点\n   */\n  private executeInputNode(\n    node: any,\n    sharedContext: Record&lt;string, any&gt;,\n    options: any\n  ): any {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class WorkflowService {\n  // 执行节点\n  static async executeNode(\n    nodeId: string, \n    inputData: any, \n    context: WorkflowContext\n  ): Promise&lt;NodeExecutionResult&gt; {\n    const node = getNodeById(nodeId);\n    if (!node) {\n      return { success: false, error: '节点不存在' };\n    }\n\n    const config = nodeConfigs[nodeId];\n    if (!config) {\n      return { success: false, error: '节点配置不存在' };\n    }\n\n    try {\n      // 验证输入数据\n      const validationResult = this.validateNodeInput(nodeId, inputData);\n      if (!validationResult.valid) {\n        return { success: false, error: validationResult.error };\n      }\n\n      // 根据节点类型执行不同的逻辑\n      let result: any;\n      switch (node.type) {\n        case 'smart_search':\n          result = await this.executeSmartSearch(inputData);\n          break;\n        case 'tech_package':\n          result = await this.executeTechPackage(inputData, context);\n          break;\n        case 'promotion_strategy':\n          result = await this.executePromotionStrategy(inputData, context);\n          break;\n        case 'core_draft':\n          result = await this.executeCoreDraft(inputData, context);\n          break;\n        case 'speech':\n          result = await this.executeSpeech(inputData, context);\n          break;\n        default:\n          return { success: false, error: '不支持的节点类型' };\n      }\n\n      // 生成下一步推荐\n      const nextRecommendations = this.generateNextStepRecommendations(\n        nodeId, \n        result, \n        context\n      );\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        data: result,\n        nextRecommendations\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '执行失败'\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 验证节点输入\n  private static validateNodeInput(nodeId: string, inputData: any): { valid: boolean; error?: string } {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\nprivate async executeAgentNode(\n    node: any,\n    sharedContext: Record&lt;string, any&gt;\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n\n\n    logger.info('准备执行Agent节点', {\n      nodeId: node.id,\n      agentId,\n      connectionType,\n      query: query?.substring(0, 100),\n      queryLength: query?.length || 0,\n      '传递给Dify的conversationId': conversationId || '空（首次对话）',\n      inputsKeys: Object.keys(inputs || {}),\n    });\n\n    if (connectionType === 'chatflow') {\n      // 使用聊天流模式\n      const result = await gateway.executeChat({\n        query,\n        conversationId,\n        inputs,\n        userId: 'todify3-user',\n      });\n\n      if (isSuccess(result)) {\n        const chatResponse = result.value.raw as any;\n        const agentOutput = {\n          answer: chatResponse.answer || result.value.answer,\n          conversation_id: chatResponse.conversation_id || result.value.conversationId,\n          message_id: chatResponse.message_id || result.value.messageId,\n          metadata: chatResponse.metadata || {},\n          raw: chatResponse,\n        };\n        \n        logger.info('Agent节点执行完成 (chatflow)', {\n          nodeId: node.id,\n          agentId,\n          hasAnswer: !!agentOutput.answer,\n          answerLength: agentOutput.answer?.length || 0,\n          answerPreview: agentOutput.answer?.substring(0, 200) || null,\n          answerType: typeof agentOutput.answer,\n          rawKeys: chatResponse &amp;&amp; typeof chatResponse === 'object' ? Object.keys(chatResponse) : null,\n        });\n        \n        return agentOutput;\n      } else {\n        logger.error('Agent节点执行失败 (chatflow)', {\n          nodeId: node.id,\n          agentId,\n          error: result.error,\n        });\n        throw new Error(result.error.message || 'Dify聊天调用失败');\n      }\n    } else {\n      // 使用工作流模式\n      const result = await gateway.executeWorkflow\n;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\nasync execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      const effectiveOutputMappings = featureConfig.outputMappings?.length\n        ? featureConfig.outputMappings\n        : targetMappingConfig?.outputMappings || [];\n\n      const baseContent = await this.resolveBaseContent(conversation, dto);\n      const conversationQuery = baseContent || &#96;触发子Agent：${dto.featureType}&#96;;\n\n      const conversationData = this.buildConversationData(\n        conversation,\n        conversationQuery,\n        targetSources,\n        dto\n      );\n\n      const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, effectiveInputMappings);\n\n      // 判断 targetWorkflowId 是 AI 角色 ID 还是工作流 ID\n      // AI 角色 ID 可能以 'role_' 或 'ai-role-' 开头，工作流 ID 以 'wf_' 开头\n      const isRoleId = targetWorkflowId.startsWith('role_') || targetWorkflowId.startsWith('ai-role-');\n      \n      let workflowResult;\n      if (isRoleId) {\n        // 直接调用 AI 角色\n        logger.info('检测到 AI 角色 ID，直接调用角色', { roleId: targetWorkflowId, featureType: dto.featureType });\n        workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeRole(targetWorkflowId, workflowInput);\n      } else {\n        // 通过工作流调用\n        logger.info('检测到工作流 ID，通过工作流调用', { workflowId: targetWorkflowId, featureType: dto.featureType });\n        workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(\n          targetWorkflowId,\n          { input: workflowInput }\n        );\n      }\n\n      const extractedOutput = extractWorkflowOutput(workflowResult, effectiveOutputMappings);\n\n      const aiContent = extractedOutput.content\n        || workflowResult.message\n        || &#96;子Agent ${dto.featureType} 已执行&#96;;\n\n      const messageOutputs = {\n        ...extractedOutput,\n,\n      };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\nprivate async executeAgentNode(\n    node: any,\n    sharedContext: Record&lt;string, any&gt;\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n\n    // 尝试从多个可能的位置获取 conversationId\n    // 优先级：nodeInput.conversationId &gt; nodeInput.workflowInput.conversationId &gt; sharedContext.workflowInput.conversationId\n    let conversationId = nodeInput.conversationId || '';\n    if (!conversationId &amp;&amp; nodeInput.workflowInput?.conversationId) {\n      conversationId = nodeInput.workflowInput.conversationId;\n      logger.info('从 nodeInput.workflowInput 获取到 conversationId', { conversationId });\n    }\n    if (!conversationId &amp;&amp; sharedContext.workflowInput?.conversationId) {\n      conversationId = sharedContext.workflowInput.conversationId;\n      logger.info('从 sharedContext.workflowInput 获取到 conversationId', { conversationId });\n    }\n\n    if (!apiKey || !apiUrl) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 的Dify配置不完整&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 处理相对路径：如果是相对路径，使用实际的 Dify 服务器地址\n    let actualBaseUrl = apiUrl;\n    if (apiUrl.startsWith('/')) {\n      // 相对路径，通过后端代理处理，使用实际的 Dify 服务器地址\n      actualBaseUrl = process.env.DIFY_BASE_URL || 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1';\n      logger.info('检测到相对路径，转换为完整URL', {\n        agentId,\n        原始: apiUrl,\n        转换后: actualBaseUrl,\n      });\n    }\n\n    logger.info('创建 DifyGateway', {\n      agentId,\n      baseUrl: actualBaseUrl,\n      apiKey: apiKey.substring(0, 10) + '...',\n      connectionType,\n    });\n\n    // 创建自定义的DifyGateway\n    const gateway = new DifyGateway({\n      baseUrl: actualBaseUrl,\n      workflowBaseUrl: actualBaseUrl,\n      apiKey,\n      timeout: 60_000,\n      maxRetries: 3,\n    });\n\n    logger.info('准备执行Agent节点',\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\nasync executeRole(\n    roleId: string,\n    input: Record&lt;string, any&gt;\n  ): Promise&lt;{ executionId: string; message: string; data?: any }&gt; {\nconst query =  || JSON.stringify(input);\n    \n    try {\n      if (provider === 'direct-agent') {\n        // Direct Agent 类型：使用 AgentOrchestrator\n        logger.info('使用 Direct Agent 模式执行', { roleId, queryLength: query?.length });\n        \n        const orchestrator = new AgentOrchestrator();\n        const result = await orchestrator.executeAgent(\n          roleId,\n          query,\n          '', // 不传递 conversationId，每次是独立的调用\n          input // 传递完整输入作为上下文\n        );\n        \n        return {\n          executionId: &#96;exec_direct_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n          message: result.content || '角色执行完成',\n          data: {\n            outputs: {\n              answer: result.content,\n              content: result.content,\n              conversationId: result.conversationId,\n              usage: result.usage,\n              metadata: result.metadata,\n            },\n            nodeOutputs: {},\n          },\n        };\n      } else {\n        // Dify 类型：使用 executeAgentNode\n        logger.info('使用 Dify 模式执行', { roleId, queryLength: query?.length });\n        \n        // 构建一个虚拟的 Agent 节点\n        const virtualNode = {\n          id: &#96;virtual_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n          type: 'agent',\n          agentId: roleId,\n          data: { agentId: roleId },\n        };\n        \n        // 构建共享上下文\n        const sharedContext = {\n          workflowInput: input,\n          nodeOutputs: {},\n        };\n        \n        const result = await this.executeAgentNode(virtualNode, sharedContext);\n        \n        // 提取内容\n        const content = result?.answer || result?.result || result?.content || '';\n        \n        return {\n          executionId: &#96;exec_role_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n          message: content || '角色执行完成',\n          data: {\n            outputs: result,\n            nodeOutputs: { [virtualNode.id]: result },\n          },\n        };\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('AI角色执行失败', { roleId, provider, error });\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ToolExecutor {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行工具调用\n   * @param toolCall 工具调用信息\n   * @param toolConfig 工具配置\n   * @returns 执行结果（JSON 字符串）\n   */\n  async executeTool(toolCall: ToolCall, toolConfig: ToolConfig): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 解析参数\n      const args = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments || '{}');\n\n      // 验证参数\n      this.validateParameters(args, toolConfig.parameters);\n\n      // 根据工具类型执行\n      let result: ToolExecutionResult;\n\n      switch (toolConfig.type) {\n        case 'search':\n          result = await this.executeSearch(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'calculation':\n          result = this.executeCalculation(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'time':\n          result = this.getTime(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'api':\n          result = await this.executeAPI(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'workflow':\n          result = await this.executeWorkflow(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'agent':\n          result = await this.executeAgent(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        default:\n          result = {\n            success: false,\n            content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;不支持的工具类型: ${toolConfig.type}&#96; })\n          };\n      }\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return JSON.stringify({ error: result.error || '工具执行失败' });\n      }\n\n      return result.content;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(&#96;工具执行失败: ${toolConfig.name}&#96;, error);\n      return JSON.stringify({\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '工具执行失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 验证参数\n   */\n  private validateParameters(args: any, parameters: ToolConfig['parameters']): void {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\nasync executeWorkflow(\n    workflowId: string,\n    options: any\n  ): Promise&lt;{ executionId: string; message: string; data?: any }&gt; {\n\n(level, idx) =&gt; (\n)),\n      });\n\n      for (const level of executionOrder) {\n        // 并行执行同一层的节点\n        logger.info('执行节点层级', {\n          workflowId,\n          levelNodes: level.map((n: any) =&gt; ({ id: n.id, type: n.type })),\n        });\n        \n        const levelResults = await Promise.allSettled(\n          level.map(node =&gt; this.executeNode(node, sharedContext, options))\n        );\n\n        levelResults.forEach((result, index) =&gt; {\n          const node = level[index];\n          if (result.status === 'fulfilled') {\n            const nodeOutput = result.value;\n            nodeResults.push({\n              nodeId: node.id,\n              status: 'completed',\n              output: nodeOutput,\n            });\n            sharedContext.nodeOutputs[node.id] = nodeOutput;\n            \n            // 记录节点执行结果（特别是Agent节点）\n            if (node.type === 'agent') {\n              logger.info('Agent节点执行完成', {\n                nodeId: node.id,\n                hasOutput: !!nodeOutput,\n                outputType: typeof nodeOutput,\n                outputKeys: nodeOutput &amp;&amp; typeof nodeOutput === 'object' ? Object.keys(nodeOutput) : null,\n                hasAnswer: nodeOutput &amp;&amp; typeof nodeOutput === 'object' ? !!nodeOutput.answer : false,\n                answerType: nodeOutput &amp;&amp; typeof nodeOutput === 'object' &amp;&amp; nodeOutput.answer ? typeof nodeOutput.answer : null,\n                answerLength: nodeOutput &amp;&amp; typeof nodeOutput === 'object' &amp;&amp; nodeOutput.answer &amp;&amp; typeof nodeOutput.answer === 'string' ? nodeOutput.answer.length : null,\n              });\n            }\n          } else {\n            nodeResults.push({\n              nodeId: node.id,\n              status: 'failed',\n              error: result.reason?.message || '节点执行失败',\n            });\n            logger.error(&#96;节点执行失败: ${node.id}&#96;, { error: result.reason });\n          }\n        });\n      }\n\n      // 提取输出节点的结果\n      const outputNode = nodes.find((n: any) =&gt; n.type === 'output');\n      let finalOutput: any = null;\n      let outputContent = '';\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行带工具调用的 LLM 请求（可能多轮）\n   */\n  private async executeWithTools(\n    provider: ILLMProvider,\n    messages: ChatMessage[],\n    llmConfig: LLMConfig,\n    tools: Tool[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void\n  ): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\n    let iteration = 0;\n    let currentMessages = [...messages];\n    let lastResponse: LLMResponse;\n\n    while (iteration &lt; this.maxToolCallIterations) {\n      // 检查超时\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n      \n      // 调用 LLM\n      const response = await provider.chat(currentMessages, llmConfig, tools.length &gt; 0 ? tools : undefined);\n      lastResponse = response;\n\n      // LLM 调用后检查超时\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n\n      // 如果没有工具调用，直接返回\n      if (!response.toolCalls || response.toolCalls.length === 0) {\n        return response;\n      }\n\n      // 将 assistant 的回复添加到消息历史\n      currentMessages.push({\n        role: 'assistant',\n        content: response.content || ''\n      });\n\n      // 执行工具调用（检查超时）\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n      const toolResults = await this.executeTools(response.toolCalls, toolConfigs, checkTimeout);\n\n      // 工具执行后检查超时\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n\n      // 将工具调用结果添加到消息历史\n      for (const result of toolResults) {\n        currentMessages.push({\n          role: 'tool',\n          content: result.content,\n          name: result.toolName,\n          tool_call_id: result.toolCallId\n        });\n      }\n\n      iteration++;\n    }\n\n    // 如果达到最大迭代次数，返回最后一次响应\n    if (iteration &gt;= this.maxToolCallIterations) {\n      console.warn(&#96;工具调用达到最大迭代次数: ${this.maxToolCallIterations}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    return lastResponse!;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行多个工具调用\n   */\n  private async executeTools(\n    toolCalls: any[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void\n  ): Promise&lt;Array&lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&gt;&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\nasync executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\n;\n    }\n\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\n    messages.push({\n      role: 'user',\n      content: query\n    });\n\n    // 6. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\n    const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\n\n    // 7. 获取 LLM Provider\n    const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\n\n    // 8. 调用 LLM（可能包含多轮工具调用）\n    checkTimeout();\n    let response = await this.executeWithTools(provider, messages, config.llm, tools, config.tools || [], checkTimeout);\n\n    // 9. 保存消息历史\n    await this.saveMessages(finalConversationId, query, response, roleId);\n\n    // 10. 返回结果\n    return {\n      content: response.content,\n      conversationId: finalConversationId,\n      usage: response.usage,\n      metadata: {\n        model: response.model,\n        finishReason: response.finishReason,\n        toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0\n      }\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行带工具调用的 LLM 请求（可能多轮）\n   */\n  private async executeWithTools(\n    provider: ILLMProvider,\n    messages: ChatMessage[],\n    llmConfig: LLMConfig,\n    tools: Tool[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void\n  ): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行输入节点\n   */\n  private executeInputNode(\n    node: any,\n    sharedContext: Record&lt;string, any&gt;,\n    options: any\n  ): any {\n    const data = node.data || {};\n    const inputs = data.inputs || [];\n    const workflowInput = sharedContext.workflowInput || {};\n\n    logger.info('执行输入节点', {\n      nodeId: node.id,\n      inputsCount: inputs.length,\n      inputNames: inputs.map((i: any) =&gt; i.name),\n      workflowInputKeys: Object.keys(workflowInput),\n      hasQuery: !!workflowInput.query,\n    });\n\n    const results: any[] = [];\n    for (const inputParam of inputs) {\n      const inputName = inputParam.name || 'input';\n      let value = workflowInput[inputName];\n\n      // 如果字段名为 'input' 但没有值，尝试使用 'query' 字段\n      if (value === undefined &amp;&amp; inputName === 'input' &amp;&amp; workflowInput.query) {\n        value = workflowInput.query;\n        logger.info('输入节点：将query字段映射到input', {\n          nodeId: node.id,\n          queryValue: typeof value === 'string' ? value.substring(0, 100) : value,\n        });\n      }\n\n      if (value === undefined &amp;&amp; inputParam.defaultValue !== undefined) {\n        value = inputParam.defaultValue;\n      }\n\n      if (inputParam.required &amp;&amp; value === undefined) {\n        logger.error('输入节点必需参数未提供', {\n          nodeId: node.id,\n          inputName,\n          availableKeys: Object.keys(workflowInput),\n        });\n        throw new Error(&#96;必需参数 ${inputName} 未提供&#96;);\n      }\n\n      sharedContext[inputName] = value;\n      results.push({\n        name: inputName,\n        value,\n        type: inputParam.type || typeof value,\n      });\n    }\n\n    logger.info('输入节点执行完成', {\n      nodeId: node.id,\n      resultsCount: results.length,\n      results: results.map((r: any) =&gt; ({ name: r.name, type: r.type, hasValue: r.value !== undefined })),\n    });\n\n    return {\n      inputs: results,\n      count: results.length,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行Agent节点\n   */\n  private async executeAgentNode(\n    node: any,\n    sharedContext: Record&lt;string, any&gt;\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n\n        const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, mappingConfig.inputMappings);\n\n        // 获取对话的 Dify conversation_id（如果存在），用于多轮对话\n        const difyConversationId = conversationRecord?.difyConversationId || null;\n        \n        logger.info('准备发送消息到Dify工作流', {\n          本地对话ID: params.conversationId,\n          DifyConversationId: difyConversationId || '未设置（首次对话，Dify将返回新的conversation_id）',\n        });\n        \n        // 将 Dify conversation_id 添加到 workflowInput 中，这样 Agent 节点可以获取到\n        if (difyConversationId) {\n          workflowInput.conversationId = difyConversationId;\n          logger.info('已设置Dify conversation_id到工作流输入', { difyConversationId });\n        } else {\n          logger.info('首次对话，未设置Dify conversation_id，Dify将创建新的对话');\n        }\n\n        const workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(finalWorkflowId, {\n          input: workflowInput,\n        });\n\n        // 从工作流执行结果中提取 Dify conversation_id\n        // Agent 节点的输出中可能包含 conversation_id\n        let newDifyConversationId: string | null = null;\n        \n        // 尝试从工作流执行结果的数据中提取 conversation_id\n        // 首先检查 outputs 中是否包含 conversation_id\n        if (workflowResult?.data?.outputs) {\n          const outputs = workflowResult.data.outputs;\n          if (outputs.conversation_id &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.conversation_id === 'string') {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputs.conversation_id;\n          } else if (outputs.output &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.output === 'object' &amp;&amp; outputs.output.conversation_id) {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputs.output.conversation_id;\n          } else if (outputs.metadata &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.metadata === 'object' &amp;&amp; outputs.metadata.conversation_id) {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputs.metadata.conversation_id;\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果还没有找到，尝试从 extractedOutput 中提取\n  }\n}",

                  "lineNumber": 15519,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&amp;lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&amp;gt; = \\n\\n\\n  // 加载页面类型的来源信息（作为基础来源，始终保留）\\n  const loadPageTypeSources = useCallback(async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 使用有效的 pageType（可能包含项目ID）\\n      const pageTypeToLoad = projectId ? &amp;#96;${config.pageType}-project-${projectId}&amp;#96; : config.pageType;\\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 开始加载页面类型来源信息:', pageTypeToLoad);\\n      const sourceResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByPageType(pageTypeToLoad);\\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载结果:', {\\n        success: sourceResult.success,\\n        count: sourceResult.data?.length || 0,\\n        error: sourceResult.error\\n      });\\n      \\n      if (sourceResult.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; sourceResult.data &amp;amp;&amp;amp; sourceResult.data.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载到的来源:', sourceResult.data.map(s =&amp;gt; ({ id: s.id, title: s.title })));\\n        setSources(prev =&amp;gt; {\\n          // 合并现有来源和数据库中的来源，避免重复\\n          const sourceMap = new Map&amp;lt;string, Source&amp;gt;();\\n          // 先添加现有来源\\n          prev.forEach(s =&amp;gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\\n          // 再添加数据库中的来源（会覆盖重复的）\\n          sourceResult.data!.forEach(s =&amp;gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\\n          const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\\n          console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length);\\n          return merged;\\n        });\\n      } else if (sourceResult.error) {\\n        console.warn('[SourceInfo] 加载失败:', sourceResult.error);\\n      } else {\\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 没有找到页面类型的来源信息');\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"[SourceInfo] 加载页面类型来源信息失败:\\\", error);\\n      // 不阻止页面加载，只记录错误\\n    }\\n  }, [config.pageType, projectId]);\\n\\n  // 检查 URL 参数中的 sourceId 并自动选中（支持多个 sourceId）\\n;\","

'用户' : 'AI助手';\\\\n        return &amp;amp;#96;${role}: ${msg.content}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n      }).join('\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n');\\\\n\\\\n      // 如果对话文本太长，先截断（保留前2000字符）\\\\n      const maxLength = 2000;\\\\n      const truncatedText = conversationText.length &amp;amp;gt; maxLength \\\\n        ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\\\\n          undefined\\\\n        );\\\\n\\\\n        if (result.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; result.data) {\\\\n          const aiResponse = result.data.answer || result.data.result || '';\\\\n          // 解析 AI 响应，提取标题和摘要\\\\n          const titleMatch = aiResponse.match(/标题[：:]\\\\\\\\s*(.+)/);\\\\n          const summaryMatch = aiResponse.match(/摘要[：:]\\\\\\\\s*(.+?)(?:\\\\\\\\n|$)/s);\\\\n          \\\\n          if (titleMatch &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; titleMatch[1]) {\\\\n            summaryTitle = titleMatch[1].trim();\\\\n          }\\\\n          if (summaryMatch &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; summaryMatch[1]) {\\\\n            summaryDescription = summaryMatch[1].trim();\\\\n            // 如果 AI 生成的摘要太短，补充完整对话内容\\\\n            if (summaryDescription.length &amp;amp;lt; 200) {\\\\n              summaryDescription = &amp;amp;#96;${summaryDescription}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n完整对话内容：\\\\\\\\n${truncatedText}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n            }\\\\n          }\\\\n        }\\\\n      } catch (error) {\\\\n        console.warn('使用 AI 生成总结失败，使用简化版本:', error);\\\\n        // 如果 AI 调用失败，使用简化版本\\\\n        summaryTitle = aiMessages.length &amp;amp;gt; 0 \\\\n          ? &amp;amp;#96;项目对话摘要（${aiMessages.length}条消息）&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n          : '项目对话摘要';\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 创建来源信息\\\\n      const sourceId = &amp;amp;#96;project_conversation_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n      const source: Source = {\\\\n        id: sourceId,\\\\n        title: summaryTitle,\\\\n        type: 'external',\\\\n        description: summaryDescription,\\\\n      };\\\\n\\\\n      // 保存到数据库\\\\n      const saveResult = await sourceService.saveSourceInformation(\\\\n        source,\\\",\""

'发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      return null;\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\\\n      return null;\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\\\n   */\\\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\\\n    \\\\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\\\n    \\\\n    return {\\\\n      id: workflow.id,\\\\n      name: workflow.name,\\\\n      description: workflow.description,\\\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\\\n        required: p.required || false,\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\n      })),\\\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\n      })),\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取文件列表\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\\\n    category?: string;\\\",\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"class AiSearchService {\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 上传文件\\\\n   */\\\\n  async uploadFiles(files: File[], pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;amp;lt;FileUploadResponse[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const formData = new FormData();\\\\n      files.forEach((file) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n        formData.append('files', file);\\\\n      });\\\\n      \\\\n      // 如果提供了pageType，添加到formData\\\\n      if (pageType) {\\\\n        formData.append('pageType', pageType);\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await api.post('/ai-search/upload', formData, {\\\\n        headers: {\\\\n          'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data',\\\\n        },\\\\n      });\\\\n\\\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\\\n        return response.data.data;\\\\n      }\\\\n      throw new Error(response.data.error || '文件上传失败');\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\\\\n      throw error;\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 合并知识库内容\\\\n   */\\\\n  async mergeKnowledgeBaseContent(sources: Source[]): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const knowledgeBaseSources = sources.filter((s) =&amp;amp;gt; s.type === 'knowledge_base');\\\\n  }\\\",\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"                  \\\"content\\\": \\\"  \\\\\\\"contents\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"import api from './api';\\\\\\\\nimport { agentWorkflowService } from './agentWorkflowService';\\\\\\\\nimport { techPointService } from './techPointService';\\\\\\\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from './knowledgePointService';\\\\\\\\nimport {\\\\\\\\n  Conversation,\\\\\\\\n  Message,\\\\\\\\n  OutputContent,\\\\\\\\n  WorkflowConfig,\\\\\\\\n  FileUploadResponse,\\\\\\\\n  CreateConversationRequest,\\\\\\\\n  SendMessageRequest,\\\\\\\\n  ApiResponse,\\\\\\\\n  Source,\\\\\\\\n  FieldMappingConfig,\\\\\\\\n} from '../types/aiSearch';\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/**\\\\\\\\n * AI问答服务\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\\nclass AiSearchService {\\\\\\\\n  private normalizeMessage(raw: any): Message {\\\\\\\\n    return {\\\\\\\\n      ...raw,\\\\\\\\n      createdAt: raw?.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n  /**\\\\\\\\n   * 获取配置的工作流\\\\\\\\n   */\\\\\\\\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;amp;amp;lt;WorkflowConfig | null&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    try {\\\\\\\\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\\\\\\\\n      const params = pageType ? &amp;amp;amp;#96;?pageType=${pageType}&amp;amp;amp;#96; : '';\\\\\\\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;amp;amp;#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&amp;amp;amp;#96;);\\\\\\\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\\\\\\\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\\\\\\\\n        // 获取工作流详情\\\\\\\\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\\\\\\\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\\\\\\\n        if (workflow) {\\\\\\\\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n      \\\\\\\\n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\\\\\\\\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\\\\\\\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\\\\\\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\\\\\\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\\\\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n      \\\\\\\\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\\\\\\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n      \\\\\\\\n      return null;\\\\\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n      return null;\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n  /**\\\\\\\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\\\\\\\n   */\\\\\\\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\\\\\\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\\\\\\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\\\\\\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\\\\\\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    return {\\\\\\\\n      id: workflow.id,\\\\\\\\n      name: workflow.name,\\\\\\\\n      description: workflow.description,\\\\\\\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\\\\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\\\\\\\n        required: p.required || false,\\\\\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\\\\\n      })),\\\\\\\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\\\\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\\\\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\\\\\n      })),\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n  /**\\\\\\\\n   * 获取文件列表\\\\\\\\n   */\\\\\\\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\\\\\\\n    category?: string;\\\\\\\",\\\"\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"                  \\\"content\\\": \\\"  \\\\\\\"contents\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"import { apiClient, type ApiErrorPayload, type ApiResponse } from \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"@/shared/lib/api/apiClient\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\";\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nexport interface WorkflowResponse {\\\\\\\\n  success: boolean;\\\\\\\\n  data?: any;\\\\\\\\n  error?: string;\\\\\\\\n  message?: string;\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nconst toWorkflowResponse = &amp;amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;amp;gt;(response: ApiResponse&amp;amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;amp; { message?: string }): WorkflowResponse =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  if (response.success) {\\\\\\\\n    return {\\\\\\\\n      success: true,\\\\\\\\n      data: response.data,\\\\\\\\n      message: response.message,\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n  return {\\\\\\\\n    success: false,\\\\\\\\n    error: response.error?.message ?? response.message ?? \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"请求失败\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n    data: response.data,\\\\\\\\n  };\\\\\\\\n};\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nconst handleApiError = (scope: string, error: unknown): WorkflowResponse =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  console.error(&amp;amp;amp;#96;${scope} error:&amp;amp;amp;#96;, error);\\\\\\\\n  if ((error as ApiErrorPayload)?.message) {\\\\\\\\n    return {\\\\\\\\n      success: false,\\\\\\\\n      error: (error as ApiErrorPayload).message,\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n  if (error instanceof Error) {\\\\\\\\n    return {\\\\\\\\n      success: false,\\\\\\\\n      error: error.message,\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n  return {\\\\\\\\n    success: false,\\\\\\\\n    error: \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"请求失败\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n  };\\\\\\\\n};\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nexport interface DifyAPIConfig {\\\\\\\\n  id: string;\\\\\\\\n  name: string;\\\\\\\\n  description: string;\\\\\\\\n  apiUrl: string;\\\\\\\\n  apiKey: string;\\\\\\\\n  enabled: boolean;\\\\\\\\n  createdAt?: Date;\\\\\\\\n  updatedAt?: Date;\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nconst warnDeprecatedDifyConfig = (scope: string) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  console.warn(&amp;amp;amp;#96;[workflowAPI] 已忽略前端传入的 difyConfig (${scope})，所有调用均改为通过后端网关处理&amp;amp;amp;#96;);\\\\\\\\n};\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nexport const workflowAPI = {\\\\\\\\n  // AI问答 - 支持自定义Dify配置\\\\\\\\n  aiSearch: async (query: string, inputs: any = {}, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('aiSearch');\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    try {\\\\\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post&amp;amp;amp;lt;{ message?: string }&amp;amp;amp;gt;(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"/workflow/ai-search\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", {\\\\\\\\n        query,\\\\\\\\n        inputs,\\\\\\\\n        conversationId,\\\\\\\\n      }, {\\\\\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\\\\\n      });\\\\\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"AI search API\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", error);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n  },\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n  // 智能搜索\\\\\\\\n  smartSearch: async (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('smartSearch');\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    try {\\\\\\\\n      const requestData: any = { query };\\\\\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"/workflow/smart-search\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\\\\\n      });\\\\\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Smart search API\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", error);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n  },\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n  // 技术包装\\\\\\\\n  techPackage: async (searchResults: any, template?: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techPackage');\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    try {\\\\\\\\n      let inputs: any;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n      if (searchResults &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; typeof searchResults === 'object' &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; searchResults.query) {\\\\\\\\n        inputs = {\\\\\\\\n          query: searchResults.query,\\\\\\\\n          selectedKnowledgePoints: searchResults.selectedKnowledgePoints,\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n      } else {\\\\\\\\n        inputs = {\\\\\\\\n          searchResults: searchResults,\\\\\\\\n          template: template,\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\\\\\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"/workflow/tech-package\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\\\\\n      });\\\\\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Tech package API\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", error);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n  },\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n  // 技术策略\\\\\\\\n  techStrategy: async (techPackage: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techStrategy');\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    try {\\\\\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\\\\\n        inputs: { techPackage },\\\\\\\\n      };\\\\\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"/workflow/tech-strategy\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\\\\\n      });\\\\\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Tech strategy API\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", error);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n  },\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n  // 推广策略\\\\\\\\n  promotionStrategy: async (techStrategy: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('promotionStrategy');\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    try {\\\\\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\\\\\n        inputs: { techStrategy },\\\\\\\\n      };\\\\\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"/workflow/promotion-strategy\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\\\\\n      });\\\\\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Promotion strategy API\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", error);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n  },\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n  // 技术通稿\\\\\\\\n  coreDraft: async (promotionStrategy: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('coreDraft');\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    try {\\\\\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\\\\\n        inputs: { promotionStrategy },\\\\\\\\n      };\\\\\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"/workflow/core-draft\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\\\\\n      });\\\\\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Core draft API\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", error);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n  },\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n  // 发布会演讲稿\\\\\\\\n  speechGeneration: async (coreDraft: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('speechGeneration');\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    try {\\\\\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\\\\\n        inputs: { coreDraft },\\\\\\\\n      };\\\\\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"/workflow/speech-generation\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\\\\\n      });\\\\\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Speech generation API\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", error);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n  },\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n  // 演讲稿\\\\\\\\n  speech: async (inputs: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('speech');\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    try {\\\\\\\\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\\\\\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"/workflow/speech-generation\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", requestData);\\\\\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Speech API\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", error);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n  },\\\\\\\\n};\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nconst legacyApi = {\\\\\\\\n  async get&amp;amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;amp;gt;(url: string, config?: any) {\\\\\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.get&amp;amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;amp;gt;(url, config);\\\\\\\\n    return { data };\\\\\\\\n  },\\\\\\\\n  async post&amp;amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;amp;gt;(url: string, body?: any, config?: any) {\\\\\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.post&amp;amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;amp;gt;(url, body, config);\\\\\\\\n    return { data };\\\\\\\\n  },\\\\\\\\n  async put&amp;amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;amp;gt;(url: string, body?: any, config?: any) {\\\\\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.put&amp;amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;amp;gt;(url, body, config);\\\\\\\\n    return { data };\\\\\\\\n  },\\\\\\\\n  async delete&amp;amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;amp;gt;(url: string, config?: any) {\\\\\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.delete&amp;amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;amp;gt;(url, config);\\\\\\\\n    return { data };\\\\\\\\n  },\\\\\\\\n};\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nexport default legacyApi;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\",\\\"\""

{\\\\n  console.error(&amp;amp;#96;${scope} error:&amp;amp;#96;, error);\\\\n  if ((error as ApiErrorPayload)?.message) {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      success: false,\\\\n      error: (error as ApiErrorPayload).message,\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n  if (error instanceof Error) {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      success: false,\\\\n      error: error.message,\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n  return {\\\\n    success: false,\\\\n    error: \\\\\\\"请求失败\\\\\\\",\\\\n  };\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport interface DifyAPIConfig {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  name: string;\\\\n  description: string;\\\\n  apiUrl: string;\\\\n  apiKey: string;\\\\n  enabled: boolean;\\\\n  createdAt?: Date;\\\\n  updatedAt?: Date;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nconst warnDeprecatedDifyConfig = (scope: string) =&amp;amp;gt;
