                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport { Bot, Send, Paperclip, X, AlertCircle, RotateCcw, Loader2, Plus } from \\\"lucide-react\\\";\\nimport { Message, Conversation } from \\\"../../types/aiSearch\\\";\\nimport { Source } from \\\"./SourceSidebar\\\";\\nimport { aiSearchService } from \\\"../../services/aiSearchService\\\";\\nimport MessageItem from \\\"./MessageItem\\\";\\n\\ninterface DialogueContentProps {\\n  conversation: Conversation | null;\\n  sources: Source[];\\n  sentSourceIds?: string[]; // 已发送给 Dify 的来源 ID\\n  onSourcesSent?: (sourceIds: string[]) =&amp;gt; void; // 标记来源已发送\\n  contextWindowSize: number;\\n  onContextWindowSizeChange?: (value: number) =&amp;gt; void;\\n  workflowId?: string | null;\\n  hasMoreMessages?: boolean;\\n  onLoadMoreMessages?: () =&amp;gt; void;\\n  isLoadingMore?: boolean;\\n  onMessageSent?: (message: Message) =&amp;gt; void;\\n  onSaveToNotes?: (content: string) =&amp;gt; void;\\n  onEnsureConversation?: () =&amp;gt; Promise&amp;lt;Conversation | null&amp;gt;;\\n  onCreateNewConversation?: () =&amp;gt; Promise&amp;lt;void&amp;gt;;\\n  availableWorkflows?: Array&amp;lt;{ id: string; name: string }&amp;gt;;\\n  selectedWorkflowId?: string | null;\\n  onWorkflowChange?: (workflowId: string) =&amp;gt; void;\\n  isWorkflowLoading?: boolean;\\n  dialogueTitle?: string;\\n}\\n\\nconst DialogueContent: React.FC&amp;lt;DialogueContentProps&amp;gt; = ({\\n  conversation,\\n  sources,\\n  sentSourceIds = [],\\n  onSourcesSent,\\n  contextWindowSize,\\n  onContextWindowSizeChange,\\n  workflowId,\\n  hasMoreMessages,\\n  onLoadMoreMessages,\\n  isLoadingMore,\\n  onMessageSent,\\n  onSaveToNotes,\\n  onEnsureConversation,\\n  onCreateNewConversation,\\n  availableWorkflows = [],\\n  selectedWorkflowId,\\n  onWorkflowChange,\\n  isWorkflowLoading = false,\\n  dialogueTitle = \\\"AI内容助手\\\",\\n}) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const [query, setQuery] = useState(\\\"\\\");\\n  const [messages, setMessages] = useState&amp;lt;Message[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\\n  const [selectedFiles, setSelectedFiles] = useState&amp;lt;File[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState&amp;lt;string | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [errorDetail, setErrorDetail] = useState&amp;lt;string | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const messagesEndRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLDivElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const fileInputRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLInputElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const lastSubmissionRef = useRef&amp;lt;{ content: string; files: File[] } | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n\\n  // 同步对话消息\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (conversation) {\\n      const rawMessages = conversation.messages || [];\\n      // 按消息ID去重，保留最新的消息\\n      const messageMap = new Map&amp;lt;string, Message&amp;gt;();\\n      rawMessages.forEach((msg) =&amp;gt; {\\n        messageMap.set(msg.id, msg);\\n      });\\n      // 按时间排序\\n      const uniqueMessages = Array.from(messageMap.values()).sort((a, b) =&amp;gt; {\\n        const timeA = a.createdAt instanceof Date ? a.createdAt.getTime() : new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();\\n        const timeB = b.createdAt instanceof Date ? b.createdAt.getTime() : new Date(b.createdAt).getTime();\\n        return timeA - timeB; // 升序排列，最早的在前\\n      });\\n      setMessages(uniqueMessages);\\n    } else {\\n      setMessages([]);\\n    }\\n    setErrorMessage(null);\\n    setErrorDetail(null);\\n  }, [conversation]);\\n\\n  // 自动滚动到底部\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: \\\"smooth\\\" });\\n  }, [messages]);\\n\\n  const handleSend = async (override?: { content: string; files: File[] }) =&amp;gt; {\\n    const draftContent = override?.content ?? query.trim();\\n    const draftFiles = override?.files ?? selectedFiles;\\n\\n    if (!draftContent &amp;amp;&amp;amp; draftFiles.length === 0) return;\\n\\n    let activeConversation = conversation;\\n\\n    if (!activeConversation &amp;amp;&amp;amp; onEnsureConversation) {\\n      try {\\n        setIsLoading(true);\\n        setErrorMessage(null);\\n        setErrorDetail(null);\\n        const ensured = await onEnsureConversation();\\n        if (!ensured) {\\n          setIsLoading(false);\\n          setErrorMessage(\\\"请先在左侧选择来源并创建对话\\\");\\n          return;\\n        }\\n        activeConversation = ensured;\\n        setMessages(ensured.messages || []);\\n      } catch (error: any) {\\n        console.error(\\\"创建对话失败:\\\", error);\\n        setIsLoading(false);\\n        setErrorMessage(error?.message || \\\"创建对话失败，请稍后重试\\\");\\n        return;\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    if (!activeConversation) {\\n      setErrorMessage(\\\"请先创建对话\\\");\\n      return;\\n    }\\n\\n    setIsLoading(true);\\n    setErrorMessage(null);\\n    setErrorDetail(null);\\n\\n    try {\\n      const submission = {\\n        content: draftContent || \\\"已上传文件\\\",\\n        files: draftFiles,\\n      };\\n      lastSubmissionRef.current = submission;\\n\\n      // 计算新增的来源（当前选中但尚未发送过的）\\n      const newSources = sources.filter((s) =&amp;gt; !sentSourceIds.includes(s.id));\\n      const newSourceIds = newSources.map((s) =&amp;gt; s.id);\\n      \\n      // 构建文件列表和知识库名称（仅针对新增的来源）\\n      let fileList: string | undefined;\\n      let knowledgeBaseNames: string | undefined;\\n      \\n      if (newSources.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        // 筛选新增的文件（type === 'external'）\\n        const fileSources = newSources.filter((s) =&amp;gt; s.type === 'external');\\n        if (fileSources.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n          fileList = fileSources.map((s) =&amp;gt; s.title).join(', ');\\n        }\\n        \\n        // 筛选新增的知识库（type === 'knowledge_base'）\\n        const knowledgeBaseSources = newSources.filter((s) =&amp;gt; s.type === 'knowledge_base');\\n        if (knowledgeBaseSources.length &amp;gt; {\\\\n              const timeA = a.createdAt instanceof Date ? a.createdAt.getTime() : new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();\\\\n              const timeB = b.createdAt instanceof Date ? b.createdAt.getTime() : new Date(b.createdAt).getTime();\\\\n              return timeA - timeB;\\\\n            });\\\\n            return {\\\\n              ...detail,\\\\n              messages: uniqueMessages,\\\\n            };\\\\n          }\\\\n          return detail;\\\\n        });\\\\n      } catch (error) {\\\\n        console.error(\\\\\\\"加载对话详情失败:\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n        reportError(\\\\\\\"加载对话详情失败，请稍后重试\\\\\\\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\\\\n      } finally {\\\\n        // 清除加载标记\\\\n        loadingConversationRef.current.delete(conversationId);\\\\n      }\\\\n    },\\\\n    [reportError]\\\\n  );\\\\n\\\\n  const loadConversations = useCallback(async (options?: { refreshActive?: boolean; {\\\\n        const existing = conversationMap.get(conv.id);\\\\n        if (!existing) {\\\\n          conversationMap.set(conv.id, conv);\\\\n        } else {\\\\n          duplicateIds.push(conv.id);\\\\n          // 如果已存在，比较更新时间，保留更新的\\\\n          const existingTime = existing.updatedAt instanceof Date \\\\n            ? existing.updatedAt.getTime() \\\\n            : new Date(existing.updatedAt).getTime();\\\\n          const currentTime = conv.updatedAt instanceof Date \\\\n            ? conv.updatedAt.getTime() \\\\n            : new Date(conv.updatedAt).getTime();\\\\n          if (currentTime &amp;amp;gt; existingTime) {\\\\n            conversationMap.set(conv.id, conv);\\\\n          }\\\\n        }\\\\n      });\\\\n      \\\\n      if (duplicateIds.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n        console.warn('[ConversationDebug] 发现重复的对话ID:', duplicateIds);\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 转换为数组并按更新时间排序\\\\n      const uniqueConversations = Array.from(conversationMap.values()).sort((a, b) =&amp;amp;gt;                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"const NodePage: React.FC = \\n() =&amp;gt; {\\n\\n  }, [nodeType]);\\n\\n  // 加载AI角色配置（如果没有从公开配置中获取）\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const loadAIRole = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果已经从公开配置中获取了角色，则跳过\\n      if (aiRole || !nodeType || !isValidIndependentNodeType(nodeType)) {\\n        setRolesLoading(false);\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      try {\\n        setRolesLoading(true);\\n        setRoleError(null);\\n        \\n        // 获取所有AI角色\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleService.getAIRoles();\\n        \\n        // 查找匹配的AI角色\\n        const matchedRole = findAIRoleForNode(nodeType as IndependentNodeType, allRoles);\\n        \\n        if (matchedRole) {\\n          setAiRole(matchedRole);\\n        } else {\\n          setRoleError('未找到匹配的AI角色配置，请前往AI角色管理页面创建对应的角色。');\\n        }\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        console.error('加载AI角色失败:', error);\\n        setRoleError('加载AI角色配置失败，将使用默认API配置。');\\n      } finally {\\n        setRolesLoading(false);\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    if (!configLoading) {\\n      loadAIRole();\\n    }\\n  }, [nodeType, configLoading, aiRole]);\\n\\n  // 处理节点执行\\n  const handleNodeExecution = async (inputData: any) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setIsLoading(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 模拟执行过程\\n      await new Promise((resolve) =&amp;gt; setTimeout(resolve, 2000));\\n\\n      const result = {\\n        success: true,\\n        message: \\\"执行成功\\\",\\n        data: inputData,\\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n      };\\n\\n      setExecutionResult(result);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      setExecutionResult({\\n        success: false,\\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : \\\"执行失败\\\",\\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n      });\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 重新执行\\n  const handleReExecute = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setExecutionResult(null);\\n  };\\n\\n  // 如果节点类型是 speech，使用发布会稿页面\\n  if (nodeType === 'speech') {\\n    return &amp;lt;PressReleasePage /&amp;gt;;\\n  }\\n\\n  if (nodeType === 'tech-strategy') {\\n    return &amp;lt;TechStrategyPage /&amp;gt;;\\n  }\\n;\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class AgentOrchestrator {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行 Agent（核心方法）\\n   * @param roleId 角色ID\\n   * @param query 用户查询\\n   * @param conversationId 对话ID（可选，如果不存在会生成新的）\\n   * @param context 上下文数据（用于变量替换）\\n   * @returns 执行结果\\n   */\\n  async executeAgent(\\n    roleId: string,\\n    query: string,\\n    conversationId: string = '',\\n    context: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {}\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;AgentExecutionResult&amp;gt; {\\n    const startTime = Date.now();\\n    const MAX_EXECUTION_TIME = 360000; // 6分钟总体超时（留出缓冲给前端7分钟超时）\\n    \\n    // 检查超时的辅助函数\\n    const checkTimeout = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;\\n      if (elapsed &amp;gt; MAX_EXECUTION_TIME) {\\n        throw new Error(&amp;#96;Agent执行超时：已执行 ${Math.round(elapsed / 1000)} 秒，超过最大执行时间 ${MAX_EXECUTION_TIME / 1000} 秒&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n    };\\n    \\n    // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\\n    checkTimeout();\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\\n    if (!role) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    if (!role.agentConfig) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;Agent配置不存在: ${roleId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\\n\\n    // 2. 生成或使用 conversationId\\n    const finalConversationId = conversationId || this.generateConversationId();\\n\\n    // 3. 渲染 System Prompt\\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\\n      context\\n    );\\n\\n    // 4. 获取上下文消息\\n    checkTimeout();\\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\\n      finalConversationId,\\n      config.contextStrategy,\\n      query\\n    );\\n\\n    // 5. 构建完整消息列表\\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [];\\n    \\n    // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\\n    if (config.contextStrategy.includeSystemPrompt || contextMessages.length === 0) {\\n      messages.push({\\n        role: 'system',\\n        content: systemPrompt\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 20962,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import api from './api';\\nimport { agentWorkflowService } from './agentWorkflowService';\\nimport { techPointService } from './techPointService';\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from './knowledgePointService';\\nimport {\\n  Conversation,\\n  Message,\\n  OutputContent,\\n  WorkflowConfig,\\n  FileUploadResponse,\\n  CreateConversationRequest,\\n  SendMessageRequest,\\n  ApiResponse,\\n  Source,\\n  FieldMappingConfig,\\n} from '../types/aiSearch';\\n\\n/**\\n * AI问答服务\\n */\\nclass AiSearchService {\\n  private normalizeMessage(raw: any): Message {\\n    return {\\n      ...raw,\\n      createdAt: raw?.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取配置的工作流\\n   */\\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowConfig | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\\n      const params = pageType ? &amp;#96;?pageType=${pageType}&amp;#96; : '';\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&amp;#96;);\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\\n        // 获取工作流详情\\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\n        if (workflow) {\\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\\n        }\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\n      }\\n      \\n      return null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\n   */\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\n    \\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\n    \\n    return {\\n      id: workflow.id,\\n      name: workflow.name,\\n      description: workflow.description,\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\n        required: p.required || false,\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取文件列表\\n   */\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\n    category?: string;\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"// 配置multer用于文件上传\\nconst storage = multer.diskStorage({\\n  destination: (req, file, cb) =&amp;gt; {\\n    cb(null, 'uploads/ai-search/');\\n  },\\n  filename: (req, file, cb) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 生成唯一文件名，但保留原始扩展名\\n    const uniqueSuffix = Date.now() + '-' + Math.round(Math.random() * 1E9);\\n    const ext = path.extname(file.originalname);\\n    cb(null, &amp;#96;${uniqueSuffix}${ext}&amp;#96;);\\n  },\\n});\\n\\nconst upload = multer({\\n  storage: storage,\\n  limits: {\\n    fileSize: 10 * 1024 * 1024, // 10MB\\n  },\\n  fileFilter: (req: Request, file: Express.Multer.File, cb: multer.FileFilterCallback) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 允许的文件类型：PDF, PPT, txt, markdown, word\\n    const allowedTypes = [\\n      'application/pdf',\\n      'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint', // .ppt\\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation', // .pptx\\n      'application/msword', // .doc\\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', // .docx\\n      'text/plain',\\n      'text/markdown',\\n    ];\\n    // 也允许通过扩展名判断\\n    const allowedExtensions = ['.pdf', '.ppt', '.pptx', '.doc', '.docx', '.txt', '.md', '.markdown'];\\n    const fileExtension = require('path').extname(file.originalname).toLowerCase();\\n    \\n    if (allowedTypes.includes(file.mimetype) || allowedExtensions.includes(fileExtension)) {\\n      cb(null, true);\\n    } else {\\n      cb(new Error(&amp;#96;不支持的文件类型: ${file.mimetype}。支持的类型：PDF, PPT, txt, markdown, word&amp;#96;));\\n    }\\n  },\\n});\\n\\n// 确保上传目录存在\\nconst uploadDir = 'uploads/ai-search/';\\nif (!fs.existsSync(uploadDir)) {\\n  fs.mkdirSync(uploadDir, { recursive: true });\\n}\\n\\n// 初始化服务\\nconst aiSearchService = new AiSearchService();\\nconst fieldMappingService = new FieldMappingService();\\nconst createConversationUseCase = new CreateConversationUseCase(aiSearchService);\\nconst getConversationsUseCase = new GetConversationsUseCase(aiSearchService);\\nconst getConversationDetailUseCase = new GetConversationDetailUseCase(aiSearchService);\\nconst sendMessageUseCase = new SendMessageUseCase;\","

                  "lineNumber": 12101,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import api from './api';\\nimport { agentWorkflowService } from './agentWorkflowService';\\nimport { techPointService } from './techPointService';\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from './knowledgePointService';\\nimport {\\n  Conversation,\\n  Message,\\n  OutputContent,\\n  WorkflowConfig,\\n  FileUploadResponse,\\n  CreateConversationRequest,\\n  SendMessageRequest,\\n  ApiResponse,\\n  Source,\\n  FieldMappingConfig,\\n} from '../types/aiSearch';\\n\\n/**\\n * AI问答服务\\n */\\nclass AiSearchService {\\n  private normalizeMessage(raw: any): Message {\\n    return {\\n      ...raw,\\n      createdAt: raw?.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取配置的工作流\\n   */\\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowConfig | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\\n      const params = pageType ? &amp;#96;?pageType=${pageType}&amp;#96; : '';\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&amp;#96;);\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\\n        // 获取工作流详情\\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\n        if (workflow) {\\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\\n        }\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\n      }\\n      \\n      return null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\n   */\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\n    \\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\n    \\n    return {\\n      id: workflow.id,\\n      name: workflow.name,\\n      description: workflow.description,\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\n        required: p.required || false,\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        name: p.name,\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\n        description: p.description,\\n      })),\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取文件列表\\n   */\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\n    category?: string;\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\\nimport { Upload, Search, X, FileText, Trash2, Check, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';\\nimport { Project } from '../types/project';\\nimport projectService from '../services/projectService';\\nimport { aiSearchService } from '../services/aiSearchService';\\nimport { techPointService } from '../services/techPointService';\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from '../services/knowledgePointService';\\nimport { TechPoint } from '../types/techPoint';\\nimport { KnowledgePoint } from '../types/knowledgePoint';\\nimport { FileUploadResponse } from '../types/aiSearch';\\nimport api from '../services/api';\\n\\ninterface SourceInformation {\\n  id: number;\\n  source_id: string;\\n  title: string;\\n  type: 'knowledge_base' | 'external';\\n  url?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  created_at: string;\\n}\\n\\nconst ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const { projectId } = useParams&amp;lt;{ projectId: string }&amp;gt;();\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const fileInputRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLInputElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const techPointSelectorRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLDivElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  \\n  const [project, setProject] = useState&amp;lt;Project | null&amp;gt;(null);\","

                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 28290,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# 文件转Markdown功能设置说明\\n\\n## 概述\\n\\n系统已实现文件转Markdown功能，支持将上传的PDF、Word、PPT、TXT、Markdown文件转换为Markdown格式，并将其作为附加信息传递给Agent参与对话。\\n\\n## 功能特性\\n\\n1. **支持的文件类型**：\\n   - PDF (.pdf)\\n   - PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptx)\\n   - Word (.doc, .docx)\\n   - 文本文件 (.txt)\\n   - Markdown (.md, .markdown)\\n\\n2. **自动转换**：\\n   - 文件上传时自动提取文本内容并转换为Markdown格式\\n   - Markdown内容存储在文件记录的metadata中\\n\\n3. **智能传递**：\\n   - 文件的Markdown内容作为附加信息自动传递给Agent\\n   - 无论是否第一次对话，文件内容都会作为上下文传递\\n\\n## 安装依赖\\n\\n为了支持文件转换功能，需要安装以下npm包：\\n\\n### 必需依赖\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\n# PDF文件转换\\nnpm install pdf-parse\\n\\n# Word文件转换\\nnpm install mammoth\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 可选依赖（PPT转换）\\n\\nPPT文件转换功能目前返回占位符文本。如需完整支持，可以安装以下库：\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\n# PPT转换（可选，需要额外配置）\\nnpm install officegen\\n# 或\\nnpm install pptx2json\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 使用说明\\n\\n### 前端使用\\n\\n1. 在\\\"添加来源\\\"弹窗中选择\\\"上传文件\\\"模式\\n2. 拖放或选择文件（支持PDF、PPT、Word、TXT、Markdown）\\n3. 文件上传后会自动提取文本内容\\n\\n### 后端处理\\n\\n1. 文件上传时，&amp;#96;FileToMarkdownService&amp;#96;会自动识别文件类型\\n2. 调用相应的转换方法提取文本内容\\n3. 将Markdown内容存储在文件记录的metadata中\\n4. 发送消息时，从文件记录中提取Markdown内容\\n5. 将Markdown内容作为附加信息添加到用户查询中\\n\\n## 代码结构\\n\\n### 服务文件\\n\\n- &amp;#96;backend/src/services/FileToMarkdownService.ts&amp;#96; - 文件转Markdown服务\\n- &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes.ts&amp;#96; - 文件上传路由（已集成转换功能）\\n- &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/SendMessage.usecase.ts&amp;#96; - 消息发送用例（已集成Markdown内容提取）\\n\\n### 前端组件\\n\\n- &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/ai-search/AddTextModal.tsx&amp;#96; - 添加来源弹窗（已更新文件类型限制）\","
                },

                {
                  "lineNumber": 38458,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"class AiSearchService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取文件列表\\n   */\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\n    category?: string;\\n    conversationId?: string;\\n    pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release';\\n    limit?: number;\\n    offset?: number;\\n    excludeGarbled?: boolean; // 排除乱码文件名\\n  }): Promise&amp;lt;FileUploadResponse[]&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const params = new URLSearchParams();\\n      if (options?.category) {\\n        params.set('category', options.category);\\n      }\\n      if (options?.conversationId) {\\n        params.set('conversationId', options.conversationId);\\n      }\\n      if (options?.pageType) {\\n        params.set('pageType', options.pageType);\\n      }\\n      if (options?.limit) {\\n        params.set('limit', String(options.limit));\\n      }\\n      if (options?.offset) {\\n        params.set('offset', String(options.offset));\\n      }\\n      if (options?.excludeGarbled !== false) {\\n        // 默认排除乱码文件名\\n        params.set('excludeGarbled', 'true');\\n      } else {\\n        // 如果明确设置为false，则不排除\\n        params.set('excludeGarbled', 'false');\\n      }\\n\\n      const query = params.toString();\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;/ai-search/files${query ? &amp;#96;?${query}&amp;#96; : ''}&amp;#96;);\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        return response.data.data;\\n      }\\n      return [];\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\\n      return [];\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 上传文件\\n   */\\n  async uploadFiles(files: File[], pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;lt;FileUploadResponse[]&amp;gt; {\\n    \\n  }\","

                  "lineNumber": 39001,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&amp;lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&amp;gt; = \\n\\n\\n  const loadFiles = useCallback(async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      try {\\n        const cleanupApi = await import(\\\"../../services/api\\\");\\n        await cleanupApi.default.delete('/ai-search/files/garbled/cleanup');\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        console.warn('清理乱码文件失败:', error);\\n      }\\n\\n      const files = await aiSearchService.getFiles({ pageType: config.pageType });\\n      const fileSources: Source[] = files.map((file) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        id: &amp;#96;file_${file.id || file.fileId}&amp;#96;,\\n        title: file.name,\\n        type: 'external' as const,\\n        url: file.url,\\n        description: &amp;#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(file.size)}&amp;#96;,\\n      }));\\n      \\n      setSources((prev) =&amp;gt; {\\n        const nonFileSources = prev.filter((s) =&amp;gt; !s.id.startsWith('file_'));\\n        return [...nonFileSources, ...fileSources];\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载文件列表失败:', error);\\n    }\\n  }, [config.pageType]);\\n\\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024) return bytes + ' B';\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';\\n    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadAvailableWorkflows = useCallback(async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(true);\\n      const list = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n      setAvailableWorkflows(list);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"加载工作流列表失败:\\\", error);\\n      reportError(\\\"加载工作流列表失败\\\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  }, [reportError]);\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    loadAvailableWorkflows();\\n  }, [loadAvailableWorkflows]);\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const loadEnabledToolsForPage = async () =&amp;gt;\\n;\\n  }\\n;\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 39793,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const AISearchPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n  const loadFiles = useCallback(async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 先尝试清理乱码文件\\n      try {\\n        const cleanupApi = await import(\\\"../services/api\\\");\\n        await cleanupApi.default.delete('/ai-search/files/garbled/cleanup');\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        // 清理失败不影响文件列表加载\\n        console.warn('清理乱码文件失败:', error);\\n      }\\n\\n      const files = await aiSearchService.getFiles({ pageType });\\n      // 将文件转换为Source格式\\n      const fileSources: Source[] = files.map((file) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        id: &amp;#96;file_${file.id || file.fileId}&amp;#96;,\\n        title: file.name,\\n        type: 'external' as const,\\n        url: file.url,\\n        description: &amp;#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(file.size)}&amp;#96;,\\n      }));\\n      \\n      // 完全替换文件来源，避免重复\\n      setSources((prev) =&amp;gt; {\\n        // 保留非文件来源（知识库来源等）\\n        const nonFileSources = prev.filter((s) =&amp;gt; !s.id.startsWith('file_'));\\n        // 使用数据库中的文件列表，完全替换文件来源\\n        return [...nonFileSources, ...fileSources];\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载文件列表失败:', error);\\n    }\\n  }, [pageType]);\\n\\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024) return bytes + ' B';\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';\\n    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadAvailableWorkflows = useCallback(async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(true);\\n      const list = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\n      setAvailableWorkflows(list);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"加载工作流列表失败:\\\", error);\\n      reportError(\\\"加载工作流列表失败\\\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  }, [reportError]);\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    loadAvailableWorkflows();\\n  }, [loadAvailableWorkflows]);\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const loadEnabledToolsForPage = async () =&amp;gt;\\n;\\n  }\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 45034,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"# 文件转Markdown功能设置说明\\n\\n## 概述\\n\\n系统已实现文件转Markdown功能，支持将上传的PDF、Word、PPT、TXT、Markdown文件转换为Markdown格式，并将其作为附加信息传递给Agent参与对话。\\n\\n## 功能特性\\n\\n1. **支持的文件类型**：\\n   - PDF (.pdf)\\n   - PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptx)\\n   - Word (.doc, .docx)\\n   - 文本文件 (.txt)\\n   - Markdown (.md, .markdown)\\n\\n2. **自动转换**：\\n   - 文件上传时自动提取文本内容并转换为Markdown格式\\n   - Markdown内容存储在文件记录的metadata中\\n\\n3. **智能传递**：\\n   - 文件的Markdown内容作为附加信息自动传递给Agent\\n   - 无论是否第一次对话，文件内容都会作为上下文传递\\n\\n## 安装依赖\\n\\n为了支持文件转换功能，需要安装以下npm包：\\n\\n### 必需依赖\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\n# PDF文件转换\\nnpm install pdf-parse\\n\\n# Word文件转换\\nnpm install mammoth\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 可选依赖（PPT转换）\\n\\nPPT文件转换功能目前返回占位符文本。如需完整支持，可以安装以下库：\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;bash\\n# PPT转换（可选，需要额外配置）\\nnpm install officegen\\n# 或\\nnpm install pptx2json\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 使用说明\\n\\n### 前端使用\\n\\n1. 在\\\"添加来源\\\"弹窗中选择\\\"上传文件\\\"模式\\n2. 拖放或选择文件（支持PDF、PPT、Word、TXT、Markdown）\\n3. 文件上传后会自动提取文本内容\\n\\n### 后端处理\\n\\n1. 文件上传时，&amp;#96;FileToMarkdownService&amp;#96;会自动识别文件类型\\n2. 调用相应的转换方法提取文本内容\\n3. 将Markdown内容存储在文件记录的metadata中\\n4. 发送消息时，从文件记录中提取Markdown内容\\n5. 将Markdown内容作为附加信息添加到用户查询中\\n\\n## 代码结构\\n\\n### 服务文件\\n\\n- &amp;#96;backend/src/services/FileToMarkdownService.ts&amp;#96; - 文件转Markdown服务\\n- &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes.ts&amp;#96; - 文件上传路由（已集成转换功能）\\n- &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/SendMessage.usecase.ts&amp;#96; - 消息发送用例（已集成Markdown内容提取）\\n\\n### 前端组件\\n\\n- &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/ai-search/AddTextModal.tsx&amp;#96; - 添加来源弹窗（已更新文件类型限制）\","

                  "lineNumber": 46317,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"// 配置multer用于文件上传\\nconst storage = multer.diskStorage({\\n  destination: (req, file, cb) =&amp;gt; {\\n    cb(null, 'uploads/ai-search/');\\n  },\\n  filename: (req, file, cb) =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 生成唯一文件名，但保留原始扩展名\\n    const uniqueSuffix = Date.now() + '-' + Math.round(Math.random() * 1E9);\\n    const ext = path.extname(file.originalname);\\n    cb(null, &amp;#96;${uniqueSuffix}${ext}&amp;#96;);\\n  },\\n});\\n\\nconst upload = multer({\\n  storage: storage,\\n  limits: {\\n    fileSize: 10 * 1024 * 1024, // 10MB\\n  },\\n  fileFilter: (req: Request, file: Express.Multer.File, cb: multer.FileFilterCallback) =&amp;gt;                   "lineNumber": 5230,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import api from './api';\\\\nimport { agentWorkflowService } from './agentWorkflowService';\\\\nimport { techPointService } from './techPointService';\\\\nimport { knowledgePointService } from './knowledgePointService';\\\\nimport {\\\\n  Conversation,\\\\n  Message,\\\\n  OutputContent,\\\\n  WorkflowConfig,\\\\n  FileUploadResponse,\\\\n  CreateConversationRequest,\\\\n  SendMessageRequest,\\\\n  ApiResponse,\\\\n  Source,\\\\n  FieldMappingConfig,\\\\n} from '../types/aiSearch';\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * AI问答服务\\\\n */\\\\nclass AiSearchService {\\\\n  private normalizeMessage(raw: any): Message {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      ...raw,\\\\n      createdAt: raw?.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt) : new Date(),\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取配置的工作流\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowConfig | null&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\\\\n      const params = pageType ? &amp;amp;#96;?pageType=${pageType}&amp;amp;#96; : '';\\\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;amp;#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\\\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\\\\n        // 获取工作流详情\\\\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\\\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;amp;gt; w.id === workflowId);\\\\n        if (workflow) {\\\\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\\\\n        }\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\\\\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\\\\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\\\\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&amp;amp;gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\\\\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 返回第一个工作流\\\\n      if (workflows.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      return null;\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\\\\n      return null;\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\\\\n   */\\\\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\\\\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\\\\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'input');\\\\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&amp;amp;gt; n.type === 'output');\\\\n    \\\\n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\\\\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\\\\n    \\\\n    return {\\\\n      id: workflow.id,\\\\n      name: workflow.name,\\\\n      description: workflow.description,\\\\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\n        type: p.type || 'string',\\\\n        required: p.required || false,\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\n      })),\\\\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&amp;amp;gt; ({\\\\n        name: p.name,\\\\n        type: p.type || 'object',\\\\n        description: p.description,\\\\n      })),\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 获取文件列表\\\\n   */\\\\n  async getFiles(options?: {\\\\n    category?: string;\\\",\""
                },

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"/**\\\\n * AI问答页面\\\\n * 复用tech-package系统构建，但作为独立页面可进行定制化改造\\\\n */\\\\nimport React from \\\\\\\"react\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport BaseAISearchPage from \\\\\\\"../components/ai-search/BaseAISearchPage\\\\\\\";\\\\nimport { aiQaConfig } from \\\\\\\"../configs/pageConfigs\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\nconst AIQAPage: React.FC = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  return &amp;amp;lt;BaseAISearchPage config={aiQaConfig} /&amp;amp;gt;;\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport default AIQAPage;\\\\n\\\\n\\\",\""

                  "lineNumber": 5251,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import { apiClient, type ApiErrorPayload, type ApiResponse } from \\\\\\\"@/shared/lib/api/apiClient\\\\\\\";\\\\n\\\\nexport interface WorkflowResponse {\\\\n  success: boolean;\\\\n  data?: any;\\\\n  error?: string;\\\\n  message?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nconst toWorkflowResponse = &amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt;(response: ApiResponse&amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp; { message?: string }): WorkflowResponse =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  if (response.success) {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      success: true,\\\\n      data: response.data,\\\\n      message: response.message,\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  return {\\\\n    success: false,\\\\n    error: response.error?.message ?? response.message ?? \\\\\\\"请求失败\\\\\\\",\\\\n    data: response.data,\\\\n  };\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nconst handleApiError = (scope: string, error: unknown): WorkflowResponse =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  console.error(&amp;amp;#96;${scope} error:&amp;amp;#96;, error);\\\\n  if ((error as ApiErrorPayload)?.message) {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      success: false,\\\\n      error: (error as ApiErrorPayload).message,\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n  if (error instanceof Error) {\\\\n    return {\\\\n      success: false,\\\\n      error: error.message,\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n  return {\\\\n    success: false,\\\\n    error: \\\\\\\"请求失败\\\\\\\",\\\\n  };\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport interface DifyAPIConfig {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  name: string;\\\\n  description: string;\\\\n  apiUrl: string;\\\\n  apiKey: string;\\\\n  enabled: boolean;\\\\n  createdAt?: Date;\\\\n  updatedAt?: Date;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nconst warnDeprecatedDifyConfig = (scope: string) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  console.warn(&amp;amp;#96;[workflowAPI] 已忽略前端传入的 difyConfig (${scope})，所有调用均改为通过后端网关处理&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport const workflowAPI = {\\\\n  // AI问答 - 支持自定义Dify配置\\\\n  aiSearch: async (query: string, inputs: any = {}, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('aiSearch');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post&amp;amp;lt;{ message?: string }&amp;amp;gt;(\\\\\\\"/workflow/ai-search\\\\\\\", {\\\\n        query,\\\\n        inputs,\\\\n        conversationId,\\\\n      }, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"AI search API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 智能搜索\\\\n  smartSearch: async (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('smartSearch');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = { query };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/smart-search\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Smart search API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 技术包装\\\\n  techPackage: async (searchResults: any, template?: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techPackage');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      let inputs: any;\\\\n\\\\n      if (searchResults &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; typeof searchResults === 'object' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; searchResults.query) {\\\\n        inputs = {\\\\n          query: searchResults.query,\\\\n          selectedKnowledgePoints: searchResults.selectedKnowledgePoints,\\\\n        };\\\\n      } else {\\\\n        inputs = {\\\\n          searchResults: searchResults,\\\\n          template: template,\\\\n        };\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/tech-package\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Tech package API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 技术策略\\\\n  techStrategy: async (techPackage: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techStrategy');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\n        inputs: { techPackage },\\\\n      };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/tech-strategy\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Tech strategy API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 推广策略\\\\n  promotionStrategy: async (techStrategy: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('promotionStrategy');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\n        inputs: { techStrategy },\\\\n      };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/promotion-strategy\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Promotion strategy API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 技术通稿\\\\n  coreDraft: async (promotionStrategy: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('coreDraft');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\n        inputs: { promotionStrategy },\\\\n      };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/core-draft\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Core draft API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 发布会演讲稿\\\\n  speechGeneration: async (coreDraft: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('speechGeneration');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = {\\\\n        inputs: { coreDraft },\\\\n      };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/speech-generation\\\\\\\", requestData, {\\\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\\\n      });\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Speech generation API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n\\\\n  // 演讲稿\\\\n  speech: async (inputs: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;amp;gt; =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('speech');\\\\n\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\\\\n      if (conversationId) {\\\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\\\\\"/workflow/speech-generation\\\\\\\", requestData);\\\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      return handleApiError(\\\\\\\"Speech API\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  },\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nconst legacyApi = {\\\\n  async get&amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;gt;(url: string, config?: any) {\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.get&amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt;(url, config);\\\\n    return { data };\\\\n  },\\\\n  async post&amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;gt;(url: string, body?: any, config?: any) {\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.post&amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt;(url, body, config);\\\\n    return { data };\\\\n  },\\\\n  async put&amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;gt;(url: string, body?: any, config?: any) {\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.put&amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt;(url, body, config);\\\\n    return { data };\\\\n  },\\\\n  async delete&amp;amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;amp;gt;(url: string, config?: any) {\\\\n    const data = await apiClient.delete&amp;amp;lt;T&amp;amp;gt;(url, config);\\\\n    return { data };\\\\n  },\\\\n};\\\\n\\\\nexport default legacyApi;\\\\n\\\",\""

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { Router } from 'express';\\n\\nimport workflowModuleRouter from '@/modules/workflow/api/workflow.routes';\\nimport aiSearchModuleRouter from '@/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes';\\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\\n\\nimport techCategoriesRouter from './techCategories';\\nimport techPointsRouter from './techPoints';\\nimport brandsRouter from './brands';\\nimport carModelsRouter from './carModels';\\nimport carSeriesRouter from './carSeries';\\nimport knowledgePointsRouter from './knowledgePointRoutes';\\nimport chatRouter from './chat';\\nimport workflowStatsRouter from './workflowStats';\\nimport difyProxyRouter from './dify-proxy';\\nimport aiRoleRouter from './aiRole';\\nimport agentWorkflowRouter from './agentWorkflow';\\nimport workflowExecutionRouter from './workflowExecution';\\nimport workflowTemplateRouter from './workflowTemplate';\\nimport publicPageConfigRouter from './publicPageConfig';\\nimport pageToolConfigRouter from './pageToolConfig';\\nimport sourceInformationRouter from './sourceInformationRoutes';\\nimport projectsRouter from './projects';\\n\\nconst router = Router();\\n\\n// 添加路由级别的日志记录\\nrouter.use((req, res, next) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.debug('API Route Handler', {\\n    method: req.method,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    baseUrl: req.baseUrl,\\n    path: req.path,\\n    params: req.params,\\n    query: req.query,\\n    body: req.body,\\n  });\\n  next();\\n});\\n\\n// 注册路由\\nrouter.use('/tech-categories', techCategoriesRouter);\\nrouter.use('/tech-points', techPointsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/brands', brandsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/car-models', carModelsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/car-series', carSeriesRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow', workflowModuleRouter);\\nrouter.use('/knowledge-points', knowledgePointsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/chat', chatRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow-stats', workflowStatsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/dify', difyProxyRouter);\\nrouter.use('/ai-roles', aiRoleRouter);\\nrouter.use('/agent-workflows', agentWorkflowRouter);\\nrouter.use('/executions', workflowExecutionRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow-templates', workflowTemplateRouter);\\nrouter.use('/public-page-configs', publicPageConfigRouter);\\nrouter.use('/page-tool-configs', pageToolConfigRouter);\\nrouter.use('/source-information', sourceInformationRouter);\\nrouter.use('/projects', projectsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/ai-search', aiSearchModuleRouter);\\n\\n// 健康检查\\nrouter.get('/health', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\\n    headers: req.headers,\\n    method: req.method,\\n    url: req.url,\\n  });\\n  try {\\n    const response = {\\n      success: true,\\n      message: 'API is running',\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n      version: '1.0.0'\\n    };\\n    res.json(response);\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: 'Health check failed',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 简单测试端点\\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.debug('Test endpoint called');\\n  res.json({\\n    success: true,\\n    message: 'Test endpoint working',\\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\\n  });\\n});\\n\\n// 404 处理中间件（必须在所有路由之后）\\nrouter.use((req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.warn('API 路由未找到', {\\n    method: req.method,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    path: req.path,\\n  });\\n  res.status(404).json({\\n    success: false,\\n    error: {\\n      code: 'NOT_FOUND',\\n      message: &amp;#96;路由不存在: ${req.method} ${req.path}&amp;#96;,\\n    },\\n  });\\n});\\n\\nexport default router;\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { apiClient, type ApiErrorPayload, type ApiResponse } from \\\"@/shared/lib/api/apiClient\\\";\\n\\nexport interface WorkflowResponse {\\n  success: boolean;\\n  data?: any;\\n  error?: string;\\n  message?: string;\\n}\\n\\nconst toWorkflowResponse = &amp;lt;T&amp;gt;(response: ApiResponse&amp;lt;T&amp;gt; &amp;amp; { message?: string }): WorkflowResponse =&amp;gt; {\\n  if (response.success) {\\n    return {\\n      success: true,\\n      data: response.data,\\n      message: response.message,\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  return {\\n    success: false,\\n    error: response.error?.message ?? response.message ?? \\\"请求失败\\\",\\n    data: response.data,\\n  };\\n};\\n\\nconst handleApiError = (scope: string, error: unknown): WorkflowResponse =&amp;gt; {\\n  console.error(&amp;#96;${scope} error:&amp;#96;, error);\\n  if ((error as ApiErrorPayload)?.message) {\\n    return {\\n      success: false,\\n      error: (error as ApiErrorPayload).message,\\n    };\\n  }\\n  if (error instanceof Error) {\\n    return {\\n      success: false,\\n      error: error.message,\\n    };\\n  }\\n  return {\\n    success: false,\\n    error: \\\"请求失败\\\",\\n  };\\n};\\n\\nexport interface DifyAPIConfig {\\n  id: string;\\n  name: string;\\n  description: string;\\n  apiUrl: string;\\n  apiKey: string;\\n  enabled: boolean;\\n  createdAt?: Date;\\n  updatedAt?: Date;\\n}\\n\\nconst warnDeprecatedDifyConfig = (scope: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n  console.warn(&amp;#96;[workflowAPI] 已忽略前端传入的 difyConfig (${scope})，所有调用均改为通过后端网关处理&amp;#96;);\\n};\\n\\nexport const workflowAPI = {\\n  // AI问答 - 支持自定义Dify配置\\n  aiSearch: async (query: string, inputs: any = {}, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('aiSearch');\\n\\n    try {\\n      const response = await apiClient.post&amp;lt;{ message?: string }&amp;gt;(\\\"/workflow/ai-search\\\", {\\n        query,\\n        inputs,\\n        conversationId,\\n      }, {\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\n      });\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      return handleApiError(\\\"AI search API\\\", error);\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 智能搜索\\n  smartSearch: async (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('smartSearch');\\n\\n    try {\\n      const requestData: any = { query };\\n      if (conversationId) {\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\"/workflow/smart-search\\\", requestData, {\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\n      });\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      return handleApiError(\\\"Smart search API\\\", error);\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 技术包装\\n  techPackage: async (searchResults: any, template?: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techPackage');\\n\\n    try {\\n      let inputs: any;\\n\\n      if (searchResults &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof searchResults === 'object' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; searchResults.query) {\\n        inputs = {\\n          query: searchResults.query,\\n          selectedKnowledgePoints: searchResults.selectedKnowledgePoints,\\n        };\\n      } else {\\n        inputs = {\\n          searchResults: searchResults,\\n          template: template,\\n        };\\n      }\\n\\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\\n      if (conversationId) {\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\"/workflow/tech-package\\\", requestData, {\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\n      });\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      return handleApiError(\\\"Tech package API\\\", error);\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 技术策略\\n  techStrategy: async (techPackage: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('techStrategy');\\n\\n    try {\\n      const requestData: any = {\\n        inputs: { techPackage },\\n      };\\n      if (conversationId) {\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\"/workflow/tech-strategy\\\", requestData, {\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\n      });\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      return handleApiError(\\\"Tech strategy API\\\", error);\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 推广策略\\n  promotionStrategy: async (techStrategy: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('promotionStrategy');\\n\\n    try {\\n      const requestData: any = {\\n        inputs: { techStrategy },\\n      };\\n      if (conversationId) {\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\"/workflow/promotion-strategy\\\", requestData, {\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\n      });\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      return handleApiError(\\\"Promotion strategy API\\\", error);\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 技术通稿\\n  coreDraft: async (promotionStrategy: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('coreDraft');\\n\\n    try {\\n      const requestData: any = {\\n        inputs: { promotionStrategy },\\n      };\\n      if (conversationId) {\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\"/workflow/core-draft\\\", requestData, {\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\n      });\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      return handleApiError(\\\"Core draft API\\\", error);\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 发布会演讲稿\\n  speechGeneration: async (coreDraft: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('speechGeneration');\\n\\n    try {\\n      const requestData: any = {\\n        inputs: { coreDraft },\\n      };\\n      if (conversationId) {\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\"/workflow/speech-generation\\\", requestData, {\\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\\n      });\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      return handleApiError(\\\"Speech generation API\\\", error);\\n    }\\n  },\\n\\n  // 演讲稿\\n  speech: async (inputs: any, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&amp;lt;WorkflowResponse&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('speech');\\n\\n    try {\\n      const requestData: any = { inputs };\\n      if (conversationId) {\\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\\n      }\\n\\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\\\"/workflow/speech-generation\\\", requestData);\\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      return handleApiError(\\\"Speech API\\\", error);\\n    }\\n  },\\n};\\n\\nconst legacyApi = {\\n  async get&amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;gt;(url: string, config?: any) {\\n    const data = await apiClient.get&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;(url, config);\\n    return { data };\\n  },\\n  async post&amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;gt;(url: string, body?: any, config?: any) {\\n    const data = await apiClient.post&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;(url, body, config);\\n    return { data };\\n  },\\n  async put&amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;gt;(url: string, body?: any, config?: any) {\\n    const data = await apiClient.put&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;(url, body, config);\\n    return { data };\\n  },\\n  async delete&amp;lt;T = unknown&amp;gt;(url: string, config?: any) {\\n    const data = await apiClient.delete&amp;lt;T&amp;gt;(url, config);\\n    return { data };\\n  },\\n};\\n\\nexport default legacyApi;\\n\","

                  "lineNumber": 3724,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { Router } from 'express';\\n\\nimport workflowModuleRouter from '@/modules/workflow/api/workflow.routes';\\nimport aiSearchModuleRouter from '@/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes';\\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\\n\\nimport techCategoriesRouter from './techCategories';\\nimport techPointsRouter from './techPoints';\\nimport brandsRouter from './brands';\\nimport carModelsRouter from './carModels';\\nimport carSeriesRouter from './carSeries';\\nimport knowledgePointsRouter from './knowledgePointRoutes';\\nimport chatRouter from './chat';\\nimport workflowStatsRouter from './workflowStats';\\nimport difyProxyRouter from './dify-proxy';\\nimport aiRoleRouter from './aiRole';\\nimport agentWorkflowRouter from './agentWorkflow';\\nimport workflowExecutionRouter from './workflowExecution';\\nimport workflowTemplateRouter from './workflowTemplate';\\nimport publicPageConfigRouter from './publicPageConfig';\\nimport pageToolConfigRouter from './pageToolConfig';\\nimport sourceInformationRouter from './sourceInformationRoutes';\\n\\nconst router = Router();\\n\\n// 添加路由级别的日志记录\\nrouter.use((req, res, next) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.debug('API Route Handler', {\\n    method: req.method,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    baseUrl: req.baseUrl,\\n    path: req.path,\\n    params: req.params,\\n    query: req.query,\\n    body: req.body,\\n  });\\n  next();\\n});\\n\\n// 注册路由\\nrouter.use('/tech-categories', techCategoriesRouter);\\nrouter.use('/tech-points', techPointsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/brands', brandsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/car-models', carModelsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/car-series', carSeriesRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow', workflowModuleRouter);\\nrouter.use('/knowledge-points', knowledgePointsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/chat', chatRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow-stats', workflowStatsRouter);\\nrouter.use('/dify', difyProxyRouter);\\nrouter.use('/ai-roles', aiRoleRouter);\\nrouter.use('/agent-workflows', agentWorkflowRouter);\\nrouter.use('/executions', workflowExecutionRouter);\\nrouter.use('/workflow-templates', workflowTemplateRouter);\\nrouter.use('/public-page-configs', publicPageConfigRouter);\\nrouter.use('/page-tool-configs', pageToolConfigRouter);\\nrouter.use('/source-information', sourceInformationRouter);\\nrouter.use('/ai-search', aiSearchModuleRouter);\\n\\n// 健康检查\\nrouter.get('/health', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\\n    headers: req.headers,\\n    method: req.method,\\n    url: req.url,\\n  });\\n  try {\\n    const response = {\\n      success: true,\\n      message: 'API is running',\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n      version: '1.0.0'\\n    };\\n    res.json(response);\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: 'Health check failed',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 简单测试端点\\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.debug('Test endpoint called');\\n  res.json({\\n    success: true,\\n    message: 'Test endpoint working',\\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\\n  });\\n});\\n\\n// 404 处理中间件（必须在所有路由之后）\\nrouter.use((req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  logger.warn('API 路由未找到', {\\n    method: req.method,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    path: req.path,\\n  });\\n  res.status(404).json({\\n    success: false,\\n    error: {\\n      code: 'NOT_FOUND',\\n      message: &amp;#96;路由不存在: ${req.method} ${req.path}&amp;#96;,\\n    },\\n  });\\n});\\n\\nexport default router;\","

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\nasync execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      const effectiveOutputMappings = featureConfig.outputMappings?.length\n        ? featureConfig.outputMappings\n        : targetMappingConfig?.outputMappings || [];\n\n      const baseContent = await this.resolveBaseContent(conversation, dto);\n      const conversationQuery = baseContent || &#96;触发子Agent：${dto.featureType}&#96;;\n\n      const conversationData = this.buildConversationData(\n        conversation,\n        conversationQuery,\n        targetSources,\n        dto\n      );\n\n      const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, effectiveInputMappings);\n\n      // 判断 targetWorkflowId 是 AI 角色 ID 还是工作流 ID\n      // AI 角色 ID 可能以 'role_' 或 'ai-role-' 开头，工作流 ID 以 'wf_' 开头\n      const isRoleId = targetWorkflowId.startsWith('role_') || targetWorkflowId.startsWith('ai-role-');\n      \n      let workflowResult;\n      if (isRoleId) {\n        // 直接调用 AI 角色\n        logger.info('检测到 AI 角色 ID，直接调用角色', { roleId: targetWorkflowId, featureType: dto.featureType });\n        workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeRole(targetWorkflowId, workflowInput);\n      } else {\n        // 通过工作流调用\n        logger.info('检测到工作流 ID，通过工作流调用', { workflowId: targetWorkflowId, featureType: dto.featureType });\n        workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(\n          targetWorkflowId,\n          { input: workflowInput }\n        );\n      }\n\n      const extractedOutput = extractWorkflowOutput(workflowResult, effectiveOutputMappings);\n\n      const aiContent = extractedOutput.content\n        || workflowResult.message\n        || &#96;子Agent ${dto.featureType} 已执行&#96;;\n\n      const messageOutputs = {\n        ...extractedOutput,\n,\n      };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "async (req, res) =&gt; {\n\n    \n    console.log('AI角色对话请求:', {\n      roleId: id,\n      roleName: role.name,\n      query: query.substring(0, 100),\n      conversationId,\n      provider: role.provider || 'dify'\n    });\n    \n    // 根据 provider 类型选择不同的处理逻辑\n    const provider = role.provider || 'dify';\n    \n    if (provider === 'direct-agent') {\n      // Direct Agent 模式\n      if (!role.agentConfig) {\n        return res.status(400).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, 'Direct Agent配置不存在'));\n      }\n      \n      // 使用 AgentOrchestrator 执行\n      const orchestrator = new AgentOrchestrator();\n      const context = inputs || {}; // 将 inputs 作为 context 传递\n      \n      const result = await orchestrator.executeAgent(\n        id,\n        query,\n        conversationId,\n        context\n      );\n      \n      // 返回统一格式\n      res.json(formatApiResponse(true, {\n        answer: result.content,\n        conversation_id: result.conversationId,\n        metadata: {\n          ...result.metadata,\n          usage: result.usage\n        }\n      }, '对话成功'));\n    } else {\n      // Dify 模式（保持现有逻辑）\n      if (!role.difyConfig)\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 执行Agent工作流\n * POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute\n */\nrouter.post('/:id/execute', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const { input, options } = req.body;\n    \n    const result = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(id, {\n      input,\n      ...options,\n    });\n    \n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, result, '工作流执行已开始'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('执行工作流失败:', error);\n    \n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message.includes('不存在')) {\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, error.message));\n    }\n    \n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '执行工作流失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 获取工作流执行历史\n * GET /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/executions\n */",

        "contents": "export class AgentWorkflowService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行Agent节点\n   */\n  private async executeAgentNode(\n    node: any,\n    sharedContext: Record&lt;string, any&gt;\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    const agentId = node.agentId || node.data?.agentId;\n    if (!agentId) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;Agent节点 ${node.id} 未配置agentId&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 获取AI角色配置\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(agentId);\n    if (!role) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${agentId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    if (!role.enabled) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色已禁用: ${agentId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 准备输入数据\n    const nodeInput = this.prepareNodeInput(node, sharedContext);\n    \n    // 尝试从多个可能的字段中提取query\n    // 优先级：query &gt; input &gt; workflowInput.query &gt; 整个nodeInput的字符串化\n    let query = nodeInput.query;\n    if (!query) {\n      query = nodeInput.input;\n    }\n    if (!query &amp;&amp; nodeInput.workflowInput?.query) {\n      query = nodeInput.workflowInput.query;\n    }\n    if (!query &amp;&amp; typeof nodeInput === 'object') {\n      // 如果还是没有，尝试从其他常见字段中提取\n      query = nodeInput.question || nodeInput.text || nodeInput.content;\n    }\n    if (!query) {\n      // 最后回退：如果nodeInput是字符串，直接使用；否则字符串化\n      query = typeof nodeInput === 'string' ? nodeInput : JSON.stringify(nodeInput);\n    }\n    \n    const inputs = { ...nodeInput };\n    delete inputs.query;\n    delete inputs.input;\n\n    // 检查 provider 类型，Workflow 目前只支持 Dify\n    const provider = role.provider || 'dify';\n    if (provider === 'direct-agent') {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 是 Direct Agent 类型，不支持在 Workflow 中使用。请使用 Dify 类型的角色。&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 根据连接类型调用Dify API\n    if (!role.difyConfig) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 的Dify配置不存在&#96;);\n    }\n\n    const { connectionType, apiKey, apiUrl } = role.difyConfig;\n    // 尝试从多个可能的位置获取 conversationId\n    // 优先级：nodeInput.conversationId &gt; nodeInput.workflowInput.conversationId &gt; sharedContext.workflowInput.conversationId\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 发送消息\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages\n */\nrouter.post(\n  '/conversations/:id/messages',\n  ensureTablesInitialized,\n  upload.array('files', 10),\n  async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const { id } = req.params;\n      let sourcesValue = req.body.sources;\n      if (typeof sourcesValue === 'string') {\n        try {\n          sourcesValue = JSON.parse(sourcesValue);\n        } catch (parseError) {\n          logger.warn('解析sources失败，使用原始值', { parseError });\n          sourcesValue = undefined;\n        }\n      }\n\n      const body = {\n        content: req.body.content,\n        sources: Array.isArray(sourcesValue) ? sourcesValue : undefined,\n        contextWindowSize: req.body.contextWindowSize,\n        workflowId: req.body.workflowId,\n        fileList: req.body.fileList,\n        knowledgeBaseNames: req.body.knowledgeBaseNames,\n      };\n      const files = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\n\n      const dto = validateDTO(SendMessageSchema, body);\n      const result = await sendMessageUseCase.execute({\n        conversationId: id,\n        content: dto.content,\n        sources: dto.sources,\n        files,\n        contextWindowSize: typeof dto.contextWindowSize === 'number' ? dto.contextWindowSize : (dto.contextWindowSize ? parseInt(String(dto.contextWindowSize), 10) : undefined),\n        workflowId: dto.workflowId,\n        fileList: dto.fileList,\n        knowledgeBaseNames: dto.knowledgeBaseNames,\n      });\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return res.status(500).json(\n          formatApiResponse(false, null, '发送消息失败', result.error.message)\n        );\n      }\n\n      res.json(\n        formatApiResponse(\n          true,\n          result.value,\n          result.value.error ?         "contents": "export class WorkflowController {\n\n\n  executeAiSearch = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const conversationIdInput = req.body.conversationId ?? req.body.conversation_id;\n      const normalizedConversationId = typeof conversationIdInput === 'string' ? conversationIdInput : '';\n\n      const normalizedPayload: { query: unknown; inputs?: unknown; conversationId: string } = {\n        query: req.body.query,\n        inputs: req.body.inputs,\n        conversationId: normalizedConversationId,\n      };\n\n      const dto = validateDTO&lt;ExecuteAiSearchDTO&gt;(ExecuteAiSearchSchema, normalizedPayload);\n      const result = await this.executeAiSearchUseCase.execute(dto);\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return res.status(500).json(\n          createErrorResponse(result.error.code, result.error.message, result.error.details)\n        );\n      }\n\n      res.json(createSuccessResponse(result.value, 'AI搜索完成'));\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('AI 搜索接口执行失败', { error });\n      next(error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  executeTechPackage = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const payload = {\n        inputs: req.body.inputs ?? {},\n        conversationId: req.body.conversationId ?? req.body.conversation_id,\n      };\n      const dto = validateDTO(ExecuteTechPackageSchema, payload);\n      const result = await this.executeTechPackageUseCase.execute(dto);\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return res.status(500).json(\n          createErrorResponse(result.error.code, result.error.message, result.error.details)\n        );\n      }\n\n      res.json(createSuccessResponse(result.value, '技术包装完成'));\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('技术包装接口执行失败', { error });\n      next(error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  executeTechStrategy =\n;\n}",

        "contents": "// Dify聊天消息代理\nrouter.post('/chat-messages', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    console.log('=== Dify Chat Messages Proxy ===');\n    console.log('Request body:', req.body);\n    \n    const { appType, apiKey: clientApiKey, ...requestBody } = req.body;\n    const apiKey = getApiKey(appType) || clientApiKey;\n\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      console.error('API key is missing for appType:', appType);\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'API key is required' });\n    }\n\n    console.log('Using API key for appType:', appType);\n    console.log('API Key (first 10 chars):', apiKey.substring(0, 10) + '...');\n    \n    // 直接使用Dify后端地址（9999端口）\n    const difyBaseUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1';\n    console.log('Dify base URL:', difyBaseUrl);\n\n    // 清理requestBody，确保只发送Dify需要的字段\n    const { appType: _, ...cleanedBody } = requestBody;\n    \n    console.log('发送给Dify的请求体:', {\n      query: cleanedBody.query,\n      inputs: cleanedBody.inputs,\n      conversation_id: cleanedBody.conversation_id,\n      response_mode: 'blocking'\n    });\n\n    // 正确的Dify API端点\n    const difyApiUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/chat-messages';\n    console.log('请求Dify API URL:', difyApiUrl);\n    \n    // 构建请求体，只在有有效conversation_id时才包含它\n    const requestPayload: any = {\n      query: cleanedBody.query,\n      inputs: cleanedBody.inputs || {},\n      user: requestBody.user || &#96;user-${Date.now()}&#96;, \n      response_mode: 'blocking'\n    };\n    \n    // 只在有有效conversation_id时才添加它\n    if (cleanedBody.conversation_id &amp;&amp; cleanedBody.conversation_id.trim() !== '') {\n      requestPayload.conversation_id = cleanedBody.conversation_id;\n    }\n    \n    console.log('最终发送给Dify的请求体:', requestPayload);\n    \n    const difyResponse = await axios.post\n;\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export const workflowAPI = {\n  // AI问答 - 支持自定义Dify配置\n  aiSearch: async (query: string, inputs: any = {}, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('aiSearch');\n\n    try {\n      const response = await apiClient.post&lt;{ message?: string }&gt;(\"/workflow/ai-search\", {\n        query,\n        inputs,\n        conversationId,\n      }, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"AI search API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 智能搜索\n  smartSearch: async (query: string, difyConfig?: DifyAPIConfig, conversationId?: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowResponse&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (difyConfig) warnDeprecatedDifyConfig('smartSearch');\n\n    try {\n      const requestData: any = { query };\n      if (conversationId) {\n        requestData.conversationId = conversationId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await apiClient.post(\"/workflow/smart-search\", requestData, {\n        timeout: 180_000, // AI请求使用3分钟超时\n      });\n      return toWorkflowResponse(response);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return handleApiError(\"Smart search API\", error);\n    }\n  },\n\n  // 技术包装\n  techPackage:\n,\n};",

            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行 Agent（核心方法）\n   * @param roleId 角色ID\n   * @param query 用户查询\n   * @param conversationId 对话ID（可选，如果不存在会生成新的）\n   * @param context 上下文数据（用于变量替换）\n   * @returns 执行结果\n   */\n  async executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\n    const startTime = Date.now();\n    const MAX_EXECUTION_TIME = 360000; // 6分钟总体超时（留出缓冲给前端7分钟超时）\n    \n    // 检查超时的辅助函数\n    const checkTimeout = () =&gt; {\n      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;\n      if (elapsed &gt; MAX_EXECUTION_TIME) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent执行超时：已执行 ${Math.round(elapsed / 1000)} 秒，超过最大执行时间 ${MAX_EXECUTION_TIME / 1000} 秒&#96;);\n      }\n    };\n    \n    // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\n    checkTimeout();\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\n    if (!role) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    if (!role.agentConfig) {\n      throw new Error(&#96;Agent配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\n\n    // 2. 生成或使用 conversationId\n    const finalConversationId = conversationId || this.generateConversationId();\n\n    // 3. 渲染 System Prompt\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\n      context\n    );\n\n    // 4. 获取上下文消息\n    checkTimeout();\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\n      finalConversationId,\n      config.contextStrategy,\n      query\n    );\n\n    // 5. 构建完整消息列表\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [];\n    \n    // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\n    if (config.contextStrategy.includeSystemPrompt || contextMessages.length === 0) {\n      messages.push({\n        role: 'system',\n        content: systemPrompt\n      });\n    }\n\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// Dify工作流代理\nrouter.post('/workflows/run', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    console.log('=== Dify Workflow Proxy ===');\n    console.log('Request body:', req.body);\n    \n    const { appType, apiKey: clientApiKey, ...requestBody } = req.body;\n    const apiKey = getApiKey(appType) || clientApiKey;\n\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      console.error('API key is missing for appType:', appType);\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'API key is required' });\n    }\n\n    console.log('Using API key for appType:', appType);\n    // 直接使用正确的Dify工作流API端点\n    const difyWorkflowUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/workflows/run';\n    console.log('Dify workflow URL:', difyWorkflowUrl);\n\n    const difyResponse = await axios.post(\n      difyWorkflowUrl,\n      { \n        ...requestBody, \n        user: requestBody.user || &#96;user-${Date.now()}&#96;, \n        response_mode: 'blocking' \n      },\n      {\n        headers: {\n          'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${apiKey}&#96;,\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        },\n        timeout: 60000,\n      }\n    );\n    \n    console.log('Dify workflow response received:', difyResponse.status);\n    res.json(difyResponse.data);\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('Dify workflow proxy error:', error.message);\n    console.error('Error details:', error.response?.data);\n    res.status(error.response?.status || 500).json({\n      error: error.response?.data || error.message\n    });\n  }\n});\n\nexport default router;",
