= {}\\\\n  ): Promise&amp;amp;lt;AgentExecutionResult&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const startTime = Date.now();\\\\n    const MAX_EXECUTION_TIME = 360000; // 6分钟总体超时（留出缓冲给前端7分钟超时）\\\\n    \\\\n    // 检查超时的辅助函数\\\\n    const checkTimeout = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;\\\\n      if (elapsed &amp;amp;gt; MAX_EXECUTION_TIME) {\\\\n        throw new Error(&amp;amp;#96;Agent执行超时：已执行 ${Math.round(elapsed / 1000)} 秒，超过最大执行时间 ${MAX_EXECUTION_TIME / 1000} 秒&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\\\\n    checkTimeout();\\\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\\\\n    if (!role) {\\\\n      throw new Error(&amp;amp;#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if (!role.agentConfig) {\\\\n      throw new Error(&amp;amp;#96;Agent配置不存在: ${roleId}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\\\\n\\\\n    // 2. 生成或使用 conversationId\\\\n    const finalConversationId = conversationId || this.generateConversationId();\\\\n\\\\n    // 3. 渲染 System Prompt\\\\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\\\\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\\\\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\\\\n      context\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // 4. 获取上下文消息\\\\n    checkTimeout();\\\\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\\\\n      finalConversationId,\\\\n      config.contextStrategy,\\\\n      query\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // 5. 构建完整消息列表\\\\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [];\\\\n    \\\\n    // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\\\\n    if (config.contextStrategy.includeSystemPrompt || contextMessages.length === 0) {\\\\n      messages.push({\\\\n        role: 'system',\\\\n        content: systemPrompt\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\",\""

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class AgentWorkflowService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行Agent节点\\n   */\\n  private async executeAgentNode(\\n    node: any,\\n    sharedContext: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt;\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n    const agentId = node.agentId || node.data?.agentId;\\n    if (!agentId) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;Agent节点 ${node.id} 未配置agentId&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取AI角色配置\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(agentId);\\n    if (!role) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色不存在: ${agentId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    if (!role.enabled) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色已禁用: ${agentId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // 准备输入数据\\n    const nodeInput = this.prepareNodeInput(node, sharedContext);\\n    \\n    // 尝试从多个可能的字段中提取query\\n    // 优先级：query &amp;gt; input &amp;gt; workflowInput.query &amp;gt; 整个nodeInput的字符串化\\n    let query = nodeInput.query;\\n    if (!query) {\\n      query = nodeInput.input;\\n    }\\n    if (!query &amp;amp;&amp;amp; nodeInput.workflowInput?.query) {\\n      query = nodeInput.workflowInput.query;\\n    }\\n    if (!query &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof nodeInput === 'object') {\\n      // 如果还是没有，尝试从其他常见字段中提取\\n      query = nodeInput.question || nodeInput.text || nodeInput.content;\\n    }\\n    if (!query) {\\n      // 最后回退：如果nodeInput是字符串，直接使用；否则字符串化\\n      query = typeof nodeInput === 'string' ? nodeInput : JSON.stringify(nodeInput);\\n    }\\n    \\n    const inputs = { ...nodeInput };\\n    delete inputs.query;\\n    delete inputs.input;\\n\\n    // 检查 provider 类型，Workflow 目前只支持 Dify\\n    const provider = role.provider || 'dify';\\n    if (provider === 'direct-agent') {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 是 Direct Agent 类型，不支持在 Workflow 中使用。请使用 Dify 类型的角色。&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // 根据连接类型调用Dify API\\n    if (!role.difyConfig) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 的Dify配置不存在&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    const { connectionType, apiKey, apiUrl } = role.difyConfig;\\n    // 尝试从多个可能的位置获取 conversationId\\n    // 优先级：nodeInput.conversationId &amp;gt; nodeInput.workflowInput.conversationId &amp;gt; sharedContext.workflowInput.conversationId\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 29731,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class AgentWorkflowService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行工作流（异步）\\n   */\\n  async executeWorkflow(\\n    workflowId: string,\\n    options: any\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;{ executionId: string; message: string; data?: any }&amp;gt; {\\n    // 获取工作流定义\\n    const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(workflowId);\\n    if (!workflow) {\\n      throw new Error('工作流不存在');\\n    }\\n\\n    const startedAt = Date.now();\\n    // 创建执行实例\\n    const execution = await workflowExecutionModel.create({\\n      execution_type: 'agent_workflow',\\n      workflow_id: workflowId,\\n      workflow_name: workflow.name,\\n      status: 'running',\\n      shared_context: options.input || {},\\n      node_results: [],\\n      start_time: new Date().toISOString(),\\n    });\\n\\n    try {\\n      // 解析工作流节点和边\\n      const nodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\n      const edges = JSON.parse(workflow.edges || '[]');\\n\\n      logger.info('开始执行工作流', {\\n        workflowId,\\n        workflowName: workflow.name,\\n        nodesCount: nodes.length,\\n        edgesCount: edges.length,\\n        nodeTypes: nodes.map((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type),\\n        agentNodes: nodes.filter((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'agent').map((n: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n          id: n.id,\\n          agentId: n.agentId || n.data?.agentId,\\n          hasData: !!n.data,\\n        })),\\n        outputNodes: nodes.filter((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'output').map((n: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n          id: n.id,\\n          outputs: n.data?.outputs,\\n        })),\\n      });\\n\\n      // 检查是否有配置的Agent节点\\n      const hasConfiguredAgent = this.workflowHasConfiguredAgent(workflow);\\n      logger.info('检查Agent节点配置', {\\n        workflowId,\\n        hasConfiguredAgent,\\n      });\\n      \\n      if (!hasConfiguredAgent) {\\n        const fallbackOutput = this.buildFallbackOutput;\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 30943,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class AgentWorkflowService {\\nprivate async executeAgentNode(\\n    node: any,\\n    sharedContext: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt;\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n\\n\\n    logger.info('准备执行Agent节点', {\\n      nodeId: node.id,\\n      agentId,\\n      connectionType,\\n      query: query?.substring(0, 100),\\n      queryLength: query?.length || 0,\\n      '传递给Dify的conversationId': conversationId || '空（首次对话）',\\n      inputsKeys: Object.keys(inputs || {}),\\n    });\\n\\n    if (connectionType === 'chatflow') {\\n      // 使用聊天流模式\\n      const result = await gateway.executeChat({\\n        query,\\n        conversationId,\\n        inputs,\\n        userId: 'todify3-user',\\n      });\\n\\n      if (isSuccess(result)) {\\n        const chatResponse = result.value.raw as any;\\n        const agentOutput = {\\n          answer: chatResponse.answer || result.value.answer,\\n          conversation_id: chatResponse.conversation_id || result.value.conversationId,\\n          message_id: chatResponse.message_id || result.value.messageId,\\n          metadata: chatResponse.metadata || {},\\n          raw: chatResponse,\\n        };\\n        \\n        logger.info('Agent节点执行完成 (chatflow)', {\\n          nodeId: node.id,\\n          agentId,\\n          hasAnswer: !!agentOutput.answer,\\n          answerLength: agentOutput.answer?.length || 0,\\n          answerPreview: agentOutput.answer?.substring(0, 200) || null,\\n          answerType: typeof agentOutput.answer,\\n          rawKeys: chatResponse &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof chatResponse === 'object' ?                   "lineNumber": 31237,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\\nasync execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&amp;lt;Result&amp;lt;any&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n\\n\\n      const effectiveOutputMappings = featureConfig.outputMappings?.length\\n        ? featureConfig.outputMappings\\n        : targetMappingConfig?.outputMappings || [];\\n\\n      const baseContent = await this.resolveBaseContent(conversation, dto);\\n      const conversationQuery = baseContent || &amp;#96;触发子Agent：${dto.featureType}&amp;#96;;\\n\\n      const conversationData = this.buildConversationData(\\n        conversation,\\n        conversationQuery,\\n        targetSources,\\n        dto\\n      );\\n\\n      const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, effectiveInputMappings);\\n\\n      // 判断 targetWorkflowId 是 AI 角色 ID 还是工作流 ID\\n      // AI 角色 ID 可能以 'role_' 或 'ai-role-' 开头，工作流 ID 以 'wf_' 开头\\n      const isRoleId = targetWorkflowId.startsWith('role_') || targetWorkflowId.startsWith('ai-role-');\\n      \\n      let workflowResult;\\n      if (isRoleId) {\\n        // 直接调用 AI 角色\\n        logger.info('检测到 AI 角色 ID，直接调用角色', { roleId: targetWorkflowId, featureType: dto.featureType });\\n        workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeRole(targetWorkflowId, workflowInput);\\n      } else {\\n        // 通过工作流调用\\n        logger.info('检测到工作流 ID，通过工作流调用', { workflowId: targetWorkflowId, featureType: dto.featureType });\\n        workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(\\n          targetWorkflowId,\\n          { input: workflowInput }\\n        );\\n      }\\n\\n      const extractedOutput = extractWorkflowOutput(workflowResult, effectiveOutputMappings);\\n\\n      const aiContent = extractedOutput.content\\n        || workflowResult.message\\n        || &amp;#96;子Agent ${dto.featureType} 已执行&amp;#96;;\\n\\n      const messageOutputs = {\\n        ...extractedOutput,\\n,\\n      };\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 32057,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class AgentWorkflowService {\\nprivate async executeAgentNode(\\n    node: any,\\n    sharedContext: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt;\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n\\n    // 尝试从多个可能的位置获取 conversationId\\n    // 优先级：nodeInput.conversationId &amp;gt; nodeInput.workflowInput.conversationId &amp;gt; sharedContext.workflowInput.conversationId\\n    let conversationId = nodeInput.conversationId || '';\\n    if (!conversationId &amp;amp;&amp;amp; nodeInput.workflowInput?.conversationId) {\\n      conversationId = nodeInput.workflowInput.conversationId;\\n      logger.info('从 nodeInput.workflowInput 获取到 conversationId', { conversationId });\\n    }\\n    if (!conversationId &amp;amp;&amp;amp; sharedContext.workflowInput?.conversationId) {\\n      conversationId = sharedContext.workflowInput.conversationId;\\n      logger.info('从 sharedContext.workflowInput 获取到 conversationId', { conversationId });\\n    }\\n\\n    if (!apiKey || !apiUrl) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 的Dify配置不完整&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // 处理相对路径：如果是相对路径，使用实际的 Dify 服务器地址\\n    let actualBaseUrl = apiUrl;\\n    if (apiUrl.startsWith('/')) {\\n      // 相对路径，通过后端代理处理，使用实际的 Dify 服务器地址\\n      actualBaseUrl = process.env.DIFY_BASE_URL || 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1';\\n      logger.info('检测到相对路径，转换为完整URL', {\\n        agentId,\\n        原始: apiUrl,\\n        转换后: actualBaseUrl,\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    logger.info('创建 DifyGateway', {\\n      agentId,\\n      baseUrl: actualBaseUrl,\\n      apiKey: apiKey.substring(0, 10) + '...',\\n      connectionType,\\n    });\\n\\n    // 创建自定义的DifyGateway\\n    const gateway = new DifyGateway({\\n      baseUrl: actualBaseUrl,\\n      workflowBaseUrl: actualBaseUrl,\\n      apiKey,\\n      timeout: 60_000,\\n      maxRetries: 3,\\n    });\\n\\n    logger.info('准备执行Agent节点',\\n\\n  }\\n}\","

     },\\n            nodeOutputs: {},\\n          },\\n        };\\n      } else {\\n        // Dify 类型：使用 executeAgentNode\\n        logger.info('使用 Dify 模式执行', { roleId, queryLength: query?.length });\\n        \\n        // 构建一个虚拟的 Agent 节点\\n        const virtualNode = {\\n          id: &amp;#96;virtual_${Date.now()}&amp;#96;,\\n          type: 'agent',\\n          agentId: roleId,\\n          data: { agentId: roleId },\\n        };\\n        \\n        // 构建共享上下文\\n        const sharedContext = {\\n          workflowInput: input,\\n          nodeOutputs: {},\\n        };\\n        \\n                   "lineNumber": 34570,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class AgentOrchestrator {\\nasync executeAgent(\\n    roleId: string,\\n    query: string,\\n    conversationId: string = '',\\n    context: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {}\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;AgentExecutionResult&amp;gt; {\\n;\\n    }\\n\\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\\n    messages.push({\\n      role: 'user',\\n      content: query\\n    });\\n\\n    // 6. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\\n    const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\\n\\n    // 7. 获取 LLM Provider\\n    const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\\n\\n    // 8. 调用 LLM（可能包含多轮工具调用）\\n    checkTimeout();\\n    let response = await this.executeWithTools(provider, messages, config.llm, tools, config.tools || [], checkTimeout);\\n\\n    // 9. 保存消息历史\\n    await this.saveMessages(finalConversationId, query, response, roleId);\\n\\n    // 10. 返回结果\\n    return {\\n      content: response.content,\\n      conversationId: finalConversationId,\\n      usage: response.usage,\\n      metadata: {\\n        model: response.model,\\n        finishReason: response.finishReason,\\n        toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0\\n      }\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行带工具调用的 LLM 请求（可能多轮）\\n   */\\n  private async executeWithTools(\\n    provider: ILLMProvider,\\n    messages: ChatMessage[],\\n    llmConfig: LLMConfig,\\n    tools: Tool[],\\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\\n    checkTimeout?: () =&amp;gt; void\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;LLMResponse&amp;gt; {\\n    \\n  }\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 35488,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import axios from 'axios';\\nimport { AIRoleConfig } from '../types/aiRole';\\n\\nconst API_BASE_URL = '/api/v1';\\n\\nconst api = axios.create({\\n  baseURL: API_BASE_URL,\\n  timeout: 120_000, // 增加到120秒（2分钟），适应AI请求的较长响应时间\\n  headers: {\\n    'Content-Type': 'application/json',\\n  },\\n});\\n\\nexport interface AIRoleResponse {\\n  success: boolean;\\n  data?: any;\\n  message?: string;\\n  error?: string;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface AIRoleUsageLocation {\\n  type: 'independent-page' | 'agent-workflow' | 'multi-chat' | 'workflow-editor';\\n  name: string;\\n  path?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  nodeId?: string;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface AIRoleUsage {\\n  roleId: string;\\n  roleName: string;\\n  locations: AIRoleUsageLocation[];\\n  totalUsageCount: number;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface ChatResponse {\\n  success: boolean;\\n  data?: {\\n    answer?: string;\\n    result?: string;\\n    conversation_id?: string;\\n    metadata?: any;\\n  };\\n  message?: string;\\n  error?: string;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * AI角色服务\\n */\\nclass AIRoleService {\\n  /**\\n   * 获取所有AI角色\\n   */\\n  async getAIRoles(): Promise&amp;lt;AIRoleConfig[]&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get('/ai-roles');\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        return response.data.data.map((role: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n          ...role,\\n          createdAt: new Date(role.createdAt),\\n          updatedAt: new Date(role.updatedAt),\\n        }));\\n      }\\n      return [];\\n    } catch (error: any) {\\n      const errorStatus = error?.response?.status || 'N/A';\\n      const errorCode = error?.code;\\n      \\n      // 对于404、500错误或连接错误（后端未运行），静默处理，不输出任何日志\\n      // 这是正常情况，不需要记录\\n      if (errorStatus === 404 || errorStatus === 500 || errorCode === 'ECONNREFUSED' || errorCode === 'ERR_NETWORK') {\\n        // 静默失败，返回空数组\\n        return [];\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 其他错误才输出详细信息\\n      const errorMessage = error?.response?.data?.message || error?.message || '未知错误';\\n      const errorUrl = error?.config?.url || error?.request?.responseURL;\\n      const errorBaseURL = error?.config?.baseURL;\\n      console.error('🔴 [aiRoleService] 获取AI角色列表失败');\\n      console.error('错误消息:', errorMessage);\\n      console.error('HTTP状态码:', errorStatus);\\n      console.error('请求URL:', errorUrl);\\n      console.error('Base URL:', errorBaseURL);\\n      \\n      throw error;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取单个AI角色\\n   */\\n  async getAIRole(id: string): Promise&amp;lt;AIRoleConfig | null&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.get(&amp;#96;/ai-roles/${id}&amp;#96;);\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        const role = response.data.data;\\n        return {\\n          ...role,\\n          createdAt: new Date(role.createdAt),\\n          updatedAt: new Date(role.updatedAt),\\n        };\\n      }\\n      return null;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('获取AI角色失败:', error);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 创建AI角色\\n   */\\n  async createAIRole(config: Omit&amp;lt;AIRoleConfig, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'&amp;gt;): Promise&amp;lt;AIRoleResponse&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.post('/ai-roles', config);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('创建AI角色失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '创建AI角色失败',\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 更新AI角色\\n   */\\n  async updateAIRole(id: string, updates: Partial&amp;lt;AIRoleConfig&amp;gt;): Promise&amp;lt;AIRoleResponse&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.put(&amp;#96;/ai-roles/${id}&amp;#96;, updates);\\n      return response.data;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('更新AI角色失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '更新AI角色失败',\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 删除AI角色\\n   */\\n  async deleteAIRole(id: string): Promise&amp;lt;AIRoleResponse&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await api.delete(&amp;#96;/ai-roles/${id}&amp;#96;);\\n      return response.data;\","

= {}\\\\n  ): Promise&amp;amp;lt;AgentExecutionResult&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const startTime = Date.now();\\\\n    const MAX_EXECUTION_TIME = 360000; // 6分钟总体超时（留出缓冲给前端7分钟超时）\\\\n    \\\\n    // 检查超时的辅助函数\\\\n    const checkTimeout = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;\\\\n      if (elapsed &amp;amp;gt; MAX_EXECUTION_TIME) {\\\\n        throw new Error(&amp;amp;#96;Agent执行超时：已执行 ${Math.round(elapsed / 1000)} 秒，超过最大执行时间 ${MAX_EXECUTION_TIME / 1000} 秒&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\\\\n    checkTimeout();\\\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\\\\n    if (!role) {\\\\n      throw new Error(&amp;amp;#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if (!role.agentConfig) {\\\\n      throw new Error(&amp;amp;#96;Agent配置不存在: ${roleId}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\\\\n\\\\n    // 2. 生成或使用 conversationId\\\\n    const finalConversationId = conversationId || this.generateConversationId();\\\\n\\\\n    // 3. 渲染 System Prompt\\\\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\\\\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\\\\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\\\\n      context\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // 4. 获取上下文消息\\\\n    checkTimeout();\\\\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\\\\n      finalConversationId,\\\\n      config.contextStrategy,\\\\n      query\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // 5. 构建完整消息列表\\\\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [];\\\\n    \\\\n    // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\\\\n    if (config.contextStrategy.includeSystemPrompt || contextMessages.length === 0) {\\\\n      messages.push({\\\\n        role: 'system',\\\\n        content: systemPrompt\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\",\""

{\\\\n  logger.debug('API Route Handler', {\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\\\n    baseUrl: req.baseUrl,\\\\n    path: req.path,\\\\n    params: req.params,\\\\n    query: req.query,\\\\n    body: req.body,\\\\n  });\\\\n  next();\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// 注册路由\\\\nrouter.use('/tech-categories', techCategoriesRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/tech-points', techPointsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/brands', brandsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/car-models', carModelsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/car-series', carSeriesRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/workflow', workflowModuleRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/knowledge-points', knowledgePointsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/chat', chatRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/workflow-stats', workflowStatsRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/dify', difyProxyRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/ai-roles', aiRoleRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/agent-workflows', agentWorkflowRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/executions', workflowExecutionRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/workflow-templates', workflowTemplateRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/public-page-configs', publicPageConfigRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/page-tool-configs', pageToolConfigRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/source-information', sourceInformationRouter);\\\\nrouter.use('/ai-search', aiSearchModuleRouter);\\\\n\\\\n// 健康检查\\\\nrouter.get('/health', (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  logger.debug('Health check endpoint called', {\\\\n    headers: req.headers,\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\n    url: req.url,\\\\n  });\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const response = {\\\\n      success: true,\\\\n      message: 'API is running',\\\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\\\n      version: '1.0.0'\\\\n    };\\\\n    res.json(response);\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    logger.error('Health check error', { error });\\\\n    res.status(500).json({\\\\n      success: false,\\\\n      message: 'Health check failed',\\\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'\\\\n    });\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// 简单测试端点\\\\nrouter.get('/test', (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  logger.debug('Test endpoint called');\\\\n  res.json({\\\\n    success: true,\\\\n    message: 'Test endpoint working',\\\\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\\\\n  });\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n// 404 处理中间件（必须在所有路由之后）\\\\nrouter.use((req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  logger.warn('API 路由未找到', {\\\\n    method: req.method,\\\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\\\n    path: req.path,\\\\n  });\\\\n  res.status(404).json({\\\\n    success: false,\\\\n    error: {\\\\n      code: 'NOT_FOUND',\\\\n      message: &amp;amp;#96;路由不存在: ${req.method} ${req.path}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n    },\\\\n  });\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\nexport default router;\\\",\""

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"async deleteAIRole(id: string): Promise&amp;lt;AIRoleResponse&amp;gt; {\\n\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 与AI角色对话\\n   */\\n  async chatWithRole(\\n    roleId: string,\\n    query?: string,\\n    inputs: any = {},\\n    conversationId?: string,\\n    files?: File[]\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;ChatResponse&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 如果有文件，使用 FormData 上传\\n      if (files &amp;amp;&amp;amp; files.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        const formData = new FormData();\\n        formData.append('query', query || '');\\n        formData.append('inputs', JSON.stringify(inputs));\\n        if (conversationId) {\\n          formData.append('conversationId', conversationId);\\n        }\\n        \\n        // 添加所有文件\\n        files.forEach((file) =&amp;gt; {\\n          formData.append('files', file);\\n        });\\n\\n        const response = await api.post(&amp;#96;/ai-roles/${roleId}/chat&amp;#96;, formData, {\\n          timeout: 420_000, // AI对话请求使用7分钟超时（独立Agent可能需要多轮工具调用，留出缓冲）\\n          headers: {\\n            'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data',\\n          },\\n        });\\n        return response.data;\\n      } else {\\n        // 没有文件，使用 JSON\\n        const response = await api.post(&amp;#96;/ai-roles/${roleId}/chat&amp;#96;, {\\n          query,\\n          inputs,\\n          conversationId,\\n        }, {\\n          timeout: 420_000, // AI对话请求使用7分钟超时（独立Agent可能需要多轮工具调用，留出缓冲）\\n        });\\n        return response.data;\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('AI角色对话失败:', error);\\n      return {\\n        success: false,\\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'AI角色对话失败',\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 测试AI角色连接\\n   */\\n  async testConnection(roleId: string): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n    try\\n  }\","

                  "lineNumber": 45978,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class AgentWorkflowService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行Agent节点\\n   */\\n  private async executeAgentNode(\\n    node: any,\\n    sharedContext: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt;\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;any&amp;gt; {\\n    const agentId = node.agentId || node.data?.agentId;\\n    if (!agentId) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;Agent节点 ${node.id} 未配置agentId&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取AI角色配置\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(agentId);\\n    if (!role) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色不存在: ${agentId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    if (!role.enabled) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色已禁用: ${agentId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // 准备输入数据\\n    const nodeInput = this.prepareNodeInput(node, sharedContext);\\n    \\n    // 尝试从多个可能的字段中提取query\\n    // 优先级：query &amp;gt; input &amp;gt; workflowInput.query &amp;gt; 整个nodeInput的字符串化\\n    let query = nodeInput.query;\\n    if (!query) {\\n      query = nodeInput.input;\\n    }\\n    if (!query &amp;amp;&amp;amp; nodeInput.workflowInput?.query) {\\n      query = nodeInput.workflowInput.query;\\n    }\\n    if (!query &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof nodeInput === 'object') {\\n      // 如果还是没有，尝试从其他常见字段中提取\\n      query = nodeInput.question || nodeInput.text || nodeInput.content;\\n    }\\n    if (!query) {\\n      // 最后回退：如果nodeInput是字符串，直接使用；否则字符串化\\n      query = typeof nodeInput === 'string' ? nodeInput : JSON.stringify(nodeInput);\\n    }\\n    \\n    const inputs = { ...nodeInput };\\n    delete inputs.query;\\n    delete inputs.input;\\n\\n    // 检查 provider 类型，Workflow 目前只支持 Dify\\n    const provider = role.provider || 'dify';\\n    if (provider === 'direct-agent') {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 是 Direct Agent 类型，不支持在 Workflow 中使用。请使用 Dify 类型的角色。&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    // 根据连接类型调用Dify API\\n    if (!role.difyConfig) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 的Dify配置不存在&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    const { connectionType, apiKey, apiUrl } = role.difyConfig;\\n    // 尝试从多个可能的位置获取 conversationId\\n    // 优先级：nodeInput.conversationId &amp;gt; nodeInput.workflowInput.conversationId &amp;gt; sharedContext.workflowInput.conversationId\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 47481,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class AgentOrchestrator {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行 Agent（核心方法）\\n   * @param roleId 角色ID\\n   * @param query 用户查询\\n   * @param conversationId 对话ID（可选，如果不存在会生成新的）\\n   * @param context 上下文数据（用于变量替换）\\n   * @returns 执行结果\\n   */\\n  async executeAgent(\\n    roleId: string,\\n    query: string,\\n    conversationId: string = '',\\n    context: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {}\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;AgentExecutionResult&amp;gt; {\\n    const startTime = Date.now();\\n    const MAX_EXECUTION_TIME = 360000; // 6分钟总体超时（留出缓冲给前端7分钟超时）\\n    \\n    // 检查超时的辅助函数\\n    const checkTimeout = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;\\n      if (elapsed &amp;gt; MAX_EXECUTION_TIME) {\\n        throw new Error(&amp;#96;Agent执行超时：已执行 ${Math.round(elapsed / 1000)} 秒，超过最大执行时间 ${MAX_EXECUTION_TIME / 1000} 秒&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n    };\\n    \\n    // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\\n    checkTimeout();\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\\n    if (!role) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    if (!role.agentConfig) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;Agent配置不存在: ${roleId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\\n\\n    // 2. 生成或使用 conversationId\\n    const finalConversationId = conversationId || this.generateConversationId();\\n\\n    // 3. 渲染 System Prompt\\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\\n      context\\n    );\\n\\n    // 4. 获取上下文消息\\n    checkTimeout();\\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\\n      finalConversationId,\\n      config.contextStrategy,\\n      query\\n    );\\n\\n    // 5. 构建完整消息列表\\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [];\\n    \\n    // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\\n    if (config.contextStrategy.includeSystemPrompt || contextMessages.length === 0) {\\n      messages.push({\\n        role: 'system',\\n        content: systemPrompt\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\\n  }\\n}\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 48213,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class AgentOrchestrator {\\nasync executeAgent(\\n    roleId: string,\\n    query: string,\\n    conversationId: string = '',\\n    context: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {}\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;AgentExecutionResult&amp;gt; {\\n;\\n    }\\n\\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\\n    messages.push({\\n      role: 'user',\\n      content: query\\n    });\\n\\n    // 6. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\\n    const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\\n\\n    // 7. 获取 LLM Provider\\n    const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\\n\\n    // 8. 调用 LLM（可能包含多轮工具调用）\\n    checkTimeout();\\n    let response = await this.executeWithTools(provider, messages, config.llm, tools, config.tools || [], checkTimeout);\\n\\n    // 9. 保存消息历史\\n    await this.saveMessages(finalConversationId, query, response, roleId);\\n\\n    // 10. 返回结果\\n    return {\\n      content: response.content,\\n      conversationId: finalConversationId,\\n      usage: response.usage,\\n      metadata: {\\n        model: response.model,\\n        finishReason: response.finishReason,\\n        toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0\\n      }\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行带工具调用的 LLM 请求（可能多轮）\\n   */\\n  private async executeWithTools(\\n    provider: ILLMProvider,\\n    messages: ChatMessage[],\\n    llmConfig: LLMConfig,\\n    tools: Tool[],\\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\\n    checkTimeout?: () =&amp;gt; void\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;LLMResponse&amp;gt; {\\n    \\n  }\\n}\","

                {
                  "lineNumber": 48484,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\\nasync execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&amp;lt;Result&amp;lt;any&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n\\n\\n      if (!featureConfig) {\\n        return failure({\\n          code: 'FEATURE_NOT_FOUND',\\n          message: &amp;#96;未找到功能对象映射配置: ${dto.featureType}&amp;#96;,\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      // 优先使用 agentId（AI角色ID），如果没有再使用 workflowId\\n      // agentId 用于直接调用 AI 角色，workflowId 用于通过工作流调用\\n      const configuredAgentId = (featureConfig as any).agentId;\\n      const configuredWorkflowId = featureConfig.workflowId;\\n      \\n      // 如果配置了 agentId，使用它；否则使用 workflowId\\n      // 注意：只有当 agentId 是不同的角色时才使用它，避免使用当前工作流\\n      let targetWorkflowId: string;\\n      if (configuredAgentId &amp;amp;&amp;amp; configuredAgentId !== workflowId) {\\n        targetWorkflowId = configuredAgentId;\\n        logger.info('使用配置的 AI 角色', {\\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\\n          agentId: configuredAgentId,\\n        });\\n      } else if (configuredWorkflowId &amp;amp;&amp;amp; configuredWorkflowId !== workflowId) {\\n        targetWorkflowId = configuredWorkflowId;\\n        logger.info('使用配置的工作流', {\\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\\n          workflowId: configuredWorkflowId,\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        targetWorkflowId = workflowId;\\n        logger.warn('功能对象未配置专属 agentId 或 workflowId，将使用当前工作流', {\\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\\n          fallbackWorkflowId: workflowId,\\n          configuredAgentId,\\n          configuredWorkflowId,\\n        });\\n      }\\n      const targetMappingConfig = targetWorkflowId === workflowId\\n        ? baseMappingConfig\\n        : await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, targetWorkflowId);\\n\\n      const effectiveInputMappings = featureConfig.inputMappings?.length\\n        ? featureConfig.inputMappings\\n        : targetMappingConfig?.inputMappings || [];\\n\\n      const effectiveOutputMappings = featureConfig.outputMappings?.length\\n;\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"# 项目AI/Agent调用节点完整识别\\n\\n本文档完整识别了todify3项目中所有的AI/Agent调用节点。\\n\\n## 一、后端服务层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. AgentOrchestrator（Agent编排器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/AgentOrchestrator.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 执行Direct Agent类型的AI角色\\n- **调用方法**: &amp;#96;executeAgent(roleId, query, conversationId, context)&amp;#96;\\n- **特点**: \\n  - 支持工具调用（Function Calling）\\n  - 支持多轮对话\\n  - 支持上下文管理\\n  - 支持Prompt变量替换\\n- **使用场景**: Direct Agent类型的AI角色对话\\n\\n### 2. AgentWorkflowService（Agent工作流服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;executeRole(roleId, input)&amp;#96; - 直接执行AI角色\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\n  - 根据provider类型选择不同的执行方式\\n  \\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;executeWorkflow(workflowId, options)&amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\n  - 支持拓扑排序执行节点\\n  - 支持并行执行同一层节点\\n  \\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;executeAgentNode(node, sharedContext)&amp;#96; - 执行工作流中的Agent节点\\n  - 支持Dify Chatflow模式\\n  - 支持Dify Workflow模式\\n  - 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\\n\\n### 3. DifyClient（Dify客户端）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/DifyClient.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, conversationId)&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;techPackage(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术包装\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术策略\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;#96;techArticle(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs)&amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;#96;techPublish(inputs, conversationId)&amp;#96; - 技术发布\\n- **调用节点7**: &amp;#96;callApp(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;#96; - 通用应用调用\\n- **调用节点8**: &amp;#96;runWorkflow(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;#96; - 工作流调用\\n\\n### 4. TriggerAgentUseCase（触发Agent用例）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/TriggerAgent.usecase.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 触发子Agent执行（五看、三定、技术矩阵等）\\n- **调用方式**: \\n  - 通过&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeRole()&amp;#96;直接调用AI角色\\n  - 通过&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;调用工作流\\n- **支持的功能类型**:\\n  - &amp;#96;five-view-analysis&amp;#96; - 技术转译（五看）\\n  - &amp;#96;three-fix-analysis&amp;#96; - 用户场景挖掘（三定）\\n  - &amp;#96;tech-matrix&amp;#96; - 技术矩阵\\n  - &amp;#96;propagation-strategy&amp;#96; - 传播策略\\n  - &amp;#96;exhibition-video&amp;#96; - 展具与视频\\n  - &amp;#96;translation&amp;#96; - 翻译\\n  - &amp;#96;ppt-outline&amp;#96; - 技术讲稿\\n  - &amp;#96;script&amp;#96; - 脚本\\n\\n### 5. ToolExecutor（工具执行器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ToolExecutor.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;executeTool(toolCall, toolConfig)&amp;#96; - 执行工具调用\\n- **支持的工具类型**:\\n  - &amp;#96;search&amp;#96; - 搜索工具\\n  - &amp;#96;calculation&amp;#96; - 计算工具\\n  - &amp;#96;time&amp;#96; - 时间工具\\n  - &amp;#96;api&amp;#96; - API调用工具\\n  - &amp;#96;workflow&amp;#96; - 工作流调用工具\\n  - &amp;#96;agent&amp;#96; - Agent调用工具（嵌套Agent调用）\\n\\n## 二、前端服务层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. workflowAPI（工作流API）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/api.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;smartSearch(query, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;#96; - 智能搜索\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;techPackage(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术包装\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术策略\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;#96;techArticle(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\n\\n### 2. aiRoleService（AI角色服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiRoleService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;chatWithRole(roleId, query, inputs)&amp;#96; - 与AI角色对话\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\n  - 自动根据角色配置选择调用方式\\n\\n### 3. aiSearchService（AI搜索服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiSearchService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;triggerFeatureAgent(conversationId, payload)&amp;#96; - 触发功能Agent\\n  - 用于触发子Agent（五看、三定等）\\n  - 支持上下文窗口大小配置\\n\\n### 4. WorkflowEngine（工作流引擎）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/workflowEngine.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;callAgent(agent, input)&amp;#96; - 调用Agent\\n  - 通过&amp;#96;aiRoleService.chatWithRole()&amp;#96;调用\\n  - 用于前端工作流执行\\n\\n## 三、前端页面/组件层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. BaseAISearchPage（基础AI搜索页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/ai-search/BaseAISearchPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleTriggerFeature(featureType)&amp;#96; - 触发功能Agent\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;aiSearchService.triggerFeatureAgent()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持的功能类型：五看、三定、技术矩阵、传播策略等\\n\\n### 2. AIChatPage（AI聊天页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/AIChatPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleSendMessage()&amp;#96; - 发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持多轮对话\\n\\n### 3. ProjectResourcesPage（项目资源页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/ProjectResourcesPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleAISendMessage()&amp;#96; - AI问答发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持项目资源上下文\\n\\n### 4. AiSearchComponent（AI搜索组件）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/AiSearchComponent.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleAiSearch()&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 5. 独立节点组件\\n以下节点组件都包含AI调用：\\n\\n#### AiSearchNode（AI搜索节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/AiSearchNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### TechPackageNode（技术包装节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/TechPackageNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.techPackage()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### CoreDraftNode（核心稿件节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/CoreDraftNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.coreDraft()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### PromotionStrategyNode（推广策略节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/PromotionStrategyNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.techStrategy()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### PressReleaseNode（新闻稿节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/PressReleaseNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用相关AI服务\\n\\n#### TechNewsletterNode（技术通讯节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/TechNewsletterNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用相关AI服务\\n\\n## 四、后端API路由层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. AI角色路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/aiRole.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat&amp;#96;\\n  - 根据provider类型调用：\\n    - Direct Agent: &amp;#96;AgentOrchestrator.executeAgent()&amp;#96;\\n    - Dify: &amp;#96;DifyGateway.executeChat()&amp;#96; 或 &amp;#96;DifyGateway.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2. AI搜索路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由1**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages&amp;#96; - 发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;SendMessageUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n  \\n- **路由2**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/agents&amp;#96; - 触发子Agent\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;TriggerAgentUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 3. 工作流路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/agentWorkflow.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由1**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute&amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;\\n  \\n- **路由2**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/roles/:id/execute&amp;#96; - 执行AI角色\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeRole()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 4. 工作流API路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/workflow/api/workflow.routes.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/workflow/ai-search&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;ExecuteAiSearchUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 五、工作流节点类型\\n\\n### 1. Agent节点（工作流编辑器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/AgentNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **类型**: &amp;#96;agent&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 在工作流中调用AI角色\\n- **执行**: 通过后端&amp;#96;AgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()&amp;#96;执行\\n\\n### 2. 其他工作流节点类型\\n- &amp;#96;input&amp;#96; - 输入节点\\n- &amp;#96;output&amp;#96; - 输出节点\\n- &amp;#96;condition&amp;#96; - 条件判断节点\\n- &amp;#96;assign&amp;#96; - 变量赋值节点\\n- &amp;#96;merge&amp;#96; - 数据合并节点\\n- &amp;#96;transform&amp;#96; - 数据转换节点\\n- &amp;#96;memory&amp;#96; - 文本记忆节点\\n\\n## 六、调用链路总结\\n\\n### 链路1: 前端页面 → 前端服务 → 后端API → 后端服务 → Dify/LLM\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n前端页面组件\\n  ↓\\n前端服务层 (workflowAPI/aiRoleService/aiSearchService)\\n  ↓\\n后端API路由层\\n  ↓\\n后端服务层 (AgentWorkflowService/DifyClient/AgentOrchestrator)\\n  ↓\\nDify Gateway / LLM Provider\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 链路2: 工作流执行 → Agent节点 → AI角色\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n工作流执行\\n  ↓\\nAgent节点\\n  ↓\\nAgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()\\n  ↓\\nAI角色配置 (Dify/Direct Agent)\\n  ↓\\nDify Gateway / AgentOrchestrator\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 链路3: 工具调用 → Agent嵌套调用\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\nLLM工具调用\\n  ↓\\nToolExecutor.executeTool()\\n  ↓\\nAgent工具类型\\n  ↓\\nAgentOrchestrator.executeAgent() (嵌套调用)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 七、AI/Agent调用节点统计\\n\\n### 后端调用节点（共15个）\\n1. AgentOrchestrator.executeAgent()\\n2. AgentWorkflowService.executeRole()\\n3. AgentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()\\n4. AgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()\\n5. DifyClient.aiSearch()\\n6. DifyClient.techPackage()\\n7. DifyClient.techStrategy()\\n8. DifyClient.techArticle()\\n9. DifyClient.coreDraft()\\n10. DifyClient.techPublish()\\n11. DifyClient.callApp()\\n12. DifyClient.runWorkflow()\\n13. TriggerAgentUseCase.execute()\\n14. ToolExecutor.executeTool() (agent类型)\\n15. SendMessageUseCase.execute()\\n\\n### 前端调用节点（共10个）\\n1. workflowAPI.aiSearch()\\n2. workflowAPI.smartSearch()\\n3. workflowAPI.techPackage()\\n4. workflowAPI.techStrategy()\\n5. workflowAPI.techArticle()\\n6. workflowAPI.coreDraft()\\n7. aiRoleService.chatWithRole()\\n8. aiSearchService.triggerFeatureAgent()\\n9. WorkflowEngine.callAgent()\\n10. 各节点组件的AI调用方法\\n\\n### 页面/组件调用节点（共8个）\\n1. BaseAISearchPage.handleTriggerFeature()\\n2. AIChatPage.handleSendMessage()\\n3. ProjectResourcesPage.handleAISendMessage()\\n4. AiSearchComponent.handleAiSearch()\\n5. AiSearchNode的AI调用\\n6. TechPackageNode的AI调用\\n7. CoreDraftNode的AI调用\\n8. PromotionStrategyNode的AI调用\\n\\n### API路由调用节点（共4个）\\n1. POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat\\n2. POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages\\n3. POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/agents\\n4. POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute\\n\\n## 八、关键特性\\n\\n1. **多Provider支持**: 支持Dify和Direct Agent两种类型\\n2. **多轮对话**: 支持conversationId传递，实现多轮对话\\n3. **工具调用**: 支持Function Calling，包括嵌套Agent调用\\n4. **工作流编排**: 支持复杂的工作流编排，Agent节点可嵌入工作流\\n5. **上下文管理**: 支持多种上下文管理策略（窗口、摘要等）\\n6. **字段映射**: 支持输入输出字段映射配置\\n7. **超时控制**: 支持执行超时控制\\n8. **错误重试**: 支持错误重试机制\\n\\n## 九、总结\\n\\n本项目共有**37个**主要的AI/Agent调用节点，分布在：\\n- 后端服务层：15个\\n- 前端服务层：10个\\n- 页面/组件层：8个\\n- API路由层：4个\\n\\n这些调用节点形成了一个完整的AI/Agent调用体系，支持多种使用场景和调用方式。\\n\","

nodeType.replace(/-/g, \\\"_\\\") : null;\\n  const node = nodeId ? getNodeById(nodeId) : null;\\n  const NodeComponent = node\\n    ? nodeComponents[node.type as keyof typeof nodeComponents]\\n    : null;\\n\\n  // 加载公开页面配置（如果存在）\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const loadPublicConfig = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n      if (!nodeType) {\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      try {\\n        setConfigLoading(true);\\n        // 尝试根据地址查找配置\\n        const configData = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigByAddress(nodeType);\\n        if (configData &amp;amp;&amp;amp; configData.config) {\\n          setPublicConfig(configData);\\n          \\n          // 如果配置中有角色，使用第一个角色\\n          if (configData.roles &amp;amp;&amp;amp; configData.roles.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n            const firstRole = configData.roles[0];\\n            setAiRole({\\n              ...firstRole,\\n              createdAt: new Date(firstRole.createdAt),\\n              updatedAt: new Date(firstRole.updatedAt),\\n            });\\n            setRolesLoading(false);\\n            return;\\n          }\\n        }\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        console.log('未找到公开页面配置，使用默认方式加载:', error);\\n      } finally {\\n        setConfigLoading(false);\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    loadPublicConfig();\\n  }, [nodeType]);\\n\\n  // 加载AI角色配置（如果没有从公开配置中获取）\\n  useEffect\\n\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 56593,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * 根据节点类型查找匹配的AI角色\\n * 优先匹配 source === 'independent-page' 的角色\\n * \\n * @param nodeType - 节点类型（如 'ai-search'）\\n * @param roles - AI角色列表\\n * @returns 匹配的AI角色，如果未找到返回null\\n */\\nexport function findAIRoleForNode(\\n  nodeType: IndependentNodeType,\\n  roles: AIRoleConfig[]\\n): AIRoleConfig | null {\\n  // 查找节点配置\\n  const nodeConfig = INDEPENDENT_NODE_CONFIGS.find(config =&amp;gt; config.nodeType === nodeType);\\n  \\n  if (!nodeConfig) {\\n    console.warn(&amp;#96;未找到节点类型配置: ${nodeType}&amp;#96;);\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n\\n  // 优先级1: 查找 source === 'independent-page' 且ID精确匹配的角色\\n  for (const role of roles) {\\n    if (role.source === 'independent-page' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; role.enabled) {\\n      if (nodeConfig.patterns.some(pattern =&amp;gt; pattern.test(role.id))) {\\n        console.log(&amp;#96;找到独立页面AI角色 (ID精确匹配): ${role.name}&amp;#96;);\\n        return role;\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  // 优先级2: 查找 source === 'independent-page' 且名称匹配的角色\\n  for (const role of roles) {\\n    if (role.source === 'independent-page' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; role.enabled) {\\n      if (nodeConfig.patterns.some(pattern =&amp;gt; pattern.test(role.name))) {\\n        console.log(&amp;#96;找到独立页面AI角色 (名称匹配): ${role.name}&amp;#96;);\\n        return role;\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  // 优先级3: 查找 source === 'independent-page' 且描述匹配的角色\\n  for (const role of roles) {\\n    if (role.source === 'independent-page' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; role.enabled) {\\n      if (nodeConfig.patterns.some(pattern =&amp;gt; pattern.test(role.description))) {\\n        console.log(&amp;#96;找到独立页面AI角色 (描述匹配): ${role.name}&amp;#96;);\\n        return role;\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  // 优先级4: 回退到任意source的匹配（用于兼容性）\\n  for (const role of roles) {\\n    if (role.enabled) {\\n      if (nodeConfig.patterns.some(pattern =&amp;gt; \\n        pattern.test(role.id) || \\n        pattern.test(role.name) || \\n        pattern.test(role.description)\\n      )) {\\n        console.warn(&amp;#96;找到AI角色但source不匹配 (回退匹配): ${role.name}, source: ${role.source}&amp;#96;);\\n        return role;\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  console.warn(&amp;#96;未找到匹配的AI角色: ${nodeType}&amp;#96;);\\n  return null;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取节点类型配置\\n * \\n * @param nodeType - 节点类型\\n * @returns 节点配置，如果未找到返回null\\n */\","

                  "lineNumber": 57598,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const NodePage: React.FC = \\n() =&amp;gt; {\\n\\n  }, [nodeType]);\\n\\n  // 加载AI角色配置（如果没有从公开配置中获取）\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const loadAIRole = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 如果已经从公开配置中获取了角色，则跳过\\n      if (aiRole || !nodeType || !isValidIndependentNodeType(nodeType)) {\\n        setRolesLoading(false);\\n        return;\\n      }\\n\\n      try {\\n        setRolesLoading(true);\\n        setRoleError(null);\\n        \\n        // 获取所有AI角色\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleService.getAIRoles();\\n        \\n        // 查找匹配的AI角色\\n        const matchedRole = findAIRoleForNode(nodeType as IndependentNodeType, allRoles);\\n        \\n        if (matchedRole) {\\n          setAiRole(matchedRole);\\n        } else {\\n          setRoleError('未找到匹配的AI角色配置，请前往AI角色管理页面创建对应的角色。');\\n        }\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        console.error('加载AI角色失败:', error);\\n        setRoleError('加载AI角色配置失败，将使用默认API配置。');\\n      } finally {\\n        setRolesLoading(false);\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    if (!configLoading) {\\n      loadAIRole();\\n    }\\n  }, [nodeType, configLoading, aiRole]);\\n\\n  // 处理节点执行\\n  const handleNodeExecution = async (inputData: any) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setIsLoading(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 模拟执行过程\\n      await new Promise((resolve) =&amp;gt; setTimeout(resolve, 2000));\\n\\n      const result = {\\n        success: true,\\n        message: \\\"执行成功\\\",\\n        data: inputData,\\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n      };\\n\\n      setExecutionResult(result);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      setExecutionResult({\\n        success: false,\\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : \\\"执行失败\\\",\\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n      });\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 重新执行\\n  const handleReExecute = () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setExecutionResult(null);\\n  };\\n\\n  // 如果节点类型是 speech，使用发布会稿页面\\n  if (nodeType === 'speech') {\\n    return &amp;lt;PressReleasePage /&amp;gt;;\\n  }\\n\\n  if (nodeType === 'tech-strategy') {\\n    return &amp;lt;TechStrategyPage /&amp;gt;;\\n  }\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 58747,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * 导入独立页面配置\\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs/import-independent-pages\\n */\\nrouter.post('/import-independent-pages', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    // 获取所有独立页面角色\\n    const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n    const independentPageRoles = allRoles.filter(\\n      r =&amp;gt; r.source === 'independent-page' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled\\n    );\\n\\n    if (independentPageRoles.length === 0) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(\\n        false,\\n        null,\\n        '未找到独立页面角色，请先初始化独立页面AI角色'\\n      ));\\n    }\\n\\n    // 定义节点映射\\n    const nodeMapping: Record&amp;lt;string, { name: string; description: string }&amp;gt; = {\\n      'independent-page-ai-search': {\\n        name: 'AI问答',\\n        description: '智能问答和搜索功能公开页面'\\n      },\\n      'independent-page-tech-package': {\\n        name: '技术包装',\\n        description: '技术内容包装工作流公开页面'\\n      },\\n      'independent-page-tech-strategy': {\\n        name: '技术策略',\\n        description: '技术策略生成工作流公开页面'\\n      },\\n      'independent-page-core-draft': {\\n        name: '技术通稿',\\n        description: '核心内容生成工作流公开页面'\\n      },\\n      'independent-page-speech': {\\n        name: '发布会演讲稿',\\n        description: '技术发布内容生成工作流公开页面'\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    const importResults: Array&amp;lt;{ role: any; config: any; status: 'created' | 'exists' | 'error'; error?: string }&amp;gt; = [];\\n\\n    // 为每个独立页面角色创建公开页面配置\\n}\","

ToolExecutor（工具执行器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ToolExecutor.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;executeTool(toolCall, toolConfig)&amp;#96; - 执行工具调用\\n- **支持的工具类型**:\\n  - &amp;#96;search&amp;#96; - 搜索工具\\n  - &amp;#96;calculation&amp;#96; - 计算工具\\n  - &amp;#96;time&amp;#96; - 时间工具\\n  - &amp;#96;api&amp;#96; - API调用工具\\n  - &amp;#96;workflow&amp;#96; - 工作流调用工具\\n  - &amp;#96;agent&amp;#96; - Agent调用工具（嵌套Agent调用）\\n\\n## 二、前端服务层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. workflowAPI（工作流API）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/api.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;smartSearch(query, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;#96; - 智能搜索\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;techPackage(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术包装\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术策略\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;#96;techArticle(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\n\\n### 2. aiRoleService（AI角色服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiRoleService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;chatWithRole(roleId, query, inputs)&amp;#96; - 与AI角色对话\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\n  - 自动根据角色配置选择调用方式\\n\\n### 3. aiSearchService（AI搜索服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiSearchService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;triggerFeatureAgent(conversationId, payload)&amp;#96; - 触发功能Agent\\n  - 用于触发子Agent（五看、三定等）\","

                  "lineNumber": 59646,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"// 节点类型与AI角色映射工具\\n// 用于在独立页面模式下自动匹配对应的AI角色配置\\n\\nimport { AIRoleConfig } from '../types/aiRole';\\n\\n/**\\n * 独立页面节点类型定义\\n */\\nexport type IndependentNodeType = \\n  | 'ai-search' \\n  | 'tech-package' \\n  | 'promotion-strategy' \\n  | 'core-draft' \\n  | 'speech';\\n\\n/**\\n * 节点类型配置\\n * 定义了5个独立页面的匹配规则\\n */\\nexport interface NodeTypeConfig {\\n  nodeType: IndependentNodeType;\\n  name: string;\\n  description: string;\\n  patterns: RegExp[];  // 用于匹配AI角色的正则表达式模式\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 5个独立页面节点的配置\\n */\\nexport const INDEPENDENT_NODE_CONFIGS: NodeTypeConfig[] = [\\n  {\\n    nodeType: 'ai-search',\\n    name: 'AI问答',\\n    description: '智能问答和搜索功能',\\n    patterns: [\\n      /ai-search/i,\\n      /ai问答/i,\\n      /智能搜索/i,\\n      /smart-search/i,\\n    ],\\n  },\\n  {\\n    nodeType: 'tech-package',\\n    name: '技术包装',\\n    description: '技术内容包装工作流',\\n    patterns: [\\n      /tech-package/i,\\n      /技术包装/i,\\n    ],\\n  },\\n  {\\n    nodeType: 'promotion-strategy',\\n    name: '技术策略',\\n    description: '技术策略生成工作流',\\n    patterns: [\\n      /promotion-strategy/i,\\n      /tech-strategy/i,\\n      /技术策略/i,\\n      /推广策略/i,\\n    ],\\n  },\\n  {\\n    nodeType: 'core-draft',\\n    name: '技术通稿',\\n    description: '核心内容生成工作流',\\n    patterns: [\\n      /core-draft/i,\\n      /tech-article/i,\\n      /技术通稿/i,\\n      /核心稿件/i,\\n    ],\\n  },\\n  {\\n    nodeType: 'speech',\\n    name: '发布会演讲稿',\\n    description: '技术发布内容生成工作流',\\n    patterns: [\\n      /speech/i,\\n      /发布会/i,\\n      /演讲稿/i,\\n      /tech-publish/i,\\n    ],\\n  },\\n];\\n\\n/**\\n * 根据节点类型查找匹配的AI角色\\n * 优先匹配 source === 'independent-page' 的角色\\n * \\n * @param nodeType - 节点类型（如 'ai-search'）\\n * @param roles - AI角色列表\\n * @returns 匹配的AI角色，如果未找到返回null\\n */\\nexport function findAIRoleForNode(\\n  nodeType: IndependentNodeType,\\n  roles: AIRoleConfig[]\\n): AIRoleConfig | null {\\n  // 查找节点配置\\n  const nodeConfig = INDEPENDENT_NODE_CONFIGS.find(config =&amp;gt; config.nodeType === nodeType);\\n  \\n  if (!nodeConfig) {\\n    console.warn(&amp;#96;未找到节点类型配置: ${nodeType}&amp;#96;);\\n    return null;\\n  }\\n\\n  // 优先级1: 查找 source === 'independent-page' 且ID精确匹配的角色\\n  for (const role of roles) {\\n    if (role.source === 'independent-page' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; role.enabled) {\\n      if (nodeConfig.patterns.some(pattern =&amp;gt; pattern.test(role.id))) {\\n        console.log(&amp;#96;找到独立页面AI角色 (ID精确匹配): ${role.name}&amp;#96;);\\n        return role;\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  // 优先级2: 查找 source === 'independent-page' 且名称匹配的角色\\n  for (const role of roles) {\\n    if (role.source === 'independent-page' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; role.enabled) {\\n      if (nodeConfig.patterns.some(pattern =&amp;gt; pattern.test(role.name))) {\\n        console.log(&amp;#96;找到独立页面AI角色 (名称匹配): ${role.name}&amp;#96;);\\n        return role;\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  // 优先级3: 查找 source === 'independent-page' 且描述匹配的角色\\n  for (const role of roles) {\\n    if (role.source === 'independent-page' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; role.enabled) {\\n      if (nodeConfig.patterns.some(pattern =&amp;gt; pattern.test(role.description))) {\\n        console.log(&amp;#96;找到独立页面AI角色 (描述匹配): ${role.name}&amp;#96;);\\n        return role;\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  // 优先级4: 回退到任意source的匹配（用于兼容性）\\n  for (const role of roles) {\\n    if (role.enabled) {\\n      if (nodeConfig.patterns.some(pattern =&amp;gt; \\n        pattern.test(role.id) || \\n        pattern.test(role.name) || \\n        pattern.test(role.description)\\n      )) {\\n        console.warn(&amp;#96;找到AI角色但source不匹配 (回退匹配): ${role.name}, source: ${role.source}&amp;#96;);\\n        return role;\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  console.warn(&amp;#96;未找到匹配的AI角色: ${nodeType}&amp;#96;);\\n  return null;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取节点类型配置\\n * \\n * @param nodeType - 节点类型\\n * @returns 节点配置，如果未找到返回null\\n */\\nexport function getNodeTypeConfig(nodeType: IndependentNodeType): NodeTypeConfig | null {\\n  return INDEPENDENT_NODE_CONFIGS.find(config =&amp;gt; config.nodeType === nodeType) || null;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取所有独立页面节点类型配置\\n */\\nexport function getAllNodeTypeConfigs(): NodeTypeConfig[] {\\n  return INDEPENDENT_NODE_CONFIGS;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 检查是否为有效的独立页面节点类型\\n * \\n * @param nodeType - 节点类型字符串\\n * @returns 是否为有效的独立页面节点类型\\n */\\nexport function isValidIndependentNodeType(nodeType: string): nodeType is IndependentNodeType {\\n  return INDEPENDENT_NODE_CONFIGS.some(config =&amp;gt; config.nodeType === nodeType);\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取独立页面所有可用的AI角色\\n * 返回所有 source === 'independent-page' 且 enabled === true 的角色\\n * \\n * @param roles - AI角色列表\\n * @returns 独立页面AI角色列表\\n */\\nexport function getIndependentPageRoles(roles: AIRoleConfig[]): AIRoleConfig[] {\\n  return roles.filter(role =&amp;gt; \\n    role.source === 'independent-page' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; \\n    role.enabled\\n  );\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取智能工作流所有可用的AI角色\\n * 返回所有 source === 'smart-workflow' 且 enabled === true 的角色\\n * \\n * @param roles - AI角色列表\\n * @returns 智能工作流AI角色列表\\n */\\nexport function getSmartWorkflowRoles(roles: AIRoleConfig[]): AIRoleConfig[] {\\n  return roles.filter(role =&amp;gt; \\n    role.source === 'smart-workflow' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; \\n    role.enabled\\n  );\\n}\\n\","
                },

                  "lineNumber": 61913,
                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"// 公开页面配置类型定义\\n\\nexport interface PublicPageConfig {\\n  id: string;\\n  name: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  address?: string; // 地址配置\\n  displayMode: 'all' | 'workflow' | 'custom' | 'role';\\n  workflowId?: string;\\n  roleIds?: string[];\\n  accessToken: string;\\n  isActive: boolean;\\n  templateType?: 'speech' | 'ai-chat' | 'ai-chat-edit' | 'ai-chat-knowledge' | 'ai-chat-source' | 'ai-chat-source-tools' | 'custom' | null;\\n  customHtml?: string;\\n  createdAt: Date;\\n  updatedAt: Date;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface CreatePublicPageConfigRequest {\\n  name: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  address?: string; // 地址配置\\n  displayMode?: 'all' | 'workflow' | 'custom' | 'role'; // 可选，默认为'role'\\n  workflowId?: string;\\n  roleIds?: string[];\\n  templateType?: 'speech' | 'ai-chat' | 'ai-chat-edit' | 'ai-chat-knowledge' | 'ai-chat-source' | 'ai-chat-source-tools' | 'custom' | null;\\n  customHtml?: string;\\n  isActive?: boolean; // 可选，用于创建时直接设置状态\\n}\\n\\nexport interface UpdatePublicPageConfigRequest {\\n  name?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  address?: string; // 地址配置\\n  displayMode?: 'all' | 'workflow' | 'custom' | 'role';\\n  workflowId?: string;\\n  roleIds?: string[];\\n  isActive?: boolean;\\n  templateType?: 'speech' | 'ai-chat' | 'ai-chat-edit' | 'ai-chat-knowledge' | 'ai-chat-source' | 'ai-chat-source-tools' | 'custom' | null;\\n  customHtml?: string;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface PublicPageConfigPreview {\\n  config: PublicPageConfig;\\n  roles: any[]; // AIRoleConfig[]\\n}\\n\\nexport interface ApiResponse&amp;lt;T&amp;gt; {\\n  success: boolean;\\n  message: string;\\n  data: T;\\n  error?: string;\\n}\\n\\n\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"# 项目AI/Agent调用节点完整识别\\n\\n本文档完整识别了todify3项目中所有的AI/Agent调用节点。\\n\\n## 一、后端服务层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. AgentOrchestrator（Agent编排器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/AgentOrchestrator.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 执行Direct Agent类型的AI角色\\n- **调用方法**: &amp;#96;executeAgent(roleId, query, conversationId, context)&amp;#96;\\n- **特点**: \\n  - 支持工具调用（Function Calling）\\n  - 支持多轮对话\\n  - 支持上下文管理\\n  - 支持Prompt变量替换\\n- **使用场景**: Direct Agent类型的AI角色对话\\n\\n### 2. AgentWorkflowService（Agent工作流服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;executeRole(roleId, input)&amp;#96; - 直接执行AI角色\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\n  - 根据provider类型选择不同的执行方式\\n  \\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;executeWorkflow(workflowId, options)&amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\n  - 支持拓扑排序执行节点\\n  - 支持并行执行同一层节点\\n  \\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;executeAgentNode(node, sharedContext)&amp;#96; - 执行工作流中的Agent节点\\n  - 支持Dify Chatflow模式\\n  - 支持Dify Workflow模式\\n  - 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\\n\\n### 3. DifyClient（Dify客户端）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/DifyClient.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, conversationId)&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;techPackage(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术包装\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术策略\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;#96;techArticle(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs)&amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;#96;techPublish(inputs, conversationId)&amp;#96; - 技术发布\\n- **调用节点7**: &amp;#96;callApp(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;#96; - 通用应用调用\\n- **调用节点8**: &amp;#96;runWorkflow(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;#96; - 工作流调用\\n\\n### 4. TriggerAgentUseCase（触发Agent用例）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/TriggerAgent.usecase.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 触发子Agent执行（五看、三定、技术矩阵等）\\n- **调用方式**: \\n  - 通过&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeRole()&amp;#96;直接调用AI角色\\n  - 通过&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;调用工作流\\n- **支持的功能类型**:\\n  - &amp;#96;five-view-analysis&amp;#96; - 技术转译（五看）\\n  - &amp;#96;three-fix-analysis&amp;#96; - 用户场景挖掘（三定）\\n  - &amp;#96;tech-matrix&amp;#96; - 技术矩阵\\n  - &amp;#96;propagation-strategy&amp;#96; - 传播策略\\n  - &amp;#96;exhibition-video&amp;#96; - 展具与视频\\n  - &amp;#96;translation&amp;#96; - 翻译\\n  - &amp;#96;ppt-outline&amp;#96; - 技术讲稿\\n  - &amp;#96;script&amp;#96; - 脚本\\n\\n### 5. ToolExecutor（工具执行器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ToolExecutor.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;executeTool(toolCall, toolConfig)&amp;#96; - 执行工具调用\\n- **支持的工具类型**:\\n  - &amp;#96;search&amp;#96; - 搜索工具\\n  - &amp;#96;calculation&amp;#96; - 计算工具\\n  - &amp;#96;time&amp;#96; - 时间工具\\n  - &amp;#96;api&amp;#96; - API调用工具\\n  - &amp;#96;workflow&amp;#96; - 工作流调用工具\\n  - &amp;#96;agent&amp;#96; - Agent调用工具（嵌套Agent调用）\\n\\n## 二、前端服务层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. workflowAPI（工作流API）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/api.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;smartSearch(query, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;#96; - 智能搜索\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;techPackage(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术包装\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术策略\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;#96;techArticle(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\n\\n### 2. aiRoleService（AI角色服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiRoleService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;chatWithRole(roleId, query, inputs)&amp;#96; - 与AI角色对话\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\n  - 自动根据角色配置选择调用方式\\n\\n### 3. aiSearchService（AI搜索服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiSearchService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;triggerFeatureAgent(conversationId, payload)&amp;#96; - 触发功能Agent\\n  - 用于触发子Agent（五看、三定等）\\n  - 支持上下文窗口大小配置\\n\\n### 4. WorkflowEngine（工作流引擎）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/workflowEngine.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;callAgent(agent, input)&amp;#96; - 调用Agent\\n  - 通过&amp;#96;aiRoleService.chatWithRole()&amp;#96;调用\\n  - 用于前端工作流执行\\n\\n## 三、前端页面/组件层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. BaseAISearchPage（基础AI搜索页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/ai-search/BaseAISearchPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleTriggerFeature(featureType)&amp;#96; - 触发功能Agent\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;aiSearchService.triggerFeatureAgent()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持的功能类型：五看、三定、技术矩阵、传播策略等\\n\\n### 2. AIChatPage（AI聊天页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/AIChatPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleSendMessage()&amp;#96; - 发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持多轮对话\\n\\n### 3. ProjectResourcesPage（项目资源页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/pages/ProjectResourcesPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleAISendMessage()&amp;#96; - AI问答发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持项目资源上下文\\n\\n### 4. AiSearchComponent（AI搜索组件）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/AiSearchComponent.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleAiSearch()&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 5. 独立节点组件\\n以下节点组件都包含AI调用：\\n\\n#### AiSearchNode（AI搜索节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/AiSearchNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### TechPackageNode（技术包装节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/TechPackageNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.techPackage()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### CoreDraftNode（核心稿件节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/CoreDraftNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.coreDraft()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### PromotionStrategyNode（推广策略节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/PromotionStrategyNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.techStrategy()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### PressReleaseNode（新闻稿节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/PressReleaseNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用相关AI服务\\n\\n#### TechNewsletterNode（技术通讯节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/TechNewsletterNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用相关AI服务\\n\\n## 四、后端API路由层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. AI角色路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/aiRole.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat&amp;#96;\\n  - 根据provider类型调用：\\n    - Direct Agent: &amp;#96;AgentOrchestrator.executeAgent()&amp;#96;\\n    - Dify: &amp;#96;DifyGateway.executeChat()&amp;#96; 或 &amp;#96;DifyGateway.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2. AI搜索路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由1**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages&amp;#96; - 发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;SendMessageUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n  \\n- **路由2**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/agents&amp;#96; - 触发子Agent\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;TriggerAgentUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 3. 工作流路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/agentWorkflow.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由1**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute&amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;\\n  \\n- **路由2**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/roles/:id/execute&amp;#96; - 执行AI角色\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeRole()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 4. 工作流API路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/workflow/api/workflow.routes.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/workflow/ai-search&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;ExecuteAiSearchUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 五、工作流节点类型\\n\\n### 1. Agent节点（工作流编辑器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/AgentNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **类型**: &amp;#96;agent&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 在工作流中调用AI角色\\n- **执行**: 通过后端&amp;#96;AgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()&amp;#96;执行\\n\\n### 2. 其他工作流节点类型\\n- &amp;#96;input&amp;#96; - 输入节点\\n- &amp;#96;output&amp;#96; - 输出节点\\n- &amp;#96;condition&amp;#96; - 条件判断节点\\n- &amp;#96;assign&amp;#96; - 变量赋值节点\\n- &amp;#96;merge&amp;#96; - 数据合并节点\\n- &amp;#96;transform&amp;#96; - 数据转换节点\\n- &amp;#96;memory&amp;#96; - 文本记忆节点\\n\\n## 六、调用链路总结\\n\\n### 链路1: 前端页面 → 前端服务 → 后端API → 后端服务 → Dify/LLM\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n前端页面组件\\n  ↓\\n前端服务层 (workflowAPI/aiRoleService/aiSearchService)\\n  ↓\\n后端API路由层\\n  ↓\\n后端服务层 (AgentWorkflowService/DifyClient/AgentOrchestrator)\\n  ↓\\nDify Gateway / LLM Provider\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 链路2: 工作流执行 → Agent节点 → AI角色\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n工作流执行\\n  ↓\\nAgent节点\\n  ↓\\nAgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()\\n  ↓\\nAI角色配置 (Dify/Direct Agent)\\n  ↓\\nDify Gateway / AgentOrchestrator\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 链路3: 工具调用 → Agent嵌套调用\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\nLLM工具调用\\n  ↓\\nToolExecutor.executeTool()\\n  ↓\\nAgent工具类型\\n  ↓\\nAgentOrchestrator.executeAgent() (嵌套调用)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 七、AI/Agent调用节点统计\\n\\n### 后端调用节点（共15个）\\n1. AgentOrchestrator.executeAgent()\\n2. AgentWorkflowService.executeRole()\\n3. AgentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()\\n4. AgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()\\n5. DifyClient.aiSearch()\\n6. DifyClient.techPackage()\\n7. DifyClient.techStrategy()\\n8. DifyClient.techArticle()\\n9. DifyClient.coreDraft()\\n10. DifyClient.techPublish()\\n11. DifyClient.callApp()\\n12. DifyClient.runWorkflow()\\n13. TriggerAgentUseCase.execute()\\n14. ToolExecutor.executeTool() (agent类型)\\n15. SendMessageUseCase.execute()\\n\\n### 前端调用节点（共10个）\\n1. workflowAPI.aiSearch()\\n2. workflowAPI.smartSearch()\\n3. workflowAPI.techPackage()\\n4. workflowAPI.techStrategy()\\n5. workflowAPI.techArticle()\\n6. workflowAPI.coreDraft()\\n7. aiRoleService.chatWithRole()\\n8. aiSearchService.triggerFeatureAgent()\\n9. WorkflowEngine.callAgent()\\n10. 各节点组件的AI调用方法\\n\\n### 页面/组件调用节点（共8个）\\n1. BaseAISearchPage.handleTriggerFeature()\\n2. AIChatPage.handleSendMessage()\\n3. ProjectResourcesPage.handleAISendMessage()\\n4. AiSearchComponent.handleAiSearch()\\n5. AiSearchNode的AI调用\\n6. TechPackageNode的AI调用\\n7. CoreDraftNode的AI调用\\n8. PromotionStrategyNode的AI调用\\n\\n### API路由调用节点（共4个）\\n1. POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat\\n2. POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages\\n3. POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/agents\\n4. POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute\\n\\n## 八、关键特性\\n\\n1. **多Provider支持**: 支持Dify和Direct Agent两种类型\\n2. **多轮对话**: 支持conversationId传递，实现多轮对话\\n3. **工具调用**: 支持Function Calling，包括嵌套Agent调用\\n4. **工作流编排**: 支持复杂的工作流编排，Agent节点可嵌入工作流\\n5. **上下文管理**: 支持多种上下文管理策略（窗口、摘要等）\\n6. **字段映射**: 支持输入输出字段映射配置\\n7. **超时控制**: 支持执行超时控制\\n8. **错误重试**: 支持错误重试机制\\n\\n## 九、总结\\n\\n本项目共有**37个**主要的AI/Agent调用节点，分布在：\\n- 后端服务层：15个\\n- 前端服务层：10个\\n- 页面/组件层：8个\\n- API路由层：4个\\n\\n这些调用节点形成了一个完整的AI/Agent调用体系，支持多种使用场景和调用方式。\\n\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import express from 'express';\\nimport dotenv from 'dotenv';\\nimport cors from 'cors';\\nimport path from 'path';\\nimport apiRoutes from './routes';\\nimport difyProxyRoutes from './routes/dify-proxy';\\nimport { testConnection } from './config/database';\\nimport { publicPageConfigModel, aiRoleModel } from './models';\\nimport { logger } from './shared/lib/logger';\\nimport { errorTracking } from './shared/infrastructure/monitoring/errorTracking';\\nimport { SourceInformationService } from './services/sourceInformationService';\\n\\n// 导入监控模块\\nimport { performanceMonitor as _performanceMonitor } from './shared/infrastructure/monitoring/performanceMonitor';\\nimport { prometheusMetrics as _prometheusMetrics } from './shared/infrastructure/monitoring/prometheusMetrics';\\n\\n// 确保模块正确加载\\nconst performanceMonitor = _performanceMonitor || null;\\nconst prometheusMetrics = _prometheusMetrics || null;\\n\\ndotenv.config();\\n\\nconst app = express();\\nconst port = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3003;\\n\\n// 初始化错误追踪\\nerrorTracking.init();\\n\\n// 中间件\\napp.use(cors());\\napp.use(express.json());\\n\\n// 性能监控中间件（放在最前面）\\nif (performanceMonitor &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof performanceMonitor.middleware === 'function') {\\n  app.use(performanceMonitor.middleware());\\n} else {\\n  logger.warn('性能监控中间件未正确加载，跳过');\\n}\\n\\n// Prometheus 指标中间件（放在性能监控之后）\\nif (prometheusMetrics &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof prometheusMetrics.middleware === 'function') {\\n  app.use(prometheusMetrics.middleware());\\n} else {\\n  logger.warn('Prometheus 指标中间件未正确加载，跳过');\\n}\\n\\n// 添加请求日志中间件（放在最前面，但要在路由之前）\\napp.use((req, res, next) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();\\n  logger.info('收到请求', {\\n    timestamp,\\n    method: req.method,\\n    url: req.url,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    ip: req.ip || req.connection.remoteAddress,\\n    userAgent: req.get('User-Agent'),\\n    body: req.body,\\n    authorization: req.get('Authorization')?.substring(0, 20),\\n    contentType: req.get('Content-Type'),\\n  });\\n  next();\\n});\\n\\n// API 路由必须放在静态文件服务之前\\n// 路由配置（API 保持 /api/v1 前缀）\\napp.use('/api/v1', apiRoutes);\\n\\n// Dify API 代理路由\\napp.use('/api/dify', difyProxyRoutes);\\n\\n// 公开访问接口（通过token获取配置和角色）\\napp.get('/api/v1/public/:token', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { token } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getByAccessToken(token);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: '配置不存在或已禁用', data: null });\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取角色列表\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\n    \\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; r.enabled);\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.workflowId) {\\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\\n      if (workflow) {\\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&amp;gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n      }\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json({ success: true, message: '获取公开配置成功', data: { config, roles } });\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('获取公开配置失败', { error });\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\\n      context: { metadata: { token: req.params.token } },\\n    });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: '获取公开配置失败',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\\n      data: null\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 公开访问接口（通过address获取配置和角色）\\napp.get('/api/v1/public-by-address/:address', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { address } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getByAddress(address);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: '配置不存在或已禁用', data: null });\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取角色列表\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\n    \\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; r.enabled);\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.workflowId) {\\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\\n      if (workflow) {\\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&amp;gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n      }\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'role' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json({ success: true, message: '获取公开配置成功', data: { config, roles } });\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('获取公开配置失败', { error });\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\\n      context: { metadata: { address: req.params.address } },\\n    });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: '获取公开配置失败',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\\n      data: null\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 公开访问接口（通过configId获取配置和角色）\\napp.get('/api/v1/public-config/:configId', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { configId } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(configId);\\n    \\n    if (!config || !config.isActive) {\\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: '配置不存在或已禁用', data: null });\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取角色列表\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\n    \\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; r.enabled);\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.workflowId) {\\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\\n      if (workflow) {\\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&amp;gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n      }\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;&amp;amp;
