r.enabled);\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json({ success: true, message: '获取公开配置成功', data: { config, roles } });\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('获取公开配置失败', { error });\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\\n      context: { metadata: { configId: req.params.configId } },\\n    });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: '获取公开配置失败',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\\n      data: null\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// API 健康检查\\napp.get('/api/health', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  res.json({ \\n    message: 'Todify3 Backend API',\\n    version: '1.0.0',\\n    status: 'running',\\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n    uptime: process.uptime(),\\n  });\\n});\\n\\n// 性能监控 API\\napp.get('/api/v1/monitoring/performance', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const stats = performanceMonitor.getStats();\\n    res.json({\\n      success: true,\\n      data: stats,\\n    });\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)));\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      error: {\\n        code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',\\n        message: '获取性能统计失败',\\n      },\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// Prometheus 指标端点\\napp.get('/metrics', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    res.set('Content-Type', 'text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8');\\n    const metrics = await prometheusMetrics.getMetrics();\\n    res.send(metrics);\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)));\\n    res.status(500).send('# Error generating metrics\\\\n');\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 公共知识库文件服务\\nconst publicKnowledgeUploadDir = path.join(__dirname, '../uploads/public-knowledge');\\napp.use('/api/v1/public-knowledge/files', express.static(publicKnowledgeUploadDir, {\\n  maxAge: 86400000, // 1 day\\n  etag: true,\\n  lastModified: true,\\n}));\\n\\n// 生产环境静态文件服务：直接从 frontend/dist 提供资源\\n// 注意：必须在 API 路由之后，否则会拦截 API 请求\\n// 仅在非开发环境或明确需要时才启用静态文件服务\\nconst isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';\\nif (!isDev) {\\n  const distDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../frontend/dist');\\n  app.use(express.static(distDir, {\\n    maxAge: 0,\\n    etag: true,\\n    lastModified: true,\\n  }));\\n\\n  // SPA Fallback：除 /api/* 外的所有路由都返回 index.html\\n  app.get(/^(\\\\/(?!api).*)$/, (_req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n    res.sendFile(path.join(distDir, 'index.html'));\\n  });\\n}\\n\\n// 全局错误处理中间件\\napp.use((err: any, req: any, res: any, next: any) =&amp;gt; {\\n    errorTracking.captureException(err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)), {\\n      context: {\\n        metadata: {\\n          method: req.method,\\n          path: req.path,\\n          body: req.body,\\n        },\\n      },\\n    });\\n\\n  logger.error('全局错误处理', {\\n    error: err,\\n    stack: err?.stack,\\n    requestUrl: req.url,\\n    method: req.method,\\n    body: req.body,\\n  });\\n  \\n  res.status(500).json({\\n    success: false,\\n    message: 'Internal server error',\\n    error: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? '服务器内部错误' : (err.message || 'Unknown error')\\n  });\\n});\\n\\n// 启动服务器前测试数据库连接\\nasync function startServer() {\\n  try {\\n    logger.info('正在测试数据库连接...');\\n    const isConnected = await testConnection();\\n    if (!isConnected) {\\n      throw new Error('数据库连接失败');\\n    }\\n    logger.info('数据库连接成功');\\n    \\n    // 初始化AI角色数据库表\\n    try {\\n      const { aiRoleModel } = await import('./models');\\n      await aiRoleModel.initializeTable();\\n      logger.info('AI角色数据库表初始化成功');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.warn('AI角色数据库表初始化警告', { error });\\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 初始化Agent工作流数据库表\\n    try {\\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\\n      await agentWorkflowModel.initializeTable();\\n      logger.info('Agent工作流数据库表初始化成功');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.warn('Agent工作流数据库表初始化警告', { error });\\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 初始化公开页面配置数据库表\\n    try {\\n      const { publicPageConfigModel } = await import('./models');\\n      await publicPageConfigModel.initializeTable();\\n      logger.info('公开页面配置数据库表初始化成功');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.warn('公开页面配置数据库表初始化警告', { error });\\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 初始化来源信息数据库表\\n    try {\\n      const sourceInformationService = new SourceInformationService();\\n      await sourceInformationService.initializeTable();\\n      logger.info('来源信息数据库表初始化成功');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.warn('来源信息数据库表初始化警告', { error });\\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 初始化公共知识库数据库表\\n    try {\\n      const { publicKnowledgeModel } = await import('./models');\\n      await publicKnowledgeModel.initializeTable();\\n      logger.info('公共知识库数据库表初始化成功');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.warn('公共知识库数据库表初始化警告', { error });\\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\\n    }\\n    \\n    const server = app.listen(port, \\\"0.0.0.0\\\", () =&amp;gt; {\\n      logger.info('Backend server 已启动', { url: &amp;#96;http://0.0.0.0:${port}&amp;#96; });\\n    });\\n\\n    // 保持进程运行\\n    server.keepAliveTimeout = 0;\\n    server.headersTimeout = 0;\\n\\n    // 优雅关闭处理\\n    process.on('SIGTERM', () =&amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    const configs = await publicPageConfigModel.getAll();\\\\\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, configs, '获取配置列表成功'));\\\\\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n    console.error('获取配置列表失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\\\\\n      false,\\\\\\\\n      null,\\\\\\\\n      '获取配置列表失败',\\\\\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n    ));\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/**\\\\\\\\n * 获取单个配置\\\\\\\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\\nrouter.get('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\\\\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    if (!config) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, config, '获取配置成功'));\\\\\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n    console.error('获取配置失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\\\\\n      false,\\\\\\\\n      null,\\\\\\\\n      '获取配置失败',\\\\\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n    ));\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/**\\\\\\\\n * 创建公开页面配置\\\\\\\\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\\nrouter.post('/', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    // 验证必填字段\\\\\\\\n    if (!name) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\\\\\n        field: 'name',\\\\\\\\n        message: '配置名称不能为空'\\\\\\\\n      }]));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 如果没有提供displayMode，使用默认值'role'\\\\\\\\n    const finalDisplayMode = displayMode || 'role';\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 验证显示模式\\\\\\\\n    if (finalDisplayMode &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; !['all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role'].includes(finalDisplayMode)) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\\\\\n        field: 'displayMode',\\\\\\\\n        message: '显示模式必须是all、workflow、custom或role之一'\\\\\\\\n      }]));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 验证workflow模式\\\\\\\\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; !workflowId) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\\\\\n        field: 'workflowId',\\\\\\\\n        message: '工作流模式下必须提供workflowId'\\\\\\\\n      }]));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 验证custom模式\\\\\\\\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; (!roleIds || !Array.isArray(roleIds) || roleIds.length === 0)) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\\\\\n        field: 'roleIds',\\\\\\\\n        message: '自定义模式下必须提供角色ID列表'\\\\\\\\n      }]));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 验证role模式（如果没有提供roleIds，使用空数组）\\\\\\\\n    // 注意：role模式允许空数组，表示显示所有角色\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\\\\\n      name,\\\\\\\\n      description,\\\\\\\\n      address,\\\\\\\\n      displayMode: finalDisplayMode,\\\\\\\\n      workflowId,\\\\\\\\n      roleIds: roleIds || (finalDisplayMode === 'role' ? [] : undefined),\\\\\\\\n      templateType,\\\\\\\\n      customHtml,\\\\\\\\n      isActive: req.body.isActive, // 支持创建时设置isActive\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    const newConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.create(createData);\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, newConfig, '创建配置成功'));\\\\\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n    console.error('创建配置失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\\\\\n      false,\\\\\\\\n      null,\\\\\\\\n      '创建配置失败',\\\\\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n    ));\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/**\\\\\\\\n * 更新公开页面配置\\\\\\\\n * PUT /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\\nrouter.put('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\\\\\\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\\\\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    await publicPageConfigModel.delete(id);\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, null, '删除配置成功'));\\\\\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n    console.error('删除配置失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\\\\\n      false,\\\\\\\\n      null,\\\\\\\\n      '删除配置失败',\\\\\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n    ));\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/**\\\\\\\\n * 预览配置（获取角色列表）\\\\\\\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/preview\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\\nrouter.get('/:id/preview', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\\\\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    if (!config) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\\\\\\\n      // 获取所有启用的角色\\\\\\\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\\\\\\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;amp;amp;gt; c.name === (nodeMapping[role.id]?.name || role.name)\\\\\\\\n        );\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        if (existing) {\\\\\\\\n          importResults.push({\\\\\\\\n            role,\\\\\\\\n            config: existing,\\\\\\\\n            status: 'exists'\\\\\\\\n          });\\\\\\\\n          continue;\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        // 创建新配置\\\\\\\\n        const nodeInfo = nodeMapping[role.id] || {\\\\\\\\n          name: role.name,\\\\\\\\n          description: &amp;amp;amp;#96;${role.description}公开页面&amp;amp;amp;#96;\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\\\\\n          name: nodeInfo.name,\\\\\\\\n          description: nodeInfo.description,\\\\\\\\n          displayMode: 'custom',\\\\\\\\n          roleIds: [role.id],\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        const newConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.create(createData);\\\\\\\\n        importResults.push({\\\\\\\\n          role,\\\\\\\\n          config: newConfig,\\\\\\\\n          status: 'created'\\\\\\\\n        });\\\\\\\\n      } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n        importResults.push({\\\\\\\\n          role,\\\\\\\\n          config: null,\\\\\\\\n          status: 'error',\\\\\\\\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n        });\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    const createdCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;amp;amp;gt; r.status === 'error').length;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, {\\\\\\\\n      results: importResults,\\\\\\\\n      summary: {\\\\\\\\n        total: independentPageRoles.length,\\\\\\\\n        created: createdCount,\\\\\\\\n        exists: existsCount,\\\\\\\\n        errors: errorCount\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n    }, &amp;amp;amp;#96;导入完成：创建${createdCount}个，已存在${existsCount}个，失败${errorCount}个&amp;amp;amp;#96;));\\\\\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n    console.error('导入独立页面配置失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\\\\\n      false,\\\\\\\\n      null,\\\\\\\\n      '导入独立页面配置失败',\\\\\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n    ));\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/**\\\\\\\\n * 根据地址获取配置\\\\\\\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/by-address/:address\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\\nrouter.get('/by-address/:address', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 创建公开页面配置\\\\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.post('/', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 验证必填字段\\\\n    if (!name) {\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\n        field: 'name',\\\\n        message: '配置名称不能为空'\\\\n      }]));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 如果没有提供displayMode，使用默认值'role'\\\\n    const finalDisplayMode = displayMode || 'role';\\\\n\\\\n    // 验证显示模式\\\\n    if (finalDisplayMode &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !['all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role'].includes(finalDisplayMode)) {\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\n        field: 'displayMode',\\\\n        message: '显示模式必须是all、workflow、custom或role之一'\\\\n      }]));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 验证workflow模式\\\\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !workflowId) {\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\n        field: 'workflowId',\\\\n        message: '工作流模式下必须提供workflowId'\\\\n      }]));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 验证custom模式\\\\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (!roleIds || !Array.isArray(roleIds) || roleIds.length === 0)) {\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\n        field: 'roleIds',\\\\n        message: '自定义模式下必须提供角色ID列表'\\\\n      }]));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 验证role模式（如果没有提供roleIds，使用空数组）\\\\n    // 注意：role模式允许空数组，表示显示所有角色\\\\n    \\\\n    const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\n      name,\\\\n      description,\\\\n      address,\\\\n      displayMode: finalDisplayMode,\\\\n      workflowId,\\\\n      roleIds: roleIds || (finalDisplayMode === 'role' ? [] : undefined),\\\\n      templateType,\\\\n      customHtml,\\\\n      isActive: req.body.isActive, // 支持创建时设置isActive\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    const newConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.create(createData);\\\\n    \\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, newConfig, '创建配置成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('创建配置失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '创建配置失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 更新公开页面配置\\\\n * PUT /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.put('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, isActive, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 验证显示模式\\\\n    if (displayMode &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !['all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role'].includes(displayMode)) {\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\n        field: 'displayMode',\\\\n        message: '显示模式必须是all、workflow、custom或role之一'\\\\n      }]));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\n      name,\\\\n      description,\\\\n      address,\\\\n      displayMode,\\\\n      workflowId,\\\\n      roleIds,\\\\n      isActive,\\\\n      templateType,\\\\n      customHtml,\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\\\\n    \\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '更新配置成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('更新配置失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '更新配置失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 删除公开页面配置\\\\n * DELETE /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.delete('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    await publicPageConfigModel.delete(id);\\\\n    \\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, null, '删除配置成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('删除配置失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '删除配置失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 预览配置（获取角色列表）\\\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/preview\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.get('/:id/preview', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\n    \\\\n    if (!config) {\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\\\n    \\\\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\\\n      // 获取所有启用的角色\\\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;amp;gt; r.enabled);\\\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.workflowId) {\\\\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\\\\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\\\\n      if (workflow) {\\\\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\\\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&amp;amp;gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\\\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\\\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;amp;gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; r.enabled);\\\\n      }\\\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      // 获取指定的角色\\\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; r.enabled);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, { roles, config }, '获取配置预览成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('获取配置预览失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '获取配置预览失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 导入独立页面配置\\\\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs/import-independent-pages\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.post('/import-independent-pages', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    // 获取所有独立页面角色\\\\n    const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\\\n    const independentPageRoles = allRoles.filter(\\\\n      r =&amp;amp;gt; r.source === 'independent-page' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; r.enabled\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    if (independentPageRoles.length === 0) {\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n        false,\\\\n        null,\\\\n        '未找到独立页面角色，请先初始化独立页面AI角色'\\\\n      ));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 定义节点映射\\\\n    const nodeMapping: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, { name: string; description: string }&amp;amp;gt; = {\\\\n      'independent-page-ai-search': {\\\\n        name: 'AI问答',\\\\n        description: '智能问答和搜索功能公开页面'\\\\n      },\\\\n      'independent-page-tech-package': {\\\\n        name: '技术包装',\\\\n        description: '技术内容包装工作流公开页面'\\\\n      },\\\\n      'independent-page-tech-strategy': {\\\\n        name: '技术策略',\\\\n        description: '技术策略生成工作流公开页面'\\\\n      },\\\\n      'independent-page-core-draft': {\\\\n        name: '技术通稿',\\\\n        description: '核心内容生成工作流公开页面'\\\\n      },\\\\n      'independent-page-speech': {\\\\n        name: '发布会演讲稿',\\\\n        description: '技术发布内容生成工作流公开页面'\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    const importResults: Array&amp;amp;lt;{ role: any; config: any; status: 'created' | 'exists' | 'error'; error?: string }&amp;amp;gt; = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 为每个独立页面角色创建公开页面配置\\\\n    for (const role of independentPageRoles) {\\\\n      try {\\\\n        // 检查是否已存在配置（通过名称匹配）\\\\n        const existingConfigs = await publicPageConfigModel.getAll();\\\\n        const existing = existingConfigs.find(\\\\n          c =&amp;amp;gt; c.name === (nodeMapping[role.id]?.name || role.name)\\\\n        );\\\\n\\\\n        if (existing) {\\\\n          importResults.push({\\\\n            role,\\\\n            config: existing,\\\\n            status: 'exists'\\\\n          });\\\\n          continue;\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // 创建新配置\\\\n        const nodeInfo = nodeMapping[role.id] || {\\\\n          name: role.name,\\\\n          description: &amp;amp;#96;${role.description}公开页面&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n        };\\\\n\\\\n        const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\n          name: nodeInfo.name,\\\\n          description: nodeInfo.description,\\\\n          displayMode: 'custom',\\\\n          roleIds: [role.id],\\\\n        };\\\\n\\\\n        const newConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.create(createData);\\\\n        importResults.push({\\\\n          role,\\\\n          config: newConfig,\\\\n          status: 'created'\\\\n        });\\\\n      } catch (error) {\\\\n        importResults.push({\\\\n          role,\\\\n          config: null,\\\\n          status: 'error',\\\\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const createdCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;amp;gt; r.status === 'created').length;\\\\n    const existsCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;amp;gt; r.status === 'exists').length;\\\\n    const errorCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;amp;gt; r.status === 'error').length;\\\\n\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, {\\\\n      results: importResults,\\\\n      summary: {\\\\n        total: independentPageRoles.length,\\\\n        created: createdCount,\\\\n        exists: existsCount,\\\\n        errors: errorCount\\\\n      }\\\\n    }, &amp;amp;#96;导入完成：创建${createdCount}个，已存在${existsCount}个，失败${errorCount}个&amp;amp;#96;));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('导入独立页面配置失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '导入独立页面配置失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 根据地址获取配置\\\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/by-address/:address\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.get('/by-address/:address', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const { address } = req.params;\\\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getByAddress(address);\\\\n    \\\\n    if (!config) {\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在或已禁用'));\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, config, '获取配置成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('获取配置失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '获取配置失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 切换配置启用状态\\\\n * PATCH /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/toggle\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.patch('/:id/toggle', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\n    const { isActive } = req.body;\\\\n\\\\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\n      isActive: typeof isActive === 'boolean' ? isActive : !existingConfig.isActive,\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\\\\n\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '切换状态成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('切换状态失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '切换状态失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\nexport default router;\\\\n\\\\n\\\",\""

{\\\\n      logger.info('Backend server 已启动', { url: &amp;amp;#96;http://0.0.0.0:${port}&amp;amp;#96; });\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    // 保持进程运行\\\\n    server.keepAliveTimeout = 0;\\\\n    server.headersTimeout = 0;\\\\n\\\\n    // 优雅关闭处理\\\\n    process.on('SIGTERM', () =&amp;amp;gt; updatedAt: Date;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nexport interface DirectAgentConfig {\\\\n  // LLM基础配置\\\\n  llm: {\\\\n    provider: &amp;amp;#39;openai&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;azure-openai&amp;amp;#39; | gpt-4, gpt-3.5-turbo, qwen-max等\\\\n    temperature: number;  // 0-2\\\\n    maxTokens: number;    // 最大生成token数\\\\n    topP?: number;        // 0-1\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // Prompt配置\\\\n  prompt: {\\\\n    systemPrompt: string;           // 系统提示词\\\\n    variables?: PromptVariable[];   // 动态变量\\\\n    templates?: PromptTemplate[];   // 预设模板\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 上下文管理策略\\\\n  contextStrategy: {\\\\n    type: &amp;amp;#39;window&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;summary&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;hybrid&amp;amp;#39;;  // 窗口/摘要/混合\\\\n    maxMessages: number;                     // 最大历史消息数\\\\n    maxTokens: number;                       // 最大上下文token数\\\\n    summaryThreshold?: number;               // 触发摘要的消息数阈值\\\\n    includeSystemPrompt: boolean;            // 关联的workflow ID\\\\n  };\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nexport interface ToolParameter {\\\\n  name: string;\\\\n  type: &amp;amp;#39;string&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;number&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;boolean&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;array&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;object&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n  description: string;\\\\n  required: boolean;\\\\n  enum?: string[];        // 枚举值\\\\n  default?: any;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// Agent调用配置\\\\nexport interface AgentCallConfig {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  targetAgentId?: string;      // 目标Agent ID\\\\n  targetWorkflowId?: string;   // 目标Workflow ID\\\\n  name: string;                // 调用名称\\\\n  description: string;         // 调用描述\\\\n  trigger: &amp;amp;#39;manual&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;auto&amp;amp;#39;;  // 手动/自动触发\\\\n 输出映射\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### Backend (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/models/AIRole.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n- 同步更新接口定义\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;dify_config&amp;amp;#96; 字段改为更通用的 &amp;amp;#96;config&amp;amp;#96; JSON存储\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## 2. 后端核心服务实现\\\\n\\\\n### 2.1 LLM Provider抽象层 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/llm/LLMProvider.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\n// 抽象接口\\\\nexport interface ILLMProvider {\\\\n  chat(messages: ChatMessage[], config: LLMConfig, tools?: Tool[]): Promise&amp;amp;lt;LLMResponse&amp;amp;gt;;\\\\n  testConnection(): Promise&amp;amp;lt;boolean&amp;amp;gt;;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// 统一消息格式\\\\nexport interface ChatMessage {\\\\n  role: &amp;amp;#39;system&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;user&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;assistant&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;tool&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n  content: string;\\\\n  name?: string;        // tool调用时的函数名\\\\n  tool_call_id?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// 统一响应格式\\\\nexport interface LLMResponse {\\\\n  content: string;\\\\n  toolCalls?: ToolCall[];  // Function calling结果\\\\n  usage: {\\\\n    promptTokens: number;\\\\n    completionTokens: number;\\\\n    totalTokens: number;\\\\n  };\\\\n  model: string;\\\\n  finishReason: &amp;amp;#39;stop&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;length&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;tool_calls&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;content_filter&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nexport interface ToolCall {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  type: &amp;amp;#39;function&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n  function: {\\\\n    name: string;\\\\n    arguments: string;  // JSON字符串\\\\n  };\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 2.2 具体Provider实现\\\\n\\\\n#### &amp;amp;#96;OpenAIProvider.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- 标准OpenAI API调用\\\\n- 支持Function Calling\\\\n- 错误处理和重试\\\\n\\\\n#### &amp;amp;#96;AzureOpenAIProvider.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- Azure特定的端点格式\\\\n- API版本管理\\\\n\\\\n#### &amp;amp;#96;CustomProvider.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- 通用OpenAI兼容端点\\\\n- 支持国产大模型（通义千问、文心一言等）\\\\n\\\\n### 2.3 上下文管理服务 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ContextManager.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport class ContextManager {\\\\n  // 获取上下文消息\\\\n  async getContextMessages(\\\\n    conversationId: string,\\\\n    strategy: ContextStrategy,\\\\n    currentQuery: string\\\\n  ): Promise&amp;amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const history = await ChatMessageService.getConversationMessages(conversationId);\\\\n    \\\\n    switch (strategy.type) {\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;window&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return this.applyWindowStrategy(history, strategy);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;summary&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.applySummaryStrategy(history, strategy);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;hybrid&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.applyHybridStrategy(history, strategy);\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 窗口策略：保留最近N条消息\\\\n  private applyWindowStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): ChatMessage[] {\\\\n    return history.slice(-strategy.maxMessages).map(toMessage);\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 摘要策略：旧消息压缩为摘要\\\\n  private async applySummaryStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): Promise&amp;amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (history.length &amp;amp;lt;= strategy.summaryThreshold!) {\\\\n      return history.map(toMessage);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    // 将旧消息发送给LLM生成摘要\\\\n    const oldMessages = history.slice(0, -strategy.maxMessages);\\\\n    const summary = await this.generateSummary(oldMessages);\\\\n    const recentMessages = history.slice(-strategy.maxMessages);\\\\n    \\\\n    return [\\\\n      { role: &amp;amp;#39;system&amp;amp;#39;, content: &amp;amp;#96;对话摘要：${summary}&amp;amp;#96; },\\\\n      ...recentMessages.map(toMessage)\\\\n    ];\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 混合策略：结合窗口和摘要\\\\n  private async applyHybridStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): Promise&amp;amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // Token计数 + 智能截断\\\\n    const messages = [];\\\\n    let tokenCount = 0;\\\\n    \\\\n    for (let i = history.length - 1; i &amp;amp;gt;= 0; i--) {\\\\n      const msg = history[i];\\\\n      const msgTokens = this.estimateTokens(msg.content);\\\\n      \\\\n      if (tokenCount + msgTokens &amp;amp;gt; strategy.maxTokens) {\\\\n        // 超过限制，对剩余消息生成摘要\\\\n        if (i &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n          const summary = await this.generateSummary(history.slice(0, i));\\\\n          messages.unshift({ role: &amp;amp;#39;system&amp;amp;#39;, content: &amp;amp;#96;历史摘要：${summary}&amp;amp;#96; });\\\\n        }\\\\n        break;\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      messages.unshift(toMessage(msg));\\\\n      tokenCount += msgTokens;\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    return messages;\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 生成摘要\\\\n  private async generateSummary(messages: any[]): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 调用LLM生成对话摘要\\\\n    // 使用简单的prompt：\\\\&amp;amp;quot;请总结以下对话的关键信息...\\\\&amp;amp;quot;\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // Token估算（简单实现：1 token ≈ 4 chars）\\\\n  private estimateTokens(text: string): number {\\\\n    return Math.ceil(text.length / 4);\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 2.4 Prompt管理服务 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/PromptManager.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport class PromptManager {\\\\n  // 渲染Prompt（替换变量）\\\\n  renderPrompt(\\\\n    template: string,\\\\n    variables: PromptVariable[],\\\\n    context: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, any&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n  ): string {\\\\n    let rendered = template;\\\\n    \\\\n    for (const variable of variables) {\\\\n      const value = this.resolveVariable(variable, context);\\\\n      rendered = rendered.replace(new RegExp(&amp;amp;#96;{{${variable.name}}}&amp;amp;#96;, &amp;amp;#39;g&amp;amp;#39;), value);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    return rendered;\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 解析变量值\\\\n  private resolveVariable(variable: PromptVariable, context: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, any&amp;amp;gt;): string {\\\\n    switch (variable.type) {\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;static&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return variable.value || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;dynamic&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return this.getNestedValue(context, variable.source || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;context&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return context[variable.name] || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n      default:\\\\n        return &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 获取嵌套属性值（如：user.profile.name）\\\\n  private getNestedValue(obj: any, path: string): string {\\\\n    return path.split(&amp;amp;#39;.&amp;amp;#39;).reduce((acc, part) =&amp;amp;gt; acc?.[part], obj) || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 2.5 工具执行服务 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ToolExecutor.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport class ToolExecutor {\\\\n  // 执行工具调用\\\\n  async executeTool(toolCall: ToolCall, toolConfig: ToolConfig): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const args = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments);\\\\n    \\\\n    switch (toolConfig.type) {\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;search&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.executeSearch(args);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;api&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.executeAPI(toolConfig, args);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;workflow&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.executeWorkflow(toolConfig.implementation!.workflowId!, args);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;calculation&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return this.executeCalculation(args);\\\\n      default:\\\\n        throw new Error(&amp;amp;#96;不支持的工具类型: ${toolConfig.type}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 搜索工具\\\\n  private async executeSearch(args: any): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 调用搜索API或知识库\\\\n    // 返回搜索结果\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // API调用工具\\\\n  private async executeAPI(config: ToolConfig, args: any): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const response = await axios({\\\\n      method: config.implementation!.method || &amp;amp;#39;POST&amp;amp;#39;,\\\\n      url: config.implementation!.endpoint!,\\\\n      headers: config.implementation!.headers,\\\\n      data: args\\\\n    });\\\\n    return JSON.stringify(response.data);\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // Workflow调用工具\\\\n  private async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, args: any): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const result = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(workflowId, args);\\\\n    return JSON.stringify(result);\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 计算工具\\\\n  private executeCalculation(args: any): string {\\\\n    // 安全的数学表达式计算\\\\n    // 使用沙箱环境执行\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 2.6 Agent编排服务 messages: ChatMessage[] = [\\\\n      { role: &amp;amp;#39;system&amp;amp;#39;, content: systemPrompt },\\\\n      ...contextMessages,\\\\n      { role: &amp;amp;#39;user&amp;amp;#39;, content: query }\\\\n    ];\\\\n    \\\\n    // 5. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\\\\n    const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 6. 调用LLM\\\\n    const provider = response.toolCalls.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      const toolResults = await this.executeTools(response.toolCalls, config.tools || []);\\\\n      \\\\n      // 将工具调用和结果添加到消息历史\\\\n      messages.push({ role: &amp;amp;#39;assistant&amp;amp;#39;, content: response.content || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39; });\\\\n      for (const result of toolResults) {\\\\n        messages.push({\\\\n          role: &amp;amp;#39;tool&amp;amp;#39;,\\\\n          content: result.content,\\\\n          name: result.toolName,\\\\n          tool_call_id: result.toolCallId\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 再次调用LLM处理工具结果\\\\n      response = await provider.chat(messages, config.llm, tools);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    // 8. 保存消息历史\\\\n    await this.saveMessages(conversationId, query, response, roleId);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 9. 返回结果\\\\n    return {\\\\n      content: response.content,\\\\n      usage: response.usage,\\\\n      conversationId\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // toolCall.function.name,\\\\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: &amp;amp;#39;工具不存在&amp;amp;#39; })\\\\n        });\\\\n        continue;\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      try {\\\\n        const result = await this.toolExecutor.executeTool(toolCall, config);\\\\n        results.push({\\\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\\\n          content: result\\\\n        });\\\\n      } catch (error) {\\\\n        results.push({\\\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\\\n          content: 支持国产大模型（通义千问、文心一言等）\\\\n\\\\n### 2.3 上下文管理服务 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ContextManager.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport class ContextManager {\\\\n  // 获取上下文消息\\\\n  async getContextMessages(\\\\n    conversationId: string,\\\\n    strategy: ContextStrategy,\\\\n    currentQuery: string\\\\n  ): Promise&amp;amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const history = await ChatMessageService.getConversationMessages(conversationId);\\\\n    \\\\n    switch (strategy.type) {\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;window&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return this.applyWindowStrategy(history, strategy);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;summary&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.applySummaryStrategy(history, strategy);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;hybrid&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.applyHybridStrategy(history, strategy);\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 窗口策略：保留最近N条消息\\\\n  private applyWindowStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): ChatMessage[] {\\\\n    return history.slice(-strategy.maxMessages).map(toMessage);\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 摘要策略：旧消息压缩为摘要\\\\n  private async applySummaryStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): Promise&amp;amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (history.length &amp;amp;lt;= strategy.summaryThreshold!) {\\\\n      return history.map(toMessage);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    // 将旧消息发送给LLM生成摘要\\\\n    const oldMessages = history.slice(0, -strategy.maxMessages);\\\\n    const summary = await this.generateSummary(oldMessages);\\\\n    const recentMessages = history.slice(-strategy.maxMessages);\\\\n    \\\\n    return [\\\\n      { role: &amp;amp;#39;system&amp;amp;#39;, content: &amp;amp;#96;对话摘要：${summary}&amp;amp;#96; },\\\\n      ...recentMessages.map(toMessage)\\\\n    ];\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 混合策略：结合窗口和摘要\\\\n  private async applyHybridStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): Promise&amp;amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // Token计数 + 智能截断\\\\n    const messages = [];\\\\n    let tokenCount = 0;\\\\n    \\\\n    for (let i = history.length - 1; i &amp;amp;gt;= 0; i--) {\\\\n      const msg = history[i];\\\\n      const msgTokens = this.estimateTokens(msg.content);\\\\n      \\\\n      if (tokenCount + msgTokens &amp;amp;gt; strategy.maxTokens) {\\\\n        // 超过限制，对剩余消息生成摘要\\\\n        if (i &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n          const summary = await this.generateSummary(history.slice(0, i));\\\\n          messages.unshift({ role: &amp;amp;#39;system&amp;amp;#39;, content: &amp;amp;#96;历史摘要：${summary}&amp;amp;#96; });\\\\n        }\\\\n        break;\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      messages.unshift(toMessage(msg));\\\\n      tokenCount += msgTokens;\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    return messages;\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 生成摘要\\\\n  private async generateSummary(messages: any[]): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 调用LLM生成对话摘要\\\\n    // 使用简单的prompt：\\\\&amp;amp;quot;请总结以下对话的关键信息...\\\\&amp;amp;quot;\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // Token估算（简单实现：1 token ≈ 4 chars）\\\\n  private estimateTokens(text: string): number {\\\\n    return Math.ceil(text.length / 4);\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 2.4 Prompt管理服务 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/PromptManager.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport class PromptManager {\\\\n  // 渲染Prompt（替换变量）\\\\n  renderPrompt(\\\\n    template: string,\\\\n    variables: PromptVariable[],\\\\n    context: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, any&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n  ): string {\\\\n    let rendered = template;\\\\n    \\\\n    for (const variable of variables) {\\\\n      const value = this.resolveVariable(variable, context);\\\\n      rendered = rendered.replace(new RegExp(&amp;amp;#96;{{${variable.name}}}&amp;amp;#96;, &amp;amp;#39;g&amp;amp;#39;), value);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    return rendered;\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 解析变量值\\\\n  private resolveVariable(variable: PromptVariable, context: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, any&amp;amp;gt;): string {\\\\n    switch (variable.type) {\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;static&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return variable.value || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;dynamic&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return this.getNestedValue(context, variable.source || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;context&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return context[variable.name] || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n      default:\\\\n        return &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 获取嵌套属性值（如：user.profile.name）\\\\n  private getNestedValue(obj: any, path: string): string {\\\\n    return path.split(&amp;amp;#39;.&amp;amp;#39;).reduce((acc, part) =&amp;amp;gt; acc?.[part], obj) || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 2.5 工具执行服务 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ToolExecutor.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport class ToolExecutor {\\\\n  // 执行工具调用\\\\n  async executeTool(toolCall: ToolCall, toolConfig: ToolConfig): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const args = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments);\\\\n    \\\\n    switch (toolConfig.type) {\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;search&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.executeSearch(args);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;api&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.executeAPI(toolConfig, args);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;workflow&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.executeWorkflow(toolConfig.implementation!.workflowId!, args);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;calculation&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return this.executeCalculation(args);\\\\n      default:\\\\n        throw new Error(&amp;amp;#96;不支持的工具类型: ${toolConfig.type}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 搜索工具\\\\n  private async executeSearch(args: any): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 调用搜索API或知识库\\\\n    // 返回搜索结果\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // API调用工具\\\\n  private async executeAPI(config: ToolConfig, args: any): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const response = await axios({\\\\n      method: config.implementation!.method || &amp;amp;#39;POST&amp;amp;#39;,\\\\n      url: config.implementation!.endpoint!,\\\\n      headers: config.implementation!.headers,\\\\n      data: args\\\\n    });\\\\n    return JSON.stringify(response.data);\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // Workflow调用工具\\\\n  private async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, args: any): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const result = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(workflowId, args);\\\\n    return JSON.stringify(result);\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 计算工具\\\\n  private executeCalculation(args: any): string {\\\\n    // 安全的数学表达式计算\\\\n    // 使用沙箱环境执行\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 2.6 Agent编排服务 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/AgentOrchestrator.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport class AgentOrchestrator {\\\\n  // 执行Agent（核心方法）\\\\n  async executeAgent(\\\\n    roleId: string,\\\\n    query: string,\\\\n    conversationId: string,\\\\n    context: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, any&amp;amp;gt; = {}\\\\n  ): Promise&amp;amp;lt;AgentExecutionResult&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 1. 获取Agent配置\\\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\\\\n    if (!role || !role.agentConfig) {\\\\n      throw new Error(&amp;amp;#39;Agent配置不存在&amp;amp;#39;);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 2. 渲染System Prompt\\\\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\\\\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\\\\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\\\\n      context\\\\n    );\\\\n    \\\\n    // 3. 获取上下文消息\\\\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\\\\n      conversationId,\\\\n      config.contextStrategy,\\\\n      query\\\\n    );\\\\n    \\\\n    // 4. 构建完整消息列表\\\\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [\\\\n      { role: &amp;amp;#39;system&amp;amp;#39;, content: systemPrompt },\\\\n      ...contextMessages,\\\\n      { role: &amp;amp;#39;user&amp;amp;#39;, content: query }\\\\n    ];\\\\n    \\\\n    // 5. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\\\\n    const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 6. 调用LLM\\\\n    const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\\\\n    let response = await provider.chat(messages, config.llm, tools);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 7. 处理工具调用（如果有）\\\\n    while (response.toolCalls &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.toolCalls.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      const toolResults = await this.executeTools(response.toolCalls, config.tools || []);\\\\n      \\\\n      // 将工具调用和结果添加到消息历史\\\\n      messages.push({ role: &amp;amp;#39;assistant&amp;amp;#39;, content: response.content || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39; });\\\\n      for (const result of toolResults) {\\\\n        messages.push({\\\\n          role: &amp;amp;#39;tool&amp;amp;#39;,\\\\n          content: result.content,\\\\n          name: result.toolName,\\\\n          tool_call_id: result.toolCallId\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 再次调用LLM处理工具结果\\\\n      response = await provider.chat(messages, config.llm, tools);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    // 8. 保存消息历史\\\\n    await this.saveMessages(conversationId, query, response, roleId);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 9. 返回结果\\\\n    return {\\\\n      content: response.content,\\\\n      usage: response.usage,\\\\n      conversationId\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 执行多个工具调用\\\\n  private async executeTools(toolCalls: ToolCall[], toolConfigs: ToolConfig[]) {\\\\n    const results = [];\\\\n    for (const toolCall of toolCalls) {\\\\n      const config = toolConfigs.find(t =&amp;amp;gt; t.name === toolCall.function.name);\\\\n      if (!config) {\\\\n        results.push({\\\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\\\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: &amp;amp;#39;工具不存在&amp;amp;#39; })\\\\n        });\\\\n        continue;\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      try {\\\\n        const result = await this.toolExecutor.executeTool(toolCall, config);\\\\n        results.push({\\\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\\\n          content: result\\\\n        });\\\\n      } catch (error) {\\\\n        results.push({\\\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\\\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: error.message })\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    }\\\\n    return results;\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## 3. &amp;amp;#96;backend/src/routes/aiRole.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n修改 &amp;amp;#96;POST /:id/chat&amp;amp;#96; 端点：\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nrouter.post(&amp;amp;#39;/:id/chat&amp;amp;#39;, async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const { id } = req.params;\\\\n  const { query, conversationId = &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;, context = {} } = req.body;\\\\n  \\\\n  const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(id);\\\\n  if (!role || !role.enabled) {\\\\n    return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, &amp;amp;#39;AI角色不存在或已禁用&amp;amp;#39;));\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  try {\\\\n    let result;\\\\n    \\\\n    if (role.provider === res.json(formatApiResponse(true, result, &amp;amp;#39;对话成功&amp;amp;#39;));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, &amp;amp;#39;对话失败&amp;amp;#39;, error.message));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## 5. 预设工具库\\\\n\\\\n### 内置工具实现\\\\n\\\\n#### 1. **搜索工具**                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import express from 'express';\\nimport { formatApiResponse, formatValidationErrorResponse } from '../utils/validation';\\nimport { publicPageConfigModel, agentWorkflowModel, aiRoleModel } from '../models';\\nimport { CreatePublicPageConfigDTO, UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO } from '../models/PublicPageConfig';\\n\\nconst router = express.Router();\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取所有公开页面配置\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs\\n */\\nrouter.get('/', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const configs = await publicPageConfigModel.getAll();\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, configs, '获取配置列表成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('获取配置列表失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '获取配置列表失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 预览配置（获取角色列表）\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/preview\\n * 注意：这个路由必须在 /:id 之前定义，因为 Express 按顺序匹配路由\\n */\\nrouter.get('/:id/preview', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\n    }\\n\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\n    \\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\n      // 获取所有启用的角色\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; r.enabled);\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.workflowId) {\\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\\n      if (workflow) {\\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&amp;gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n      }\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      // 获取指定的角色\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, { roles, config }, '获取配置预览成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('获取配置预览失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '获取配置预览失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 切换配置启用状态\\n * PATCH /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/toggle\\n * 注意：这个路由必须在 /:id 之前定义，因为 Express 按顺序匹配路由\\n */\\nrouter.patch('/:id/toggle', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    const { isActive } = req.body;\\n\\n    console.log(&amp;#96;[API] 切换配置状态请求: id=${id}, isActive=${isActive}, body=&amp;#96;, req.body);\\n\\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\n      console.log(&amp;#96;[API] 配置不存在: id=${id}&amp;#96;);\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\n    }\\n\\n    console.log(&amp;#96;[API] 当前配置状态: isActive=${existingConfig.isActive}&amp;#96;);\\n\\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\n      isActive: typeof isActive === 'boolean' ? isActive : !existingConfig.isActive,\\n    };\\n\\n    console.log(&amp;#96;[API] 更新数据: isActive=${updateData.isActive}&amp;#96;);\\n\\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\\n\\n    console.log(&amp;#96;[API] 配置状态已更新: id=${id}, isActive=${updatedConfig.isActive}&amp;#96;);\\n\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '切换状态成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('[API] 切换状态失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '切换状态失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取单个配置\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\n */\\nrouter.get('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, config, '获取配置成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('获取配置失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '获取配置失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ?                   "lineNumber": 26650,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class AgentWorkflowService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行工作流（异步）\\n   */\\n  async executeWorkflow(\\n    workflowId: string,\\n    options: any\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;{ executionId: string; message: string; data?: any }&amp;gt; {\\n    // 获取工作流定义\\n    const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(workflowId);\\n    if (!workflow) {\\n      throw new Error('工作流不存在');\\n    }\\n\\n    const startedAt = Date.now();\\n    // 创建执行实例\\n    const execution = await workflowExecutionModel.create({\\n      execution_type: 'agent_workflow',\\n      workflow_id: workflowId,\\n      workflow_name: workflow.name,\\n      status: 'running',\\n      shared_context: options.input || {},\\n      node_results: [],\\n      start_time: new Date().toISOString(),\\n    });\\n\\n    try {\\n      // 解析工作流节点和边\\n      const nodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\n      const edges = JSON.parse(workflow.edges || '[]');\\n\\n      logger.info('开始执行工作流', {\\n        workflowId,\\n        workflowName: workflow.name,\\n        nodesCount: nodes.length,\\n        edgesCount: edges.length,\\n        nodeTypes: nodes.map((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type),\\n        agentNodes: nodes.filter((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'agent').map((n: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n          id: n.id,\\n          agentId: n.agentId || n.data?.agentId,\\n          hasData: !!n.data,\\n        })),\\n        outputNodes: nodes.filter((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'output').map((n: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n          id: n.id,\\n          outputs: n.data?.outputs,\\n        })),\\n      });\\n\\n      // 检查是否有配置的Agent节点\\n      const hasConfiguredAgent = this.workflowHasConfiguredAgent(workflow);\\n      logger.info('检查Agent节点配置', {\\n        workflowId,\\n        hasConfiguredAgent,\\n      });\\n      \\n      if (!hasConfiguredAgent) {\\n        const fallbackOutput = this.buildFallbackOutput;\\n  }\\n}\","

AgentOrchestrator（Agent编排器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/AgentOrchestrator.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 执行Direct Agent类型的AI角色\\n- **调用方法**: &amp;#96;executeAgent(roleId, query, conversationId, context)&amp;#96;\\n- **特点**: \\n  - 支持工具调用（Function Calling）\\n  - 支持多轮对话\\n  - 支持上下文管理\\n  - 支持Prompt变量替换\\n- **使用场景**: Direct Agent类型的AI角色对话\\n\\n### 2. AgentWorkflowService（Agent工作流服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;executeRole(roleId, input)&amp;#96; - 直接执行AI角色\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\n  - 根据provider类型选择不同的执行方式\\n  \\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;executeWorkflow(workflowId, options)&amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\n  - 支持拓扑排序执行节点\\n  - 支持并行执行同一层节点\\n  \\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;executeAgentNode(node, sharedContext)&amp;#96; - 执行工作流中的Agent节点\\n  - 支持Dify Chatflow模式\\n  - 支持Dify Workflow模式\\n  - 支持多轮对话（conversationId传递）\\n\\n### 3. DifyClient（Dify客户端）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/DifyClient.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, conversationId)&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;techPackage(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术包装\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术策略\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;#96;techArticle(inputs)&amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs)&amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;#96;techPublish(inputs, conversationId)&amp;#96; - 技术发布\\n- **调用节点7**: &amp;#96;callApp(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;#96; - 通用应用调用\\n- **调用节点8**: &amp;#96;runWorkflow(appType, inputs, responseMode, user)&amp;#96; - 工作流调用\\n\\n### 4. TriggerAgentUseCase（触发Agent用例）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/application/useCases/TriggerAgent.usecase.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 触发子Agent执行（五看、三定、技术矩阵等）\\n- **调用方式**: \\n  - 通过&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeRole()&amp;#96;直接调用AI角色\\n  - 通过&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;调用工作流\\n- **支持的功能类型**:\\n  - &amp;#96;five-view-analysis&amp;#96; - 技术转译（五看）\\n  - &amp;#96;three-fix-analysis&amp;#96; - 用户场景挖掘（三定）\\n  - &amp;#96;tech-matrix&amp;#96; - 技术矩阵\\n  - &amp;#96;propagation-strategy&amp;#96; - 传播策略\\n  - &amp;#96;exhibition-video&amp;#96; - 展具与视频\\n  - &amp;#96;translation&amp;#96; - 翻译\\n  - &amp;#96;ppt-outline&amp;#96; - 技术讲稿\\n  - &amp;#96;script&amp;#96; - 脚本\\n\\n### 5. ToolExecutor（工具执行器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ToolExecutor.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;executeTool(toolCall, toolConfig)&amp;#96; - 执行工具调用\\n- **支持的工具类型**:\\n  - &amp;#96;search&amp;#96; - 搜索工具\\n  - &amp;#96;calculation&amp;#96; - 计算工具\\n  - &amp;#96;time&amp;#96; - 时间工具\\n  - &amp;#96;api&amp;#96; - API调用工具\\n  - &amp;#96;workflow&amp;#96; - 工作流调用工具\\n  - &amp;#96;agent&amp;#96; - Agent调用工具（嵌套Agent调用）\\n\\n## 二、前端服务层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. workflowAPI（工作流API）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/api.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点1**: &amp;#96;aiSearch(query, inputs, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n- **调用节点2**: &amp;#96;smartSearch(query, difyConfig, conversationId)&amp;#96; - 智能搜索\\n- **调用节点3**: &amp;#96;techPackage(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术包装\\n- **调用节点4**: &amp;#96;techStrategy(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术策略\\n- **调用节点5**: &amp;#96;techArticle(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 技术通稿\\n- **调用节点6**: &amp;#96;coreDraft(inputs, difyConfig)&amp;#96; - 核心稿件\\n\\n### 2. aiRoleService（AI角色服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiRoleService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;chatWithRole(roleId, query, inputs)&amp;#96; - 与AI角色对话\\n  - 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\\n  - 自动根据角色配置选择调用方式\\n\\n### 3. aiSearchService（AI搜索服务）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/aiSearchService.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;triggerFeatureAgent(conversationId, payload)&amp;#96; - 触发功能Agent\\n  - 用于触发子Agent（五看、三定等）\\n  - 支持上下文窗口大小配置\\n\\n### 4. WorkflowEngine（工作流引擎）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/services/workflowEngine.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;callAgent(agent, input)&amp;#96; - 调用Agent\\n  - 通过&amp;#96;aiRoleService.chatWithRole()&amp;#96;调用\\n  - 用于前端工作流执行\\n\\n## 三、前端页面/组件层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. BaseAISearchPage（基础AI搜索页面）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/ai-search/BaseAISearchPage.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleTriggerFeature(featureType)&amp;#96; - 触发功能Agent\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;aiSearchService.triggerFeatureAgent()&amp;#96;\\n  - 支持的功能类型：五看、三定、技术矩阵、传播策略等\\n\\n### 2. AiSearchComponent（AI搜索组件）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/AiSearchComponent.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **调用节点**: &amp;#96;handleAiSearch()&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 5. 独立节点组件\\n以下节点组件都包含AI调用：\\n\\n#### AiSearchNode（AI搜索节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/AiSearchNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.aiSearch()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### TechPackageNode（技术包装节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/TechPackageNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.techPackage()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### CoreDraftNode（核心稿件节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/CoreDraftNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.coreDraft()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### PromotionStrategyNode（推广策略节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/PromotionStrategyNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用&amp;#96;workflowAPI.techStrategy()&amp;#96;\\n\\n#### PressReleaseNode（新闻稿节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/PressReleaseNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用相关AI服务\\n\\n#### TechNewsletterNode（技术通讯节点）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/nodes/TechNewsletterNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- 调用相关AI服务\\n\\n## 四、后端API路由层调用节点\\n\\n### 1. AI角色路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/aiRole.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat&amp;#96;\\n  - 根据provider类型调用：\\n    - Direct Agent: &amp;#96;AgentOrchestrator.executeAgent()&amp;#96;\\n    - Dify: &amp;#96;DifyGateway.executeChat()&amp;#96; 或 &amp;#96;DifyGateway.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 2. AI搜索路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由1**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages&amp;#96; - 发送消息\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;SendMessageUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n  \\n- **路由2**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/agents&amp;#96; - 触发子Agent\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;TriggerAgentUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 3. 工作流路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/routes/agentWorkflow.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由1**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute&amp;#96; - 执行工作流\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()&amp;#96;\\n  \\n- **路由2**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/roles/:id/execute&amp;#96; - 执行AI角色\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;agentWorkflowService.executeRole()&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 4. 工作流API路由\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;backend/src/modules/workflow/api/workflow.routes.ts&amp;#96;\\n- **路由**: &amp;#96;POST /api/v1/workflow/ai-search&amp;#96; - AI搜索\\n  - 调用&amp;#96;ExecuteAiSearchUseCase.execute()&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 五、工作流节点类型\\n\\n### 1. Agent节点（工作流编辑器）\\n**位置**: &amp;#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/AgentNode.tsx&amp;#96;\\n- **类型**: &amp;#96;agent&amp;#96;\\n- **功能**: 在工作流中调用AI角色\\n- **执行**: 通过后端&amp;#96;AgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()&amp;#96;执行\\n\\n### 2. 其他工作流节点类型\\n- &amp;#96;input&amp;#96; - 输入节点\\n- &amp;#96;output&amp;#96; - 输出节点\\n- &amp;#96;condition&amp;#96; - 条件判断节点\\n- &amp;#96;assign&amp;#96; - 变量赋值节点\\n- &amp;#96;merge&amp;#96; - 数据合并节点\\n- &amp;#96;transform&amp;#96; - 数据转换节点\\n- &amp;#96;memory&amp;#96; - 文本记忆节点\\n\\n## 六、调用链路总结\\n\\n### 链路1: 前端页面 → 前端服务 → 后端API → 后端服务 → Dify/LLM\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n前端页面组件\\n  ↓\\n前端服务层 (workflowAPI/aiRoleService/aiSearchService)\\n  ↓\\n后端API路由层\\n  ↓\\n后端服务层 (AgentWorkflowService/DifyClient/AgentOrchestrator)\\n  ↓\\nDify Gateway / LLM Provider\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 链路2: 工作流执行 → Agent节点 → AI角色\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n工作流执行\\n  ↓\\nAgent节点\\n  ↓\\nAgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()\\n  ↓\\nAI角色配置 (Dify/Direct Agent)\\n  ↓\\nDify Gateway / AgentOrchestrator\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### 链路3: 工具调用 → Agent嵌套调用\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\nLLM工具调用\\n  ↓\\nToolExecutor.executeTool()\\n  ↓\\nAgent工具类型\\n  ↓\\nAgentOrchestrator.executeAgent() (嵌套调用)\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## 七、AI/Agent调用节点统计\\n\\n### 后端调用节点（共15个）\\n1. AgentOrchestrator.executeAgent()\\n2. AgentWorkflowService.executeRole()\\n3. AgentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow()\\n4. AgentWorkflowService.executeAgentNode()\\n5. DifyClient.aiSearch()\\n6. DifyClient.techPackage()\\n7. DifyClient.techStrategy()\\n8. DifyClient.techArticle()\\n9. DifyClient.coreDraft()\\n10. DifyClient.techPublish()\\n11. DifyClient.callApp()\\n12. DifyClient.runWorkflow()\\n13. TriggerAgentUseCase.execute()\\n14. ToolExecutor.executeTool() (agent类型)\\n15. SendMessageUseCase.execute()\\n\\n### 前端调用节点（共10个）\\n1. workflowAPI.aiSearch()\\n2. workflowAPI.smartSearch()\\n3. workflowAPI.techPackage()\\n4. workflowAPI.techStrategy()\\n5. workflowAPI.techArticle()\\n6. workflowAPI.coreDraft()\\n7. aiRoleService.chatWithRole()\\n8. aiSearchService.triggerFeatureAgent()\\n9. WorkflowEngine.callAgent()\\n10. 各节点组件的AI调用方法\\n\\n### 页面/组件调用节点（共8个）\\n1. BaseAISearchPage.handleTriggerFeature()\\n2. AIChatPage.handleSendMessage()\\n3. ProjectResourcesPage.handleAISendMessage()\\n4. AiSearchComponent.handleAiSearch()\\n5. AiSearchNode的AI调用\\n6. TechPackageNode的AI调用\\n7. CoreDraftNode的AI调用\\n8. PromotionStrategyNode的AI调用\\n\\n### API路由调用节点（共4个）\\n1. POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat\\n2. POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages\\n3. POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/agents\\n4. POST /api/v1/agent-workflows/:id/execute\\n\\n## 八、关键特性\\n\\n1. **多Provider支持**: 支持Dify和Direct Agent两种类型\\n2. **多轮对话**: 支持conversationId传递，实现多轮对话\\n3. **工具调用**: 支持Function Calling，包括嵌套Agent调用\\n4. **工作流编排**: 支持复杂的工作流编排，Agent节点可嵌入工作流\\n5. **上下文管理**: 支持多种上下文管理策略（窗口、摘要等）\\n6. **字段映射**: 支持输入输出字段映射配置\\n7. **超时控制**: 支持执行超时控制\\n8. **错误重试**: 支持错误重试机制\\n\\n## 九、总结\\n\\n本项目共有**37个**主要的AI/Agent调用节点，分布在：\\n- 后端服务层：15个\\n- 前端服务层：10个\\n- 页面/组件层：8个\\n- API路由层：4个\\n\\n这些调用节点形成了一个完整的AI/Agent调用体系，支持多种使用场景和调用方式。\\n\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const AIRoleManagementPage: React.FC = \\n\\n\\n  // 加载角色列表\\n  const loadRoles = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setLoading(true);\\n    try {\\n      const roleList = await aiRoleService.getAIRoles();\\n      // 去重：基于ID去除重复的角色\\n      const uniqueRoles = Array.from(\\n        new Map(roleList.map(role =&amp;gt;
