                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import express from 'express';\\nimport dotenv from 'dotenv';\\nimport cors from 'cors';\\nimport path from 'path';\\nimport apiRoutes from './routes';\\nimport difyProxyRoutes from './routes/dify-proxy';\\nimport { testConnection } from './config/database';\\nimport { publicPageConfigModel, aiRoleModel } from './models';\\nimport { logger } from './shared/lib/logger';\\nimport { errorTracking } from './shared/infrastructure/monitoring/errorTracking';\\nimport { SourceInformationService } from './services/sourceInformationService';\\n\\n// 导入监控模块\\nimport { performanceMonitor as _performanceMonitor } from './shared/infrastructure/monitoring/performanceMonitor';\\nimport { prometheusMetrics as _prometheusMetrics } from './shared/infrastructure/monitoring/prometheusMetrics';\\n\\n// 确保模块正确加载\\nconst performanceMonitor = _performanceMonitor || null;\\nconst prometheusMetrics = _prometheusMetrics || null;\\n\\ndotenv.config();\\n\\nconst app = express();\\nconst port = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3003;\\n\\n// 初始化错误追踪\\nerrorTracking.init();\\n\\n// 中间件\\napp.use(cors());\\napp.use(express.json());\\n\\n// 性能监控中间件（放在最前面）\\nif (performanceMonitor &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof performanceMonitor.middleware === 'function') {\\n  app.use(performanceMonitor.middleware());\\n} else {\\n  logger.warn('性能监控中间件未正确加载，跳过');\\n}\\n\\n// Prometheus 指标中间件（放在性能监控之后）\\nif (prometheusMetrics &amp;amp;&amp;amp; typeof prometheusMetrics.middleware === 'function') {\\n  app.use(prometheusMetrics.middleware());\\n} else {\\n  logger.warn('Prometheus 指标中间件未正确加载，跳过');\\n}\\n\\n// 添加请求日志中间件（放在最前面，但要在路由之前）\\napp.use((req, res, next) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();\\n  logger.info('收到请求', {\\n    timestamp,\\n    method: req.method,\\n    url: req.url,\\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\\n    ip: req.ip || req.connection.remoteAddress,\\n    userAgent: req.get('User-Agent'),\\n    body: req.body,\\n    authorization: req.get('Authorization')?.substring(0, 20),\\n    contentType: req.get('Content-Type'),\\n  });\\n  next();\\n});\\n\\n// API 路由必须放在静态文件服务之前\\n// 路由配置（API 保持 /api/v1 前缀）\\napp.use('/api/v1', apiRoutes);\\n\\n// Dify API 代理路由\\napp.use('/api/dify', difyProxyRoutes);\\n\\n// 公开访问接口（通过token获取配置和角色）\\napp.get('/api/v1/public/:token', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { token } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getByAccessToken(token);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: '配置不存在或已禁用', data: null });\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取角色列表\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\n    \\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; r.enabled);\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.workflowId) {\\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\\n      if (workflow) {\\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&amp;gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n      }\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json({ success: true, message: '获取公开配置成功', data: { config, roles } });\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('获取公开配置失败', { error });\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\\n      context: { metadata: { token: req.params.token } },\\n    });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: '获取公开配置失败',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\\n      data: null\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 公开访问接口（通过address获取配置和角色）\\napp.get('/api/v1/public-by-address/:address', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { address } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getByAddress(address);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: '配置不存在或已禁用', data: null });\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取角色列表\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\n    \\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; r.enabled);\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.workflowId) {\\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\\n      if (workflow) {\\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&amp;gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n      }\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'role' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json({ success: true, message: '获取公开配置成功', data: { config, roles } });\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('获取公开配置失败', { error });\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\\n      context: { metadata: { address: req.params.address } },\\n    });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: '获取公开配置失败',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\\n      data: null\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 公开访问接口（通过configId获取配置和角色）\\napp.get('/api/v1/public-config/:configId', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { configId } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(configId);\\n    \\n    if (!config || !config.isActive) {\\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: '配置不存在或已禁用', data: null });\\n    }\\n\\n    // 获取角色列表\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\n    \\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; r.enabled);\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.workflowId) {\\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\\n      if (workflow) {\\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&amp;gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n      }\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;&amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;&amp;amp; r.enabled);\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json({ success: true, message: '获取公开配置成功', data: { config, roles } });\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    logger.error('获取公开配置失败', { error });\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\\n      context: { metadata: { configId: req.params.configId } },\\n    });\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      message: '获取公开配置失败',\\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误',\\n      data: null\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// API 健康检查\\napp.get('/api/health', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  res.json({ \\n    message: 'Todify3 Backend API',\\n    version: '1.0.0',\\n    status: 'running',\\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n    uptime: process.uptime(),\\n  });\\n});\\n\\n// 性能监控 API\\napp.get('/api/v1/monitoring/performance', (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const stats = performanceMonitor.getStats();\\n    res.json({\\n      success: true,\\n      data: stats,\\n    });\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)));\\n    res.status(500).json({\\n      success: false,\\n      error: {\\n        code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',\\n        message: '获取性能统计失败',\\n      },\\n    });\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// Prometheus 指标端点\\napp.get('/metrics', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    res.set('Content-Type', 'text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8');\\n    const metrics = await prometheusMetrics.getMetrics();\\n    res.send(metrics);\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)));\\n    res.status(500).send('# Error generating metrics\\\\n');\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n// 公共知识库文件服务\\nconst publicKnowledgeUploadDir = path.join(__dirname, '../uploads/public-knowledge');\\napp.use('/api/v1/public-knowledge/files', express.static(publicKnowledgeUploadDir, {\\n  maxAge: 86400000, // 1 day\\n  etag: true,\\n  lastModified: true,\\n}));\\n\\n// 生产环境静态文件服务：直接从 frontend/dist 提供资源\\n// 注意：必须在 API 路由之后，否则会拦截 API 请求\\n// 仅在非开发环境或明确需要时才启用静态文件服务\\nconst isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';\\nif (!isDev) {\\n  const distDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../frontend/dist');\\n  app.use(express.static(distDir, {\\n    maxAge: 0,\\n    etag: true,\\n    lastModified: true,\\n  }));\\n\\n  // SPA Fallback：除 /api/* 外的所有路由都返回 index.html\\n  app.get(/^(\\\\/(?!api).*)$/, (_req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n    res.sendFile(path.join(distDir, 'index.html'));\\n  });\\n}\\n\\n// 全局错误处理中间件\\napp.use((err: any, req: any, res: any, next: any) =&amp;gt; {\\n    errorTracking.captureException(err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)), {\\n      context: {\\n        metadata: {\\n          method: req.method,\\n          path: req.path,\\n          body: req.body,\\n        },\\n      },\\n    });\\n\\n  logger.error('全局错误处理', {\\n    error: err,\\n    stack: err?.stack,\\n    requestUrl: req.url,\\n    method: req.method,\\n    body: req.body,\\n  });\\n  \\n  res.status(500).json({\\n    success: false,\\n    message: 'Internal server error',\\n    error: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? '服务器内部错误' : (err.message || 'Unknown error')\\n  });\\n});\\n\\n// 启动服务器前测试数据库连接\\nasync function startServer() {\\n  try {\\n    logger.info('正在测试数据库连接...');\\n    const isConnected = await testConnection();\\n    if (!isConnected) {\\n      throw new Error('数据库连接失败');\\n    }\\n    logger.info('数据库连接成功');\\n    \\n    // 初始化AI角色数据库表\\n    try {\\n      const { aiRoleModel } = await import('./models');\\n      await aiRoleModel.initializeTable();\\n      logger.info('AI角色数据库表初始化成功');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.warn('AI角色数据库表初始化警告', { error });\\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 初始化Agent工作流数据库表\\n    try {\\n      const { agentWorkflowModel } = await import('./models');\\n      await agentWorkflowModel.initializeTable();\\n      logger.info('Agent工作流数据库表初始化成功');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.warn('Agent工作流数据库表初始化警告', { error });\\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 初始化公开页面配置数据库表\\n    try {\\n      const { publicPageConfigModel } = await import('./models');\\n      await publicPageConfigModel.initializeTable();\\n      logger.info('公开页面配置数据库表初始化成功');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.warn('公开页面配置数据库表初始化警告', { error });\\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 初始化来源信息数据库表\\n    try {\\n      const sourceInformationService = new SourceInformationService();\\n      await sourceInformationService.initializeTable();\\n      logger.info('来源信息数据库表初始化成功');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.warn('来源信息数据库表初始化警告', { error });\\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 初始化公共知识库数据库表\\n    try {\\n      const { publicKnowledgeModel } = await import('./models');\\n      await publicKnowledgeModel.initializeTable();\\n      logger.info('公共知识库数据库表初始化成功');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      logger.warn('公共知识库数据库表初始化警告', { error });\\n      // 不阻止服务器启动，表会在首次使用时自动创建\\n    }\\n    \\n    const server = app.listen(port, \\\"0.0.0.0\\\", () =&amp;gt; {\\n      logger.info('Backend server 已启动', { url: &amp;#96;http://0.0.0.0:${port}&amp;#96; });\\n    });\\n\\n    // 保持进程运行\\n    server.keepAliveTimeout = 0;\\n    server.headersTimeout = 0;\\n\\n    // 优雅关闭处理\\n    process.on('SIGTERM', () =&amp;gt; {\\n      logger.info('SIGTERM received, shutting down gracefully');\\n      server.close(() =&amp;gt; {\\n        logger.info('Process terminated');\\n        process.exit(0);\\n      });\\n    });\\n\\n    process.on('SIGINT', () =&amp;gt; {\\n      logger.info('SIGINT received, shutting down gracefully');\\n      server.close(() =&amp;gt; {\\n        logger.info('Process terminated');\\n        process.exit(0);\\n      });\\n    });\\n\\n    return server;\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    errorTracking.captureException(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)), {\\n      level: 'fatal',\\n    });\\n    logger.error('Failed to start server', { error });\\n    process.exit(1);\\n  }\\n}\\n\\nstartServer();\","

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"                  \\\"content\\\": \\\"  \\\\\\\"contents\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"import express from 'express';\\\\\\\\nimport { formatApiResponse, formatValidationErrorResponse } from '../utils/validation';\\\\\\\\nimport { publicPageConfigModel, agentWorkflowModel, aiRoleModel } from '../models';\\\\\\\\nimport { CreatePublicPageConfigDTO, UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO } from '../models/PublicPageConfig';\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nconst router = express.Router();\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/**\\\\\\\\n * 获取所有公开页面配置\\\\\\\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\\nrouter.get('/', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\\\\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    if (!config) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, config, '获取配置成功'));\\\\\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n    console.error('获取配置失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\\\\\n      false,\\\\\\\\n      null,\\\\\\\\n      '获取配置失败',\\\\\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n    ));\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/**\\\\\\\\n * 创建公开页面配置\\\\\\\\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\\nrouter.post('/', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    // 验证必填字段\\\\\\\\n    if (!name) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\\\\\n        field: 'name',\\\\\\\\n        message: '配置名称不能为空'\\\\\\\\n      }]));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 如果没有提供displayMode，使用默认值'role'\\\\\\\\n    const finalDisplayMode = displayMode || 'role';\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 验证显示模式\\\\\\\\n    if (finalDisplayMode &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; !['all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role'].includes(finalDisplayMode)) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\\\\\n        field: 'displayMode',\\\\\\\\n        message: '显示模式必须是all、workflow、custom或role之一'\\\\\\\\n      }]));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 验证workflow模式\\\\\\\\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; !workflowId) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\\\\\n        field: 'workflowId',\\\\\\\\n        message: '工作流模式下必须提供workflowId'\\\\\\\\n      }]));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 验证custom模式\\\\\\\\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; (!roleIds || !Array.isArray(roleIds) || roleIds.length === 0)) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\\\\\n        field: 'roleIds',\\\\\\\\n        message: '自定义模式下必须提供角色ID列表'\\\\\\\\n      }]));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 验证role模式（如果没有提供roleIds，使用空数组）\\\\\\\\n    // 注意：role模式允许空数组，表示显示所有角色\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\\\\\n      name,\\\\\\\\n      description,\\\\\\\\n      address,\\\\\\\\n      displayMode: finalDisplayMode,\\\\\\\\n      workflowId,\\\\\\\\n      roleIds: roleIds || (finalDisplayMode === 'role' ? [] : undefined),\\\\\\\\n      templateType,\\\\\\\\n      customHtml,\\\\\\\\n      isActive: req.body.isActive, // 支持创建时设置isActive\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    const newConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.create(createData);\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, newConfig, '创建配置成功'));\\\\\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n    console.error('创建配置失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\\\\\n      false,\\\\\\\\n      null,\\\\\\\\n      '创建配置失败',\\\\\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n    ));\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/**\\\\\\\\n * 更新公开页面配置\\\\\\\\n * PUT /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\\nrouter.put('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\\\\\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, isActive, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\\\\\\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\\\\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 验证显示模式\\\\\\\\n    if (displayMode &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; !['all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role'].includes(displayMode)) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\\\\\n        field: 'displayMode',\\\\\\\\n        message: '显示模式必须是all、workflow、custom或role之一'\\\\\\\\n      }]));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\\\\\n      name,\\\\\\\\n      description,\\\\\\\\n      address,\\\\\\\\n      displayMode,\\\\\\\\n      workflowId,\\\\\\\\n      roleIds,\\\\\\\\n      isActive,\\\\\\\\n      templateType,\\\\\\\\n      customHtml,\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '更新配置成功'));\\\\\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n    console.error('更新配置失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\\\\\n      false,\\\\\\\\n      null,\\\\\\\\n      '更新配置失败',\\\\\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n    ));\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/**\\\\\\\\n * 删除公开页面配置\\\\\\\\n * DELETE /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\\nrouter.delete('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\\\\\\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\\\\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    await publicPageConfigModel.delete(id);\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, null, '删除配置成功'));\\\\\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n    console.error('删除配置失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\\\\\n      false,\\\\\\\\n      null,\\\\\\\\n      '删除配置失败',\\\\\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n    ));\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/**\\\\\\\\n * 预览配置（获取角色列表）\\\\\\\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/preview\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\\nrouter.get('/:id/preview', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\\\\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    if (!config) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\\\\\\\n      // 获取所有启用的角色\\\\\\\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\\\\\\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;amp;amp;gt; r.enabled);\\\\\\\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; config.workflowId) {\\\\\\\\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\\\\\\\\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\\\\\\\\n      if (workflow) {\\\\\\\\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\\\\\\\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; r.enabled);\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\\\\\n      // 获取指定的角色\\\\\\\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\\\\\\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;amp;amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; r.enabled);\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, { roles, config }, '获取配置预览成功'));\\\\\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n    console.error('获取配置预览失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\\\\\n      false,\\\\\\\\n      null,\\\\\\\\n      '获取配置预览失败',\\\\\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n    ));\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/**\\\\\\\\n * 导入独立页面配置\\\\\\\\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs/import-independent-pages\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\\nrouter.post('/import-independent-pages', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    // 获取所有独立页面角色\\\\\\\\n    const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\\\\\\\n    const independentPageRoles = allRoles.filter(\\\\\\\\n      r =&amp;amp;amp;gt; r.source === 'independent-page' &amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp; r.enabled\\\\\\\\n    );\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if (independentPageRoles.length === 0) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\\\\\n        false,\\\\\\\\n        null,\\\\\\\\n        '未找到独立页面角色，请先初始化独立页面AI角色'\\\\\\\\n      ));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 定义节点映射\\\\\\\\n    const nodeMapping: Record&amp;amp;amp;lt;string, { name: string; description: string }&amp;amp;amp;gt; = {\\\\\\\\n      'independent-page-ai-search': {\\\\\\\\n        name: 'AI问答',\\\\\\\\n        description: '智能问答和搜索功能公开页面'\\\\\\\\n      },\\\\\\\\n      'independent-page-tech-package': {\\\\\\\\n        name: '技术包装',\\\\\\\\n        description: '技术内容包装工作流公开页面'\\\\\\\\n      },\\\\\\\\n      'independent-page-tech-strategy': {\\\\\\\\n        name: '技术策略',\\\\\\\\n        description: '技术策略生成工作流公开页面'\\\\\\\\n      },\\\\\\\\n      'independent-page-core-draft': {\\\\\\\\n        name: '技术通稿',\\\\\\\\n        description: '核心内容生成工作流公开页面'\\\\\\\\n      },\\\\\\\\n      'independent-page-speech': {\\\\\\\\n        name: '发布会演讲稿',\\\\\\\\n        description: '技术发布内容生成工作流公开页面'\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    const importResults: Array&amp;amp;amp;lt;{ role: any; c.name === (nodeMapping[role.id]?.name || role.name)\\\\\\\\n        );\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        if (existing) {\\\\\\\\n          importResults.push({\\\\\\\\n            role,\\\\\\\\n            config: existing,\\\\\\\\n            status: 'exists'\\\\\\\\n          });\\\\\\\\n          continue;\\\\\\\\n        }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        // 创建新配置\\\\\\\\n        const nodeInfo = nodeMapping[role.id] || {\\\\\\\\n          name: role.name,\\\\\\\\n          description: &amp;amp;amp;#96;${role.description}公开页面&amp;amp;amp;#96;\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\\\\\n          name: nodeInfo.name,\\\\\\\\n          description: nodeInfo.description,\\\\\\\\n          displayMode: 'custom',\\\\\\\\n          roleIds: [role.id],\\\\\\\\n        };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n        const newConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.create(createData);\\\\\\\\n        importResults.push({\\\\\\\\n          role,\\\\\\\\n          config: newConfig,\\\\\\\\n          status: 'created'\\\\\\\\n        });\\\\\\\\n      } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n        importResults.push({\\\\\\\\n          role,\\\\\\\\n          config: null,\\\\\\\\n          status: 'error',\\\\\\\\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n        });\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    const createdCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;amp;amp;gt; r.status === 'created').length;\\\\\\\\n    const existsCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;amp;amp;gt; r.status === 'exists').length;\\\\\\\\n    const errorCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;amp;amp;gt; r.status === 'error').length;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, {\\\\\\\\n      results: importResults,\\\\\\\\n      summary: {\\\\\\\\n        total: independentPageRoles.length,\\\\\\\\n        created: createdCount,\\\\\\\\n        exists: existsCount,\\\\\\\\n        errors: errorCount\\\\\\\\n      }\\\\\\\\n    }, &amp;amp;amp;#96;导入完成：创建${createdCount}个，已存在${existsCount}个，失败${errorCount}个&amp;amp;amp;#96;));\\\\\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n    console.error('导入独立页面配置失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\\\\\n      false,\\\\\\\\n      null,\\\\\\\\n      '导入独立页面配置失败',\\\\\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n    ));\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/**\\\\\\\\n * 根据地址获取配置\\\\\\\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/by-address/:address\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\\nrouter.get('/by-address/:address', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    const { address } = req.params;\\\\\\\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getByAddress(address);\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    if (!config) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在或已禁用'));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n    \\\\\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, config, '获取配置成功'));\\\\\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n    console.error('获取配置失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\\\\\n      false,\\\\\\\\n      null,\\\\\\\\n      '获取配置失败',\\\\\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n    ));\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n/**\\\\\\\\n * 切换配置启用状态\\\\\\\\n * PATCH /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/toggle\\\\\\\\n */\\\\\\\\nrouter.patch('/:id/toggle', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\\\\\n    const { isActive } = req.body;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\\\\\\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\\\\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\\\\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\\\\\n      isActive: typeof isActive === 'boolean' ? isActive : !existingConfig.isActive,\\\\\\\\n    };\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '切换状态成功'));\\\\\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\\\\\n    console.error('切换状态失败:', error);\\\\\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\\\\\n      false,\\\\\\\\n      null,\\\\\\\\n      '切换状态失败',\\\\\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\\\\\n    ));\\\\\\\\n  }\\\\\\\\n});\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nexport default router;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\",\\\"\""

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"  \\\"contents\\\": \\\"import express from 'express';\\\\nimport { formatApiResponse, formatValidationErrorResponse } from '../utils/validation';\\\\nimport { publicPageConfigModel, agentWorkflowModel, aiRoleModel } from '../models';\\\\nimport { CreatePublicPageConfigDTO, UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO } from '../models/PublicPageConfig';\\\\n\\\\nconst router = express.Router();\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 获取所有公开页面配置\\\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.get('/', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const configs = await publicPageConfigModel.getAll();\\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, configs, '获取配置列表成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('获取配置列表失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '获取配置列表失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 获取单个配置\\\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.get('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\n    \\\\n    if (!config) {\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, config, '获取配置成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('获取配置失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '获取配置失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 创建公开页面配置\\\\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.post('/', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 验证必填字段\\\\n    if (!name) {\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\n        field: 'name',\\\\n        message: '配置名称不能为空'\\\\n      }]));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 如果没有提供displayMode，使用默认值'role'\\\\n    const finalDisplayMode = displayMode || 'role';\\\\n\\\\n    // 验证显示模式\\\\n    if (finalDisplayMode &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !['all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role'].includes(finalDisplayMode)) {\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\n        field: 'displayMode',\\\\n        message: '显示模式必须是all、workflow、custom或role之一'\\\\n      }]));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 验证workflow模式\\\\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !workflowId) {\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\n        field: 'workflowId',\\\\n        message: '工作流模式下必须提供workflowId'\\\\n      }]));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 验证custom模式\\\\n    if (finalDisplayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; (!roleIds || !Array.isArray(roleIds) || roleIds.length === 0)) {\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\n        field: 'roleIds',\\\\n        message: '自定义模式下必须提供角色ID列表'\\\\n      }]));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 验证role模式（如果没有提供roleIds，使用空数组）\\\\n    // 注意：role模式允许空数组，表示显示所有角色\\\\n    \\\\n    const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\n      name,\\\\n      description,\\\\n      address,\\\\n      displayMode: finalDisplayMode,\\\\n      workflowId,\\\\n      roleIds: roleIds || (finalDisplayMode === 'role' ? [] : undefined),\\\\n      templateType,\\\\n      customHtml,\\\\n      isActive: req.body.isActive, // 支持创建时设置isActive\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    const newConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.create(createData);\\\\n    \\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, newConfig, '创建配置成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('创建配置失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '创建配置失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 更新公开页面配置\\\\n * PUT /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.put('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\n    const { name, description, address, displayMode, workflowId, roleIds, isActive, templateType, customHtml } = req.body;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 验证显示模式\\\\n    if (displayMode &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !['all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role'].includes(displayMode)) {\\\\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\\\\n        field: 'displayMode',\\\\n        message: '显示模式必须是all、workflow、custom或role之一'\\\\n      }]));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const updateData: UpdatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\n      name,\\\\n      description,\\\\n      address,\\\\n      displayMode,\\\\n      workflowId,\\\\n      roleIds,\\\\n      isActive,\\\\n      templateType,\\\\n      customHtml,\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\\\\n    \\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '更新配置成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('更新配置失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '更新配置失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 删除公开页面配置\\\\n * DELETE /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.delete('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 检查配置是否存在\\\\n    const existingConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\n    if (!existingConfig) {\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    await publicPageConfigModel.delete(id);\\\\n    \\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, null, '删除配置成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('删除配置失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '删除配置失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 预览配置（获取角色列表）\\\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id/preview\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.get('/:id/preview', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\\\n    \\\\n    if (!config) {\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    let roles: any[] = [];\\\\n    \\\\n    if (config.displayMode === 'all') {\\\\n      // 获取所有启用的角色\\\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;amp;gt; r.enabled);\\\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.workflowId) {\\\\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\\\\n      const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(config.workflowId);\\\\n      if (workflow) {\\\\n        const workflowNodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\\\n        const agentIds = workflowNodes.map((node: any) =&amp;amp;gt; node.agentId).filter(Boolean);\\\\n        const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\\\n        roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;amp;gt; agentIds.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; r.enabled);\\\\n      }\\\\n    } else if (config.displayMode === 'custom' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.roleIds &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; config.roleIds.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      // 获取指定的角色\\\\n      const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\\\n      roles = allRoles.filter(r =&amp;amp;gt; config.roleIds!.includes(r.id) &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; r.enabled);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, { roles, config }, '获取配置预览成功'));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    console.error('获取配置预览失败:', error);\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n      false,\\\\n      null,\\\\n      '获取配置预览失败',\\\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n    ));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * 导入独立页面配置\\\\n * POST /api/v1/public-page-configs/import-independent-pages\\\\n */\\\\nrouter.post('/import-independent-pages', async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  try {\\\\n    // 获取所有独立页面角色\\\\n    const allRoles = await aiRoleModel.getAll();\\\\n    const independentPageRoles = allRoles.filter(\\\\n      r =&amp;amp;gt; r.source === 'independent-page' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; r.enabled\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    if (independentPageRoles.length === 0) {\\\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(\\\\n        false,\\\\n        null,\\\\n        '未找到独立页面角色，请先初始化独立页面AI角色'\\\\n      ));\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 定义节点映射\\\\n    const nodeMapping: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, { name: string; description: string }&amp;amp;gt; = {\\\\n      'independent-page-ai-search': {\\\\n        name: 'AI问答',\\\\n        description: '智能问答和搜索功能公开页面'\\\\n      },\\\\n      'independent-page-tech-package': {\\\\n        name: '技术包装',\\\\n        description: '技术内容包装工作流公开页面'\\\\n      },\\\\n      'independent-page-tech-strategy': {\\\\n        name: '技术策略',\\\\n        description: '技术策略生成工作流公开页面'\\\\n      },\\\\n      'independent-page-core-draft': {\\\\n        name: '技术通稿',\\\\n        description: '核心内容生成工作流公开页面'\\\\n      },\\\\n      'independent-page-speech': {\\\\n        name: '发布会演讲稿',\\\\n        description: '技术发布内容生成工作流公开页面'\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n\\\\n    const importResults: Array&amp;amp;lt;{ role: any; config: any; status: 'created' | 'exists' | 'error'; error?: string }&amp;amp;gt; = [];\\\\n\\\\n    // 为每个独立页面角色创建公开页面配置\\\\n    for (const role of independentPageRoles) {\\\\n      try {\\\\n        // 检查是否已存在配置（通过名称匹配）\\\\n        const existingConfigs = await publicPageConfigModel.getAll();\\\\n        const existing = existingConfigs.find(\\\\n          c =&amp;amp;gt; c.name === (nodeMapping[role.id]?.name || role.name)\\\\n        );\\\\n\\\\n        if (existing) {\\\\n          importResults.push({\\\\n            role,\\\\n            config: existing,\\\\n            status: 'exists'\\\\n          });\\\\n          continue;\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // 创建新配置\\\\n        const nodeInfo = nodeMapping[role.id] || {\\\\n          name: role.name,\\\\n          description: &amp;amp;#96;${role.description}公开页面&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n        };\\\\n\\\\n        const createData: CreatePublicPageConfigDTO = {\\\\n          name: nodeInfo.name,\\\\n          description: nodeInfo.description,\\\\n          displayMode: 'custom',\\\\n          roleIds: [role.id],\\\\n        };\\\\n\\\\n        const newConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.create(createData);\\\\n        importResults.push({\\\\n          role,\\\\n          config: newConfig,\\\\n          status: 'created'\\\\n        });\\\\n      } catch (error) {\\\\n        importResults.push({\\\\n          role,\\\\n          config: null,\\\\n          status: 'error',\\\\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const createdCount = importResults.filter(r =&amp;amp;gt; **高级Prompt管理**：System Prompt + 动态变量 + 模板\\\\n2. **上下文管理策略**：历史消息窗口、摘要压缩、Token控制\\\\n3. **工具调用能力**：Function Calling集成（搜索、计算、API调用等）\\\\n4. **Agent协作**：调用其他Agent或Workflow\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## 1. 类型定义与数据模型\\\\n\\\\n### Frontend (&amp;amp;#96;frontend/src/types/aiRole.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n扩展 &amp;amp;#96;AIRoleConfig&amp;amp;#96;：\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport interface AIRoleConfig {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  name: string;\\\\n  description: string;\\\\n  avatar?: string;\\\\n  \\\\n  // Provider配置（Dify 或 Direct Agent）\\\\n  provider: &amp;amp;#39;dify&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;direct-agent&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n  \\\\n  // Dify配置（保持现有）\\\\n  difyConfig?: DifyConfig;\\\\n  \\\\n  // Direct Agent配置（新增）\\\\n  agentConfig?: DirectAgentConfig;\\\\n  \\\\n  enabled: boolean;\\\\n  source?: string;\\\\n  createdAt: Date;\\\\n  updatedAt: Date;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nexport interface DirectAgentConfig {\\\\n  // LLM基础配置\\\\n  llm: {\\\\n    provider: &amp;amp;#39;openai&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;azure-openai&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;qwen&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;ernie&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;custom&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n    apiKey: string;\\\\n    apiBaseUrl?: string;  // 自定义端点\\\\n    model: string;        // gpt-4, gpt-3.5-turbo, qwen-max等\\\\n    temperature: number;  // 0-2\\\\n    maxTokens: number;    // 最大生成token数\\\\n    topP?: number;        // 0-1\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // Prompt配置\\\\n  prompt: {\\\\n    systemPrompt: string;           // 系统提示词\\\\n    variables?: PromptVariable[];   // 动态变量\\\\n    templates?: PromptTemplate[];   // 预设模板\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 上下文管理策略\\\\n  contextStrategy: {\\\\n    type: &amp;amp;#39;window&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;summary&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;hybrid&amp;amp;#39;;  // 窗口/摘要/混合\\\\n    maxMessages: number;                     // 最大历史消息数\\\\n    maxTokens: number;                       // 最大上下文token数\\\\n    summaryThreshold?: number;               // 触发摘要的消息数阈值\\\\n    includeSystemPrompt: boolean;            // 是否每次都包含system prompt\\\\n  };\\\\n  \\\\n  // 工具调用配置\\\\n  tools?: ToolConfig[];\\\\n  \\\\n  // Agent协作配置\\\\n  agentCalls?: AgentCallConfig[];\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// Prompt变量定义\\\\nexport interface PromptVariable {\\\\n  name: string;           // 变量名，如 {{user_name}}\\\\n  description: string;    // 变量说明\\\\n  type: &amp;amp;#39;static&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;dynamic&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;context&amp;amp;#39;;  // 静态/动态/上下文\\\\n  value?: string;         // 静态值\\\\n  source?: string;        // 动态来源（如：user.profile.name）\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// Prompt模板\\\\nexport interface PromptTemplate {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  name: string;\\\\n  content: string;\\\\n  variables: string[];    // 需要的变量列表\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// 工具配置\\\\nexport interface ToolConfig {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n &amp;amp;#39;calculation&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;workflow&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;custom&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n  enabled: boolean;\\\\n  parameters: ToolParameter[];  // 参数定义（JSON Schema格式）\\\\n  implementation?: {\\\\n    endpoint?: string;    // API端点\\\\n    method?: string;      // HTTP方法\\\\n    headers?: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, string&amp;amp;gt;;\\\\n    workflowId?: string;  // &amp;amp;#39;boolean&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;array&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;object&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n  description: string;\\\\n  required: boolean;\\\\n  enum?: string[];        // 枚举值\\\\n  default?: any;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// Agent调用配置\\\\nexport interface AgentCallConfig {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  targetAgentId?: string;      // 目标Agent ID\\\\n  targetWorkflowId?: string;   // 目标Workflow inputMapping?: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, string&amp;amp;gt;;   // 输入映射\\\\n  outputMapping?: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, string&amp;amp;gt;;  // 输出映射\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### Backend (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/models/AIRole.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n- 同步更新接口定义\\\\n- &amp;amp;#96;dify_config&amp;amp;#96; 字段改为更通用的 &amp;amp;#96;config&amp;amp;#96; JSON存储\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## 2. 后端核心服务实现\\\\n\\\\n### 2.1 LLM Provider抽象层 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/llm/LLMProvider.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\n// 抽象接口\\\\nexport interface ILLMProvider {\\\\n  chat(messages: ChatMessage[], config: LLMConfig, tools?: Tool[]): Promise&amp;amp;lt;LLMResponse&amp;amp;gt;;\\\\n  testConnection(): Promise&amp;amp;lt;boolean&amp;amp;gt;;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// 统一消息格式\\\\nexport interface ChatMessage {\\\\n  role: &amp;amp;#39;system&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;user&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;assistant&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;tool&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n  content: string;\\\\n  name?: string;        // tool调用时的函数名\\\\n  tool_call_id?: string;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n// 统一响应格式\\\\nexport interface LLMResponse {\\\\n  content: string;\\\\n  toolCalls?: ToolCall[];  // &amp;amp;#39;stop&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;length&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;tool_calls&amp;amp;#39; | &amp;amp;#39;content_filter&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\nexport interface ToolCall {\\\\n  id: string;\\\\n  type: &amp;amp;#39;function&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n  function: {\\\\n    name: string;\\\\n    arguments: string;  // JSON字符串\\\\n  };\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 2.2 具体Provider实现\\\\n\\\\n#### &amp;amp;#96;OpenAIProvider.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- 标准OpenAI API调用\\\\n- 支持Function Calling\\\\n- 错误处理和重试\\\\n\\\\n#### &amp;amp;#96;AzureOpenAIProvider.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- Azure特定的端点格式\\\\n- API版本管理\\\\n\\\\n#### &amp;amp;#96;CustomProvider.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- 通用OpenAI兼容端点\\\\n- 支持国产大模型（通义千问、文心一言等）\\\\n\\\\n### 2.3 上下文管理服务 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ContextManager.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport class ContextManager {\\\\n  // 获取上下文消息\\\\n  async getContextMessages(\\\\n    conversationId: string,\\\\n    strategy: ContextStrategy,\\\\n    currentQuery: string\\\\n  ): Promise&amp;amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const history = await ChatMessageService.getConversationMessages(conversationId);\\\\n    \\\\n    switch (strategy.type) {\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;window&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return this.applyWindowStrategy(history, strategy);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;summary&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.applySummaryStrategy(history, strategy);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;hybrid&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.applyHybridStrategy(history, strategy);\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 窗口策略：保留最近N条消息\\\\n  private applyWindowStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): ChatMessage[] {\\\\n    return history.slice(-strategy.maxMessages).map(toMessage);\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 摘要策略：旧消息压缩为摘要\\\\n  private async applySummaryStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): Promise&amp;amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (history.length &amp;amp;lt;= strategy.summaryThreshold!) {\\\\n      return history.map(toMessage);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    // 将旧消息发送给LLM生成摘要\\\\n    const oldMessages = history.slice(0, -strategy.maxMessages);\\\\n    const summary = await this.generateSummary(oldMessages);\\\\n    const recentMessages = history.slice(-strategy.maxMessages);\\\\n    \\\\n    return [\\\\n      { role: &amp;amp;#39;system&amp;amp;#39;, content: &amp;amp;#96;对话摘要：${summary}&amp;amp;#96; },\\\\n      ...recentMessages.map(toMessage)\\\\n    ];\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 混合策略：结合窗口和摘要\\\\n  private async applyHybridStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): Promise&amp;amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // Token计数 + 智能截断\\\\n    const messages = [];\\\\n    let tokenCount = 0;\\\\n    \\\\n    for (let i = history.length - 1; i &amp;amp;gt;= 0; i--) {\\\\n      const msg = history[i];\\\\n      const msgTokens = this.estimateTokens(msg.content);\\\\n      \\\\n      if (tokenCount + msgTokens &amp;amp;gt; strategy.maxTokens) {\\\\n        // 超过限制，对剩余消息生成摘要\\\\n        if (i &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n          const summary = await this.generateSummary(history.slice(0, i));\\\\n          messages.unshift({ role: &amp;amp;#39;system&amp;amp;#39;, content: &amp;amp;#96;历史摘要：${summary}&amp;amp;#96; });\\\\n        }\\\\n        break;\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      messages.unshift(toMessage(msg));\\\\n      tokenCount += msgTokens;\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    return messages;\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 生成摘要\\\\n  private async generateSummary(messages: any[]): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 调用LLM生成对话摘要\\\\n    // 使用简单的prompt：\\\\&amp;amp;quot;请总结以下对话的关键信息...\\\\&amp;amp;quot;\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // Token估算（简单实现：1 token ≈ 4 chars）\\\\n  private estimateTokens(text: string): number {\\\\n    return Math.ceil(text.length / 4);\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 2.4 Prompt管理服务 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/PromptManager.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport class PromptManager {\\\\n  // 渲染Prompt（替换变量）\\\\n  renderPrompt(\\\\n    template: string,\\\\n    variables: PromptVariable[],\\\\n    context: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, any&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n  ): string {\\\\n    let rendered = template;\\\\n    \\\\n    for (const variable of variables) {\\\\n      const value = this.resolveVariable(variable, context);\\\\n      rendered = rendered.replace(new RegExp(&amp;amp;#96;{{${variable.name}}}&amp;amp;#96;, &amp;amp;#39;g&amp;amp;#39;), value);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    return rendered;\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 解析变量值\\\\n  private resolveVariable(variable: PromptVariable, context: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, any&amp;amp;gt;): string {\\\\n    switch (variable.type) {\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;static&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return variable.value || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;dynamic&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return this.getNestedValue(context, variable.source || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;context&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return context[variable.name] || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n      default:\\\\n        return &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 获取嵌套属性值（如：user.profile.name）\\\\n  private getNestedValue(obj: any, path: string): string {\\\\n    return path.split(&amp;amp;#39;.&amp;amp;#39;).reduce((acc, part) =&amp;amp;gt; acc?.[part], obj) || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 2.5 工具执行服务 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ToolExecutor.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport class ToolExecutor {\\\\n  // 执行工具调用\\\\n  async executeTool(toolCall: ToolCall, toolConfig: ToolConfig): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const args = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments);\\\\n    \\\\n    switch (toolConfig.type) {\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;search&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.executeSearch(args);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;api&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.executeAPI(toolConfig, args);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;workflow&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.executeWorkflow(toolConfig.implementation!.workflowId!, args);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;calculation&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return this.executeCalculation(args);\\\\n      default:\\\\n        throw new Error(&amp;amp;#96;不支持的工具类型: ${toolConfig.type}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 搜索工具\\\\n  private async executeSearch(args: any): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 调用搜索API或知识库\\\\n    // 返回搜索结果\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // API调用工具\\\\n  private async executeAPI(config: ToolConfig, args: any): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const response = await axios({\\\\n      method: config.implementation!.method || &amp;amp;#39;POST&amp;amp;#39;,\\\\n      url: config.implementation!.endpoint!,\\\\n      headers: config.implementation!.headers,\\\\n      data: args\\\\n    });\\\\n    return JSON.stringify(response.data);\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // Workflow调用工具\\\\n  private async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, args: any): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const result = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(workflowId, args);\\\\n    return JSON.stringify(result);\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 计算工具\\\\n  private executeCalculation(args: any): string {\\\\n    // 安全的数学表达式计算\\\\n    // 使用沙箱环境执行\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 2.6 Agent编排服务 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/AgentOrchestrator.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport class AgentOrchestrator {\\\\n  // 执行Agent（核心方法）\\\\n  async executeAgent(\\\\n    roleId: string,\\\\n    query: string,\\\\n    conversationId: string,\\\\n    context: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, any&amp;amp;gt; = {}\\\\n  ): Promise&amp;amp;lt;AgentExecutionResult&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 1. 获取Agent配置\\\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\\\\n    if (!role || !role.agentConfig) {\\\\n      throw new Error(&amp;amp;#39;Agent配置不存在&amp;amp;#39;);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 2. 渲染System Prompt\\\\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\\\\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\\\\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\\\\n      context\\\\n    );\\\\n    \\\\n    // 3. 获取上下文消息\\\\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\\\\n      conversationId,\\\\n      config.contextStrategy,\\\\n      query\\\\n    );\\\\n    \\\\n    // 4. 构建完整消息列表\\\\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [\\\\n      { role: &amp;amp;#39;system&amp;amp;#39;, content: systemPrompt },\\\\n      ...contextMessages,\\\\n      { role: &amp;amp;#39;user&amp;amp;#39;, content: query }\\\\n    ];\\\\n    \\\\n    // 5. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\\\\n    const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 6. 调用LLM\\\\n    const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\\\\n    let response = await provider.chat(messages, config.llm, tools);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 7. 处理工具调用（如果有）\\\\n    while (response.toolCalls &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.toolCalls.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      const toolResults = await this.executeTools(response.toolCalls, config.tools || []);\\\\n      \\\\n      // 将工具调用和结果添加到消息历史\\\\n      messages.push({ role: &amp;amp;#39;assistant&amp;amp;#39;, content: response.content || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39; });\\\\n      for (const result of toolResults) {\\\\n        messages.push({\\\\n          role: &amp;amp;#39;tool&amp;amp;#39;,\\\\n          content: result.content,\\\\n          name: result.toolName,\\\\n          tool_call_id: result.toolCallId\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 再次调用LLM处理工具结果\\\\n      response = await provider.chat(messages, config.llm, tools);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    // 8. 保存消息历史\\\\n    await this.saveMessages(conversationId, query, response, roleId);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 9. 返回结果\\\\n    return {\\\\n      content: response.content,\\\\n      usage: response.usage,\\\\n      conversationId\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 执行多个工具调用\\\\n  private async executeTools(toolCalls: ToolCall[], toolConfigs: ToolConfig[]) {\\\\n    const results = [];\\\\n    for (const toolCall of toolCalls) {\\\\n      const config = toolConfigs.find(t =&amp;amp;gt; t.name === toolCall.function.name);\\\\n      if (!config) {\\\\n        results.push({\\\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\\\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: &amp;amp;#39;工具不存在&amp;amp;#39; })\\\\n        });\\\\n        continue;\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      try {\\\\n        const result = await this.toolExecutor.executeTool(toolCall, config);\\\\n        results.push({\\\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\\\n          content: result\\\\n        });\\\\n      } catch (error) {\\\\n        results.push({\\\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\\\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: error.message })\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    }\\\\n    return results;\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## 3. 前端UI实现\\\\n\\\\n### 3.1 修改 &amp;amp;#96;AIRoleManagementPage.tsx&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n#### Provider选择区\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;tsx\\\\n&amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\&amp;amp;quot;provider-selector\\\\&amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n  &amp;amp;lt;label&amp;amp;gt;Agent类型&amp;amp;lt;/label&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n  &amp;amp;lt;div className=\\\\&amp;amp;quot;radio-group\\\\&amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n    &amp;amp;lt;input type=\\\\&amp;amp;quot;radio\\\\&amp;amp;quot; value=\\\\&amp;amp;quot;dify\\\\&amp;amp;quot; Temperature滑块（0-2）\\\\n- Max Tokens输入框\\\\n\\\\n**Tab 2: Prompt配置**\\\\n- System Prompt多行文本框（支持Markdown）\\\\n- 变量管理：\\\\n  - 添加变量按钮\\\\n  - 变量列表（名称、类型、值/来源）\\\\n  - 变量预览（显示渲染后的Prompt）\\\\n- 添加工具按钮：\\\\n  - 工具类型选择（搜索/API/计算/Workflow）\\\\n  - 工具名称和描述\\\\n  - 参数定义（JSON Schema编辑器）\\\\n  - 实现配置（API端点、Workflow ID等）\\\\n- 启用/禁用工具开关\\\\n\\\\n**Tab 5: Agent协作**\\\\n- Agent调用列表\\\\n- 添加调用按钮：\\\\n  - 目标Agent/Workflow选择\\\\n  - 调用名称和描述\\\\n  - 触发方式（手动/自动）\\\\n  - 输入/输出映射配置\\\\n\\\\n### 3.2 创建独立组件\\\\n\\\\n#### &amp;amp;#96;PromptEditor.tsx&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n- 富文本编辑器\\\\n- 变量插入快捷方式\\\\n- 策略类型切换\\\\n- 参数配置表单\\\\n- 预估Token消耗展示\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## 4. 路由修改\\\\n\\\\n### &amp;amp;#96;backend/src/routes/aiRole.ts&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n修改 &amp;amp;#96;POST /:id/chat&amp;amp;#96; 端点：\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nrouter.post(&amp;amp;#39;/:id/chat&amp;amp;#39;, async (req, res) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const { id } = req.params;\\\\n  const { query, conversationId = &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;, context = {} } = req.body;\\\\n  \\\\n  const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(id);\\\\n  if (!role || !role.enabled) {\\\\n    return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, &amp;amp;#39;AI角色不存在或已禁用&amp;amp;#39;));\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  try {\\\\n    let result;\\\\n    \\\\n    if (role.provider === res.json(formatApiResponse(true, result, &amp;amp;#39;对话成功&amp;amp;#39;));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, &amp;amp;#39;对话失败&amp;amp;#39;, error.message));\\\\n  }\\\\n});\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## 5. 预设工具库\\\\n\\\\n### 内置工具实现\\\\n\\\\n#### 1. **搜索工具** (&amp;amp;#96;search&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n- 调用现有的AI Search功能\\\\n- 参数：&amp;amp;#96;query&amp;amp;#96;, &amp;amp;#96;limit&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n#### 2. **计算工具** (&amp;amp;#96;calculate&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n- 安全的数学表达式计算\\\\n- 参数：&amp;amp;#96;expression&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n#### 3. **Workflow调用工具** (&amp;amp;#96;call_workflow&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n- 调用指定的Agent Workflow\\\\n- 参数：&amp;amp;#96;workflow_id&amp;amp;#96;, (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/llm/LLMProvider.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\n// 抽象接口\\\\nexport interface ILLMProvider {\\\\n  chat(messages: 支持国产大模型（通义千问、文心一言等）\\\\n\\\\n### 2.3 上下文管理服务 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ContextManager.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport class ContextManager {\\\\n  // 获取上下文消息\\\\n  async getContextMessages(\\\\n    conversationId: string,\\\\n    strategy: ContextStrategy,\\\\n    currentQuery: string\\\\n  ): Promise&amp;amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const history = await ChatMessageService.getConversationMessages(conversationId);\\\\n    \\\\n    switch (strategy.type) {\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;window&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return this.applyWindowStrategy(history, strategy);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;summary&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.applySummaryStrategy(history, strategy);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;hybrid&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.applyHybridStrategy(history, strategy);\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 窗口策略：保留最近N条消息\\\\n  private applyWindowStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): ChatMessage[] {\\\\n    return history.slice(-strategy.maxMessages).map(toMessage);\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 摘要策略：旧消息压缩为摘要\\\\n  private async applySummaryStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): Promise&amp;amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (history.length &amp;amp;lt;= strategy.summaryThreshold!) {\\\\n      return history.map(toMessage);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    // 将旧消息发送给LLM生成摘要\\\\n    const oldMessages = history.slice(0, -strategy.maxMessages);\\\\n    const summary = await this.generateSummary(oldMessages);\\\\n    const recentMessages = history.slice(-strategy.maxMessages);\\\\n    \\\\n    return [\\\\n      { role: &amp;amp;#39;system&amp;amp;#39;, content: &amp;amp;#96;对话摘要：${summary}&amp;amp;#96; },\\\\n      ...recentMessages.map(toMessage)\\\\n    ];\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 混合策略：结合窗口和摘要\\\\n  private async applyHybridStrategy(history: any[], strategy: ContextStrategy): Promise&amp;amp;lt;ChatMessage[]&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // Token计数 + 智能截断\\\\n    const messages = [];\\\\n    let tokenCount = 0;\\\\n    \\\\n    for (let i = history.length - 1; i &amp;amp;gt;= 0; i--) {\\\\n      const msg = history[i];\\\\n      const msgTokens = this.estimateTokens(msg.content);\\\\n      \\\\n      if (tokenCount + msgTokens &amp;amp;gt; strategy.maxTokens) {\\\\n        // 超过限制，对剩余消息生成摘要\\\\n        if (i &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n          const summary = await this.generateSummary(history.slice(0, i));\\\\n          messages.unshift({ role: &amp;amp;#39;system&amp;amp;#39;, content: &amp;amp;#96;历史摘要：${summary}&amp;amp;#96; });\\\\n        }\\\\n        break;\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      messages.unshift(toMessage(msg));\\\\n      tokenCount += msgTokens;\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    return messages;\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 生成摘要\\\\n  private async generateSummary(messages: any[]): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 调用LLM生成对话摘要\\\\n    // 使用简单的prompt：\\\\&amp;amp;quot;请总结以下对话的关键信息...\\\\&amp;amp;quot;\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // Token估算（简单实现：1 token ≈ 4 chars）\\\\n  private estimateTokens(text: string): number {\\\\n    return Math.ceil(text.length / 4);\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 2.4 Prompt管理服务 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/PromptManager.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport class PromptManager {\\\\n  // 渲染Prompt（替换变量）\\\\n  renderPrompt(\\\\n    template: string,\\\\n    variables: PromptVariable[],\\\\n    context: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, any&amp;amp;gt;\\\\n  ): string {\\\\n    let rendered = template;\\\\n    \\\\n    for (const variable of variables) {\\\\n      const value = this.resolveVariable(variable, context);\\\\n      rendered = rendered.replace(new RegExp(&amp;amp;#96;{{${variable.name}}}&amp;amp;#96;, &amp;amp;#39;g&amp;amp;#39;), value);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    return rendered;\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 解析变量值\\\\n  private resolveVariable(variable: PromptVariable, context: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, any&amp;amp;gt;): string {\\\\n    switch (variable.type) {\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;static&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return variable.value || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;dynamic&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return this.getNestedValue(context, variable.source || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;context&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return context[variable.name] || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n      default:\\\\n        return &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 获取嵌套属性值（如：user.profile.name）\\\\n  private getNestedValue(obj: any, path: string): string {\\\\n    return path.split(&amp;amp;#39;.&amp;amp;#39;).reduce((acc, part) =&amp;amp;gt; acc?.[part], obj) || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;;\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 2.5 工具执行服务 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/ToolExecutor.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport class ToolExecutor {\\\\n  // 执行工具调用\\\\n  async executeTool(toolCall: ToolCall, toolConfig: ToolConfig): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const args = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments);\\\\n    \\\\n    switch (toolConfig.type) {\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;search&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.executeSearch(args);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;api&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.executeAPI(toolConfig, args);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;workflow&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return await this.executeWorkflow(toolConfig.implementation!.workflowId!, args);\\\\n      case &amp;amp;#39;calculation&amp;amp;#39;:\\\\n        return this.executeCalculation(args);\\\\n      default:\\\\n        throw new Error(&amp;amp;#96;不支持的工具类型: ${toolConfig.type}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n    }\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 搜索工具\\\\n  private async executeSearch(args: any): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 调用搜索API或知识库\\\\n    // 返回搜索结果\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // API调用工具\\\\n  private async executeAPI(config: ToolConfig, args: any): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const response = await axios({\\\\n      method: config.implementation!.method || &amp;amp;#39;POST&amp;amp;#39;,\\\\n      url: config.implementation!.endpoint!,\\\\n      headers: config.implementation!.headers,\\\\n      data: args\\\\n    });\\\\n    return JSON.stringify(response.data);\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // Workflow调用工具\\\\n  private async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, args: any): Promise&amp;amp;lt;string&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const result = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(workflowId, args);\\\\n    return JSON.stringify(result);\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 计算工具\\\\n  private executeCalculation(args: any): string {\\\\n    // 安全的数学表达式计算\\\\n    // 使用沙箱环境执行\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n### 2.6 Agent编排服务 (&amp;amp;#96;backend/src/services/agent/AgentOrchestrator.ts&amp;amp;#96;)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\nexport class AgentOrchestrator {\\\\n  // 执行Agent（核心方法）\\\\n  async executeAgent(\\\\n    roleId: string,\\\\n    query: string,\\\\n    conversationId: string,\\\\n    context: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, any&amp;amp;gt; = {}\\\\n  ): Promise&amp;amp;lt;AgentExecutionResult&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 1. 获取Agent配置\\\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\\\\n    if (!role || !role.agentConfig) {\\\\n      throw new Error(&amp;amp;#39;Agent配置不存在&amp;amp;#39;);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\\\\n    \\\\n    // 2. 渲染System Prompt\\\\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\\\\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\\\\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\\\\n      context\\\\n    );\\\\n    \\\\n    // 3. 获取上下文消息\\\\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\\\\n      conversationId,\\\\n      config.contextStrategy,\\\\n      query\\\\n    );\\\\n    \\\\n    // 4. 构建完整消息列表\\\\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [\\\\n      { role: &amp;amp;#39;system&amp;amp;#39;, content: systemPrompt },\\\\n      ...contextMessages,\\\\n      { role: &amp;amp;#39;user&amp;amp;#39;, content: query }\\\\n    ];\\\\n    \\\\n    // 5. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\\\\n    const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 6. 调用LLM\\\\n    const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\\\\n    let response = await provider.chat(messages, config.llm, tools);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 7. 处理工具调用（如果有）\\\\n    while (response.toolCalls &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.toolCalls.length &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      const toolResults = await this.executeTools(response.toolCalls, config.tools || []);\\\\n      \\\\n      // 将工具调用和结果添加到消息历史\\\\n      messages.push({ role: &amp;amp;#39;assistant&amp;amp;#39;, content: response.content || &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39; });\\\\n      for (const result of toolResults) {\\\\n        messages.push({\\\\n          role: &amp;amp;#39;tool&amp;amp;#39;,\\\\n          content: result.content,\\\\n          name: result.toolName,\\\\n          tool_call_id: result.toolCallId\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 再次调用LLM处理工具结果\\\\n      response = await provider.chat(messages, config.llm, tools);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    // 8. 保存消息历史\\\\n    await this.saveMessages(conversationId, query, response, roleId);\\\\n    \\\\n    // 9. 返回结果\\\\n    return {\\\\n      content: response.content,\\\\n      usage: response.usage,\\\\n      conversationId\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n  \\\\n  // 执行多个工具调用\\\\n  private async executeTools(toolCalls: ToolCall[], toolConfigs: ToolConfig[]) {\\\\n    const results = [];\\\\n    for (const toolCall of toolCalls) {\\\\n      const config = toolConfigs.find(t =&amp;amp;gt; t.name === toolCall.function.name);\\\\n      if (!config) {\\\\n        results.push({\\\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\\\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: &amp;amp;#39;工具不存在&amp;amp;#39; })\\\\n        });\\\\n        continue;\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      try {\\\\n        const result = await this.toolExecutor.executeTool(toolCall, config);\\\\n        results.push({\\\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\\\n          content: result\\\\n        });\\\\n      } catch (error) {\\\\n        results.push({\\\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\\\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: error.message })\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n    }\\\\n    return results;\\\\n  }\\\\n}\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## 3. query, conversationId = &amp;amp;#39;&amp;amp;#39;, context = {} } = req.body;\\\\n  \\\\n  const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(id);\\\\n  if (!role || !role.enabled) {\\\\n    return res.json(formatApiResponse(true, result, &amp;amp;#39;对话成功&amp;amp;#39;));\\\\n  } catch (error) {\\\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, &amp;amp;#39;对话失败&amp;amp;#39;, isActive : !existingConfig.isActive,\\n    };\\n\\n    console.log(&amp;#96;[API] 更新数据: isActive=${updateData.isActive}&amp;#96;);\\n\\n    const updatedConfig = await publicPageConfigModel.update(id, updateData);\\n\\n    console.log(&amp;#96;[API] 配置状态已更新: id=${id}, isActive=${updatedConfig.isActive}&amp;#96;);\\n\\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, updatedConfig, '切换状态成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('[API] 切换状态失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '切换状态失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\\n    ));\\n  }\\n});\\n\\n/**\\n * 获取单个配置\\n * GET /api/v1/public-page-configs/:id\\n */\\nrouter.get('/:id', async (req, res) =&amp;gt; {\\n  try {\\n    const { id } = req.params;\\n    const config = await publicPageConfigModel.getById(id);\\n    \\n    if (!config) {\\n      return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '配置不存在'));\\n    }\\n    \\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, config, '获取配置成功'));\\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.error('获取配置失败:', error);\\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\\n      false,\\n      null,\\n      '获取配置失败',\\n      error instanceof Error ?                   "lineNumber": 26650,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class AgentWorkflowService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行工作流（异步）\\n   */\\n  async executeWorkflow(\\n    workflowId: string,\\n    options: any\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;{ executionId: string; message: string; data?: any }&amp;gt; {\\n    // 获取工作流定义\\n    const workflow = await agentWorkflowModel.getById(workflowId);\\n    if (!workflow) {\\n      throw new Error('工作流不存在');\\n    }\\n\\n    const startedAt = Date.now();\\n    // 创建执行实例\\n    const execution = await workflowExecutionModel.create({\\n      execution_type: 'agent_workflow',\\n      workflow_id: workflowId,\\n      workflow_name: workflow.name,\\n      status: 'running',\\n      shared_context: options.input || {},\\n      node_results: [],\\n      start_time: new Date().toISOString(),\\n    });\\n\\n    try {\\n      // 解析工作流节点和边\\n      const nodes = JSON.parse(workflow.nodes);\\n      const edges = JSON.parse(workflow.edges || '[]');\\n\\n      logger.info('开始执行工作流', {\\n        workflowId,\\n        workflowName: workflow.name,\\n        nodesCount: nodes.length,\\n        edgesCount: edges.length,\\n        nodeTypes: nodes.map((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type),\\n        agentNodes: nodes.filter((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'agent').map((n: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n          id: n.id,\\n          agentId: n.agentId || n.data?.agentId,\\n          hasData: !!n.data,\\n        })),\\n        outputNodes: nodes.filter((n: any) =&amp;gt; n.type === 'output').map((n: any) =&amp;gt; ({\\n          id: n.id,\\n          outputs: n.data?.outputs,\\n        })),\\n      });\\n\\n      // 检查是否有配置的Agent节点\\n      const hasConfiguredAgent = this.workflowHasConfiguredAgent(workflow);\\n      logger.info('检查Agent节点配置', {\\n        workflowId,\\n        hasConfiguredAgent,\\n      });\\n      \\n      if (!hasConfiguredAgent) {\\n        const fallbackOutput = this.buildFallbackOutput;\\n  }\\n}\","

error.message : String(error)}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    return {\\n      isValid: errors.length === 0,\\n      errors,\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 检查是否有环\\n   */\\n  private hasCycle(nodes: any[], edges: any[]): boolean {\\n    const visited = new Set&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;();\\n  }\\n}\","
